name: Geryon (Summoner Variant)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +10, Con +13, Wis +10, Cha +13. Skills Deception +13, Intimidation +13, Perception +10. Senses: truesight 120 ft.. Languages: all, telepathy 120 ft.. Resists: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered. Damage immunities: cold, fire, poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned. Passive Perception 20.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). The creature can turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Regain 20 HP at each turn start unless radiant damage suppressed it for that turn. Geryon dies only if starting a turn at 0 HP without regenerating.
Magic Weapons. Geryon's weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one attack with Claws and one with Stinger.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +16, reach 15 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing. A Large or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 24) and Restrained while held. Geryon can hold one creature at a time. A target already held takes 27 (6d8) extra slashing damage.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack +16, reach 20 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (2d4 + 9) piercing. Failure on a DC 21 Constitution save adds 13 (2d12) poison and makes the target Poisoned until it finishes a short or long rest. Reduce its maximum HP by half the poison damage taken until this condition ends. It dies if the reduction reaches 0 maximum HP.
Teleport. Move with gear up to 120 ft. to a visible empty space.
Sound the Horn (1/day). Choose empty spaces within 600 ft. for 5d4 Minotaurs. The enslaved minotaurs roll initiative as they appear. Each remains until it dies or he dismisses any or all of them as an action.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Spend up to three legendary actions, one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Infernal Glare. One visible creature within 60 ft. that can see Geryon makes a DC 23 Wisdom save or is Frightened of Geryon until its next turn ends.
Teleport. Use Teleport.
Swift Sting (2 actions). Make one Stinger attack.
sections.Lair Actions:
Act on initiative 20, losing ties. Choose one of the following, with no repeat in consecutive rounds.
Banish. Cast Banishment.
Chill Blast. A 10-ft. cube centered on a visible point within 120 ft. forces each creature in it to pass a DC 21 Constitution save or take 28 (8d6) cold damage.
Hateful Restraints. A visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 21 Wisdom save or is Restrained for 1 minute. It can end this effect on itself by damaging an ally.
sections.Regional Effects: Within 1 mile, one or more effects apply. Freezing strong winds howl. Howls and screams fill the air. A creature finishing a short or long rest makes a DC 21 Wisdom save or gains no benefit. Sapient creatures see portals to apparently safe places, but every portal delivers travelers to Stygia. The effects dissipate 1d10 days after Geryon dies.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 21, no material components.
At will · Alter Self (may appear Medium), Detect Magic, Geas, Ice Storm, Invisibility (self only), Locate Object, Suggestion, Wall of Ice.
1/day each · Divine Word, Symbol (pain only).

Wolf Bite. Melee weapon attack +16, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) piercing.
Snakebite. Melee weapon attack +16, reach 15 ft. Hit: 12 (1d6 + 9) piercing. A failed DC 22 Constitution save reduces the target's maximum HP by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. If its maximum HP reaches 0, it becomes a Manes. Only Wish can undo the transformation.
Summon Demon (1/day). There is a 50% chance to summon either 1d6 Babaus, 1d4 Chasmes or one Marilith, as chosen by the molydeus. The demons appear in open spaces within 60 ft., fight as allies, and cannot summon other demons. Each remains for 1 minute or until it or the molydeus dies or the molydeus dismisses it as an action.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Spend up to three legendary actions, one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Attack. Make one Demonic Weapon or Snakebite attack.

Cast a Spell. Cast one spell from Innate Spellcasting.

Charisma, save DC 22, no material components.
At will · Dispel Magic, Polymorph, Telekinesis, Teleport.

It repeats the save each time it takes damage. Successfully resisting gives immunity to this charm for 24 hours.

sections.Traits:
Ooze Cube. The cube fills its space. A creature entering it is subjected to Engulf with Disadvantage. Creatures inside are visible but have total cover. A creature within 5 ft. can use an action to pull an object or creature free with a DC 12 Strength check and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage when attempting it. Transparent. A stationary cube that has not attacked needs a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot. Anyone entering its space unaware is Surprised.
Enlarged. Advantage on Strength checks and saves. Removing the glass-coated duergar skull shrinks it from 30 ft. to 10 ft. per side. Excess occupants are expelled into empty spaces. The normal cube holds one Large or four Medium or smaller creatures.

Engulf. Move up to speed through spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On success, it can move 5 ft. back or to either side, or choose to fail. Failure deals 10 (3d6) acid and engulfs the creature. It cannot breathe, is Restrained, moves with the cube and takes 21 (6d6) acid at the start of each of the cube's turns. 18th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks.

sections.Actions: The published profile has no effective attack. In combat, the sheep can use ordinary actions such as Dash, Disengage or Dodge.
sections.Good Mead encounter: In Rime of the Frostmaiden, six sheep and seven goats are kept in the Firelit Cave. A character in a position to threaten the livestock can use an action to make a DC 10 Charisma (Intimidation) check. On success the verbeeg stops fighting and calls off the ogre and bear. It lets the party leave if the animals are left unharmed in the pen.

reusedIn: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

ruleNotes: Rules source: Storm King's Thunder, p. 142. Rime of the Frostmaiden, p. 76, uses the same sheep profile.

printing.publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden

sections.Traits:
Chromatic Form. A black dragon shaped its acid breath into this elemental. The form determines its resistance and Slam damage.
Putrid Aura. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the elemental must make a DC 15 Constitution save or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn. A creature touching the elemental or hitting it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 11 (2d10) acid damage.
sections.Encounter use: Chromatic dragons create animated breaths to guard their hoards or search the area around their lairs for treasure.

name: Abominable Yeti (Allowak variant)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Skills Perception +5, Stealth +4. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Damage immunities: cold. Passive Perception 15. Languages: Common, Yeti (speaks, reads, and writes both).

sections.Traits:
Fear of Fire. After taking fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Keen Smell. It has Advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.
Snow Camouflage. It has Advantage on Stealth checks to hide in snow.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The yeti may also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing plus 7 (2d6) cold.
Chilling Gaze. Choose one creature within 30 ft. that the yeti can see and that can see the yeti. A creature immune to cold is unaffected. Otherwise, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution save against the magic or take 21 (6d6) cold damage and become Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect makes that creature immune to this abominable yeti's gaze for 1 hour.
Cold Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 45 (10d8) cold damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Encounter: Brightheart, the abominable yeti who leads Allowak’s Sanctuary, guards the location of the sanctuary on Eiselcross.

appearance: An enormous, shaggy white yeti with a powerful frame and watchful eyes.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, p. 126.

name: Husk Zombie Burster
otherStatistics: Saves Con +5, Wis +0. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Damage immunities: poison. Condition immunities: poisoned. Passive Perception 8. Languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak.

sections.Traits:
Curse of the Husk. A humanoid slain by a melee attack from this creature rises as a Husk Zombie on its next turn.
Undead Fortitude. Damage that would reduce the husk to 0 HP instead leaves it at 1 HP on a successful Constitution save (DC 5 + damage taken). Radiant damage and critical hits bypass this save.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. Each of those attacks that reduces a creature to 0 HP grants one additional Claw attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing.
Burst. The burster destroys itself. Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid killed by Burst rises as a Husk Zombie 1 minute later.
sections.Encounter: The Calamity left roaming husks in the wastes of Eastern Wynandir. Use the burster among other husks and let it close into melee before it detonates.

appearance: A bloated humanoid husk with an unnaturally swollen torso.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, p. 293.

name: Lacedon
otherStatistics: Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Damage immunities: poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, poisoned. Passive Perception 10. Languages: Common.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +2, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing. A creature struck must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or become Paralyzed for 1 minute. Elves and undead ignore this effect. A paralyzed target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Encounter: In Unwelcome Spirits, 2d4 goblinoid lacedons hunt in Brokenveil Marsh. A character with passive Perception 12 or higher hears and smells them approaching. There is a 20% chance the group includes one or two recently turned Fort Venture guards.

appearance: A waterlogged, aquatic ghoul with long claws and a gaunt goblinoid silhouette.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, p. 254, Unwelcome Spirits, Brokenveil Marsh Encounters. Base rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 148.

name: Sahuagin Warlock of Uk'otoa (variant)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Skills Arcana +1, Persuasion +5. Senses: darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages: Common, Sahuagin.

sections.Traits:
Blood Frenzy. Advantage on melee attack rolls against a creature missing any HP.
Limited Amphibiousness. It breathes air and water, but must immerse itself at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.
Shark Telepathy. It can magically command any shark within 120 ft. through limited telepathy.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 13, +5 to hit with spell attacks, no material components.
At will · Eldritch Blast, Minor Illusion.
1/day each · Armor of Agathys, Arms of Hadar, Counterspell, Crown of Madness, Invisibility, Hunger of Hadar.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Sword of Fathoms attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing.
Sword of Fathoms. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing. A creature struck must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or choke and become Incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
Eldritch Blast (cantrip). Ranged spell attack +5, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d10) force.
sections.Reactions: Retribution (3/day). While holding its Rod of Retribution, the warlock can react when a creature it can see within 60 ft. damages it. That creature makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 11 (2d10) lightning on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Encounter: These followers of Uk’otoa move through the Lucidian Ocean and along the Menagerie Coast. The warlock can command sharks nearby and retaliate against an attacker while holding its rod.

appearance: A scaled sahuagin with fins, a Sword of Fathoms, and a Rod of Retribution.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, p. 297.

name: Yeti (Allowak variant)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Skills Perception +3, Stealth +3. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Damage immunities: cold. Passive Perception 13. Languages: Common, Yeti (speaks, reads, and writes both).

sections.Traits:
Fear of Fire. After taking fire damage, the yeti has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Keen Smell. It has Advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.
Snow Camouflage. It has Advantage on Stealth checks to hide in snow.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. The yeti may also use Chilling Gaze.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing plus 3 (1d6) cold.
Chilling Gaze. Choose one creature within 30 ft. that the yeti can see and that can see the yeti. A creature immune to cold is unaffected. Otherwise, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save against the magic or take 10 (3d6) cold damage and become Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save or the end of the effect makes that creature immune to ordinary yetis’ gazes for 1 hour.
sections.Encounter: On Eiselcross, 2d4 yetis from Allowak’s Sanctuary try to frighten the party away without harming them. In the Hurt Yeti encounter, Dawnmind begins with 1 hit point.

ruleNotes: Rules source: Explorer's Guide to Wildemount, p. 126.

name: Gazer Familiar
otherStatistics: Saves Wis +2. Skills Perception +4, Stealth +5. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Condition immunities: prone. Passive Perception 14. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Mimicry. The gazer imitates simple speech sounds it has heard in any language. A listener identifies the imitation with a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Familiar. The gazer can form a telepathic bond with a willing master who is at least a 3rd-level spellcaster. The master can perceive through the gazer's senses while they are within 1 mile of each other. If the master physically harms the gazer, it ends its service and breaks the bond.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage.
Eye Rays. Randomly select two different rays and direct them at one or two targets the gazer can see within 60 ft.
1 · Dazing Ray. The target makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure it is Charmed until the start of the gazer's next turn, with half speed and Disadvantage on attack rolls.
2 · Fear Ray. The target makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened until the start of the gazer's next turn.
3 · Frost Ray. The target makes a DC 12 Dexterity save or takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.
4 · Telekinetic Ray. A Medium or smaller creature makes a DC 12 Strength save or moves up to 30 ft. directly away from the gazer. The gazer can move an object weighing 10 pounds or less that nobody is wearing or carrying up to 30 ft. in any direction. It can also use the ray for fine work such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a container.
sections.Bonus Actions: Aggressive. Move up to the gazer's speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Encounter: A spellcaster can keep a gazer as a familiar and use its senses to watch a nearby passage. A gazer may imitate speech it overhears. Its master needs to rein it in around small creatures.

appearance: A floating sphere with one large central eye, four small eyestalks, and sharp teeth.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 126.

name: Guard Drake
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Skills Perception +2. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages: understands Draconic but can't speak it.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Chromatic variants:
Black Guard Drake. Acid resistance, swim 30 ft., Amphibious.
Blue Guard Drake. Lightning resistance, burrow 20 ft.
Green Guard Drake. Poison resistance, swim 30 ft., Amphibious.
Red Guard Drake. Fire resistance, climb 30 ft.
White Guard Drake. Cold resistance, burrow 20 ft., climb 30 ft.
If you use a color variant, add only its listed traits. Amphibious drakes can breathe both air and water.
sections.Encounter: A trained drake guards a dragon's hoard, a stronghold or another site its handlers want protected. Its scales reflect the dragon used to create it.

appearance: A muscular, wingless dragon with armored scales, a blunt head, and a heavy tail.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 158.

name: Mind Flayer Lich (Illithilich)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +10, Int +12, Wis +9. Skills Arcana +19, History +12, Insight +9, Perception +9. Senses: truesight 120 ft. Damage resistances: cold, lightning, necrotic. Damage immunities: poison, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned. Passive Perception 19. Languages: Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). If it fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Rejuvenation. If the phylactery survives, the destroyed lich returns in 1d10 days with full HP in a new body within 5 ft. of the phylactery.
Turn Resistance. Advantage on saves against effects that turn undead.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Psionics. Intelligence, save DC 20. No components.
At will · Detect Thoughts, Levitate.
1/day each · Dominate Monster, Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Spellcasting:
18th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will) · Mage Hand, Prestidigitation, Ray of Frost.
1st level (4 slots) · Detect Magic, Magic Missile, Shield, Thunderwave.
2nd level (3 slots) · Detect Thoughts, Invisibility, Melf's Acid Arrow, Mirror Image.
3rd level (3 slots) · Animate Dead, Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Fireball.
4th level (3 slots) · Blight, Dimension Door.
5th level (3 slots) · Cloudkill, Scrying.
6th level (1 slot) · Disintegrate, Globe of Invulnerability.
7th level (1 slot) · Finger of Death, Plane Shift.
8th level (1 slot) · Dominate Monster, Power Word Stun.
9th level (1 slot) · Power Word Kill.
sections.Actions:
Paralyzing Touch. Melee spell attack +12, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution save or becomes Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is Grappled (escape DC 15) and must make a DC 20 Intelligence save or become Stunned until the grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 5 ft., one Incapacitated humanoid Grappled by the lich. Hit 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If that drops the target to 0 HP, the lich kills it by removing and devouring its brain.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Intelligence save. On a failure it takes 27 (5d8 + 5) psychic damage and becomes Stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The lich has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. It uses at most one option at the end of another creature's turn.
Tentacles (1 action). Make one Tentacles attack.
Extract Brain (2 actions). Use Extract Brain.
Mind Blast (3 actions). Recharge Mind Blast immediately and use it.
Cast Spell (1–3 actions). Cast a prepared spell of 1st through 3rd level, spending the spell slot and one legendary action per level of the spell.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect. The same effect cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Recover a slot. Roll 1d8 and recover one spent spell slot of that level or lower. With no eligible slot, nothing happens.
Negative energy tether. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. Whenever the lich takes damage, the creature makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure the lich takes half the damage, rounded down, and the creature takes the rest. The tether ends on initiative count 20 next round or when either creature leaves the lair.
Spirits of the dead. Apparitions strike one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 52 (15d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The apparitions then vanish.

appearance: A mummified mind flayer with a gaunt, tentacled face and decaying wizard robes.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, p. 172. Base Lich and lair rules from Monster Manual (2014), pp. 202–203.
The illithilich feeds souls to its phylactery to retain its tentacle strength and ability to extract brains.

name: Shadow (Variant)
otherStatistics: Skills Stealth +4. Senses: darkvision 60 ft. Damage resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunities: necrotic, poison. Damage vulnerabilities: radiant. Condition immunities: exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained. Passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The shadow moves through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Shadow Stealth. Its Stealth bonus is +6 in dim light or darkness, where it can Hide as a bonus action.
Sunlight Weakness. In sunlight it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
sections.Actions: Strength Drain. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage and reduce the target's Strength score by 1d4. At Strength 0, the target falls Unconscious. After a short or long rest, the target recovers the lost Strength and any consciousness lost this way.
sections.Carnival thief actions:
Gleam's shadow has the following options while acting as Endelyn Moongrave's carnival thief.
No Ticket. Choose a visible carnival guest within 5 ft. A guest without a ticket must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or become Stunned for 1 minute, with no memory of events while stunned this way. The guest repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A successful save grants 24 hours of immunity to this particular thief's No Ticket.
Sticky Fingers. Choose a visible Stunned creature within 5 ft. Steal one item weighing 10 pounds or less. The stolen item vanishes and reappears in Endelyn's space.
sections.Encounters: Gleam's shadow slips through the Hall of Illusions to prey on ticketless visitors. At Motherhorn's shadow theater, eleven detached shadows are Invisible while hidden in shadows cast by wooden silhouettes. Moving the silhouettes exposes the shadows. A detached shadow destroyed there rejoins its owner.

appearance: A detached silhouette. Gleam’s shadow has pointed ears, a crescent moon mask, and the stance of an acrobat.
ruleNotes: Rules source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 30, 159, and 213.

name: Will-o’-Wisp (Variant)
otherStatistics: Senses: darkvision 120 ft. Damage resistances: acid, cold, fire, necrotic, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunities: lightning, poison. Condition immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious. Passive Perception 12. Languages: the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Ephemeral. The wisp cannot wear or carry anything.
Incorporeal Movement. It can move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Variable Illumination. It sheds bright light in a radius of 5 to 20 ft. and dim light for the same distance beyond that. It can change the radius as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Shock. Melee spell attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
Invisibility. The wisp and its light become Invisible until it attacks, uses Consume Life, or loses Concentration as though concentrating on a spell.
Magic Boon (recharges after a long rest). Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. other than an Undead. Within 24 hours, that creature can roll a d4 and add it to one of its ability checks, attack rolls, or saves. A creature can carry only one of these boons at a time.
sections.Bonus Actions: Consume Life. Choose one visible creature within 5 ft. that is alive at 0 HP. It makes a DC 10 Constitution save against this magic or dies. If it dies, the wisp regains 10 (3d6) HP.
sections.Encounter: Each O'-well in Hither shelters 1d4 spirits of creatures drowned when Bavlorna flooded the realm. They remain within a few hundred yards of their well. They grant their boon to visitors who promise to oppose Bavlorna.

appearance: A hovering orb of spectral light above a stone well in the marsh.
ruleNotes: Rules source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 61–62.

name: Witchlight Hand
classification: Small or Medium Humanoid, any alignment
otherStatistics: Skills Sleight Of Hand +6. Passive Perception 11. Languages: Common plus any one language.

sections.Traits: Secret Expertise. Choose one extra skill for the hand from Acrobatics +6, Animal Handling +5, Arcana +5, Athletics +4, Medicine +5, or Performance +5.
sections.Size and hit points: A Medium hand has 9 HP (2d8). A Small hand has 7 HP (2d6). Both have a speed of 30 ft.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Pixie Dust (1/day). The hand sprinkles dust on itself or another visible creature within 5 ft. The recipient gains a fly speed of 30 ft. for 1 minute. If still airborne when it ends, the recipient drops safely and lands on its feet.
Spellcasting. The hand uses Charisma to cast Dancing Lights, Message, or Prestidigitation at will.
sections.Encounters: The carnival's hands run stalls, repair equipment, and tend animals. Staff wear imitation butterfly wings on duty. If guests are caught fighting or stealing, 1d6 chaotic good hands escort them out and the carnival's mood drops by one step.

appearance: Carnival workers wear artificial butterfly wings with their working clothes or stage costumes.
ruleNotes: Rules source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 27.

name: Inspired (Hashalaq variant)
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saves Int +5, Wis +2. Skills Deception +7, Insight +2, Persuasion +7. Psychic resistance. Condition immunities: charmed, frightened. Passive Perception 10. Languages: Common, Quori.

sections.Traits: Dual Mind. The Inspired has Advantage on Wisdom saves.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Intelligence, save DC 13. These spells require no material components.
At will · Mage Hand, Vicious Mockery.
1/day each · Charm Person, Dissonant Whispers, Hex, Hold Person, Mage Armor.
3/day · Suggestion (save DC 13).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Crysteel Dagger attacks. The Inspired can use Vicious Mockery in place of one attack.
Crysteel Dagger. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 10 (3d6) force damage.
Vicious Mockery (cantrip). Choose a creature the Inspired can see within 60 ft. If the target can hear the Inspired, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or take 2 (1d4) psychic damage and have Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
sections.Quori Vessel: The variant's extra abilities apply while the quori possesses the Inspired. The quori gains access to the host's knowledge and features. The humans bred as vessels in Sarlona cannot resist that possession. Elsewhere, a dreaming humanoid can agree to become a vessel.
sections.Encounter: A Hashalaq can steer a conversation through Suggestion. A vessel can pass as a diplomat or courtier while pursuing the Dreaming Dark’s plans.

publication: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
appearance: An elegant, human quori vessel carrying a crysteel dagger.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Eberron: Rising from the Last War, p. 294.

Eberron: Rising from the Last War

Vicious Mockery (cantrip). Choose a creature the Inspired can see within 60 ft. If the target can hear the Inspired, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or take 2 (1d4) psychic damage and have Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
sections.Quori Vessel: The variant's extra abilities apply while the quori possesses the Inspired. The quori gains access to the host's knowledge and features. The humans bred as vessels in Sarlona cannot resist that possession. Elsewhere, a dreaming humanoid can agree to become a vessel.
sections.Encounter: A Kalaraq can use Arcane Eye to observe an area before its vessel enters. Its All Around Vision also prevents an ambush from surprising it.

name: Rose Durst
otherStatistics: Damage resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunities: cold, necrotic, poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages: Common.

sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. The ghost sees 60 ft. from the Material Plane into the Ethereal Plane and the same distance in the reverse direction.
Incorporeal Movement. The ghost treats creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain when moving through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Reformation. A ghost reduced to 0 HP can reform at the next dawn. Laying its remains in the matching family crypt puts it to rest and ends any possession.
sections.Actions:
Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Etherealness. The ghost crosses between the Material and Ethereal Planes. Creatures on either side can see it across the boundary while it is in the Border Ethereal, and effects cannot cross between the planes.
Possession (Recharge 6). Choose one visible humanoid within 5 ft. The humanoid must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma save or the ghost disappears into its body. The host remains aware. Normally the host is Incapacitated and the ghost controls its body. Apply the Death House exception below when the host is a player character. The ghost cannot be targeted except by effects that turn undead. It retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being Charmed and Frightened. It uses the host's other statistics without gaining its knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
The possession ends if the host drops to 0 HP, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, it is turned, or magic such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. The ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host. After a successful save or after the possession ends, the host is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours.
sections.Death House Possession:
When Rose possesses a player character in Death House, the player retains control and takes on this flaw. I want to be in charge and resent being told what to do. The character will not willingly leave the house or its dungeon.
A creature can spend an action and succeed on a DC 11 Charisma (Intimidation) check to drive Rose out. Laying the children to rest in both crypts grants each character Inspiration.
sections.Encounter: Disturbing the children's dollhouse or toy chest summons the ghosts. They fight in self-defense and try to possess people who attempt to leave. Rose can point the group toward the secret attic door. Characters who search the dollhouse afterward have Advantage on Perception checks to find secret doors.

appearance: The ghost of an older girl in a high-collared cape and a dark embroidered dress.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Curse of Strahd, Death House pp. 217–218. Base Ghost rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 147.

name: Thorn Durst
otherStatistics: Damage resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunities: cold, necrotic, poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages: Common.
