appearance: The ghost of a young boy in a hooded coat who clutches a doll.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Curse of Strahd, Death House pp. 217–218. Base Ghost rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 147.

name: Wereraven
speed: 30 ft., fly 50 ft. in raven or hybrid form
otherStatistics: Skills Insight +4, Perception +6. Damage immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks unless made with silvered weapons. Passive Perception 16. Languages: Common. It cannot speak in raven form.

sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. The wereraven can spend an action to become a raven, a raven-humanoid hybrid, or its human form. Its other statistics carry across forms except for size and the listed flight. Its gear does not change with it. It returns to human form when it dies.
Mimicry. It can imitate simple sounds it has heard. A listener can identify an imitation with a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (human or hybrid only). Make two weapon attacks, with at most one Hand Crossbow attack.
Beak (raven or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing in raven form or 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing in hybrid form. A humanoid hit must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or contract wereraven lycanthropy.
Shortsword (human or hybrid only). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
Hand Crossbow (human or hybrid only). Ranged weapon attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
sections.Encounter: The Martikov family and other Keepers of the Feather hide among the ravens of Barovia. Allies can find them around the Blue Water Inn and the Wizard of Wines. Wereravens favor weapons in their human and hybrid forms to avoid spreading their curse.

appearance: A Barovian shapeshifter that can appear human, raven, or as a winged hybrid with a raven head and black feathers.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Curse of Strahd, p. 242, original printed profile.

name: Aberrant Zealot (Variant)
otherStatistics: Studded leather armor. Saves Dex +7, Cha +7. Skill Perception +5. Psychic resistance. Condition immunities: blinded, charmed, frightened, grappled, restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., truesight 10 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages: Common, Deep Speech.

sections.Traits:
Aberrant Form. A creature other than an Aberration that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the zealot must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Weirdly Pliable. The zealot and its equipment can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Psychic Rend attack and two Shortsword attacks.
Psychic Rend. Melee or ranged spell attack +7, reach 15 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or become Stunned until the start of the zealot's next turn.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.
Mind Blast (Recharge 5–6). The zealot emits magical psychic energy in a 60-ft. cone. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence save or take 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and become Stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
Psionics. Charisma, save DC 15. These spells require no components.
At will · Detect Thoughts, Minor Illusion.
1/day each · Arcane Gate, Hunger of Hadar.
sections.Bonus Actions: Void Warp (Recharge 5–6). The zealot and its equipment teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 ft. Each other creature within 30 ft. of the space it left makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 18 (4d8) force damage and is pulled to the unoccupied space closest to the void. On a success it takes half damage. The void then vanishes.
sections.Encounter: Nouashu and Groushim watch the mindgate from the Collectors’ Nook in the Briny Maze. They attack unexpected visitors. Their experiments left them with violet skin and moving facial tentacles.

publication: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk
appearance: A violet-skinned aberration in studded leather, with facial tentacles and a pair of shortswords.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk. Beyond a Lightless Star, B18, pp. 180–181. Base rules in appendix A, p. 203.

printing.publication: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk

name: Goblin Boss (Variant)
otherStatistics: Chain shirt and shield. Skill Stealth +6. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages: Common, Goblin.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Scimitar attacks. The second has Disadvantage.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 80/320 ft., one creature. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
sections.Bonus Actions: Nimble Escape. The goblin can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.
sections.Reactions: Redirect Attack. When a creature the boss can see targets it with an attack, the boss can choose another goblin within 5 ft. They trade places, and the chosen goblin becomes the target.
sections.Equipment: Chain shirt, shield, scimitar, and shortbow. The shortbow requires two hands. AC is 15 while the shield is doffed.
sections.Encounter: Two goblin bosses guard each Archer Post at Cragmaw Castle. They shoot through arrow slits and switch to melee when intruders enter the room.

publication: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk
appearance: A small goblin sentry with mismatched armor and a shortbow.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Phandelver and Below: The Shattered Obelisk. The Spider’s Web, C3, p. 60. Base Goblin Boss rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 166.

name: Agony the Ghost
otherStatistics: Damage resistances: acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunities: cold, necrotic, poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages: those it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Ethereal Sight. Agony can see 60 ft. between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane in either direction.
Incorporeal Movement. Agony treats creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain when passing through them. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Bound to the Last Breath. If Agony drops to 0 HP while the ship has at least 1 HP, it returns at full HP in the cargo hold 24 hours later. If it moves more than 100 ft. from the ship, Agony vanishes and immediately reappears in the cargo hold.
sections.Actions:
Withering Touch. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage.
Etherealness. Agony crosses between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. Agony remains visible across the boundary while in the Border Ethereal, but effects cannot cross the boundary.
Horrifying Visage. Each non-Undead creature within 60 ft. that can see Agony must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or become Frightened for 1 minute. Failing by 5 or more also ages it by 1d4 × 10 years. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success. A success or the end of the effect grants 24 hours of immunity to Agony's visage. Greater Restoration reverses the aging if cast within 24 hours of the effect.
Possession (Recharge 6). One visible humanoid within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma save or Agony disappears into its body. The host is Incapacitated and aware while Agony controls it. Agony can be targeted only by effects that turn undead. Agony retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being Charmed and Frightened. It otherwise uses the host's statistics and gains none of the host's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.
Possession ends if the host drops to 0 HP, Agony releases it as a bonus action, Agony is turned, or a spell such as Dispel Evil and Good forces it out. Agony reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the host. A successful save or the end of possession grants that creature 24 hours of immunity to Agony's Possession.
sections.Bonus Actions: Return to Ship. While away from the Last Breath, Agony can magically teleport to the lower cargo hold or another location it can see aboard the ship.
sections.Encounters:
Mutiny. Agony possesses the hadozee Flinch on the Second Wind and publicly rebukes Captain Gargenhale before returning to the Last Breath. Flinch remembers none of the incident.
Lower Cargo Hold. If Agony hears someone approach or open the brig door, it tries to possess a character and smash a keg of alchemist’s fire. If the blaze burns for 1 minute, the remaining kegs ignite, destroying the Last Breath and dealing 110 (20d10) fire damage to everything within 100 ft.

appearance: A horned tiefling ghost in tattered sailor’s clothes.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Light of Xaryxis, Ship of the Dead, pp. 34–35. Base Ghost rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 147.

name: Flapjack the Flumph
otherStatistics: Skills Arcana +4, History +4, Religion +4. Psychic vulnerability. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Understands Undercommon without speaking. Telepathy 60 ft.

sections.Traits:
Advanced Telepathy. Flapjack perceives the content of any telepathic communication within 60 ft. and cannot be Surprised by telepathic creatures.
Prone Deficiency. When knocked Prone, roll a die. On an odd result, Flapjack lands upside down and becomes Incapacitated. At the end of each of its turns it can make a DC 10 Dexterity save to right itself and end that condition.
Telepathic Shroud. Flapjack is immune to divination spells and effects that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts.
sections.Actions:
Tendrils. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 2 (1d4) acid damage. At the end of each of the target's turns, it makes a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 2 (1d4) acid damage on a failure. A success or Lesser Restoration ends the recurring acid damage.
Stench Spray (1/day). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity save or be coated in a foul liquid for 1d4 hours. A coated creature is Poisoned for the duration. Other creatures are Poisoned while within 5 ft. of it. A creature can remove the stench from itself by bathing in water, alcohol, or vinegar during a short rest.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, Flapjack can cast one of these spells using Intelligence, save DC 12, with no material components.
At will · Mage Hand, Minor Illusion.
1/day each · Magic Missile, Unseen Servant.
sections.Encounters:
Flapjack pilots Captain Sartell's Moondancer and can teach spellcasters the basics of spelljamming.
The Moondancer's helm lets Flapjack sense telepathic activity aboard nearby ships while piloting. The Lucent Edict's psurlons obscure their presence with Aberrant Mind. Flapjack senses something aboard and shares that with Sartell and close companions.

appearance: A floating, lavender flumph with eyestalks, trailing tentacles, and an oversized feathered hat.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Light of Xaryxis, pp. 13 and 15–16. Base Flumph rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 135.

name: Dracolich (Gargantuan)
otherStatistics: Initiative +12 (22). Saves Dex +6, Wis +8. Skills Perception +14, Stealth +6. Damage immunities: necrotic, poison. Condition immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 24. Languages: Common, Draconic. XP in lair 20,000.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dracolich fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.
Life Suppression. Creatures within 60 ft. of the dracolich cannot regain hit points.
Magic Resistance. The dracolich has Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Soul Gem. If destroyed while its gem is on the same plane, the dracolich reforms at full hit points in 1d20 days within 5 ft. of the gem. The gem is a Tiny object with AC 20 and 50 HP and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. It returns to full HP at the end of every turn, but turns to dust at 0 HP. Making a replacement takes an 8-hour ritual, a gem worth at least 1,000 GP, and 5,000 GP that the ritual consumes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dracolich can replace one of them with the 2nd-level version of Ray of Sickness.
Rend. Melee attack +13, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.
Necrotic Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 20 Constitution save, taking 52 (8d12) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one spell using Charisma, save DC 19 and +11 to hit with spell attacks. The spells require no material components.
At will · Detect Magic, Ray of Sickness (2nd level).
1/day each · Create Undead (8th level), Finger of Death.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The dracolich has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one immediately after another creature's turn and regains all uses at the start of its own turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make a Rend attack.
Sickening Ray. Cast the 2nd-level version of Ray of Sickness. The dracolich can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.
Terrifying Presence. Each creature in a 30-ft. emanation from the dracolich makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage and becomes Frightened until the end of that creature's next turn. The dracolich can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.
sections.Regional Effects:
Sapping Mist. Pale fog Lightly Obscures the region within 1 mile of the lair. Creatures other than the dracolich and its allies who finish a Long Rest there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
Soul Drain. Within 1 mile of the lair, creatures have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws.
The effects end immediately if the dracolich is destroyed or moves its lair. They resume if it gains a new body through the soul gem.
sections.Encounter: A dracolich often occupies a corrupted version of the lair it held in life. Its soul gem allows it to return after defeat and can be hidden away from its hoard.

appearance: A skeletal dragon with weathered bones, ragged wings, and traces of its former scales.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2024), p. 102.
Huge and Gargantuan dracoliches use the same printed hit points and Hit Dice.

name: Shadow Dragon (Large)
otherStatistics: Initiative +14 (24). Saves Dex +9, Wis +6. Skills Perception +11, Stealth +14. Damage immunity: necrotic. Conditional damage resistance from Living Shadow. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 21. Languages: Common, Draconic. XP in lair 11,500.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When the dragon fails a save, it can choose to succeed instead.
Living Shadow. In Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon resists all damage except force, psychic, and radiant.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack +10, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Shadow Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. A humanoid reduced to 0 HP by this damage dies and a Shadow rises from its corpse. The Shadow obeys the dragon, shares its initiative, and acts immediately after it.
sections.Bonus Actions: Shadow Stealth. In Dim Light or Darkness, the dragon can take the Hide action.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The dragon has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one immediately after another creature's turn and regains all uses at the start of its own turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make a Rend attack.
Veil of Shadow. Use Shadow Stealth. One visible creature of the dragon's choice within 10 ft. takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The dragon can use this option only once before the start of its next turn.
sections.Regional Effects:
Negative Energy Suffusion. Within 1 mile of the lair, subtract 1d10 from any hit points a creature regains from a spell.
Stifling Shadows. Within 1 mile of the lair, effects that create Bright Light produce Dim Light instead. Creatures in this area have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
These effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.
sections.Encounter: Shadow dragons lurk in lightless Underdark reaches, accursed ruins, and sites touched by the Shadowfell. A dragon may return to a corrupted version of the terrain it inhabited before its transformation.

appearance: A dark-scaled dragon with smoky wing membranes and a silhouette that blends into darkness.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 274–275.
Large and Huge shadow dragons use the same printed hit points and Hit Dice.

name: Sensa Prince
classification: Medium Humanoid (human), alignment varies by prince
otherStatistics: Skills Athletics +5, Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. Languages: any one language, usually Common.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.
sections.Princes and Scorpions:
Prince Kirina and Prince Simbon use this profile when five summoned giant scorpions attack in Anisa. Kirina charges first and Simbon follows. Both fight alongside the characters. A prince at half his hit points or fewer (29 HP with the listed average) takes the Dodge action to avoid further harm.
A DC 16 Intelligence (Nature) check identifies the attackers as twilight dune scorpions. The scorpions vanish when killed. A DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana or Religion) check identifies that as evidence of magical summoning.
sections.The rival princes:
Kirina, Prince of Niba, is chaotic evil. He works with High Priest Kedjou to stage a crisis that will make him look like Empress Inaya's strongest heir.
Simbon, Prince of Anisa, is neutral. He takes charge of the Goldwarren rescue at his father's direction and feels obligated to act as a candidate for the throne.

appearance: An unarmored Sensa royal with court robes, a draped mantle, and a longsword.
ruleNotes: Rules source: Journeys through the Radiant Citadel, Gold for Fools and Princes, pp. 94–95. Base Veteran rules from Monster Manual (2014), p. 350.

name: Dust Devil
otherStatistics: Damage resistances: lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Damage immunity: poison. Condition immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages: Auran.

sections.Traits: Air Form. The dust devil can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Whirlwind (Recharge 4–6). Each creature sharing the dust devil's space makes a DC 13 Strength save. On a failure it takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, is thrown up to 20 ft. in a random direction, and falls Prone. On a success it takes half damage and is neither thrown nor knocked Prone.
Collision. A thrown creature that hits an object takes an additional 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. thrown. If thrown at another creature, that creature makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes the same distance-based damage and falls Prone.
sections.Blue dragon regional effect: Dust devils scour the land within 6 miles of a legendary blue dragon’s lair. The dust devils tied to that lair vanish immediately when the dragon dies.

appearance: A twisting funnel of dust and grit with a faint resemblance to a face in the swirling cloud.
ruleNotes: The Monster Manual (2014), p. 92, defines the blue dragon regional variant using the Air Elemental rules on p. 124. D&D Beyond lists its standalone stat block under Basic Rules (2014).

name: Lightbender
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +8. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. On a saving throw that normally halves damage on a success, the lightbender takes no damage on a success and half on a failure.
Pounce. If it moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Claw on the same turn, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone. If the target is Prone, the lightbender can make a Bite attack against it as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks, or make two Tail Whip attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Tail Whip. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.
Hypnotic Mane (1/day). Every creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or is Charmed by the lightbender for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, the creature is Incapacitated and its speed is 0. The effect ends for a creature that takes damage or is shaken out of it by someone spending an action.
sections.Reactions: Afterimage. On a hit against the lightbender, an imprint is revealed and the lightbender appears in a visible unoccupied space within 30 ft. of it. The attack misses and the imprint disappears. An attacker that perceives without sight, such as with Blindsight, or sees through illusions, such as with Truesight, prevents this reaction.

appearance: A lionlike hunter with a prismatic mane and two lashing tails tipped with crystals. Its coat bends daylight into mirages.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Glass Cavern, p. 266, area R4. Six lightbenders attack if provoked or if the party uses a light source with a bright radius of at least 120 ft. Xaantikorijek arrives at the start of round three if combat breaks out. The mirrored walls double illumination radii and force each creature in the room to make a DC 15 Constitution save when such a light is used. On a failure it is Blinded for 1 minute, with a new save at the end of each turn.

name: Overmind
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Int +8, Wis +6, Cha +7. Arcana +8, Deception +7, Insight +6, Intimidation +7, Perception +6. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 16. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.

sections.Traits: Detached Eyes. Six floating eyes function as objects, each with AC 24 and 1 HP. An eye's shield makes it immune to damage until it uses a psionic effect. The shield returns at the start of the overmind's next turn. Destroyed eyes are replaced at the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Psionics. Use three different effects through the detached eyes. Unless specified, each targets a creature the overmind can see within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. DC 16 Wisdom save or Charmed by the overmind for 1 hour. The charm ends if the overmind harms the target or an ally of the target.
Compulsion Beam. DC 16 Intelligence save or the target uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed toward the closest ally it can see and make a weapon attack against that ally. Creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.
Toxic Vapors. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each creature within 10 ft. of it makes a DC 16 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on success.
Telekinetic Beam. DC 16 Strength save or the overmind moves the target up to 30 ft. in any direction and deals 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of the movement. Alternatively, it can move a visible unworn, uncarried object within 120 ft., weighing up to 300 pounds, up to 30 ft. and manipulate it precisely.
Lightning Bolt. Each creature in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Fire Beam. The target makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and burns for 1 minute, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage at the start of each turn. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the burning on a success. Any creature can use an action to put out the flames.
sections.Bonus Actions: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). The overmind projects a 150-ft. cone. For the overmind and each creature in the cone affected by a spell, that spell’s effects end immediately for that creature.
sections.Reactions: Away with You! When a creature within 5 ft. hits the overmind with a melee attack, it can use Telekinetic Beam against that attacker.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the overmind can choose one effect. It can't choose the same effect two rounds in a row.
Gas Belch. The ceiling, floor, or wall within 60 ft. gives off gas in a 20-ft. sphere through the end of initiative count 20 in the next round. A creature that enters the gas for the first time or starts its turn there makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Slime Shower. Slime from the ceiling coats one enemy within 120 ft. on a failed DC 15 Dexterity save. The creature is vulnerable to both fire and lightning damage until it takes either type or until the end of initiative count 20 in the next round.
Telekinetic Hold. Three enemies within 60 ft. each make a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the enemy's speed becomes 0 and it rises 20 ft. straight up. The effect lasts through the end of initiative count 20 in the next round, then the enemy falls.

appearance: A floating vaurath with a huge central eye and six small eyes that drift independently around it.

name: Xorannox
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +9. Arcana +9, Deception +9, Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 17. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.
appearance: The Tyract is an armored vaurath with a massive central eye and eight detached psionic eyes.

sections.Traits:
Painful Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Xorannox can succeed by destroying one of his eight floating eyes, chosen randomly with a d8. He grows a new eye to replace it 24 hours later.
Eyes Always Shielded. The eyes retain their psionic shields even after using Eye Psionics.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Psionics. Use three different effects from the floating eyes. No effect can be used twice on the same turn. Except where an effect specifies otherwise, each targets one creature Xorannox can see within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. DC 17 Wisdom save or Charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour. The charm ends if he harms the target or one of the target’s allies.
Compulsion Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save or the target uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed toward its closest visible ally and make a weapon attack against that ally. Creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.
Memory Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save. On a failure, the target expends an available spell slot of its highest remaining level with no effect. A target with no slots left loses proficiency with one weapon it holds or carries for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end that loss early.
Toxic Vapors. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. All creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end the effect early.
Telekinetic Field. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy within 10 ft. of it makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, Xorannox moves the enemy up to 30 ft. in any direction and deals 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of that movement. He can also move an object in the area up to 30 ft. in any direction if it weighs 300 pounds or less and is neither worn nor carried. He can manipulate the object precisely.
Lightning Bolt. Creatures in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Explosion. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Necrosis Beam. DC 17 Constitution save or the target takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage immediately and loses 7 (2d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. A target reduced to 0 HP by this effect dies. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or loses sight of the target. He cannot use the beam again while that effect lasts.
sections.Bonus Actions: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). Xorannox projects a 150-ft. cone. For Xorannox and each creature in the cone affected by a spell, that spell’s effects end immediately for that creature.
sections.Reactions: Cower! When an attacker hits Xorannox, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Frightened of him for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each option is available once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
Disruption Beams. Choose three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage whenever it makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell of 1st level or higher. The effect lasts 1 minute, and each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end it early.
Disappearing Act. Xorannox becomes Invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.
Megabeam. In a 120-ft. line, 20 ft. wide, each creature saves against two random Eye Psionics effects from Xorannox’s remaining eyes. Reroll duplicates for each creature. Effects that normally cover an area affect only that individual creature.

name: Angulotl Blade
otherStatistics: Skills Perception +4, Stealth +4. Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Language Angulotl.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Slippery. Opportunity attacks against the blade have disadvantage.
Toxiferous. A creature that touches the angulotl, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Machete. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wild Hop. The blade jumps up to its walking speed. If it leaps at least 10 ft. straight toward a creature, its next Machete attack against that creature on this turn has advantage.

appearance: A red, spotted frogfolk skirmisher with webbed digits and a broad machete.

name: Angulotl Needler
otherStatistics: Dexterity save +6. Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +5, Stealth +8, Survival +5. Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. Language Angulotl.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Sniper. The needler stays hidden when it misses with a ranged weapon attack made while hidden. A ranged weapon hit made with advantage deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage.
Toxiferous. A creature that touches the angulotl, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Poison Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Blowgun. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 25/100 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 minute. While Poisoned this way, the target takes 14 (4d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hop and Hide. The needler jumps up to its walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

appearance: A blue frogfolk sniper with green markings and a wooden blowgun, crouched among marsh leaves.

name: Angulotl Seer
otherStatistics: Dexterity save +6, Wisdom save +7. Skills Acrobatics +6, Perception +10, Stealth +6, Survival +7. Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 120 ft., truesight 60 ft. Passive Perception 20. Language Angulotl.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Third Eye. Creatures within 30 ft. cannot hide from the seer. Creatures immune to being targeted by divination magic are unaffected.
Toxiferous. A creature that touches the angulotl, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Acid Grasp. Melee spell attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) acid damage. A creature hit by this attack takes another 14 (4d6) acid damage if it attacks the seer before the start of the seer’s next turn.
Refulgent Beam. Fire two beams, each at a visible creature within 120 ft. Each target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 13 (3d8) radiant damage and sheds dim light out to 10 ft. for 1 minute. While lit, attacks against it have advantage, it gets no benefit from being Invisible, and it cannot Hide. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.
Noxious Bubble (1/day). Create a sphere of toxic gas with a 5-ft. radius in an empty visible space within 60 ft. It dissipates after 1 minute if undisturbed. Attacking, touching, entering or otherwise disturbing it bursts the sphere. Every creature within 15 ft. of it makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 27 (6d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
Psychedelic Drone (1/day). Each enemy within 60 ft. that can hear the seer makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage and is Dazed for 1 minute. The enemy repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hop. The seer jumps up to its walking speed.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature chooses one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, that turn ends. It still gets any extra action granted by an effect such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

appearance: A purple frogfolk mystic with orange-red eyes, a dark mantle and small pendants.

name: Angulotl Slink
otherStatistics: Dexterity save +5. Skills Perception +4, Stealth +7, Survival +4. Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. Language Angulotl.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Spider Climb. The slink climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without making an ability check.
Toxiferous. A creature that touches the angulotl, or hits it with a melee attack from within 5 ft., takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Poison Dagger attack and one Tongue Nab attack.
Poison Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing plus 10 (3d6) poison damage. The target loses its reactions until the start of its next turn.
Tongue Nab. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. On a hit, the slink grabs one visible Small or Tiny object the target holds or carries. It catches the object with a free hand if it has one. Otherwise it drops at the slink’s feet.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hop and Hide. The slink jumps up to its walking speed, then takes the Hide action.

appearance: A gold-yellow frogfolk lurker with long webbed toes that grips river rock and carries a short dagger.

name: Angulotl Tadpole
otherStatistics: Damage immunity poison. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Acid Burst. When the tadpole drops to 0 HP, it bursts and deals 1 acid damage to every creature within 5 ft.
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Minion. An attack or a failed save that deals damage immediately drops the tadpole to 0 HP. Any other single instance of damage kills it if it deals at least 6 damage. The tadpole ignores lower damage from such an effect.
Noxious Skin. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of at least three tadpoles makes a Constitution save with DC 10 plus the number of tadpoles within 5 ft. of it. Failure leaves it Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
sections.Actions: Bite (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five tadpoles that share a turn and can all reach a target spend their actions on one Bite roll. Add their number to +3. A hit deals 1 piercing damage per participant. A solo tadpole rolls at +3. Apply advantage or disadvantage only when it applies to all participants. Roll separately for groups with different cover or concealment. If the attack triggers an effect that can affect only one attacker, the target chooses which tadpole it affects.
Group opportunity attack. Multiple tadpoles can each spend their reaction to join the same Bite if the target provokes from them at the same time. Tadpoles have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 6 damage leaves a surplus equal to damage minus 6. Reduce one additional eligible tadpole to 0 HP per 6 surplus damage or fraction of 6. Additional melee targets must be within reach. Additional ranged targets must be on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Opportunity attacks cannot deal overkill damage.

ruleNotes: Bite uses the default 5-ft. reach for a melee attack.
appearance: An amphibious frogfolk larva with a finned tail, dark round eyes and small webbed feet.

name: Clawfish
otherStatistics: Skill Perception +2. Damage immunities lightning and poison. Passive Perception 12. No languages.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The clawfish can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage. If the target is a Small or larger creature, the clawfish can enter its space and attach to it.
While attached, the clawfish follows the target without provoking opportunity attacks and cannot use Claw. A creature that can reach it can use an action to detach it with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On success it moves to an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. of the target. It also detaches by spending 5 ft. of movement or if it becomes Grappled, Incapacitated, Prone, or Restrained.
Electrocute (Recharge 6). Every creature touching the clawfish takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage. If the clawfish is immersed, every other creature within 10 ft. touching the same body of water makes a DC 11 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) lightning damage.
sections.Angulotl training: Angulotls call clawfish q’ukutxal. They train them to pull rafts and to fight in rivers with their claws and electrical discharge.

appearance: An eel-like river beast with eight reptilian legs, a moray head and rippling fins.

name: Angulotl Yegg
hpRule: 7 × the yegg’s level in hit points. It has one d8 Hit Die per level.
otherStatistics: Light armor. Saving throws +PB across all abilities. Skills Acrobatics +3 + PB, Athletics +PB, Stealth +3 + PB, Survival +2 + PB. Poison resistance. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages Angulotl and Common.
appearance: A small frogfolk retainer wearing light leather armor and carrying a poison knife and an acid flask.

sections.Mentor scaling: The yegg uses its mentor’s level and proficiency bonus (PB). It acts on its mentor’s initiative, immediately before or after the mentor as the player chooses. At 0 HP it follows the same rules as a player character, including death saves.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The yegg breathes air and water.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Poison Knife). Melee or ranged weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1d4 + PB piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage. Starting at level 7, the yegg can make two of these attacks when it takes the Attack action. It can use its signature attack for opportunity attacks.
sections.Retainer features:
Level 3, Death from Above! (3/day). As a bonus action, jump up to walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If the yegg jumps over an enemy, it can make a signature attack against that enemy with advantage. A hit deals extra piercing damage equal to PB.
Level 5, Lay Low (3/day). After hitting a creature with a signature attack while hidden, the yegg can use its reaction to stay hidden.
Level 7, Excoriating Acid (3/day). As an action, throw a flask at a visible point within 20 ft. Every creature within 10 ft. of the point makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB, taking PBd10 acid damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Clawfish Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points. It has one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.
otherStatistics: Natural armor 13 + PB. Saves Strength +3 + PB and Dexterity +1 + PB. Skills Perception +PB and Stealth +1 + PB. Passive Perception 10 + PB. It understands basic commands in one language its caregiver chooses.
appearance: A trained eel-like river beast with eight reptilian legs and long, rippling fins.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The companion can hold its breath for 15 minutes.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Overwhelming Attack (2 Ferocity). Make a Bite. A hit deals extra lightning damage equal to PB, and the target loses reactions until the start of the clawfish’s next turn.
Level 3, Coiling Claws (5 Ferocity). Make a Bite against a Medium or smaller creature. A hit also leaves the target Grappled with escape DC 10 + PB. The target stays Restrained during this grapple and the clawfish cannot make a signature attack against another target.
Level 5, Lightning Bomb (8 Ferocity). Every creature within 10 ft. makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB, taking PBd8 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Lightning Retaliation (short or long rest). When a creature the clawfish sees within 5 ft. attacks it or its caregiver, the clawfish can shock the attacker. The attacker makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB, taking PBd6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Mystic connection: Riverkith. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and the Mystic Connection feature gains a swim speed equal to walking speed and can hold their breath for 15 minutes. Once per long rest, they can use a bonus action to breathe lightning in a 30-ft. cone. Every creature in it makes a Dexterity save against the Beastheart’s exploit save DC, taking 6d6 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Owlbear (MCDM)
appearance: A broad, feathered predator with owl eyes and beak, bear-like haunches and long talons.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Deadly Leap. The owlbear can long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start. After leaping at least 20 ft. toward a target and hitting it with Bite or Claw, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone.
Keen Sight and Smell. The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight or smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage. The owlbear can move the target 5 ft. in any direction.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Bear Hug (Recharge 4–6). Choose one creature the owlbear can see within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is Grappled (escape DC 15). On a success, it takes half damage. While Grappled this way it is Restrained and takes 5 (1d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. Using Bear Hug or Claw against a different target also ends the grapple.
sections.Reactions: Hulking Rush. After taking damage, the owlbear can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Optional transformation rules: MCDM offers a GM option for Wild Shape or Polymorph to use this Monstrosity. In that form, Bear Hug and Hulking Rush each have one use and each refreshes on a long rest.

name: Shambling Mound (MCDM)
appearance: A huge mass of roots, reeds and swamp vines with lashing tendrils and an interwoven sack for prey.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Constitution save +8. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Flanked, Frightened, Poisoned and Prone. Blindsight 120 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Engulfing Sack. The mound’s sack can be targeted separately. It has AC 15, 50 HP, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Damage to the sack does not hurt the mound. Destroying the sack frees all engulfed creatures. The mound regrows the sack at the start of its next turn.
False Appearance. While motionless, the mound looks like an ordinary mass of vegetation.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Vine Lash attacks. The mound may replace one of them with Engulf when it is available.
Vine Lash. Melee or ranged weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage. The mound can pull a Medium or smaller target up to 30 ft. toward it.
Engulf (Recharge 5–6). Choose up to two Medium or smaller creatures within 30 ft. Each makes a DC 16 Strength save or is drawn into the sack. An engulfed creature is Restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the mound, and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of the mound’s turns. It moves with the mound. If the mound dies or the sack is destroyed, each engulfed creature is freed into an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. of the mound.
sections.Reactions: Poison Froth. When the mound takes damage, each creature in the sack takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. The mound regains HP equal to the total damage this reaction deals to the engulfed creatures.

name: Shambling Pile
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Flanked, Frightened, Poisoned and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A low heap of wet leaves, roots and grabbing fronds, smaller than a full-grown shambling mound.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless pile passes for an ordinary heap of vegetation.
Hungry Grab. An enemy starting its turn within 5 ft. of at least three piles makes a Dexterity save or is Grappled. While grappled this way, it is Restrained and takes poison damage at the start of each of its turns equal to the number of piles within 5 ft. of it. The save and escape DC are 10 plus that number. The grapple ends if fewer than three piles remain within 5 ft.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed saving throw drops the pile to 0 HP. It ignores other damage below 12 and dies if such an effect deals at least 12 damage.
sections.Actions: Vine Lash (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 piercing damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five piles on the same turn can each spend an action to lash one target within reach of all of them. Make a single attack at +6 plus the number joining. A hit deals 4 piercing damage per pile. A solo pile attacks at +6. If all participants have advantage or disadvantage, so does the roll. Separate groups when cover or concealment differs. The target chooses one attacker for a response that can only affect one.
Group opportunity attack. If the target provokes from multiple piles at once, each can spend its reaction to join. Piles have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. After a weapon attack exceeds a pile’s 12 HP, each additional 12 points of damage or part of 12 can drop another eligible pile to 0 HP. For melee, each additional pile must be within the weapon’s reach. For ranged, it must be on the line from attacker through the original target and within the weapon’s short range. This rule does not apply to opportunity attacks.

name: Owlbear Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.
otherStatistics: Natural armor 13 + PB. Saves Strength +3 + PB and Constitution +2 + PB. Skills Athletics +3 + PB and Perception +1 + PB. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11 + PB.
appearance: A broad, tawny owlbear with a feathered face, hooked beak and curved talons.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Traits: Keen Sight and Smell. The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Claw). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB slashing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Violent Attack (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. A hit deals extra damage equal to PB and lets the owlbear move the target 5 ft. in any direction.
Level 3, Owlie Oop (5 Ferocity). Leap up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks. On landing, every creature within 5 ft. of the owlbear makes a Strength save against DC 10 + PB or falls Prone.
Level 5, Bear Hug (8 Ferocity). Choose a visible creature within 5 ft. It makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB. A failure deals PBd10 bludgeoning damage and leaves it Grappled, with escape DC 10 + PB. On success it takes half damage. While grappled this way it is Restrained. Using Bear Hug or the signature attack against a different target ends the grapple.
sections.Bonus Actions: Give a Hoot (long rest). The owlbear hoots. If its caregiver hears it, the caregiver gains 5 × PB temporary hit points.

name: Shambling Mound Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.
otherStatistics: Armor class 13 + PB. Constitution save +2 + PB. Skills Athletics +3 + PB and Perception +PB. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Blinded and Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10 + PB.
appearance: A compact, fern-covered mound with two lashing vines and a woven pocket that can hold prey.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Traits: False Appearance. A motionless mound looks like ordinary vegetation. A caregiver of Large size or smaller can take the Hide action to try to hide in its space while it remains still.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Vine Lash). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Long-Range Lash (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack at 30-ft. reach. On a hit against a Medium or smaller creature, the mound can pull it up to 10 ft.
Level 3, Verdant Roundup (5 Ferocity). Choose up to PB Large or smaller creatures within 30 ft. Each makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure, the target is pulled up to 15 ft. toward the mound and takes PBd4 poison damage.
Level 5, Engulf (8 Ferocity). One Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a Strength save against DC 10 + PB. A failure pulls it into the mound’s space, deals PBd8 poison damage and engulfs it. A success deals half damage and leaves it in place. While engulfed it moves with the mound, is Restrained, has total cover from outside effects and takes PBd8 poison damage at the start of each of the mound’s turns. It can spend an action on a Strength check against DC 10 + PB to escape into a free space of its choice within 5 ft. The mound can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures.
sections.Mystic connection: Maw of the Mound. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can use a bonus action to bite an enemy with an unarmed strike. Use Strength or Dexterity to hit and for damage. A hit deals 1d6 plus the chosen modifier in piercing damage and grants temporary HP equal to the damage dealt. Uses equal PB and refresh on a long rest.

name: Ankheg (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +6. Acid resistance. Immune to Flanked. Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.
appearance: A giant burrowing insect with a ridged exoskeleton, curved mandibles and long crooked feelers.

sections.Traits:
Disoriented Resistance (2/day). On a failed save, the ankheg can succeed instead. It then cannot take bonus actions until the end of its next turn.
Earth Walk. Difficult terrain made of earth or stone costs no extra movement.
Soft Underbelly. A Prone creature attacking from within 5 ft. of the ankheg gets advantage in place of the usual disadvantage for attacking while Prone.
Unstable Tunneler. The ankheg leaves a tunnel 10 ft. across as it burrows. Each section collapses 1 minute after it leaves that space.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing plus 2 (1d4) acid damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled, escape DC 14. It is also Restrained while this grapple lasts, and the ankheg cannot Bite another target during it.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Acid Spit (Recharge 6). Every creature in a 30-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure the creature takes 7 (2d6) acid damage and is coated in acid. On a success it takes half damage only. A coated creature takes 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Any creature can use an action to wipe acid off itself or another creature it can reach.
sections.Bonus Actions: Earth Eruption. When it is burrowing within 10 ft. of the surface, the ankheg can rise without spending movement into a 10-ft. square directly above it. The square becomes difficult terrain. Each creature on the ground in it makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, the ankheg pushes it 5 ft. into an unoccupied space of the ankheg’s choice and rubble Restrains it. A creature can use an action to free itself or another creature within reach. On a success, the creature moves 5 ft. into an unoccupied space of its own choice.
sections.Reactions: Skitter. When a creature attacks the ankheg, it can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each can be used once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. The ankheg can use them in any order, at most one per round.
Big Bug! Every enemy within 30 ft. that can see the ankheg makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or is Frightened of it for 1 minute. The enemy repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
Quick Burrow. If the ankheg is Grappled, end that condition for it. It burrows up to twice its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Grappling a Large or smaller creature does not halve its speed during this move.
Acid Bath. Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) acid damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Basilisk (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Petrified and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. No languages.
ruleNotes: The printed Multiattack wording allows two readings. This profile treats Poison Fumes as an alternative to the combined Eye Beams and Bite.
appearance: A squat, eight-legged reptile with rough stone-like scales, sharp teeth and watchful eyes.

sections.Traits:
Alchemical Ingredients. After the basilisk dies, a creature can make a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check with an herbalism kit, using up the basilisk’s gullet. Success produces three doses of salve. Apply one dose to a Petrified creature as an action. The condition ends for that creature 1 minute later.
Toxic Ichor. A creature within 5 ft. that deals piercing or slashing damage to the basilisk takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Choose either Petrifying Eye Beams followed by one Bite attack, or one use of Poison Fumes if available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
Petrifying Eye Beams. Choose one or two creatures the basilisk can see within 30 ft. Each makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is Restrained as it begins turning to stone. Up to the end of the target’s next turn, the target or an ally within 5 ft. can spend an action to cut away the stone with a slashing weapon. This deals 13 (2d12) slashing damage to the target, which cannot be reduced, and frees it from the restraint. If the target is still Restrained by the beams at the end of its turn, it repeats the save. On a success the effect ends. On a failure the target is Petrified until cured by Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or similar supernatural means.
Poison Fumes (Recharge 4–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 12 Constitution save. It takes 10 (4d4) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Poison Splash. When the basilisk takes piercing or slashing damage, each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is Poisoned for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Cloud Fang Keep, area E3. Passive Perception 17 spots Blinkers and Blunders sleeping among the rubble. A DC 12 group Dexterity (Stealth) check gets the party through without waking them. A DC 17 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check removes a collar without waking its wearer.

name: Chimera (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +7, Perception +5. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. Understands one language. Cannot speak.
appearance: A winged guardian with a lion’s head, a curled-horn ram’s head, a dragon’s head and a lashing scaled tail.

sections.Traits: Volant. After reducing a creature to 0 HP, the chimera can move up to its speed toward an enemy it can see.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks. Replace up to one with either Lion’s Toss or Dragon’s Eruption if the latter is available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Lion’s Toss. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save or is moved up to 20 ft. in any direction.
Dragon’s Eruption (Recharge 6). Choose a point the chimera sees within 120 ft. Each creature in a sphere of radius 10 ft. around it makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. A failure takes 27 (6d8) fire damage and a success takes half.
sections.Bonus Actions: Roar. Every enemy within 60 ft. that can hear the chimera makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened of it for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on success. A creature that succeeds on a save against Roar or for whom the effect ends gains immunity to this chimera’s Roar for 24 hours.
sections.Reactions: Ram’s Defiance. When a creature within 30 ft. misses the chimera with an attack, the chimera can move in a straight line toward it up to half its speed. If the chimera ends within 5 ft. of it, the creature makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Protector variant: When using the optional Protector trait, name one creature as the chimera’s charge. On the same plane, the charge can communicate telepathically with the chimera, which knows the charge’s direction and distance. While the chimera is within 60 ft. of the charge, half of any damage the charge takes, rounded up, transfers to the chimera.

name: Wyvern (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +6, Perception +5. Acid damage immunity. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. No languages.
appearance: A rocky-scaled dragon with two hind legs, wings used as forelimbs on the ground, and a long, acid-delivering stinger.

sections.Traits: Stubborn Rage. The wyvern is immune to Frightened and Stunned while below half its maximum HP or within 60 ft. of another wyvern it can see or hear.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Stinger attack and one Bite attack. The wyvern can replace either one of those attacks with Tail Sweep.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute. The target repeats this save at the end of each of its turns. A success ends the ongoing acid damage. Cure Ailment or Lesser Restoration also ends the effect.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage. A Large or smaller target is also Grappled (escape DC 13) and Restrained during the grapple. The wyvern cannot Bite another target until that grapple ends.
Tail Sweep. Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Strength save. A failure deals 14 (2d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage and pushes the creature up to 10 ft. away from the wyvern.
sections.Bonus Actions: Seek. The wyvern takes the Search action.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Cloud Fang Keep, area E5. The wyvern watches from the pedestal and waits until intruders approach the center of the garden. It favors Bite and Stinger.

name: Chimera Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Ram’s Defense (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. A hit gives the target disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of the chimera’s next turn.
Level 3, Lion’s Leap (5 Ferocity). The chimera moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If it ends on the ground, each creature within 5 ft. makes a Strength save against DC 10 + PB or falls Prone.
Level 5, Volcanic Blow (8 Ferocity). Choose a visible point within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft.-radius sphere around the point makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB. It takes PBd6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Protective Absorption (short or long rest). When the caregiver takes damage within 60 ft. of the chimera, the chimera can use its reaction to take half that damage in the caregiver’s place, rounded up.
sections.Mystic connection: Defensive Eruption. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can spend a bonus action once per long rest to unleash a burst of energy. Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a Dexterity save against the Beastheart’s exploit save DC. On a failure it takes 4d6 fire damage and falls Prone. On a success it takes half damage. The Beastheart and allies within 30 ft. have advantage on their next attack roll before the start of the Beastheart’s next turn.

otherStatistics: Natural armor 13 + PB. Constitution save +2 + PB. Athletics +3 + PB. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.
appearance: A winged guardian with three heads, a lion, a ram and a dragon, and a scaled tail.

name: Wyvern Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Traits: Learning to Fly. The wyvern has a flying speed of 10 × PB feet.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Stinger). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Acidic Sting (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack at 15-ft. reach. A hit deals extra acid damage equal to PB.
Level 3, Liquefied Meal (5 Ferocity). A Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure it falls Prone and takes 1d4 + PB acid damage. The wyvern gains temporary hit points equal to the acid damage dealt.
Level 5, Tail Sweep (8 Ferocity). Every creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a Strength save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure it takes PBd6 bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 10 ft. away.
sections.Reactions: Enraged Protector. When a visible creature within 30 ft. of the wyvern drops its caregiver to 0 HP or scores a critical hit against the caregiver, the wyvern can move up to its speed. If it ends within 5 ft. of that attacker, it can make a signature attack against it.
sections.Mystic connection: Acid-Enhanced. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can spend a bonus action once per long rest to exude acid from their hands for 1 minute. Their melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d8 acid damage during this time.

otherStatistics: Armor class 13 + PB. Strength save +3 + PB. Perception +2 + PB. Acid damage immunity. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12 + PB.
appearance: A two-legged dragon with leathery wings, rocky indigo scales and a hooked tail stinger.

name: Basilisk Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Poison Spittle (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. On a hit, add damage equal to PB. A different creature of the basilisk’s choice within 5 ft. of the basilisk takes poison damage equal to PB.
Level 3, Poison Gaze (5 Ferocity). Choose up to three creatures the basilisk sees within 15 ft. Each makes a Constitution save against DC 10 + PB or becomes Poisoned until the start of the basilisk’s next turn.
Level 5, Lesser Petrifying Eye Beams (8 Ferocity). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a Constitution save against DC 10 + PB or becomes Restrained as it starts turning to stone. If it is still Restrained this way at the end of its turn, it repeats the save. A success ends the effect. A failure Petrifies it for 1 hour, or until Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect ends the condition.
sections.Reactions: Heavy Glare. When the caregiver’s attack hits a creature that can see the basilisk, the target makes a Constitution save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure, until the start of the target’s next turn, its speed drops by 10 ft. and it cannot make opportunity attacks.

otherStatistics: Natural armor 15 + PB. Constitution save +2 + PB. Athletics +3 + PB and Survival +1 + PB. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.
appearance: A low-slung, eight-legged reptile with rough slate-green scales and watchful eyes.

name: Lightbender Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Actions: Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Tail Whip (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. On a hit, add radiant damage equal to PB. A different creature of the lightbender’s choice within 15 ft. of the lightbender also takes radiant damage equal to PB.
Level 3, Silent Pounce (5 Ferocity). Teleport 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. The lightbender can make a signature attack before or after teleporting. On a hit, the target falls Prone.
Level 5, Hypnotic Mane (8 Ferocity). Every creature within 10 ft. makes a Wisdom save against DC 10 + PB or is Charmed by the lightbender until the end of the lightbender’s next turn. A creature Charmed this way is Incapacitated and its speed is 0. The effect on it also ends if it takes damage or another creature spends an action shaking it out of the stupor.
sections.Reactions: Shared Afterimage (long rest). When the lightbender or its caregiver is hit by an attack while they are within 30 ft. of each other, both are revealed as imprints. Each appears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 ft. of its own imprint. The attack misses and the imprints disappear. This is unavailable against attackers that rely on senses other than sight, such as Blindsight, or can see through illusions, such as with Truesight.
sections.Mystic connection: Unleash Sunlight. At 9th level, a Beastheart with this companion and Mystic Connection can spend a bonus action once per long rest to flash with bright light. Choose creatures within 10 ft. that can see the Beastheart. Each makes a Constitution save against the Beastheart’s exploit save DC or becomes Blinded for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the condition on a success.

otherStatistics: Natural armor 13 + PB. Strength save +3 + PB and Dexterity save +2 + PB. Perception +1 + PB and Stealth +2 + PB. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11 + PB.
appearance: A pale lionlike creature with an iridescent silver mane and two separate whip-like tails.

name: Bigger Mimic
otherStatistics: Deception +2, Stealth +5. Immune to acid damage and bludgeoning damage from falling. Immune to Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance (object form). A motionless mimic passes for an ordinary object.
Mimicry. The mimic can imitate sounds it has heard, including voices. A listener can recognize the imitation with a DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. A Large or smaller creature hit this way is Grappled (escape DC 15).
Gnashing Maw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing plus 10 (3d6) acid damage. If the mimic is grappling the target, deal an extra 3 (1d6) acid damage.
Shapechanger. The mimic can become any object of Medium size or larger or return to its true amorphous form. Its size is the only statistic that changes. Worn or carried gear keeps its shape. On death the mimic resumes its true form.
Envelop. While grappling a creature, the mimic uses Shapechanger to become an object at least as large as that creature if it is not already in such a form. The creature is then enveloped and its grapple ends. It cannot breathe, is Blinded and Restrained, and has total cover from attacks and effects outside the mimic. It moves with the mimic and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the mimic’s turns.
The mimic can envelop one creature at a time. An engulfed creature can spend an action to make a DC 15 Strength check, escaping into an empty space of its choice within 5 ft. of the mimic on a success. It also escapes automatically if the mimic uses Shapechanger or Panic Shift, becomes Incapacitated, or dies.
sections.Reactions: Panic Shift (1/day). When it takes damage, the mimic releases any Grappled or enveloped creatures and becomes a Small, dense, spiked object. In this form its walking and climbing speeds double, it resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks, and its actions are limited to Dash, Disengage, and Shapechanger. A creature within 5 ft. that touches it or hits it with a melee attack takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage. This ends when the mimic dies or uses Shapechanger to take another form.

appearance: An amorphous predator that can imitate a building or a stone doorway, opening into a tooth-lined maw.
ruleNotes: The variant keeps the base block’s true-form size and printed physical damage. Its listed changes add acid damage to both attacks and allow it to assume larger object forms.

sections.Variant: A Bigger Mimic can use the same ambush tactics at building scale.

appearance: An amorphous shapechanger that can resemble an oak chest or other object, then reveal a toothy maw and reaching pseudopods.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: The green-banded key at the Holding Cell (O4) is a trained mimic. It attacks if touched or if someone attacks the door or bends the bars. It flees at 15 HP or fewer.

name: Mimic Mimiature
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A small amorphous shapechanger that can masquerade as a palm-sized lockbox, with tiny teeth and sticky pseudopods.

sections.Traits:
In Your Space. The mimiature and another creature can occupy the same space. It can pass through openings at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save reduces the mimiature to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if it reaches 8 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from those other effects.
sections.Actions:
Sticky Swarm (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 bludgeoning damage. Through the end of its next turn, the target has disadvantage on checks and saves to escape the Grappled condition and advantage on checks to initiate or maintain a grapple. If at least three mimiatures join the attack, for the same duration the target cannot cast spells with somatic components, drop objects, or interact with objects it is not already holding.
Group Shapechanger. A mimiature can turn into a Tiny object or return to its amorphous form. Four mimiatures within 5 ft. of one another can use this action together to become one Small object. Gear stays unchanged. The combined form breaks if any member moves, takes an action, or dies, returning its members to their true forms.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five mimiatures on the same turn can each spend an action to attack one target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +3 plus the number joining. A hit deals 1 bludgeoning damage per mimiature. A lone mimiature uses +3. Advantage or disadvantage applies only if all participants have it. Roll for separate groups if cover or concealment differs. The target chooses a single participant for responses that only affect one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If a creature provokes from multiple mimiatures at the same time, each can spend its reaction to join. Mimiatures have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. If a weapon hit deals more than 8 damage, apply the surplus to other eligible mimiatures, dropping one to 0 HP for each 8 surplus damage or fraction of 8. In melee, they must be within the weapon’s reach. At range, they must be on the line through the original target within the weapon’s short range. Opportunity attacks cannot deal overkill damage.

name: Mimic Companion
hpRule: 7 + 7 × the caregiver’s level in hit points, with one d8 Hit Die per caregiver level.
otherStatistics: Natural armor 13 + PB. Dexterity save +1 + PB. Stealth +1 + PB. Acid damage immunity. Immune to Prone. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.
appearance: An amorphous companion that can wrap itself around its caregiver in the guise of clothing, such as a folded traveling cloak.

sections.Caregiver scaling: PB is the caregiver’s proficiency bonus.
sections.Traits: False Appearance (object form). A motionless mimic passes for an ordinary object.
sections.Actions:
Shapechanger. As an action, the mimic can become a Small, Medium, or Large object or return to its amorphous form. Only its size changes. Its gear stays unchanged. It returns to its true form if it dies.
Signature Attack (Bite). Melee weapon attack at +3 + PB, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1d6 + PB piercing damage.
sections.Ferocity actions:
Level 1, Distracting Attack (2 Ferocity). Make a signature attack. On a hit, the next attack against the target before the start of the mimic’s next turn has advantage.
Level 3, Adhesive Pseudopods (5 Ferocity). Choose any creatures within 5 ft. Each makes a Dexterity save against DC 10 + PB or is Grappled (escape DC 10 + PB).
Level 5, I’m You (8 Ferocity). Use Shapechanger to copy one Large or smaller creature the mimic sees within 5 ft. Only size changes, and the mimic reverts to its previous form at the start of its next turn. After transforming it can make a signature attack against the creature it copied. Hit or miss, the creature then makes a Wisdom save against DC 10 + PB. On a failure, until the start of the mimic’s next turn it has disadvantage on attacks and saves, and attacks against it have advantage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Wearable Companion. Within 5 ft. of its caregiver, the mimic can enter the caregiver’s space, cover them, and take the form of clothing. Its space is not difficult terrain for the caregiver, who gains advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. While neither is Incapacitated, the caregiver can change the clothing’s appearance at will without an action.
An attack that hits either the caregiver or the worn mimic hits both, and both take the full damage and effects. While worn, the mimic cannot move and can only use a bonus action to revert to its previous form. It also reverts automatically if it enters a rampage. On reverting, it stops being worn and enters the nearest unoccupied space of its choice.

name: Chimeron
classification: Huge Fiend (Demon, Category 5), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +11, Dex +5, Cha +5. Intimidation +9, Perception +6. Resists cold, fire, and thunder. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 16. Abyssal and Common. Telepathy 120 ft.
appearance: A towering demon made from mismatched limbs, a violet crest, angular support legs, and several toothed maws.

sections.Traits: Soul Resistance. With at least 2 souls, the chimeron has advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make up to three different attacks from Powerful Bite, Scorching Bite, Booming Bite, and Chilling Bite.
Powerful Bite. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.
Scorching Bite. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. The target catches fire and takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature that can reach it can use an action to put out the flames. Reigniting the target does not stack the ongoing damage.
Booming Bite (1 soul). Melee weapon attack +11, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage. The target falls Prone.
Chilling Bite (1 soul). Melee weapon attack +11, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target’s speed is halved through the end of its next turn, and it can make only one attack during that turn.
sections.Reactions: Pain Absorption (1 soul). When it takes damage, the chimeron reduces that damage by 16 (3d10).
