Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Canyon of the Tower Crown, Gorgonash evaluates Aurumvas's acquisitions. The party can slip past while he works.

name: Wobalas
classification: Medium Fiend (Demon, Category 4), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +10, Wis +8, Cha +8. Deception +8, Intimidation +8, Perception +8. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 18. Abyssal and Common. Telepathy 120 ft.
appearance: An Abyssal archer with dark segmented skin and an organic recurve bow fused to one limb.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Despair Bolt attacks.
Despair Bolt. Ranged weapon attack +10, range 150/600 ft., one creature. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. The wobalas can spend 1 soul to leave the target Frightened of it for 1 minute. If the target is immune to Frightened, the wobalas gets that soul back.
Banishing Touch. Melee spell attack +8, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 22 (4d10) psychic damage and teleport the target up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the wobalas can see.
sections.Bonus Actions: Flee, Mortal (1 soul). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. It makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On failure, if it has a reaction available, it uses it to move its speed directly away from the wobalas, taking the shortest route regardless of danger. A creature that cannot become Frightened succeeds automatically.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 165
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 156, area D5. Rancyth arrives with five pitlings 1 minute after the party enters the showroom. Venash tries to stall them until this group arrives and attacks.

name: Ruinant
classification: Medium Fiend (Demon, Category 2), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Wis +7 and Cha +6. Deception +6, Perception +7. Necrotic resistance. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 17. Abyssal and Common. Telepathy 120 ft.
appearance: A low, long-armed fiend with a tendriled maw, hooked claws and scarred blue-charcoal hide.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bloodletting Claws attacks.
Bloodletting Claws. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The target cannot take reactions for the rest of the current turn.
Salt Wounds (1 soul). Choose up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. below their maximum hit points. Each makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Reactions: Corrupt Healing (1 soul). When a creature within 60 ft. regains hit points from a spell, a power, or a similar supernatural effect, the ruinant can negate that healing. The recipient and each enemy of the ruinant within 5 ft. of the ruinant make a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, each takes necrotic damage equal to half the HP the healing would have restored.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Canyon of the Tower Crown, Xaxos and Zeron fight beside Aurumvas. Venash can help the party defeat him and escape the canyon.

name: Tormenauk
classification: Large Fiend (Demon, Category 3), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +8, Wis +5, Cha +7. Intimidation +7, Perception +5. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 15. Abyssal and Common. Telepathy 120 ft.
appearance: A hulking many-mouthed fiend with reddish-purple hide and elongated clawed arms.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks and one Many Maws attack.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 15) and remains Restrained until the grapple ends. The tormenauk can hold up to two targets this way.
Many Maws. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target Grappled by the tormenauk. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage.
Agony Wail (1 soul). Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear the tormenauk makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 35 (10d6) psychic damage on a failure or half on a success. Creatures that knew the owner of the spent soul have disadvantage on that save.
sections.Reactions: Share Agony (1 soul). When the tormenauk takes damage, choose a creature it can see within 30 ft. The creature makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure it takes psychic damage equal to the triggering damage the tormenauk took, or half on a success.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 164
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Canyon of the Tower Crown, pp. 156–157, area D6. Bray keeps stirring molten gold until she must fight. She has two ruinant assistants. Touching the gold, trough, fire, or molds deals 16 (3d10) fire damage.

name: Aurumvas
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +7, Wis +10, Cha +10. Arcana +11, Athletics +12, Deception +10, History +11, Insight +10, Perception +10, Persuasion +10. Resists necrotic, psychic, and bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed and Stunned. Darkvision 120 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 20. All languages. Telepathy 120 ft.
appearance: A towering reptilian fiend in an open gold robe with a stack of crowns and several clawed hands.

sections.Traits:
Abyssal Resistance (2 souls). When Aurumvas fails a save, he can succeed instead.
Soul Weapons. While he has at least 2 souls, his weapon attacks are magical, and allies within 60 ft. deal an extra 5 (1d10) psychic damage with weapon attacks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Greedy Hands and Covetous Bolt.
Greedy Hands. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage. Aurumvas can spend 1 soul to gain temporary HP equal to the psychic damage dealt.
Covetous Bolt. Ranged spell attack +11, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 22 (5d8) force damage. If the target has spell slots, Aurumvas can spend 2 souls to make it expend its highest remaining spell slot without any effect.
sections.Bonus Actions: Greed Is Good. Choose a visible object within 30 ft. worth at least 100 gp. Aurumvas teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Reactions: Absorb Soul. When a demon with at least 1 soul dies within 60 ft. and Aurumvas can see it, he gains 1 soul.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each option can be used once per encounter after an enemy’s turn, in any order, at most one per round.
Time Is Money. Each ally Aurumvas can see within 120 ft. moves up to their speed. At the end of this round, Aurumvas rearranges initiative in any order he chooses.
That’s Ours. Choose up to three visible magic items within 30 ft. that need no attunement and are neither legendary nor artifacts. Aurumvas can teleport each into the hands or to the feet of an ally he can see within 30 ft. An enemy wearing or carrying an item can prevent its teleportation by succeeding on a DC 19 Charisma save.
At Any Cost. Choose four different visible points within 120 ft. Aurumvas teleports an explosive Tiny treasure to each point. Every creature within 10 ft. of one or more points makes one DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 33 (6d10) force damage on a failure or half on a success.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In area D8 of Canyon of the Tower Crown, Aurumvas opens with Time Is Money beside two ruinants and ten pitlings. At 50 HP he tries to escape with his crown, which works as a helm of teleportation.

name: Pitling
classification: Tiny Fiend (Demon, Category 1), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Poison damage immunity. Immune to Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., Soulsight 10 ft., passive Perception 8. Language Abyssal.
appearance: A tiny verminlike demon with green eyes and wiry tendrils, whose shape resembles local pests.

sections.Traits:
Horrid Stench. An enemy that starts its turn within 10 ft. of at least three pitlings becomes Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Minion. An attack or failed save that deals damage drops the pitling to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if it deals at least 11 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from such effects.
Soul Feast. When the pitling reduces a creature other than a Construct or Undead to 0 HP, or deals damage to a dying creature, that creature makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On failure it dies, its soul is consumed and the pitling becomes a Category 2 demon of the GM’s choice with 1 soul. Only Wish can restore the victim to life. If a group attack brought the victim to 0 HP, the GM picks one participating pitling to consume the soul.
Soulsight. The pitling can sense creatures within 10 ft. except Constructs and Undead. This counts as sight for features that require it. Physical objects, total cover, and supernatural effects do not block this sense unless a rule says they do.
sections.Actions: Spit (Group Attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit 4 poison damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five pitlings on the same turn can each use an action to attack a target in reach or range of all of them. A single roll gets +4 plus the number joining. On a hit, deal 4 poison damage per pitling. A lone pitling uses +4. Advantage or disadvantage applies if every participant has it. Split attackers into separate rolls when cover or concealment differs. The target chooses which participant is affected by a response that can affect just one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If the target provokes from multiple pitlings at once, each can use its reaction to join the melee Spit attack. Pitlings have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 11 damage leaves surplus that can drop another eligible pitling for every 11 points of surplus damage or part thereof. Melee targets must be in reach. Ranged targets must lie on the line from the attacker through the original target within the weapon’s short range. Opportunity attacks cannot deal overkill damage.

ruleNotes: The Ruinant is one published Category 2 form a Pitling may take after Soul Feast.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 162.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In the canyon's narrow hallway (D2), twenty pitlings wait for the first character to reach the halfway point before attacking if the group alerts them. Another ten attend Aurumvas with the two ruinants Xaxos and Zeron.

name: Devil Adjudicator
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +9, Wis +7, Cha +10. Deception +10, Insight +7, Perception +7, Persuasion +10, Religion +8. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from mundane attacks. Fire damage immunity. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Common and Infernal.
appearance: A stout, horned infernal judge with a tapering scaled tail, bat wings and gold-embroidered burgundy robes.

sections.Traits: True Name. If the devil hears a creature within 60 ft. say its true name aloud, it loses its damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Infernal Injunction attacks. Also use Adjudicator’s Interdiction if it is available.
Infernal Injunction. Melee or ranged spell attack +10, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit 27 (5d8 + 5) fire damage. The target makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure, the adjudicator either Charms or Frightens the target, its choice, until the end of the target’s next turn.
Adjudicator’s Interdiction (Recharge 5–6). Choose one visible creature within 120 ft. It makes a DC 18 Charisma save. On a failure it is interdicted until the adjudicator dies. While interdicted, its speed is halved, it cannot take reactions, and it cannot regain hit points. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse, or a similar supernatural effect ends it early.
Bad Deal (1/day). Three visible creatures within 60 ft. each make a DC 18 Charisma save. A creature that fails chooses a −5 penalty to AC or a −5 penalty to both ability checks and attack rolls. The penalty lasts for 10 minutes. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the penalty on a success.
sections.Reactions: Devilish Charm (2/day). When a visible creature within 60 ft. targets the devil with an attack, spell, power or other supernatural effect, that creature makes a DC 18 Charisma save. On a failure, the creature is Charmed by the devil until the start of that creature’s next turn, and the devil redirects the effect to a new target it can see within the effect’s range.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At Eighth City Advocacy Services, Akistos guards the Vault of Leverage. He offers to help a party willing to take on Lazivos.

name: Devil Jurist
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saves Int +7, Wis +6, Cha +8. Arcana +7, Deception +8, Perception +6, Persuasion +8. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from mundane attacks. Fire damage immunity. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16. Common and Infernal.
appearance: A lean blue-gray infernal magistrate with a pair of hooked horns, tattered wings and purple-red court armor.

sections.Traits:
Hellfire. Fire damage from the jurist ignores damage resistance.
True Name. If the devil hears a creature within 60 ft. say its true name aloud, it loses its damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fire and Brimstone attacks.
Fire and Brimstone. Melee or ranged spell attack +8, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d8 + 4) fire damage. The target makes a DC 16 Constitution save or gains a festering wound. At the start of each of its turns, the target takes 4 (1d8) fire damage per festering wound. Receiving supernatural healing removes every festering wound from that creature.
Inferno (Recharge 5–6). Make one Fire and Brimstone attack against each enemy the jurist sees within 60 ft.
sections.Bonus Actions: Ashes to Ashes. Choose a visible creature within 120 ft. with at least one festering wound. The jurist ignites one of those wounds and the creature takes 9 (2d8) fire damage.
sections.Reactions: Devilish Charm (1/day). When a visible creature within 60 ft. targets the devil with an attack, spell, power or other supernatural effect, that creature makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, the creature is Charmed by the devil until the start of that creature’s next turn, and the devil redirects the effect to a new target it can see within the effect’s range.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In the Eighth City Advocacy Services guard station, Aemilios spends the first two rounds finishing a report if the party starts the fight before he orders the guards to attack.

name: Devil Legate
otherStatistics: Half plate. Saves Str +7, Wis +5, Cha +7. Athletics +7, Deception +7, Persuasion +7. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Fire damage immunity. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12. Common and Infernal.
appearance: An armored infernal soldier with sweeping horns, burnished half plate, a dark red cloak and a long pike.

sections.Traits:
Hellish Resistance. While in Hell or within 60 ft. of a devil of CR 9 or higher, the legate has advantage on saves against spells, powers and other supernatural effects.
True Name. If the devil hears a creature within 60 ft. say its true name aloud, it loses its damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Infernal Pike attacks.
Infernal Pike. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing plus 11 (2d10) fire damage, and choose one of the following effects.
Focused Hate. The target has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the legate until the end of the legate’s next turn.
Hellbite. The target takes 5 (2d4) extra fire damage.
Skewer. A different creature within 5 ft. of the target takes 5 (1d10) piercing plus 5 (1d10) fire damage.
sections.Reactions: Devilish Charm (1/day). When a visible creature within 60 ft. targets the devil with an attack, spell, power or other supernatural effect, that creature makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On a failure, the creature is Charmed by the devil until the start of that creature’s next turn, and the devil redirects the effect to a new target it can see within the effect’s range.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Eighth City Advocacy Services, reward someone who knows a guard's true name. The adventure allows revealing the name through investigation or bargaining.

name: Devil Magistrate
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saves Dex +10, Wis +7, Cha +8. Acrobatics +10, Deception +8, Insight +7, Persuasion +8, Stealth +10. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Fire damage immunity. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13. Common and Infernal.
appearance: An agile horned devil in fitted studded leather and court robes, wielding an obsidian kris and an infernal knife.

sections.Traits: True Name. If the devil hears a creature within 60 ft. say its true name aloud, it loses its damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm reaction for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Infernal Knife attacks and one Obsidian Kris attack.
Infernal Knife. Melee or ranged weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. The target becomes Frightened of its own allies until the end of the target’s next turn.
Obsidian Kris. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is Frightened, it cannot take reactions until that condition ends.
sections.Reactions: Devilish Charm (2/day). When a visible creature within 60 ft. targets the devil with an attack, spell, power or other supernatural effect, that creature makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, the creature is Charmed by the devil until the start of that creature’s next turn, and the devil redirects the effect to a new target it can see within the effect’s range.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Lazivos calls a magistrate and eight notaries to his side as soon as the fight starts in his office.

name: Devil Notary
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Fire damage immunity. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12. Common and Infernal.
appearance: A wiry horned devil clerk in a blue-gray coat carrying an open ledger and quill.

sections.Traits:
Importunity. At the start of its turn, the notary can bless a visible non-minion ally within 60 ft. without spending an action. The ally can add +1 to its next attack roll or saving throw before the start of the notary’s next turn. Blessings from multiple notaries stack to a maximum bonus of +5.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the notary to 0 HP. Other damage kills it if it deals at least 13 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from those other effects.
True Name. If the notary hears someone within 60 ft. speak its true name, it loses its damage immunity and Importunity for 24 hours.
sections.Actions: Brimstone (Group Attack). Melee or ranged spell attack +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 4 fire damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five notaries on the same turn can each spend an action to attack a target in reach or range of every participant. Make one roll at +6 plus the number joining. A hit deals 4 fire damage per participant. A solo notary attacks at +6. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. When cover or concealment differs, roll separately for each group. The target chooses which participant is affected by a response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If a target provokes from multiple notaries at once, each can spend its reaction to join the melee Brimstone attack. Notaries have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. A weapon hit dealing more than 13 damage leaves surplus that can drop an eligible additional notary to 0 HP for each 13 points of surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, each must be within reach of the weapon. At range, each must lie on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. This rule excludes opportunity attacks.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Thrubwell handles client intake in Eighth City Advocacy Services. At Camp Firefield, Mixlax can offer passage to the next circle in exchange for letting the devil place a curse.

name: Infernal Chancellor Lazivos
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +10, Int +9, Wis +9, Cha +12. Arcana +9, Deception +12, Insight +9, Perception +9, Persuasion +12, Religion +9. Resists psychic damage and resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from mundane attacks. Fire damage immunity. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Flanked, Frightened, Paralyzed and Stunned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19. Common and Infernal.
appearance: A tall horned devil chancellor with dark feathered wings, gold-trimmed court clothing and a contract in hand.

sections.Traits:
Security for Speed (3/day). On a failed save, Lazivos can succeed instead. If he does, his speed is halved and he cannot take bonus actions or reactions until the end of his next turn.
Supernatural Resistance. He has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
True Name. If he hears a creature within 60 ft. speak his true name, Minto Abi, he loses his damage resistances, damage immunities, and Devilish Charm for 24 hours.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Infernal Rapier and Chancellor’s Decree.
Infernal Rapier. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. An infernal sigil marks the target until the end of the target’s next turn. While marked, it cannot hide or benefit from being Invisible, and attack rolls against it have advantage.
Chancellor’s Decree. Ranged spell attack +12, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 18 (2d10 + 7) psychic damage. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is Charmed by Lazivos until the end of his next turn. The charm ends early if Lazivos or one of his allies harms the target.
Diabolic Deposition (Recharge 5–6). Each enemy within 30 ft. that can hear Lazivos makes a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure the creature chooses either 27 (6d8) fire plus 27 (6d8) psychic damage or Dazed for 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each of the affected creature’s turns to end it early. On a success it chooses either half that damage or Dazed until the end of its next turn. An already Dazed creature must take the damage appropriate to its save result.
sections.Bonus Actions: As I Say. A creature Charmed by Lazivos must use its reaction, if available, to make a weapon attack against a target he chooses.
sections.Reactions: Devilish Charm. When a creature Lazivos can see within 60 ft. targets him with an attack, spell, power, or other supernatural effect, that creature makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, the creature is Charmed by Lazivos until the start of that creature’s next turn, and Lazivos redirects the triggering effect to a new target he can see within its range.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each once per encounter in any order, after an enemy’s turn and at most once per round.
Welcome, Friends. Up to three enemies within 60 ft. that can hear Lazivos make a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, a creature is Charmed by Lazivos for 1 hour and repeats its save at the end of its turns to end it early. The charm also ends if Lazivos or an ally harms that creature. On a successful initial save, the creature instead takes 16 (3d10) psychic damage.
Heed My Commands! Lazivos and each ally within 60 ft. can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature Charmed by Lazivos moves up to half its speed in the direction he chooses, without spending an action.
Deceptive Stratagem. Swap places with a willing creature within 120 ft. Immediately after the swap, up to five creatures Lazivos chooses within 120 ft. can make a melee attack without spending an action.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action, choosing just one. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, that turn ends. It still receives extra actions such as those from Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration can clear the condition.

ruleNotes: Diabolic Deposition uses the corrected Flee, Mortals! v1.1 targeting and save text.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Eighth City Advocacy Services, Lazivos calls a devil magistrate and eight notaries when combat begins. He flees at 75 HP or fewer. The paintings in his office can interfere with characters subjected to soul mining.

name: Durixaviinox
speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +14, Wis +8, Cha +10. Intimidation +10, Perception +8, Persuasion +10. Immune to cold and force damage. Passive Perception 18. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft. Common and Draconic.
appearance: The Ruined Providence is a pale ruin dragon with glacial blue wings and jagged horns like icicles.

sections.Traits:
Frosted Resistance (3/day). On a failed save, Durixaviinox can succeed instead. His speed is then halved and he cannot Disengage until the end of his next turn.
Hoarfrost. His cold damage ignores resistance.
Ice Walk. No ability check is needed to cross or climb ice. Ice and snow cost him no extra movement as difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing plus 9 (2d8) cold damage. The target loses reactions until the end of its next turn.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage. Durixaviinox can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Numbing Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 42 (12d6) cold damage and leaves the creature Restrained until the end of its next turn. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint.
sections.Bonus Actions: Icy Grip. A creature Durixaviinox can see within 60 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. Failure deals 22 (4d10) cold damage and leaves it Restrained in ice. Success halves the damage and avoids restraint. A creature can spend an action to free itself or another creature it can reach, ending the restraint.
sections.Reactions: Withering Frost. When a creature within 5 ft. hits him with an attack, every creature within 5 ft. of him makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 10 (3d6) cold damage.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn, and at most one per round.
Raging Blizzard. Each creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 18 Strength save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage, pushes the creature 60 ft. straight away from Durixaviinox and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and avoids the push and knockdown.
Royal Defense. Summon a spectral guard using the Frost Giant Wind Sprinter stat block with its type changed to Undead. It acts immediately after Durixaviinox and follows his verbal commands. He has resistance to all damage while it is within 60 ft. of him. The guard is destroyed if he dies.
Frost Cataclysm. Each enemy in a 120-ft.-radius sphere centered on Durixaviinox makes a DC 18 Constitution save against 45 (10d8) cold damage, then a separate DC 18 Strength save against 45 (10d8) force damage. Each successful save halves its respective damage.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses just one. If it becomes Dazed on its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions such as those from Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Durixaviinox’s Rest, use the separate lair actions in the throne area, including Fallen Army. The thin ice around the throne can give way under a Medium or larger creature.

name: Forzaantilirys
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +16, Wis +10, Cha +13. Athletics +17, Perception +10. Immune to fire and radiant damage. Passive Perception 20. Immune to Charmed, Dazed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified and Stunned. Blindsight 120 ft., truesight 60 ft. Common and Draconic.
appearance: The Ashen Song, printed as Forzaantirilys, is a blood dragon with dark obsidian scales and ember-lit crimson wings.

sections.Traits:
Hellfire. Her fire damage ignores resistance.
Ireful Defense (3/day). On a failed save, Forzaantilirys can succeed instead. Attacks against her then have advantage until the end of her next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 21 (2d10 + 10) piercing plus 14 (4d6) fire damage. The target catches fire.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d6 + 10) slashing damage. Forzaantilirys can move the target up to 15 ft. horizontally.
Scorching Breath (Recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 90-ft. cone make a DC 24 Dexterity save. Failure deals 70 (20d6) fire damage and destroys mundane metal items the creature wears or carries. Success halves the damage and preserves its gear. The cone stays aflame as difficult terrain until the end of Forzaantilirys’s next turn. A creature takes 14 (4d6) fire damage when it first enters that area on a turn or ends its turn there.
sections.Bonus Actions: Blazing Rush. Forzaantilirys moves up to half her speed. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage if she enters its space during this move.
sections.Reactions: Ignite the Insolent. When a creature attacks her from within 120 ft., the attacker makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. It catches fire on a failure.
sections.Catching fire: A creature set on fire by Bite or Ignite the Insolent takes 10 (3d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns for 1 minute. The creature or anyone who can reach it can use an action to put out the flames. Ignition on a later turn resets the duration without stacking damage.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn, and at most one per round.
Cinderfall. Smoke and cinders fill a 30-ft.-radius area around Forzaantilirys until the end of her next turn. The area is heavily obscured to everyone else. An enemy that needs to breathe and starts its turn inside must pass a DC 21 Constitution save or be Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Ashen Armor. Gain 100 temporary hit points. While any of them remain, a creature within 5 ft. that touches her or hits her with an attack takes 14 (4d6) fire damage.
Supernova. Each creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Constitution save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) fire plus 35 (10d6) radiant damage and leaves the creature Blinded until a spell, power, or similar supernatural effect removes the condition. Success halves the damage and avoids the blindness.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses just one. If it becomes Dazed on its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions such as those from Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Mount Brazen adds lava hazards and lair actions such as Flaming Step and Hard Light. In the encounter, Forzaantilirys alternates between flight and submerging herself in lava.

name: Frost Giant Wind Sprinter
otherStatistics: Issenblau plating. Saves Str +9, Con +7. Athletics +9, Intimidation +3, Perception +3. Immune to cold damage. Passive Perception 13. Giant.
appearance: A broad frost giant with an ice axe and overlapping blue issenblau armor plates.

sections.Traits:
Crush Underfoot. When the wind sprinter enters a Medium or smaller enemy’s space, that enemy chooses to fall Prone or take 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. Limit once per enemy per turn.
Oncoming Storm. A concentrating enemy that starts its turn within 15 ft. must make a DC 15 Constitution save or lose concentration.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Ice Axe attacks.
Ice Axe. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d10 + 6) slashing damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Blizzard Surge (Recharge 5–6). Move up to speed in a straight line. During the movement, make up to three Ice Axe attacks, each against a different creature.
sections.Reactions: Begone, Smallfolk! After a Medium or smaller creature makes an opportunity attack against the wind sprinter, the wind sprinter can make an Ice Axe attack against it.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Durixaviinox’s Rest, p. 232. The guard summoned by Royal Defense uses this block with the Undead type. It acts immediately after Durixaviinox on his commands, grants him resistance to all damage while within 60 ft., and is destroyed if he dies.

name: Human Brawler
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Athletics +5, Intimidation +3. Passive Perception 10. Common.
appearance: A bald, broad-shouldered fighter with scarred forearms, studded leather and a fur collar.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). When this creature makes an attack, it can give itself advantage on that attack roll.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Grab and Haymaker.
Grab. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the target is Grappled (escape DC 13). The brawler cannot use Grab on another creature until this grapple ends.
Haymaker. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (3d4 + 3) against a Grappled target.
Throw. Hurl a Medium or smaller creature the brawler is grappling, or an object the brawler is holding, up to 30 ft. horizontally. A thrown creature lands Prone. If the target would enter the space of a creature or solid obstacle no more than one size smaller than it, it collides, stops in the nearest unoccupied space, and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for each 10 ft. thrown. A Large or smaller creature struck by the thrown target must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or take the same damage and fall Prone.
sections.Reactions: Meat Shield. When a visible creature hits the brawler with a ranged attack while the brawler is grappling someone else, the brawler gains +2 AC against that attack. If the bonus turns the hit into a miss, the attack hits the Grappled creature instead.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a tavern enforcer, pit fighter, or gang lieutenant. Grab and Haymaker work together on one turn. Throw gives the brawler a way to clear a doorway or send someone into an obstacle.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Hanging Tree, p. 36. Burnock Mill, p. 62.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Flash Maggie has 77 HP at Truss Bridge (U1). She grabs lightly armored foes, shields herself with them, and tries to throw them off the bridge.

name: Human Storm Wizard
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saves Int +7, Wis +5. Arcana +7, History +7. Passive Perception 12. Common plus any two languages.
appearance: A white-haired weather mage in indigo robes, carrying a copper-tipped staff that crackles with blue lightning.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). When this creature makes an attack, it can give itself advantage on that attack roll.
sections.Actions:
Arcane Staff. Melee or ranged spell attack +7, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one target. Hit 21 (6d6) lightning damage.
Gust of Wind (1/day, 2nd-level spell, concentration). For up to 1 minute, wind extends from the wizard in a line 60 ft. long and 10 ft. wide. A creature starting its turn in the line must pass a DC 15 Strength save or be pushed 15 ft. away. Each foot of movement toward the wizard in the line costs 2 ft. The wind disperses vapor and gas, snuffs unprotected flames, and has a 50 percent chance to snuff protected flames.
Lightning Bolt (3/day, 3rd-level spell). Each creature in a line 100 ft. long and 5 ft. wide makes a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 28 (8d6) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects in the line ignite if they are neither worn nor carried.
sections.Bonus Actions: While concentrating on Gust of Wind, the wizard can aim the line in a different direction.
sections.Reactions: Arcane Shield (3/day). When an attack hits the wizard, the wizard gains +5 AC against that attack, which may turn it into a miss. An attacker within 10 ft. also makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) thunder damage and is pushed 10 ft. away.
sections.Utility Spells: Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 15). At will: Mage Hand and Prestidigitation. Once per day each: Clairvoyance (10-minute casting time), Mage Armor, See Invisibility, and Sending. All other spells in this list use one action.
sections.Elementalist variants:
Human Cryomancer. Change Arcane Staff and Arcane Shield to cold damage and replace Lightning Bolt with Ice Storm.
Human Pyromancer. Change Arcane Staff and Arcane Shield to fire damage, replace Gust of Wind with Flaming Sphere, and replace Lightning Bolt with Fireball.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a harbor mage, rival researcher, or guild defender. Gust of Wind can hold a narrow approach. Allied guards can protect the wizard while it lines up a Lightning Bolt.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Burnock Mill, p. 66. Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 131. The White Tower, p. 147.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At Truss Bridge (U1), Gray Walter casts from the scaffolding and uses Gust of Wind to push enemies off the bridge. Basil and Cransta use this block in the White Tower attic (X2b).

name: Human Guard
otherStatistics: Chain shirt and shield. Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. Common.
appearance: A watch guard in a gray chain shirt and steel cap, carrying a spear and a plain shield.

sections.Traits:
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the guard to 0 HP. The guard dies from any other effect that deals at least 5 damage. It ignores smaller amounts from those effects.
Overwhelm. When a Medium or smaller enemy starts its turn within 5 ft. of three or more guards that can see it, reduce its speed by 5 ft. for each guard within 5 ft. This lasts until the start of the enemy’s next turn. If this reduces its walking speed to 0, it is Restrained for the same duration.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per guard making or joining it.
sections.Actions: Spear (Group Attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five guards on the same turn can each spend their action to attack one target all of them can reach or target at range. Roll once at +3 plus the number of guards. On a hit, deal 1 piercing damage per guard, or 2 per guard if the roll had advantage. A solo guard uses +3. The group roll has advantage or disadvantage if all participants do. Divide guards with different cover or concealment into separate rolls. The target picks which guard receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If the same movement provokes from multiple guards, each can spend its reaction to join the melee Spear attack. Guards have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the initial guard’s 5 HP maximum drops one eligible additional guard to 0 HP for each 5 points of surplus or part thereof. For melee, eligible guards are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they are on the line from the attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill does not apply to opportunity attacks.
sections.Encounter uses: Use a few guards on a short stretch of wall or at a gate. Their formation can hold a doorway or delay a fleeing suspect.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Hanging Tree, p. 36. Burnock Mill, p. 64. The White Tower, p. 146.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: When Burnock Mill goes on alert, six guards leave the first floor and patrol the outside with Barrelhouse Jill. In the White Tower (X2a), ten guards share the barracks with two trickshots.

name: Human Scoundrel
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Deception +4, Sleight of Hand +5, Stealth +5. Passive Perception 10. Common.
appearance: A lean street duelist in charcoal studded leather with a rapier and a parrying dagger.

sections.Traits:
Ambusher. During the first round, the scoundrel has advantage on attack rolls against Surprised creatures.
Exploit Opening (3/day). When making an attack, the scoundrel can give itself advantage on that roll.
Hit ’Em Where It Hurts. A weapon hit deals 7 (2d6) extra damage when its attack roll had advantage.
sections.Actions:
Rapier. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The scoundrel can also make a Dagger attack against that target with advantage.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a guild thief, smuggler’s lookout, or rooftop ambusher. Opening with the rapier creates a chance to land the follow-up dagger strike with extra damage.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Burnock Mill, p. 65. The White Tower, p. 146.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Barrelhouse Jill uses this block at Burnock Mill (U5). A character who exposes Brother John's healing and succeeds on a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check can get Jill to turn on him until he is defeated.

name: Human Knave
otherStatistics: Breastplate and shield. Intimidation +4, Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. Common.
appearance: A dark-cloaked soldier with a steel breastplate, broad shield and spiked morningstar.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). When making an attack, this creature can give itself advantage on that roll.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Morningstar attacks or two Javelin attacks. The knave can replace one of those attacks with Shield Bash.
Morningstar. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) against a Prone target.
Shield Bash. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature that is hit must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall Prone.
Javelin. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Stay Down. One Prone creature within 5 ft. is kicked and must pass a DC 14 Constitution save. On a failure, its speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a bridge toll collector, mercenary sergeant, or gang enforcer. The knave can lead with Shield Bash, follow with Morningstar, then use Stay Down to keep a fallen target from standing.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Burnock Mill, p. 64. Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 130. The White Tower, p. 146.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Four knaves guard the White Tower entrance. At Burnock Mill, Beatrice the Cruel fights with Baron Uthrak and helps him knock enemies down.

name: Human Trickshot
otherStatistics: Perception +4, Stealth +6. Passive Perception 14. Common.
appearance: A hooded marksman in an olive tunic and worn red-brown cape, carrying a heavy crossbow with a bayonet.

sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). When making an attack, this creature can give itself advantage on that roll.
Point Blank Shooting. When a ranged weapon attack hits a creature within 30 ft. of the trickshot, it deals 7 (2d6) extra piercing damage. Enemies within 5 ft. do not impose disadvantage on the trickshot’s ranged attack rolls.
sections.Actions:
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Bayonet. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Ricochet Bolt (Recharge 5–6). Make a Heavy Crossbow attack against one target within 100 ft. of the trickshot, then another Heavy Crossbow attack against a different target within 30 ft. of the first target.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a rooftop lookout, convoy escort, or smuggler’s guard. Give the trickshot a firing position overlooking a route where targets may bunch up, such as a stair landing or alley mouth.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Burnock Mill, p. 67. Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 131. The White Tower, p. 147.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: When Burnock Mill goes on alert, two trickshots move to the roof. They have half cover against attacks from the ground.

name: Human Death Acolyte
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Passive Perception 12. Common.
appearance: A funerary attendant in a russet hood and worn leather, carrying a candle and bone pendant.

sections.Traits:
Death Chant. When an enemy succeeds on a death saving throw within 30 ft. of at least three acolytes who are not Incapacitated, count the success as a failure. On a natural 20, the enemy regains no hit points.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per acolyte making or joining the attack.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the acolyte to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 9 damage. The acolyte ignores smaller amounts from those effects.
sections.Actions:
Transfer Life (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 2 necrotic damage. If more than one acolyte made the attack, a creature they choose within 30 ft. of them recovers 1 HP per participating acolyte.
Necrotic Bolt (Group Attack). Ranged spell attack +4, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 2 necrotic damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five acolytes on the same turn can each spend an action to use the same attack against a target all can reach or attack at range. Roll once at +4 plus the number of acolytes. A hit deals 2 necrotic damage per acolyte, or 3 per acolyte with advantage. A lone acolyte uses +4. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Divide participants into separate rolls if the target has different cover or concealment against them. The target chooses which acolyte receives any response that affects only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If the same enemy movement provokes an opportunity attack from multiple acolytes, each can spend a reaction to join the melee Transfer Life attack. Acolytes have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the initial acolyte’s 9 HP maximum drops one eligible additional acolyte to 0 HP for each 9 points of surplus or part thereof. For melee, each eligible acolyte must be within the weapon’s reach. At range, it must be on the line from attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as crypt attendants or a cult leader’s escort. Three or more acolytes can keep Death Chant active. Players can break the formation to protect a fallen ally.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Burnock Mill, p. 63. Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 129.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At Burnock Mill (U5), six acolytes pray for Brother John during his bout with Barrelhouse Jill. Ten acolytes fight alongside the Havoc Host mercenaries in Ruins of Wrathrock.

name: Human Death Cultist
otherStatistics: Chain mail. Saves Wis +6, Cha +3. Intimidation +3, Religion +4. Passive Perception 14. Common plus any one language.
appearance: A cult leader in an oxblood cowl and black vestments over chain mail, carrying a ceremonial scythe.

sections.Traits: Exploit Opening (3/day). When making an attack, the cultist can give itself advantage on that roll.
sections.Actions:
Scythe. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The cultist regains HP equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
Death Bolt. Ranged spell attack +6, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target’s weapon attacks deal half damage until the start of the cultist’s next turn.
Blackfire Blessing (1/day). Choose up to ten non-minion allies within 30 ft. Their weapons deal an extra 2 (1d4) necrotic damage on a hit for 1 minute, or until the cultist dies.
sections.Bonus Actions: Rise, My Minions! (1/day). Choose up to three creatures within 30 ft. that died in the last minute. They return to life at 1 HP, cannot regain HP, and die after 1 minute.
sections.Reactions: Life from Death. When the cultist sees a creature within 30 ft. fail a death saving throw or die, the cultist chooses a creature within 30 ft. that is not Unconscious. It regains 14 (4d6) HP.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a burial cult leader or a necromancer’s lieutenant. The cultist can revive slain acolytes and use nearby deaths to heal a surviving ally.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Burnock Mill, p. 63. Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 130.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 123. A Havoc Host patrol consists of a death cultist and two human knaves. Its lanterns give characters advantage on the DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to see the patrol first.

name: Human Apprentice Mage
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Arcana +5. Passive Perception 10. Common plus any two languages.
appearance: A young mage with windswept hair, maroon studded leather, a blue cloak and an open spellbook.

sections.Traits:
Empower Patron. The mage chooses a non-minion patron. At the start of the patron’s turn, count the apprentice mages who chose that patron, are within 60 ft. of them, and can see them. The patron gains 2 temporary HP for each of those mages.
Exploit Weakness. An attack made with advantage deals 1 extra damage per apprentice making or joining it.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the mage to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 13 damage. The mage ignores smaller amounts from those effects.
sections.Actions:
Lightning Strike (Group Attack). Ranged spell attack +5, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit 2 lightning damage. If more than one mage made the attack, each participant picks a creature within 30 ft. of the original target. Each selected creature takes 2 lightning damage for each mage that picked it. Exploit Weakness adds no extra damage to these secondary effects.
Thunder Crack (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 thunder damage. The target loses opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five apprentice mages on the same turn can each spend an action to use the same attack on one target they can all reach or target at range. Make a single roll at +5 plus the number of mages. A hit deals the listed damage per participant. A solo mage uses +5. Advantage or disadvantage requires every mage to have it. Make separate rolls for groups with different cover or concealment. The target picks which mage receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. When the same creature provokes from multiple apprentices, each can spend its reaction to join Thunder Crack. Apprentices have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first apprentice’s 13 HP maximum drops one eligible additional apprentice to 0 HP per 13 surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, eligible apprentices are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they lie on the line through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.
sections.Elemental variants: For an acid, cold, or fire apprentice, change both Lightning Strike and Thunder Crack to that damage type. Participants in the same group attack must deal matching damage types.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as apprentices defending a patron or as guards at an arcane college. Breaking their line of sight weakens the patron’s protection.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At Truss Bridge (U1), Gray Walter's three apprentice sons fight from the scaffolding 10 ft. above the bridge.

name: Human Raider
otherStatistics: Padded armor and shield. AC 12 without shield. Stealth +3. Passive Perception 11. Common.
appearance: A close-shaven raider in a dark padded jack and russet trousers, carrying a round wooden shield and a handaxe.

sections.Traits:
Charge. If the raider moves at least 15 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with a melee attack that turn, the target takes 3 (1d6) extra damage.
Exploit Opening (3/day). When making an attack, the raider can give itself advantage on that roll.
sections.Actions:
Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Shield Shove. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature that is hit must pass a DC 12 Strength save or be pushed 5 ft. away from the raider.
sections.Reactions: Splinter Shield. While wielding a shield, when the raider is hit by a visible attacker, add +4 AC against that attack. If that changes the hit into a miss, the shield breaks. The raider’s AC falls by 2, and it loses Splinter Shield and Shield Shove until it gets another shield.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a roadside raider or camp outrider. An open path lets it charge. Around a bend or up close, it can use Shield Shove to clear space before retreating.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: The raiders on Burnock Mill's third floor try to shove intruders into the millstone or out of the crane bay. Dogface uses this block if attacked. If recruited, he uses the Human Mercenary block instead.

name: Hobgoblin Death Captain
otherStatistics: Plate and shield. Saves Con +6, Wis +4. Athletics +7, History +5, Intimidation +5, Perception +4. Fire resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A tusked and horned field commander in dark plate with a purple cloak, a worn shield and a violet-edged sword.

sections.Traits:
Battle Ready. While the captain is not Incapacitated, the captain and allies within 60 ft. that can hear them have advantage on initiative rolls and cannot be Surprised.
Infernal Ichor. When this hobgoblin dies, every creature within 5 ft. takes 5 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Blightblade attacks or two Eye Fire attacks. The captain can replace one attack with On My Mark.
Blightblade. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Eye Fire. Ranged spell attack +6, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) fire damage.
On My Mark. One ally within 60 ft. that can hear the captain can make a weapon attack without spending an action. A hit deals an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Lead the Charge (1/day). The captain and allies within 30 ft. that can see the captain can each move up to their own speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Reactions: Hidden Gift (3/day). When an ally the captain can see within 30 ft. takes damage, the captain magically turns that ally Invisible. The effect lasts until the end of the ally’s next turn. It ends early if the ally attacks, deals damage, or forces another creature to make a saving throw.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a raiding-party commander or a fortification officer. The captain can reposition the squad, call for an attack at the right moment, or help an injured ally withdraw.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, p. 72, area C6. A death captain feasts with three incendiarists and thirty recruits. The recruits are Poisoned from drink, so characters have advantage on Charisma checks to influence them.

name: Hobgoblin War Mage
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Saves Int +6, Cha +5. Arcana +6, History +6. Fire resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A lean, horned hobgoblin in dark jade robes over a chain shirt, carrying a crooked bone-inlaid staff.

sections.Traits: Infernal Ichor. When this hobgoblin dies, every creature within 5 ft. takes 5 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Infernal Teleport. Melee spell attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must pass a DC 14 Charisma save or the mage teleports it up to 15 ft. to an empty space the mage can see.
Rain Hellfire (2nd-level spell). Choose a point the mage can see within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft.-radius sphere centered there makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) fire damage. Success halves the damage. Fire spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren’t worn or carried.
Unhallowed Ground (3rd-level spell, concentration). Choose a point on the ground the mage can see within 60 ft. Enemies in the 20-ft. square centered on that point have vulnerability to fire damage for as long as they are in the area. The square lasts up to 1 minute.
sections.Reactions: Spell Siphon. When a visible creature within 60 ft. casts a spell, it must pass a DC 14 Dexterity save or take 3 (1d6) force damage per level of that spell, with a minimum of 1d6.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a camp mage or siege caster. Infernal Teleport can move enemies into Unhallowed Ground, where allied fire attacks become more dangerous.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, area C7. Three war mages maintain a ritual. It summons a slaughter demon at the start of the fourth round after the party arrives unless all three mages are killed, Incapacitated, or moved outside the ring of pillars.

name: Hobgoblin Firerunner
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Save Dex +6. Acrobatics +6. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A lean red-orange hobgoblin skirmisher with swept horns, light studded leather, and a fire-wreathed scimitar.

sections.Traits:
Fiery Leap. The firerunner can long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft., with or without a running start. The first time it lands after a jump on its turn, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
Infernal Ichor. When the firerunner dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 5 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fire Scimitar attacks.
Fire Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.
Blaze Sprint (Recharge 5–6). Move up to the firerunner’s speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each creature the firerunner comes within 5 ft. of during that move makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. Failure deals 10 (3d6) fire damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a camp outrider or a skirmisher in broken terrain. On a clear route it can sprint past several opponents, then use gaps or ledges to spread the party out.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Camp Firefield, p. 77. The White Tower, p. 145.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Camp Firefield, a firerunner waits by the barracks gate if Oki raises the alarm. Two firerunners guard the White Tower library with a bugbear channeler and commander.

name: Hobgoblin Trooper
otherStatistics: Ring mail and shield. Athletics +4, Perception +2. Fire resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A tusked hobgoblin in worn ring mail with a large bone-faced shield and a burning military flail.

sections.Traits: Infernal Ichor. When the trooper dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 2 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Fire Flail. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Another target within 5 ft. of the first takes 2 (1d4) fire damage.
Brimstone Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 2 (1d4) fire damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Fight Me, Coward. Hex a creature within 5 ft. that is not already hexed by another trooper. Until the start of this trooper’s next turn, the first time on any turn that the hexed creature damages a creature other than this trooper, the hexed creature takes 5 fire damage.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as a shield-line guard or officer’s bodyguard. The hex pressures characters to trade blows with the trooper while its allies reposition.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, area C5. Six wounded troopers each have 9 HP instead of 18. They avoid fighting and surrender if threatened.

name: Hobgoblin Brandbearer
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A red-skinned hobgoblin in layered hide and bronze, carrying a brazier-topped standard and a worn round shield.

sections.Traits:
Infernal Ichor. A creature within 5 ft. that reduces the brandbearer to 0 HP takes 1 fire damage.
Too Hot to Handle. When an enemy takes fire damage from a non-minion creature, it takes an extra 1 fire damage for each brandbearer within 5 ft. of it.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the brandbearer to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 12 damage. The brandbearer ignores smaller amounts from those effects.
sections.Actions: Searing Grasp (Group Attack). Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 fire damage. On a hit by at least three brandbearers, the target also has disadvantage on saves against fire-damaging spells, powers, and other supernatural effects until the start of the brandbearers’ next turn.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five brandbearers on the same turn can each spend an action to use Searing Grasp on a target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +5 plus the number of participants. A hit deals 4 fire damage per participant. A lone brandbearer uses +5. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Use separate rolls for groups with different cover or concealment. The target picks which brandbearer receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If an enemy provokes at the same time from multiple brandbearers, each can spend its reaction to join a Searing Grasp attack. Brandbearers have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first brandbearer’s 12 HP maximum drops one eligible additional brandbearer to 0 HP per 12 surplus damage or part thereof. For melee, eligible brandbearers are within the weapon’s reach. At range, they lie on the line from the attacker through the first target, within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.
sections.Encounter uses: Use behind a shield line beside a War Mage or another non-minion ally with fire attacks. A group can set up a tougher fire save, then the caster can follow while the brandbearers keep close to the enemy.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, area C5. Eight brandbearers and a war mage tend wounded troopers. The party can go around the tent with a successful DC 12 group Dexterity (Stealth) check.

name: Hobgoblin Incendiarist
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Perception +5. Fire resistance. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A red-skinned hobgoblin in worn leather armor, holding an incendiary clay pot and a burning taper.

sections.Traits: Infernal Ichor. When the incendiarist dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Blazing Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. A creature hit catches fire and takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the end of each of its turns. It, or another creature that can reach it, can use an action to put out the flames. A hit against an already burning creature deals the normal piercing damage without adding a second burning effect.
Fire Mote (Recharge 6). Choose a creature the incendiarist can see within 100 ft. It makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage and falls Prone if Large or smaller. Every other creature within 15 ft. of that target also makes a DC 13 Dexterity save and takes 3 (1d6) fire damage on a failure.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as siege artillery or a lookout guarding a long approach. Fire Mote can force a tightly packed group to spread out.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, areas C3 and C4. The barracks incendiarists stand by the bonfire if Oki raises the alarm. Narine is the armory smith. Her sword pendant is a key to the field hospital.

name: Hobgoblin Smokebinder
speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. in smoke form
otherStatistics: Studded leather and shield. Stealth +5. Fire resistance. In smoke form, resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks and is immune to Grappled and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A dark red, horned hobgoblin with a battered shield and curls of gray smoke drifting from its armor.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous (Smoke Form Only). The smokebinder can move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Infernal Ichor. When the smokebinder dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 3 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Toxic Flame. Melee spell attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage. With advantage on the attack, a hit also leaves the target Poisoned and unable to speak until the end of its next turn.
Choking Bolt. Ranged spell attack +5, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d8) fire damage. With advantage on the attack, a hit also leaves the target unable to speak until the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Smoke Form (1/day). Transform into magical gray smoke for 1 minute, including worn and carried gear. Gain a flying speed equal to walking speed, resistance to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing attacks, and immunity to Grappled and Restrained. Revert as a bonus action or immediately upon becoming Incapacitated or dying.
Sneak (Smoke Form Only). Take the Hide action.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as an infiltrator who passes through a narrow gap, hides, and strikes from ambush. It can switch back to physical form as needed.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, p. 72, area C7. The smokebinder hides behind the obsidian arch while three war mages conduct their ritual. Passive Perception 17 spots the guard. If the ritual continues, a slaughter demon appears at the start of round four after the characters arrive.

name: Hobgoblin Recruit
otherStatistics: Leather armor and shield. Immune to fire damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A young hobgoblin in plain leather with a cloth headband, a wooden shield and a longsword.

sections.Traits:
Infernal Ichor. A creature within 5 ft. that reduces the recruit to 0 HP takes 1 fire damage.
Minion. Damage from an attack or failed save drops the recruit to 0 HP. Any other effect kills it if it deals at least 7 damage. The recruit ignores smaller amounts from those effects.
Tactical Positioning. When a non-minion ally attacks a creature, the ally adds +1 to the attack roll for each recruit within 5 ft. of the target, to a maximum of +5.
sections.Actions: Longsword (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 slashing damage.
sections.Minion rules:
Group attack. Two to five recruits on the same turn can each spend an action to attack one target within reach of all of them. Roll once at +4 plus the number of participants. A hit deals 1 slashing damage per participant. A lone recruit uses +4. Advantage or disadvantage applies if all participants have it. Roll separately for groups facing different cover or concealment. The target picks which recruit receives any response that can affect only one attacker.
Group opportunity attack. If an enemy provokes at the same time from multiple recruits, they can each spend a reaction to join a Longsword attack. Recruits have no Hit Dice and cannot score critical hits.
Overkill. Weapon damage above the first recruit’s 7 HP maximum drops one eligible additional recruit to 0 HP for each 7 points of surplus or part thereof. For melee, eligible recruits are within reach of the weapon. At range, they lie on the line from the attacker through the first target and within the weapon’s short range. Overkill excludes opportunity attacks.
sections.Encounter uses: Use as training-yard guards or a junior shield line. Recruit placement helps an officer’s attacks and gives the party a reason to break up the formation.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, area C3. Twenty recruits are in the barracks. If Oki raises the alarm, they are ready at the entrance gate with the troopers and firerunner.

name: Grilp
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +6, Perception +3. Immune to fire and necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A green-skinned devil about the size of a housecat. Its skin changes color and texture to match its surroundings.

sections.Traits: Shifting Camouflage. The grilp has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can hide even while creatures are watching it.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become vulnerable to fire and necrotic damage until the start of the grilp’s next turn.
Necrotic Mote. Ranged spell attack +3, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Encounter uses: Use it as a flying scout or courier for a hobgoblin camp. In an ambush, have an ally follow up with fire or necrotic damage before the grilp’s next turn.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, area C2. A DC 18 Wisdom (Perception) check spots the twelve grilps in the tall grass. Oki’s malachite opens the barracks gate when brought within 5 ft. of the arch. If overlooked, she opens it to warn the barracks and drops the stone on the path.

name: Slaughter Demon
classification: Huge Fiend (Demon, Category 3), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +9, Dex +3, Con +8. Athletics +9, Perception +7. Fire resistance. Immune to Flanked. Darkvision 60 ft., Soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 17. Abyssal, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A towering, serpent-bodied demon with six pincers and a venomous tail spike.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four attacks in any combination of Pincer, Sword, and Javelin. One of the four can be replaced with Tail Spike. Spend 1 soul to add one Pincer, Sword, or Javelin attack.
Pincer. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained while that grapple lasts. Each of the demon’s six pincers can hold a grappled target or wield a weapon.
Sword. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage.
Tail Spike. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d10 + 6) piercing damage. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the effect on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Dive Deep (1 soul). Take the Disengage action and gain a burrowing speed equal to the demon’s walking speed until the end of its next turn.
sections.Encounter uses: Use Pincer to hold the front line and Javelin to reach foes farther away. Track the soul total as the demon spends it on extra attacks or burrowing. At zero souls, Lethe can turn it against the closest creature it senses, even an ally.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, p. 72, area C7. Three war mages summon the demon at the start of round four after the party arrives. The ritual fails if every mage dies, becomes Incapacitated, or leaves the ring of pillars.

name: Bloodlord Varrox
otherStatistics: Plate armor. Saves Wis +5, Cha +5. Arcana +3, Athletics +7, History +3, Intimidation +5. Resists fire and necrotic damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Common, Goblin, Infernal.
appearance: A horned hobgoblin warlord in dark plate, brandishing a curved sword and purple flaming skulls.

sections.Traits:
Infernal Ichor. When Varrox dies, each creature within 5 ft. takes 5 fire damage.
Infernal Sacrifice (3/day). When Varrox fails a saving throw, he can turn it into a success. Each ally within 60 ft. then takes 5 necrotic damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Soulsword and Death Skulls.
Soulsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A creature hit cannot regain HP until the start of Varrox’s next turn.
Death Skulls. Ranged weapon attack +7, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. On a hit, Varrox can teleport to a vacant space he can see within 5 ft. of the target.
sections.Bonus Actions: Advance and Attack. Choose one ally within 60 ft. who can hear Varrox. That ally can spend its reaction to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack.
sections.Reactions: An Army from Blood. When a non-minion hobgoblin Varrox can see within 60 ft. takes damage, Varrox magically summons three hobgoblin recruits in the vacant spaces nearest that hobgoblin.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn. Use at most one per round.
Uncanny Leadership. Choose up to six non-minion allies within 60 ft. who can see or hear Varrox. Varrox and each chosen ally gain 10 temporary HP and can move up to their speed.
Hellish Transport. Varrox and each ally within 60 ft. can teleport up to 60 ft. to a vacant space that creature can see.
I Am Fire and Death. Enemies within 20 ft. make a DC 15 Constitution save against 11 (2d10) fire plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, taking half as much on success. Black flames then surround Varrox for 1 minute. Each time a creature touches him or hits him with an attack from within 5 ft., it takes 5 (1d10) fire plus 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
sections.Encounter uses: Varrox trains his army in Camp Firefield, a demiplane reached through his pavilion. His line officers give him targets for Advance and Attack and can trigger his recruit summons when wounded.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Camp Firefield, p. 72, area C8. Varrox fights alongside four hobgoblin troopers, a firerunner, and a war mage. At 20 HP he tries to retreat through the camp. Page 74 gives an optional returning version with 168 HP and Strength 24, or a return as a devil adjudicator or a vampire.

name: Baron Uthrak
otherStatistics: Half plate. Saves Str +7, Con +7. Athletics +10, Deception +6, Insight +5, Intimidation +9, Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. Common.
appearance: A bearded mercenary captain in half plate and a fur-lined cloak. His magic longsword, Nine Lives, has bloodstones set in its pommel.

sections.Traits:
Bloodstones (3 uses). When Uthrak fails a save while holding Nine Lives, he can succeed instead. If he does, he takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Exploit Opening (3/day). When Uthrak makes an attack, he can roll it with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Nine Lives and Whip.
Nine Lives. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Whip. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage. On a failed DC 15 Strength save, the target is pulled up to 15 ft. toward Uthrak.
sections.Bonus Actions: Kneel, Peasant! A Large or smaller creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure it takes 6 (1d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Riposte. When a creature Uthrak can see misses him with a melee attack, he makes a melee attack against that creature.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each once per encounter, in any order after an enemy’s turn. Use at most one per round.
Shoot! Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Uthrak can make a ranged weapon attack without spending an action.
Form Up! Uthrak and each ally within 60 ft. who can hear him can move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Each enters a defensive stance that ends when that creature moves again or becomes Restrained or Incapacitated. When at least two allies in the stance are within 5 ft. of one another, attack rolls against them have disadvantage.
Lead from the Front. Uthrak moves up to twice his speed without provoking opportunity attacks. During or after this move he can make up to four attacks with advantage, choosing Nine Lives or Whip for each and using a different target each time. After each attack, each ally within 5 ft. of that target can make a melee attack with advantage against the same target without spending an action.
sections.Encounter uses: Uthrak lost his title after backing a failed rebellion. He now leads a mercenary band. Place melee guards close enough to form a line and ranged allies within earshot so his commands have targets.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Burnock Mill, p. 59, area U7. While the machinery is running, Uthrak uses his whip to pull intruders into the millstone. At 25 HP or fewer, he uses the whip and crane to escape into the channel 30 ft. below.

name: Kingfissure Worm
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Save Con +11. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 30 ft., Tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A colossal purple worm with armored segments, a fanged maw, and three long tongues.

sections.Traits:
Multiple Tongues. Track three tongues separately. A tongue can be targeted by attacks only while it is grappling a creature. It has AC 20 and is immune to psychic damage. If it takes at least 35 damage in a single turn, it is destroyed and releases its captive. The worm regains destroyed tongues after a long rest. Damage to a tongue never damages the worm.
Slowed, Not Stopped (3/day). On a failed save, the worm can succeed instead. Each use reduces its speed and Tongue Grab reach by 10 ft. until it finishes a long rest, with a minimum of 5 ft. for each.
Tunneler. The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its burrowing speed, leaving a tunnel 10 ft. in diameter.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make up to one Tongue Grab per tongue the worm still has. Replace any number of these attacks with Swallow.
Tongue Grab. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) acid damage and grapple the target (escape DC 19). That tongue is unavailable against other targets until the grapple ends.
Maw. Melee weapon attack +14, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d8 + 9) piercing damage. A Huge or smaller target must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity save or be swallowed as if by Swallow.
Swallow. Swallow a Huge or smaller creature the worm is grappling. The grapple ends. The swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from outside attacks and effects, and takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worm’s turns.
If a creature inside deals at least 30 damage to the worm in a single turn, the worm makes a DC 21 Constitution check at the end of that turn.
