On a failure, it disgorges every swallowed creature into empty spaces within 10 ft., where they land Prone. After the worm dies, a swallowed creature can spend 20 ft. of movement to escape and exit Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Tongue Sweep. A creature the worm is grappling takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. Each enemy within 10 ft. of that creature makes a DC 16 Dexterity save or takes the same damage.
sections.Reactions: Tongue Recall. When a tongue takes damage and survives, the worm can release its captive and retract the tongue. Attacks can target it again once it grapples a creature.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each can be used once per encounter in any order after an enemy’s turn, at most one per round.
Open the Earth. Open a fissure starting at the worm, 20 ft. wide, 100 ft. long, and 40 ft. deep. Creatures in the area make a DC 19 Dexterity save. Failure drops them into the fissure for 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage and leaves them Prone. Success moves them to the closest unoccupied space outside the fissure.
Earth Breach. The worm burrows up to half its speed and bursts through the surface in a 10-ft.-radius circle. Each Huge or smaller creature in the circle makes a DC 19 Dexterity save or is swallowed as if by Swallow.
Better Out Than In. Creatures in a 60-ft. cone make a DC 19 Dexterity save against 21 (6d6) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) acid damage, halved on a success. The worm also ejects each swallowed creature, dealing 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage to it and placing it Prone in an empty space of the worm’s choice in the cone.
sections.Encounter uses: Use an existing fissure to stage the first tongue grab. Track tongue damage separately within each turn so the party can choose between freeing a captive and attacking the worm.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Glass Cavern, area R1. The bound worm attacks after an unauthorized creature stays on the ground for 1 minute. Treat its binding sigils as a 9th-level spell for Dispel Magic. If freed, it attacks the nearest creature it senses and flees at 100 HP. If combat lasts more than three rounds, a red fist arrives from area R3.

name: Weeping Willow
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning and piercing. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common, Elvish, and Sylvan.
appearance: A willow with hanging branches that shed salty tears.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless willow looks like an ordinary tree.
Flammable. Fire damage ignites it for 1 minute. It takes 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns while burning. Cold damage puts it out, or a creature can spend an action to extinguish it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Frenzied Branch attacks.
Frenzied Branch. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 30-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning, plus 3 (1d6) fire if the willow is burning.
Tugging Roots. Choose a visible point on the ground within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10-ft. sphere centered there makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure, it falls Prone and the roots pull it up to 30 ft. toward the willow. It takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning for every 10 ft. moved.
Willow’s Tears. Each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes Charmed by the willow. Affected creatures cannot willingly move farther than 15 ft. from it and repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the effect. Taking damage ends the charm on that creature.
sections.Reactions: Tree Transformation. When a creature within 5 ft. deals slashing damage to the willow, that creature makes a DC 14 Constitution save. If it fails, its feet take root and it is Restrained. It repeats the save at the end of its next turn. A success frees it. A failure makes it Petrified as a tree of its own size, with its face visible in the trunk. If the willow dies, the petrified creature returns to its original form. The Cure Ailment power or Lesser Restoration spell also ends the effect.
sections.Encounter uses: Place the willow beside a path where its branches can reach across the road. Pull targets into range of its tears and track which creatures have a Tree Transformation save due on their next turn.

name: Bredbeddle
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Deception +6, Perception +4, Stealth +3. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range in true form. Passive Perception 14. Common and Giant, with speech available only while transformed.
appearance: A headless giant that carries an executioner’s axe.

sections.Traits:
Headless. In true form, immune to Blinded and Deafened.
Rejuvenation. After death, return at full HP in 1d6 months. A destroyed body reforms in the nearest unoccupied space to the place of death. The Wish spell or destruction of the giant’s true head stops this return.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Executioner’s Axe attacks.
Executioner’s Axe. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 23 (3d10 + 7) slashing.
Beheading Strike (Recharge 5–6). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 15-ft. reach. Choose one Large or smaller Giant or Humanoid with a head. Hit 40 (6d10 + 7) slashing. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, its head lands at its feet. It survives while above 0 HP and is Blinded, Deafened, and unable to speak. A creature can spend an action to reattach the head and end the effect. Separation beyond 24 hours kills the target.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Get a Head. Attach a Giant or Humanoid head within 15 ft. to assume that creature’s form and size. The Bredbeddle can speak and see normally, gains the head’s special senses, and loses Headless. Its equipment resizes and keeps its statistics. Death, head removal, or 24 hours ends the disguise. The head then falls off and cannot be reused by the Bredbeddle. A creature within reach can spend an action and succeed on a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check to remove it.
Toss Head. While transformed, remove the head and return to true form. Throw the head at a visible creature within 60 ft. It lands in the target’s space. The target takes 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save.
sections.Encounter uses: Start with the giant in disguise on a road. Track the borrowed head separately from the giant’s true head and from any head removed during combat.

name: Bonestalker
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Wis +5, Cha +8. Insight +5, Perception +5, Stealth +7. Immune to psychic damage and the Charmed and Frightened conditions. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Common and Sylvan.

sections.Traits:
Bones of the Lost. Start with 5 (2d4) skulls. Choose a type for each skull or roll a d4 (1 Beast, 2 Fey, 3 Humanoid, 4 Monstrosity). Destroy skulls to fuel abilities. The GM can allow the Bonestalker to collect more skulls during a fight.
Skull Resistance. While it has a skull, it has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Touch of the Felled or two Scream of the Forsaken attacks. The Bonestalker can also use Grief of the Bygone if it has enough skulls.
Touch of the Felled. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) necrotic. On a hit, it can destroy a Humanoid or Monstrosity skull to deal another 10 (3d6) psychic damage to the target.
Scream of the Forsaken. Ranged spell attack, +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) psychic. On a hit, it can destroy a Fey skull to force a DC 16 Wisdom save. On failure, the target is Frightened of the Bonestalker until the start of the Bonestalker’s next turn.
Grief of the Bygone. Destroy two skulls of any type to create a 15-ft.-radius sphere of magical darkness around a visible point within 60 ft. It lasts 1 minute, spreads around corners, and blocks mundane light and darkvision. The Bonestalker is unaffected and has advantage on attacks against creatures in the darkness. Every other creature that starts its turn inside makes a DC 16 Wisdom save, taking 14 (4d6) psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Reactions: Power from the Conquered. When hit by an attack, destroy a Beast skull to become Invisible until the end of its next turn.
sections.Utility Spells: With Charisma (spell save DC 16), cast Minor Illusion at will or Silent Image three times per day. Each casting takes an action.

name: Dancing Lady
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +3, Wis +7. Vulnerable to fire. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Flanked, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 120 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 13. Understands Druidic and Sylvan and cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Dancing Flowers. The Dancing Lady has three flowers that look like life-sized dancers. Track each separately at AC 16 and 5 HP, with fire vulnerability, psychic immunity, and disadvantage on attacks against it. Destroying a flower leaves the Dancing Lady’s HP intact. Destroyed flowers regrow at the end of the Dancing Lady’s turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 25 (3d12 + 6) bludgeoning.
Blood-Red Waltz. For each remaining flower, choose up to one visible creature within 60 ft. of the Dancing Lady. Each target makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage and the Dancing Lady moves it to an unoccupied space within 60 ft. of itself. On a success, it takes half damage and stays in place.
Disarming Quickstep. For each remaining flower, choose up to one visible creature within 60 ft. of the Dancing Lady. Each target makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage and is Dazed until the start of the Dancing Lady’s next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and avoids Dazed.
Ballet of Terror (1/day). Each enemy within 120 ft. that can smell the flowers’ mist makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the Dancing Lady for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Reactions: Somber Dirge. When a visible attacker hits the Dancing Lady, redirect the hit to one of its flowers.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of moving, taking an action, or taking a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed on its own turn, that turn ends. Extra actions such as those from Haste or Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can end the condition.

name: Rotbeast
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Forest Rot. When the Rotbeast dies, each non-Fungus creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On a failure, it gains one level of Exhaustion and contracts forest rot.
Forest rot halves the HP a creature recovers by spending Hit Dice or finishing a long rest. It prevents the normal long-rest reduction in Exhaustion. On finishing each long rest, the infected creature makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure adds one level of Exhaustion. Success removes one level, and the creature recovers from forest rot if that success leaves its Exhaustion below 1.
Rotwake. Each space the Rotbeast leaves is difficult terrain for 24 hours for creatures other than rotbeasts. A non-Fungus creature that enters such a space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 13 Constitution save. It takes 3 (1d6) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Weakening Horns, Rotting Hooves, or a mix of the two.
Weakening Horns. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. The target has disadvantage on Constitution saves until the end of the target’s next turn.
Rotting Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the target contracts forest rot.
sections.Bonus Actions: Healing Rot (1/day). Regain 3 (1d6) HP for each creature within 60 ft. that has forest rot.

name: Empyrean Stag
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +8, Wis +10, Cha +10. Athletics +12, Insight +10, Perception +10. Resists necrotic and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to radiant damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, and Frightened. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 20. Speaks all languages. Telepathy 120 ft.

sections.Traits: Supernatural Resistance. The stag has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Ram or Lightburst.
Ram. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing.
Lightburst. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit 18 (3d8 + 5) radiant. The target glows, granting advantage on attacks against it until the start of the stag’s next turn.
Starcall (1/day). Choose a 60-ft.-long, 5-ft.-wide area within 120 ft. Each enemy there makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 28 (8d6) radiant on a failure or half on a success. Each other willing creature there regains 15 HP. A 10-ft.-high opaque wall of light then fills the area. Creatures in the wall are pushed out by the shortest route, each choosing which side to end up on. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the stag is Incapacitated or dies. An enemy entering the wall for the first time on a turn makes a DC 18 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) radiant on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Starlight Infusion. Choose a willing creature the stag can see within 60 ft. Its weapon attacks deal an extra 5 radiant damage until the start of the stag’s next turn.
sections.Reactions: Nature’s Ward. When the stag takes damage or sees a creature within 30 ft. take damage, conjure a barrier to reduce that damage by 20. The barrier then vanishes.

name: Bugbear Channeler
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saves Wis +6, Cha +7. Skills Arcana +5, Perception +6, Stealth +5, Survival +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common and Goblin.

sections.Traits: Bugbear’s Inspiration. Allied Humanoids within 15 ft. have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves if they can see or hear this bugbear.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Channeling Staff attacks.
Channeling Staff. Melee spell attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 9 (2d8) lightning damage. The channeler may also move a Large or smaller creature it hits up to 10 ft. horizontally.
Vine Eruption (3/day, 4th-level spell). One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure deals 27 (5d10) piercing and binds the target in vines, leaving it Restrained. Success halves the damage and avoids the vines. The bound creature takes 5 (1d10) piercing at the start of each of its turns until the vines are destroyed. The vines have AC 15, 10 HP, and immunity to psychic damage.
Ball Lightning (1/day, 7th-level spell, concentration). Create a 20-ft.-radius sphere at a visible point within 120 ft. It lasts up to 1 minute. An enemy that starts its turn in the sphere takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed DC 15 Dexterity save.
sections.Bonus Actions: While Ball Lightning is active, move its sphere up to 20 ft.
sections.Reactions: Shared Shield (2/day, 2nd-level spell). When a visible creature within 30 ft. is hit by an attack, give that creature +5 AC against the triggering attack and until the start of the channeler’s next turn.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, spell save DC 15. Light and Message at will. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, and Identify once each per day. Identify takes 1 minute. The others each take an action.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: The White Tower, p. 141, area X5. A channeler, a commander, and two hobgoblin firerunners guard the suspended library. A creature that climbs or flies can use the shelves as cover and sneak past with a DC 17 Dexterity (Stealth) check.

name: Bugbear Commander
otherStatistics: Plate. Saves Wis +5, Cha +5. Skills Intimidation +5, Persuasion +5, Stealth +5, Survival +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Goblin.

sections.Traits: Commander’s Inspiration. Allied Humanoids within 30 ft. who can see or hear the commander gain advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves and +1 to weapon attack and damage rolls.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make either two Greatsword attacks or two Longbow attacks.
Greatsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing. One ally who can see the commander and is within 30 ft. of the target gains advantage on its next melee attack against that target before the start of the commander’s next turn.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing.
Bark Orders (recharge 6). Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear and understand the commander may use its reaction to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack.
sections.Reactions: Bolstering Pride. When another creature within 60 ft. rolls a save, the commander can give it advantage if it can hear and understand the commander.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: The White Tower, p. 141, area X5. The commander and channeler guard the suspended library with two hobgoblin firerunners.

name: Bugbear Predator
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Save Dex +5. Skills Perception +6, Stealth +7, Survival +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16. Speaks Common and Goblin.

sections.Traits:
Bugbear’s Inspiration. Allied Humanoids within 15 ft. have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves if they can see or hear this bugbear.
Dirty Fighting. If the predator hits a creature with a melee weapon attack rolled with advantage, that creature must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or become Blinded until the end of its next turn.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Curved Dagger attacks or two Longbow attacks. If both hit the same target, the predator gains advantage on its next attack against that target before the end of its next turn.
Curved Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit for 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing.
Go for the Eyes (1/day). Each ally within 30 ft. that can hear and understand the predator gains Dirty Fighting until the start of the predator’s next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Guerilla Training. Take the Dash or Hide action.

name: Bugbear Regular
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Common and Goblin.

sections.Traits:
Bodyblock. An enemy that is Medium or smaller cannot see farther than 15 ft. while within 5 ft. of at least three Bugbear Regulars that are neither Prone nor Incapacitated.
Bugbear’s Encouragement. An allied Humanoid within 5 ft. that can see or hear the regular gains +1 to Wisdom saves. Add this bonus from each eligible regular.
sections.Actions: Bullyclub (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 1 bludgeoning.

name: Bugbear Roughneck
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Skills Athletics +5, Stealth +4, Survival +3. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Common and Goblin.

sections.Traits: Bugbear’s Inspiration. Allied Humanoids within 15 ft. have advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saves if they can see or hear this bugbear.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (Battle Fury only). Make two Handaxe attacks.
Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit for 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing.
Bugbear Battle Cry (1/day). Allies within 15 ft. who can hear and understand the roughneck gain advantage on attacks until the start of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Battle Fury (1/day). For 1 minute, the roughneck can use Multiattack and resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks.

name: Kobold Adeptus
otherStatistics: Shield. Skills Athletics +1, Arcana +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, this kobold gains +1 AC if it is within 5 ft. of an ally who has this trait, wields a shield, and is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
sections.Actions:
Firecracker. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (2d4) fire. The target is Deafened until the end of its next turn unless it succeeds on a DC 12 Constitution save.
Shocking Grasp (cantrip). Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Roll with advantage if the target wears metal armor. Hit for 4 (1d8) lightning and prevent the target from taking reactions until the start of its next turn.
Lesser Magic Missile (1/day, 1st-level spell). Fire three darts simultaneously. Each automatically hits one creature the adeptus can see within 120 ft. and deals 2 (1d2 + 1) force damage. Choose the same or different targets. Other effects treat it as Magic Missile.

name: Kobold Artifex
otherStatistics: Chain shirt and shield. Skill Athletics +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, this kobold gains +1 AC if it is within 5 ft. of an ally who has this trait, wields a shield, and is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Chain Hook attack and use Activate Trap if available.
Chain Hook. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 15/30 ft., one target. Hit for 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing. If a Large or smaller creature is hit, it must pass a DC 12 Strength save or be pulled up to 15 ft. toward the artifex.
Activate Trap (3/day). Trigger one trap described below at a visible ground point within 60 ft. A trap cannot be used on consecutive rounds.
sections.Traps:
Spiky Pit Trap. A 15-ft.-square trapdoor centered on the point opens onto a spiked pit 10 ft. deep. Each creature on the ground in that area makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On failure, it falls in for 3 (1d6) piercing from spikes and 3 (1d6) bludgeoning from the fall. On success, move it to the closest unoccupied space outside the trapdoor.
Swarm of Bees Trap. Fill a cylinder 15 ft. in radius and 10 ft. high with bees. A creature first entering the swarm on a turn or starting a turn inside it makes a DC 12 Constitution save. Failure deals 5 (2d4) poison and leaves it Poisoned until the end of its next turn. Success halves damage and avoids the condition. At the start of each artifex turn, move the swarm 10 ft. straight away from the artifex. It disperses after 1 minute or when the artifex dies.
Wall of Fire Trap. Ignite a hidden trench to make an opaque wall 20 ft. long, 15 ft. high, and 1 ft. thick for 1 minute. On creation, creatures in it make a DC 12 Dexterity save against 7 (2d6) fire, taking half on success. A creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there takes 7 (2d6) fire.

name: Kobold Centurion
otherStatistics: Chain shirt and shield. Skill Athletics +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, this kobold gains +1 AC if it is within 5 ft. of an ally who has this trait, wields a shield, and is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
sections.Actions:
Pilum. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
Firetail Pilum (2/day). Make one ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 ft. On a hit or miss, the target and every creature in the 5-ft.-wide line between target and centurion must pass a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 5 (2d4) fire. The line fills with opaque smoke 20 ft. high for 1 minute. A creature that can reach the pilum can spend an action to extinguish it and disperse the smoke.
Boom Pilum!!! (1/day). Make one ranged Pilum attack against a target within 60 ft. On a hit or miss, the target and creatures within 10 ft. of it each make a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure deals 7 (2d6) thunder, knocks the creature Prone, and leaves it Deafened for 1 minute. An affected creature can end the deafness with a successful save at the end of its turn. On initial success it takes half damage and avoids both conditions.

name: Kobold Legionary
otherStatistics: Chain shirt and shield. Skills Athletics +4, Perception +2. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, this kobold gains +1 AC if it is within 5 ft. of an ally who has this trait, wields a shield, and is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gladius attacks. One can be replaced with Shield Bash.
Gladius. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing.
Shield Bash. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning. A Medium or smaller creature hit must pass a DC 12 Strength save or fall Prone.
sections.Reactions: Reinforce. When an attack targets an ally within 10 ft., the legionary can move to the nearest open space within 5 ft. of that ally if it can see the ally and attacker. If the ally has Shield? Shield!, that ally gains its benefit against the triggering attack.

name: Kobold Signifer
otherStatistics: Shield. Skills Athletics +3, Intimidation +4, Performance +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, this kobold gains +1 AC if it is within 5 ft. of an ally who has this trait, wields a shield, and is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
Standard Bearer. A signifer that drops its signum switches to the Kobold Tiro profile. An allied Kobold Tiro can spend an action to take an unheld signum and switch to the signifer profile. Switching keeps current and maximum HP and any active conditions and effects. An unheld signum has AC 15 and 5 HP and is immune to poison and psychic damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Signum attacks.
Signum. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning.
Shield Wall Formation. Choose up to four kobolds within 60 ft. that can hear the signifer. Each can use its reaction to move up to its speed, ending within 5 ft. of an ally.
sections.Bonus Actions: Glory to the Legion (1/day). The signifer and each ally within 30 ft. that can hear it regain 5 (2d4) HP.

name: Basalt Stone Giant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +9 and Wis +5. Athletics +10, Perception +5. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks that are not adamantine. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless giant looks like a statue.
Stone Flesh. When an attacker rolls a natural 1 against the giant with a nonadamantine melee weapon, a mundane weapon breaks. A supernatural weapon loses its supernatural properties for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rune-Signed Blade attacks. One can be replaced with a Forked Knives attack.
Rune-Signed Blade. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 25 (4d8 + 7) slashing damage. Each hit against a creature reduces its speed by a cumulative 10 ft., to a minimum of 5 ft., until it regains at least 1 HP.
Forked Knives. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature on the ground, it falls Prone and is Restrained by the knife. The target or a creature that can reach the knife can spend an action and succeed on a DC 18 Strength (Athletics) check to pull it free and end the restraint.
sections.Reactions: Resonate Rune. When a melee attack hits the giant, each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, the giant pushes it up to 10 ft. away.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Molten Enclave, area Z5. Ostios oversees Hurga’s smithing. Unless the giants have been warned, a successful DC 16 group Dexterity (Stealth) check lets the party pass unnoticed.

name: Fire Giant Lightbearer
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +10, Dex +7, and Con +10. Athletics +10, Perception +9. Immune to fire damage. Passive Perception 19. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
Healing Heat. When a fire giant is the target of the lightbearer’s attack, spell, or other supernatural effect that deals fire damage, roll the fire damage and restore that many HP to the target instead. The target can choose to let the attack hit or to fail the save.
Molten Flesh. The first time on a turn that a creature other than a fire giant touches the lightbearer or hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Slam, Living Blaze, or one of each. One attack can be replaced with Flamelash.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit by this attack chooses to fall Prone or be pushed 10 ft. away.
Living Blaze. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 180 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) fire damage. On a hit, the lightbearer can make a second spell attack with disadvantage against a different target within 5 ft. of the first, dealing the same damage on a hit.
Flamelash. One creature the lightbearer can see within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 20 (4d6 + 6) fire damage, and if it is Large or smaller the lightbearer moves it up to 10 ft. horizontally.
sections.Bonus Actions: Travel by Fire (3/day). Choose two willing creatures the lightbearer can see within 30 ft. Each takes 14 (4d6) fire damage, then they teleport to swap spaces.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Molten Enclave, p. 117. Glass Cavern, p. 270. Mount Brazen, p. 280.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Molten Enclave, area Z6. One lightbearer is eating with a red fist and a hellhound. They immediately notice characters who make no effort to hide.

name: Fire Giant Red Fist
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +11, Dex +6, and Con +10. Athletics +11, Perception +6. Immune to fire damage. Passive Perception 16. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
Heat and Pressure. An enemy leaving the red fist’s reach makes a DC 18 Constitution save or gains one level of Exhaustion. Resistance or immunity to fire damage prevents this effect.
Molten Flesh. The first time on a turn that a creature other than a fire giant touches the red fist or hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Unarmed Strike attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 21 (4d6 + 7) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. A creature hit twice by Unarmed Strike on the same turn is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 180 ft., one target. Hit 34 (8d6 + 6) fire damage.
sections.Reactions: Guardian Block (3/day). When an enemy within 10 ft. hits another creature with an attack, the red fist halves the damage from that attack, then makes an Unarmed Strike against the attacker.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Molten Enclave, p. 118. Glass Cavern, p. 270. Mount Brazen, p. 281.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Glass Cavern, area R3. Three red fists sleep behind the curtain unless alerted. A successful DC 16 group Dexterity (Stealth) check lets the party pass. If awake, the giants listen first, then attack hostile visitors or call Xaantikorijek to question others.

name: Fire Giant Trooper
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to fire damage. Passive Perception 12. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed save immediately drops the trooper to 0 HP. If some other effect deals at least 19 damage, the trooper dies. It ignores lesser damage from those effects.
Molten Flesh. The first time on a turn that a creature other than a fire giant touches the trooper or hits it with a melee attack, that creature takes 7 fire damage.
sections.Actions:
Unarmed Strike (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 3 bludgeoning plus 3 fire damage per trooper. The target makes a Strength save or falls Prone. The DC is 12 plus the number of troopers attacking.
Rock (Group Attack). Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 6 bludgeoning damage per trooper.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Molten Enclave, p. 119. Mount Brazen, p. 281.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Molten Enclave, area Z8. If the giants have not been alerted, fifteen troopers and one red fist are asleep across the barracks. Sneaking through a room calls for a DC 10 group Dexterity (Stealth) check.

name: Frost Giant Storm Hurler
otherStatistics: Issenblau plating. Saves Str +9 and Con +7. Athletics +9, Intimidation +3, Perception +3. Immune to cold damage. Passive Perception 13. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits: Oncoming Storm. An enemy that starts its turn within 15 ft. while concentrating on a power, spell, or similar effect makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, its concentration ends.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Ice Javelin attacks.
Ice Javelin. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 120/360 ft., one target. Hit 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage. Reduce the target’s speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Flower of Frost (3/day). Place up to three Medium ice javelins in visible, unoccupied spaces within 300 ft. of the storm hurler. The spaces must be within 30 ft. of one another. Each javelin has AC 13, 10 HP, and vulnerability to fire damage. At the start of the giant’s next turn, any surviving javelin explodes in a 20-ft. radius. Each creature in one or more bursts makes a single DC 17 Dexterity save. Failure deals 28 (8d6) cold damage and Restrains it for 1 minute, with a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the restraint. Success halves the damage and avoids the restraint. Objects in the area take 28 (8d6) cold damage.
sections.Reactions: Frozen Retribution. When a creature within 120 ft. misses the giant with a ranged weapon attack, freeze the projectile and return it as an Ice Javelin attack against that creature.

name: Granite Stone Giant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +8 and Wis +5. Athletics +9, Perception +5. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks that are not adamantine. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. A motionless giant looks like a statue.
Stone Flesh. When an attacker rolls a natural 1 against the giant with a nonadamantine melee weapon, a mundane weapon breaks. A supernatural weapon loses its supernatural properties for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the giant hits the same creature twice with Greatclub on one turn, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength save or fall Prone.

name: Hill Giant Clobberer
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +8, Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
Distracted. When the clobberer picks an attack target, a different creature in that attack’s range can use its reaction to distract it. If the clobberer can see or hear that creature, the attack targets the distractor instead.
Pummel. A melee weapon hit against a Prone creature deals an extra 10 (3d6) damage and sets its speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
Siege Monster. The clobberer’s attacks deal double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Greatclub, Rock, or one of each.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target makes a DC 16 Strength save or falls Prone.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hill Quake. The clobberer falls Prone. Each creature on the ground within 20 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save or falls Prone. Structures in the area take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage.

name: Hill Giant Flunky
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +8, Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
Distracted. When a flunky picks a target, another creature within the attack’s range can use a reaction to distract the attackers. Any participants that can see or hear the distractor attack that creature instead. The others make a separate attack against the original target.
Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed save immediately drops the flunky to 0 HP. If some other effect deals at least 12 damage, the flunky dies. It ignores lesser damage from those effects.
The Hills Are Alive. A Large or smaller creature that ends its turn within 10 ft. of at least two flunkies makes a DC 16 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Actions: Rock (Group Attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 4 bludgeoning damage per flunky, or 5 per flunky if the target is Prone.

name: Marble Stone Giant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +8 and Wis +5. Athletics +8, Perception +5. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from mundane attacks that are not adamantine. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Giant.

sections.Traits:
Agility Rune. Enemies within 5 ft. do not impose disadvantage on the giant’s ranged attack rolls.
False Appearance. A motionless giant looks like a statue.
Stone Flesh. When an attacker rolls a natural 1 against the giant with a nonadamantine melee weapon, a mundane weapon breaks. A supernatural weapon loses its supernatural properties for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatsling attacks.
Greatsling. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 15 (3d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 27 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit by this attack makes a DC 16 Strength save or is pushed 10 ft. away.
Boulder Roll (Recharge 5–6). Roll a boulder along the ground in a 10-ft.-wide, 30-ft.-long line. Each creature in the line makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) bludgeoning and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half damage and stays upright. Objects in the line take 27 (5d10) bludgeoning unless supernatural, worn, or carried. The boulder breaks at the end of the line and leaves a 10-ft. square of difficult terrain.
sections.Bonus Actions: Siege Stance. The giant sets its speed to 0 and doubles both Greatsling ranges to 120/480 ft. On a Greatsling hit, every other creature within 5 ft. of the target makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or takes 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. The stance ends if the giant becomes Grappled, Incapacitated, Prone, or Restrained, or if it spends a bonus action to end it.

name: Ogre (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +5, Perception +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Common and Giant.

sections.Traits: Defiant Anger. At half HP or less, the ogre gains resistance to mundane bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Spiked Club attack and one Fist attack.
Spiked Club. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 13). That fist cannot attack other targets until the grapple ends. The ogre has two fists and holds the club in one of them.
People-Bowling. Throw a Medium or smaller creature the ogre is grappling up to 30 ft. horizontally. Each other creature in its path makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone. After the throw, the thrown creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.
sections.Bonus Actions: Bellow (1/day). One creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened of the ogre until the end of the ogre’s next turn. Success grants immunity to every ogre’s Bellow for 24 hours.
sections.Reactions: Violent Focus (1/day). When the ogre takes damage while Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned, it ends any of those conditions affecting it.

name: Blood-Borne Ooze
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +4. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Flanked, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The ooze can fit through a 1-inch gap without squeezing.
False Appearance. While motionless, the ooze looks identical to spilled blood.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning plus 2 (1d4) necrotic. A creature hit makes a DC 11 Constitution save unless it is a Construct or Undead. On a failure the ooze enters the creature’s body, where it has total cover from attacks and effects originating outside the host. If a source other than the ooze deals at least 5 damage to the host in one turn, the ooze makes a DC 12 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On failure, the ooze leaves the host for a nearest unoccupied space of its choice. Cure Ailment, Protection from Poison, or Lesser Restoration cast on the host also forces the ooze out. The ooze can spend 5 ft. of its movement to leave voluntarily.
Crimson Feast (inside a host only). The host makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 5 (2d4) necrotic and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. On success, it takes half the damage and avoids the condition.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Shifting Library, p. 88. Cloud Fang Keep, p. 101.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Shifting Library, p. 84, area K1. Five oozes ambush whoever opens the wine decanter. Cloud Fang Keep's approach has two infected owlbears. The adventure defaults to releasing an ooze when its host dies and offers the standard Pseudopod expulsion save as an option before then.

name: Bog Body
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +2, Stealth +5. Immune to acid and poison damage and to Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Understands its languages from life, but cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Acidic Blood. A creature within 5 ft. takes 3 (1d6) acid when it deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning. A Medium or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 13). While holding that creature, the bog body can use Slam only on it.
Sling Mud. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) acid.
Submerge. In swampy terrain the bog body sinks into the mud and water, becoming heavily obscured and taking any target it is grappling down with it. A submerged captive is heavily obscured, Restrained, unable to breathe, and takes 4 (1d8) acid at the start of each of its turns.
sections.Bonus Actions: Resurface. The bog body and any target still in its grapple rise from the mud and water.

name: Ghoul (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Immune to poison damage and to Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Barbed Tongue attack and one Claws attack. A creature hit by both is Dazed until the end of its next turn.
Barbed Tongue. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 15-ft. reach, one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing and reduce the target’s speed by 10 ft. through the end of its next turn.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing and prevent the target from taking reactions through the end of its next turn.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hungry Charge. Move up to half the ghoul’s speed in a straight line. If it goes at least 15 ft. and finishes within 5 ft. of a creature, it has advantage on its next attack roll against that creature if made before the end of the ghoul’s next turn.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): A Dazed creature chooses just one of movement, an action, or a bonus action on its turn. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, the turn ends. It can still use an extra action from a feature such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration remove the condition.

name: Giant Zombie
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Vulnerable to radiant. Immune to poison damage and to Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 7. Understands the languages it knew in life, but cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Negative Nerves. Ignore any damage a creature deals to the giant zombie if it deals 7 or less.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning. A Large or smaller target hit is Grappled (escape DC 14). Each of the zombie’s two fists can grapple one target.
Toxic Exhalation (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Constitution save against 14 (4d6) poison damage, halved on success.
sections.Reactions: Shove Away. When a Huge or smaller creature within 10 ft. hits the zombie with a melee attack, push the attacker up to 10 ft. away.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Durixaviinox's Rest, p. 225, area W2. The giant zombies have advantage on Strength checks to grapple or shove Medium or smaller creatures. A creature knocked Prone or forced against a wall or the ceiling takes 11 (2d10) piercing plus 11 (2d10) cold damage from the room's spikes.

name: Haunt
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Wis +7, Cha +8. Intimidation +8, Perception +7. Resists acid, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to cold, necrotic, and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17. Telepathy 60 ft.

sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Cloud. The haunt and another creature can occupy the same space. It can pass through creatures and objects, treating their spaces as difficult terrain. Ending a turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to it.
Invisibility. The haunt is Invisible.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spectral Wrath attacks.
Spectral Wrath. Melee spell attack, +8 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target sharing the haunt’s space. Hit 17 (2d12 + 4) force.
Wave of Despair (recharge 5–6). Each enemy within 20 ft. of the haunt makes a DC 16 Wisdom save against 33 (6d10) psychic damage, halved on success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Possess Object. Magically manipulate a Large or smaller object within 30 ft. that another creature is neither wearing nor carrying. The haunt can perform precise tasks with the object. With the same bonus action, it can throw the object as far as 30 ft. in any direction or attack a creature within 30 ft. of the object with it. The attack is +8 to hit and deals 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning, or piercing or slashing if the GM judges that more appropriate to the object.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 129. Tomb of the Keeper, p. 174. Mount Brazen, p. 286.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Ruins of Wrathrock, area J3. When the first character passes halfway into a chamber, each character who fails a DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) check is surprised by two haunts. They open with Wave of Despair.

name: Mummy (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Arcana +2, History +2, Religion +2. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Flammable. Each time the mummy takes fire damage, it takes another 5 (1d10) fire damage.
Mummy Dust. Piercing or slashing damage to the mummy releases dust that deals 4 (1d8) poison damage to each creature within 5 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Desiccating Slam attacks and use Guardian Curse.
Desiccating Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning. The target loses 10 ft. of speed and cannot regain HP until the start of the mummy’s next turn.
Guardian Curse. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. On failure, it is cursed and takes an extra 3 (1d6) necrotic damage every time it takes damage. Nothing can reduce the extra damage. Cure Ailment, Remove Curse, or a similar supernatural effect lifts the curse. A successful save grants 24 hours of immunity to Guardian Curse from any mummy.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Tomb of the Keeper, p. 175 (stat block), pp. 166, 169 (encounter rules).
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: All Undead in the Tomb of the Keeper have advantage on saves against turning. The eight guardians in area M2 ignore a first visit unless touched or harmed. They attack on a second visit.

name: Shadow (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Stealth +4. Resists acid, lightning, necrotic, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to cold and poison damage and to Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Chilling Phasing. The shadow treats creatures and objects as difficult terrain and takes 5 (1d10) force if it ends its turn inside an object. The first time the shadow crosses through a creature on a turn, it deals 1 cold to that creature.
Dark Stalker. The shadow has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in dim light or darkness.
sections.Actions:
Chilling Grasp. Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) cold and reduce the target’s Dexterity by 2. If the score reaches 0 the target dies. Otherwise, a short or long rest ends the reduction.
Freezing Dark (1/day). Fill a 15-ft. cone with stationary magical darkness. Light cannot illuminate it. Only incorporeal Undead can use darkvision to see through it. Each creature in the darkened area when it appears makes a DC 12 Constitution save or takes 7 (2d6) cold damage. The darkness ends after 1 minute or when the shadow is destroyed.
sections.Bonus Actions: Shadow Bind. One visible creature within 15 ft. in bright or dim light makes a DC 12 Strength save. On failure it is Grappled by its own shadow (escape DC 12). The grapple ends if the creature leaves bright and dim light or if the shadow that created the grapple is destroyed.

name: Skeleton (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Vulnerable to bludgeoning, force, and thunder. Resists piercing and slashing. Immune to Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits:
Bone Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical. The skeleton uses pieces of its own bones as bow ammunition and replaces them at dusk.
Hail of Bones. When bludgeoning, force, or thunder damage reduces the skeleton to 0 HP, it explodes and deals 4 piercing damage to each creature within 5 ft.
sections.Actions:
Bone Bow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing. Halve any HP the target regains before the start of the skeleton’s next turn.
Bone Knife. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing. A creature hit has disadvantage on attack rolls for the remainder of this turn.

name: Specter (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Resists acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Speaks the languages it knew in life.

sections.Traits: Corrupting Phasing. The specter can pass through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object it takes 5 (1d10) force damage. It deals 2 (1d4) necrotic to a creature the first time it passes through that creature on a turn.
sections.Actions: Decaying Touch. Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. Hit 7 (2d6) necrotic. On a failed DC 12 Constitution save the target spends one Hit Die without gaining any benefit. A target that fails and has no Hit Dice to spend drops to 0 HP. If a Humanoid dies within 1 minute of a hit from this attack, its spirit rises as a specter controlled by the GM, in the closest unoccupied space to the place of death.
sections.Bonus Actions: Hidden Movement (recharge 5–6). Become Invisible, then move up to the specter’s speed. The invisibility ends when that movement finishes.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Shifting Library, p. 92. Eighth City Advocacy Services, p. 207. Shadowkeep, p. 220. Durixaviinox’s Rest, p. 234. Boughs of Eternity, p. 314.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In the Shifting Library’s bookstacks (K3), the specter on each level fights with a wraith and five shades. If the fight lasts more than two rounds, the other floor’s librarians join at the start of round three.

name: Zombie (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Vulnerable to radiant. Immune to poison damage and to Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 7. Understands the languages it knew in life, but cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Negative Nerves. If a creature would deal 5 or less damage to the zombie, ignore the damage.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning.
sections.Reactions: Delayed Reflex. When Negative Nerves prevents damage from a creature the zombie can see within 5 ft., make a Slam attack against that creature with disadvantage.

name: Deathhawk
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +4, Con +6. Perception +4. Immune to necrotic and poison damage, and to Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 14. Understands Common but cannot speak it.

sections.Traits:
Corpse Sense. Sense the presence and general direction of Undead and corpses less than 90 days dead within 5 miles. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to find them.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Wounding Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 11 (3d4 + 4) piercing.
Wounding Talons. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing. A creature that is neither a Construct nor Undead gains a bleeding wound. At the start of each of its turns, it loses 5 (1d10) HP per wound. All wounds end when it regains at least 1 HP or when any creature within reach spends an action to staunch them.
sections.Bonus Actions: Bloodcurdling Shriek (Recharge 6). Enemies within 300 ft. that can hear the shriek make a DC 14 Wisdom save. Creatures immune to Frightened succeed automatically. On failure, an enemy is horrified for 1 minute and subtracts 1d4 from each attack roll and saving throw. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on success. Once an enemy succeeds or the effect ends on it, it is immune to this shriek from all deathhawks for 24 hours.

name: Dragonet
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Arcana +4, Insight +3, Perception +3. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Arcane Acumen. Gain advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to learn about visible supernatural effects and objects. The dragonet always knows when something senses its emotions or reads its thoughts, or when a divination spell targets or observes it.
True Words. Gain advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to detect lies spoken in Draconic.
sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing.
Revealing Breath (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). Light coats every object in a 15-ft. cone for 1 minute. A creature in the cone is also outlined for 1 minute unless it succeeds on a DC 13 Dexterity save. Outlined targets shed dim light for 5 ft. and cannot benefit from being Invisible. Attacks against an outlined target have advantage if the attacker can see it. By looking at an outlined target that bears magic, the dragonet can identify the school, if any.
Truesight (Recharges after a Long Rest). Gain Truesight out to 60 ft. for 1 minute.

name: Flintmoth Swarm
classification: Huge Swarm of Tiny Elementals, unaligned
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Save Dex +9. Stealth +9. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Flanked, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned. Blindsight 15 ft., Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Obscuring Form. Other creatures in the swarm’s space are Blinded.
Shrink. When the swarm reaches half its HP, it becomes Large.
Stone Camouflage. Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
Swarm. The swarm can share another creature’s space, either creature can enter the shared space, and the swarm can pass through openings that fit a Tiny insect. It cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Flutter Cutter attacks.
Flutter Cutter. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm’s space. Hit 26 (6d6 + 5) slashing, increased to 33 (8d6 + 5) against a stone Construct or a target wearing or holding an object that sheds bright light.
sections.Bonus Actions: Devour Stone. Choose a mostly stone mundane object or structure within 5 ft. Devour an entire Medium or smaller object, or a 5-ft. cube of a structure or a Large or larger object.

name: Gem Jelly
speed: 25 ft., climb 25 ft. (0 ft. in crystalline form)
otherStatistics: AC 20 in crystalline form. Stealth +4. Resists acid and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 12. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Pass through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
False Appearance. A motionless gem jelly looks like a natural crystal formation.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pseudopod attacks.
Pseudopod (True Form Only). Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing.
Crystalline Shatter (Crystalline Form Only). Revert to true form. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) piercing on failure or half on success. Gem jellies are immune to this damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Harden. Switch between true and crystalline forms. In crystalline form, the jelly has AC 20 and speed 0, cannot use Pseudopod, has disadvantage on Dexterity saves, and is vulnerable to thunder damage.
sections.Reactions: Reactive Shatter (Crystalline Form Only). When the jelly takes thunder damage, use Crystalline Shatter.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Cloud Fang Keep, p. 99. The living snow in the parlor can form a gem jelly as a shortcut for using the party's duplicate statistics.

name: Leyleech
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Immune to Prone. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Traits: Supernatural Resistance. Gain advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing. If the creature can cast spells, pick one of its spellcasting abilities and reduce that score by 1 to a minimum of 1 until it finishes a short or long rest. The leyleech becomes charged for 1 minute or until it uses Magic Purge.
Magic Purge (Charged Form Only). End the charge and choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 7 (2d6) force damage on failure or half on success.

name: Lightthief
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +5, Stealth +5. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but cannot speak.

sections.Actions:
Necrotic Drain. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic, increased to 13 (3d6 + 3) if the target cannot see the lightthief.
Into the Light (Recharge 6). Teleport inside a visible source of bright or dim light within 15 ft. The lightthief has total cover against effects and attacks outside that source. If the light goes out through anything other than Steal Light, the lightthief appears in an unoccupied space of its choice within 5 ft. of the source and is Paralyzed until the end of its next turn.
Steal Light (Inside Light Source Only). Every creature within 15 ft. of the occupied source makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 14 (4d6) radiant damage and loses any Darkvision it has for 1 minute. On success, it takes half damage and keeps its Darkvision. The source goes out, and the lightthief chooses an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of it to emerge in.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Shifting Library, p. 84, area K3. Four lightthieves hide in ground-floor lamps and prey on creatures carrying lights and ignore Undead. If the fight lasts more than three rounds or damages the library, the librarians on that level join the fight.

name: Marsh Hydra
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +8, Perception +7. Immune to Flanked, Poisoned, and Prone. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Multiple Heads. Gain advantage on saves to avoid Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Stunned, or being knocked Unconscious.
Roll Over. After moving at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature, hit it with Entangling Serpents on the same turn to force a DC 16 Strength save. Failure knocks it Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Entangling Serpents attacks. One can be replaced with Many Bites.
Entangling Serpents. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning and the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).
Many Bites. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing. The target makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of the hydra’s next turn. On success, it takes half the poison damage and avoids the condition.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Serpent Surprise. Choose one option. If it targets another creature, choose a visible creature within 30 ft.
Poison Spit. DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 9 (2d8) poison and makes the target Blinded until the end of the hydra’s next turn.
Entrancing Gaze. DC 16 Wisdom save. On failure, the target is Charmed by the hydra for 1 minute or until the hydra harms it. Repeat the save at the end of each of the target’s turns, ending the effect on success.
Terrifying Rattle. DC 16 Wisdom save. On failure, the target is Frightened of the hydra for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of the target’s turns, ending the effect on success.
Reinforcements. The hydra regains 10 (3d6) HP.

name: Mohler
otherStatistics: Blindsight 20 ft., tremorsense 40 ft., passive Perception 11. No languages.

sections.Actions:
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing.
Earth Bump. While burrowing under a Large or smaller creature on the ground within 5 ft., shift the earth. The creature makes a DC 12 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
Ground Grinder. Burrow up to the mohler’s burrow speed. Ground within 5 ft. of the burrowing path becomes difficult terrain.
sections.Reactions: Zip. When the mohler fails a Dexterity save while burrowing, it succeeds instead.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: The Hanging Tree, areas O5 and O6. The mohler locked in the storeroom does not attack and may follow a character who feeds it. Three mohlers in the feed room join the orcs in a fight and retreat underground once the orcs are defeated.

name: Shieldscale Drangolin
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +5 and Con +5. Perception +2, Survival +2. Resists fire. Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 12. No languages.

sections.Traits: Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed. The burrow leaves a 3-ft.-diameter tunnel for 10 minutes before it collapses. Tiny and Small creatures fit through normally. Medium and Large creatures can squeeze through.
sections.Actions:
Fiery Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 10-ft. reach, one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing plus 3 (1d6) fire.
Erupt (1/day). While burrowing within 10 ft. of the surface, emerge into a space with at least one creature without spending movement. Each creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. A creature directly above the emergence rolls with disadvantage. On failure, take 14 (4d6) bludgeoning and fall Prone. On success, take half damage and get pushed 5 ft. into an unoccupied space of the creature’s choice.
Wrecking Ball (1/day). Move in a straight line up to twice walking speed without provoking opportunity attacks, passing through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space is entered makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire. A structure or an object that is neither worn nor carried takes twice that damage if the drangolin enters its space.
sections.Reactions: Ash Shot. When a creature the drangolin can sense moves within 5 ft., force a DC 13 Dexterity save. On failure, the creature is Blinded until the start of its next turn.

name: Stoneback Isopod
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists cold and fire. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Breathe air and water.
Stone Camouflage. Gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing.
Seize. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one Medium or smaller creature. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning and the target is Grappled (escape DC 14). The isopod cannot Seize another target until this grapple ends.
sections.Reactions: Curl. When hit by a creature within 5 ft., gain +2 AC against that attack. The attacker also makes a DC 14 Strength save. On failure, it takes 4 (1d8) bludgeoning and is pushed 5 ft. into an unoccupied space chosen by the isopod.

name: Gnoll Abyssal Archer
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Perception +3, Stealth +4, Survival +3. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Traits: Bloodscent. The archer knows where every creature below full HP is within 60 ft.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing. Each hit reduces the target’s walking speed by 5 ft., stacking until it regains at least 1 HP.
sections.Reactions: Death Frenzy. When a visible ally within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, move up to half the gnoll’s speed and make a Bite attack.

name: Gnoll Abyssal Summoner
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Save Wis +5. Perception +5, Religion +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Bite, Three-Tail Flail, Fire Blast, or a combination. Replace one attack with Demonic Howl if available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic. On a hit against a creature, choose another visible creature within 30 ft. to regain 7 (2d6) HP magically. A willing ally is hit automatically.
Three-Tail Flail. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (3d4 + 4) bludgeoning and push the target 5 ft. away from the summoner.
Fire Blast (cantrip). Ranged spell attack +6, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire.
Demonic Howl (Recharge 5–6). Allies within 30 ft. that can hear the summoner gain advantage on attack rolls until the start of the summoner’s next turn.
Uplift (3/day). Magically change one allied Abyssal Hyena into a Gnoll Marauder for 1 hour.
sections.Bonus Actions: Summon Abyssal Hyenas (3/day). Place 1d4 + 1 Abyssal Hyenas in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. of the summoner. They act immediately after the summoner’s turn and obey its commands.
sections.Reactions: Death Frenzy. When a visible ally within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, move up to half the gnoll’s speed and make a Bite attack.

name: Gnoll Bonesplitter
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Save Con +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks using Bite, Spiked Flail, or both. Replace one attack with Bloody Roar if available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing, or 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing if the creature is Restrained.
Spiked Flail. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing. A Medium or smaller creature is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until it escapes. The bonesplitter cannot use Spiked Flail while this grapple lasts.
Bloody Roar (Recharge 6). Each non-Incapacitated ally within 10 ft. that can see the bonesplitter can make a weapon attack without spending an action.
sections.Bonus Actions: Over Here! Choose a creature grappled by the bonesplitter. It swaps spaces with the bonesplitter if it fails a DC 14 Strength save.
sections.Reactions: Death Frenzy. When a visible ally within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, move up to half the gnoll’s speed and make a Bite attack.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: The White Tower, p. 145. Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 162.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At the canyon's Sorting Room (D3), two bonesplitters work with twenty pitlings. If the group fails the DC 15 group Dexterity (Stealth) check in the preceding hall, the bonesplitters wait at its far end to catch anyone who makes it through.

name: Gnoll Cackler
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Save Wis +3. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite or Chill Touch attack and use Moment of Brutality.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 2 (1d4) necrotic.
Chill Touch (cantrip). Ranged spell attack +5, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit 9 (2d8) necrotic. The target cannot regain HP until the start of the cackler’s next turn.
Moment of Brutality. Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 13 Wisdom save and may fail voluntarily. A creature immune to being Charmed succeeds automatically. On a failure, it takes 7 (2d6) psychic and makes a Bite attack against a creature of the cackler’s choice within 5 ft. of it. If it lacks a Bite, use an unarmed strike that deals 1d4 + the target’s Strength modifier as piercing damage on a hit.
Fiendish Cackle (Recharge 5–6). Each enemy within 30 ft. that hears the cackler must make a DC 13 Wisdom save or become Frightened of it for 1 minute. Repeat the save at the end of each of the affected creature’s turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Reactions:
Death Frenzy. When a visible ally within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, move up to half the gnoll’s speed and make a Bite attack.
Fell Teleport. When a visible creature within 30 ft. dies, the cackler magically teleports to that creature’s space.

name: Gnoll Mage-Gorger
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Traits: Life Eater. Whenever a visible enemy within 30 ft. regains HP, choose a visible non-minion ally within 30 ft. That ally regains 2 HP.
sections.Actions: Wizard Ripper (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Each participant contributes 2 slashing plus 2 acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage on a hit. Choose one of those types for the whole attack. The target has disadvantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration until the start of the mage-gorger’s next turn. This includes the save caused by the hit.

name: Gnoll Marauder
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Traits: Rampaging Charge. After moving at least 10 ft. straight toward a creature and hitting it with Flail on the same turn, the marauder can Bite that creature as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing.
Flail. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning.
sections.Reactions: Death Frenzy. When a visible ally within 30 ft. drops to 0 HP, move up to half the gnoll’s speed and make a Bite attack.

name: Gnoll Wildling
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10. Abyssal and Gnoll.

sections.Traits: Death Feast. When an ally within 5 ft. drops to 0 HP, the wildling can deal 1 piercing damage to a creature within 5 ft. without spending an action, provided the wildling is not Incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Flail (Group Attack). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage per participant. Each participating wildling grapples the target. Escape DC is 10 plus the number of wildlings grappling it. The target is Restrained until the grapple ends, and grappling wildlings cannot use Flail against another creature. Any wildling may let go independently. Recalculate the escape DC using the number still holding on.

name: Lizardfolk Bloodeye
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Save Str +5. Athletics +5, Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The lizardfolk can breathe in air and underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite or Bola attack and use either Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure if available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing.
Bola. Ranged weapon attack +5, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning and the target becomes Restrained. A creature can spend an action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature in reach. The bola has AC 10. Dealing 5 slashing damage to it destroys it and frees the target without harming it.
Bloodeye Bolt (3/day). Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 13 Constitution save or becomes Blinded for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Mesmeric Lure (3/day). Choose a visible creature within 30 ft. If it fails a DC 13 Wisdom save, all creatures except the bloodeye are Invisible to it until the end of the bloodeye’s next turn.
sections.Reactions: Reptilian Escape (1/day). After failing a Strength or Dexterity save, shed the tail to succeed instead. The tail grows back when the lizardfolk finishes a long rest.

name: Lizardfolk Scaletooth
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +4, Survival +2. Passive Perception 10. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The lizardfolk can breathe in air and underwater.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
Tail. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning. For a Medium or smaller creature, choose to move it 5 ft. in any direction or grapple it (escape DC 12). The scaletooth cannot Tail another target while this grapple lasts.
Rending Bite. Make a Bite attack with advantage against a creature the scaletooth is grappling. On a hit, deal 3 (1d6) additional piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Reptilian Escape (1/day). After failing a Strength or Dexterity save, shed the tail to succeed instead. The tail grows back when the lizardfolk finishes a long rest.

name: Lizardfolk Terrorsaur
otherStatistics: Natural armor. AC 16 in flight. Athletics +6, Perception +3, Stealth +5. Passive Perception 13. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Aerial Agility. The terrorsaur has AC 16 while flying.
Amphibious. The lizardfolk can breathe in air and underwater.
Running Start. To use its flying speed on a turn, the terrorsaur must first either walk 10 ft. in a straight line or fall 10 ft. without touching the ground.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Glaive attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing.
Blowgun (Recharge 6). Ranged weapon attack +5, range 30/120 ft., one creature. Hit 1 piercing plus 17 (5d6) poison. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Reactions:
Reptilian Escape (1/day). After failing a Strength or Dexterity save, shed the tail to succeed instead. The tail grows back when the lizardfolk finishes a long rest.
Skulking Retreat. After taking damage from a melee attack, the terrorsaur can move up to half its speed.

name: Abyssal Hyena
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Understands Abyssal and cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Death Snap. When reduced to 0 HP, the hyena can deal 1 piercing damage to a creature within 5 ft. No action is required. The hyena must have been able to act before dropping to 0 HP (it was not Incapacitated).
sections.Actions: Bite (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Deal 1 piercing damage per participant on a hit. If at least two hyenas took part, a creature hit must pass a Strength save or fall Prone. The DC equals 10 + the number of participating hyenas.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 159
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Canyon of the Tower Crown, p. 155, area D4. The wounded hyena in the dungeon starts Incapacitated. Restore any HP or succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom (Medicine) check to gain it as a companion. Use the separate companion profile from that point.

name: Kobold Tiro
otherStatistics: Shield. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, the kobold gains +1 AC if within 5 ft. of a shield-wielding ally with the same trait who is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
Testudo. On finishing a long rest, choose a non-minion as the tiro’s commander. The commander gets +1 AC while the tiro is within 5 ft. and neither Incapacitated nor Prone. Combine bonuses from multiple tiros up to +5.
sections.Actions: Pugio (group attack). Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 20/60-ft. range, one target. Deal 1 piercing damage per participant on a hit.

name: Kobold Veles
otherStatistics: Shield. Athletics +3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits: Shield? Shield! While wielding a shield, the kobold gains +1 AC if within 5 ft. of a shield-wielding ally with the same trait who is neither Incapacitated nor Prone.
sections.Actions: Pilum. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30/120-ft. range, one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing. On a hit against a creature wielding a shield, the veles can lodge the pilum in it.
