Soul Blade. Melee or ranged weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit 25 (5d6 + 8) psychic damage. On a failed DC 19 Wisdom save, the target is Frightened of Athmia until the end of her next turn.
Psychic Frenzy (1/day). Each enemy within 60 ft. makes a DC 19 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Dazed until the start of Athmia’s next turn. Athmia gains 5 temporary HP for each enemy that fails.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Cunning Action. Dash, Disengage, or Hide.
Sun Eater’s Gift (3/day). If Aronar Valkys is within 30 ft. and is willing, Athmia and Aronar trade places.
sections.Reactions: Sun Eater’s Mind (3/day). When a creature Athmia can see within 60 ft. makes a spell attack against her or casts a spell requiring her to save, she can mark its mind. Her next attack against that creature is an automatic critical hit.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Hallowed Dark. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 2, Dual Blades. Athmia moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks and makes two melee attacks.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On each turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses only one. Its turn ends if it becomes Dazed during that turn. It can still take extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration remove Dazed.

name: Caithas
description: A winged archer of the Hallowed Dark. Caithas can call forth an echo of Qazyldrath to breathe acid and darkness.
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saves Dex +11, Con +5, Wis +11. Skills Perception +11, Stealth +11, Survival +11. Resists acid, fire, and necrotic damage. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 21. Common, Draconic, and Infernal.

sections.Traits: Forest Defense. While Caithas is in forest terrain, ranged attacks against him have disadvantage if he can see the attacker.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Scimitar attacks or three Scaled Longbow attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.
Scaled Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +11, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 12 (1d8 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The attack has advantage against a creature that has not attacked Caithas since the end of his last turn.
Manifestation (recharge 5–6). Qazyldrath appears in Caithas’s space and breathes a line 30 ft. long and 5 ft. wide. Each creature in it makes a DC 19 Dexterity save, taking 18 (4d8) acid damage and 18 (4d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Magical darkness fills the line for 1 minute. Darkvision cannot pierce it, and supernatural light cannot illuminate it. The dragon then vanishes.
sections.Bonus Actions: Gaze of the Decay (1/day). Mark a creature Caithas can see within 60 ft. for 24 hours. While on the same plane, Caithas knows its distance and direction. The marked creature cannot hide from him and gains no benefit from being Invisible against him.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Hallowed Dark. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 3, Hunter of Mortals. Make one Scaled Longbow attack against every enemy within 600 ft. Anyone reduced to 0 HP by these attacks dies.

name: Draven Malas
description: A sorcerer who turned to blood magic for revenge. In battle he uses it to pin enemies down and keep the Hallowed Dark alive.
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Saves Dex +11, Con +7, Int +11. Skills Arcana +11, Investigation +11. Resists acid and necrotic damage. Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 10. Common and Draconic.

sections.Traits:
Exploit Opening (3/day). Gain advantage on an attack roll Draven makes.
Profane Sacrifice (1/turn). After hitting a creature with a melee attack, Draven can reduce its speed to 0 until the start of his next turn. He takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage if he does.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Gloom Dagger attacks.
Gloom Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d4 + 8) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) necrotic damage. Draven can move the target up to 10 ft. horizontally. If this attack reduces a creature to 0 HP, he regains one use of Blood of the Dragon.
Blood of the Dragon (1/day). Choose up to three creatures Draven can see within 60 ft. Each takes 33 (6d10) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 19 Constitution save, it also falls Prone and is Poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the poisoning.
sections.Bonus Actions: Creeping Dread. Choose a creature Draven can see within 30 ft. in dim light or darkness. On a failed DC 19 Wisdom save, it moves its speed in a direction Draven chooses. Advantage on saves against becoming Frightened applies here, and a creature immune to Frightened succeeds automatically.
sections.Utility Spells: Intelligence, spell save DC 19. At will: Alarm and Mage Hand. Once per day each: Glyph of Warding and Scrying. Mage Hand takes an action. Use each other spell’s normal casting time.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Hallowed Dark. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 4, Blood Drain. Choose an enemy Draven can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 19 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and is Dazed until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and is not Dazed. Draven divides healing equal to twice the necrotic damage dealt between himself and any member of the Hallowed Dark he can see within 60 ft.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On each turn, a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses only one. Its turn ends if it becomes Dazed during that turn. It can still take extra actions granted by effects such as Haste or Action Surge. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration remove Dazed.

name: The Horror
description: The Grave Order made the Horror from five fallen adventurers and bound Elyas Leodeir’s unwilling soul to it.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +6, Con +5, Wis +1. Skill Intimidation +4. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. Understands Common and cannot speak.

sections.Traits: Dying Gasp. When the Horror dies, the creature that reduced it to 0 HP can appeal to Elyas with a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check without spending an action. On a success, each enemy of the Grave Order within 30 ft. of the Horror gains 7 (2d6) temporary HP. On a failure or if nobody attempts the check, each creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 4 (1d8) acid damage and 4 (1d8) necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Actions:
Spine Cleaver. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) against a Grappled target.
Bone Hook. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 15 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14), and the Horror can pull it up to 15 ft. closer. The Horror cannot use Bone Hook against another target until this grapple ends.
sections.Bonus Actions: Valor’s Death. Each enemy within 10 ft. who can hear the Horror must make a DC 13 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is Frightened of the Horror for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition. A creature becomes immune to this Horror’s Valor’s Death for 24 hours when it succeeds on the save or the effect ends.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Grave Order. Once per encounter for each party action, after an enemy finishes its turn. The party can use the actions in any order, one per round. The creature performing the action must be present and must not be Incapacitated.
Action 3, Threshing Flail. The Horror moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks. When the movement ends, each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. On a failure, the enemy takes 7 (2d6) piercing damage and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and stays upright.

name: Dohma Raskovar
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Saves Str +6, Con +7, Wis +5. Skills Athletics +6, Deception +6, Insight +5, Intimidation +6, Perception +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common and Orc.
description: The Ivory Throne’s mercenary commander calls in reinforcements and drives his troops into grappling range.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 213.
sections.Traits:
Adrenaline Rush. After failing a save, Raskovar can succeed by spending one use of Dohma Rally without receiving its benefits. This takes no action.
Relentless (1/turn). If Raskovar would fall to 0 HP without dying outright and is not Incapacitated, he can attack an enemy before the loss of HP resolves, without an action. If the attack hits and drops the enemy to 0 HP, Raskovar drops to 1 HP instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Repeating Crossbow attacks or two War Mace attacks.
War Mace. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and Daze the target until the end of its next turn.
Repeating Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d12 + 1) piercing damage and reduce the target's speed by 10 ft. until the end of its next turn.
Reinforcements (1/day). Take the Dodge action. Ten Orc Blitzers appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. of Raskovar.
sections.Bonus Actions: Dohma Rally (3/day). Regain 20 HP and gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of Raskovar's next turn.
sections.Reactions: On the House. After a visible creature within 30 ft. fails a check or misses with an attack roll, that creature can reroll and choose either result.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each villain action is available once per encounter. Use one at most per round, in any order, immediately after an enemy's turn.
1. Close In. Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Raskovar can move up to its speed. Afterward, each enemy within 5 ft. of at least one ally who moved makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, the enemy is Frightened of Raskovar for 1 minute, with an end-of-turn save.
2. Lockdown. Each ally within 60 ft. who can hear Raskovar can attempt a Strength (Athletics) check with advantage to grapple an enemy it can reach, without an action. Raskovar can then move up to his speed.
3. Do It Myself. Move up to Raskovar's speed without provoking opportunity attacks, then make up to five War Mace attacks with advantage.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Hanging Tree, pp. 33–34, area O8. The red-light signal brings Raskovar after one round. His Reinforcements enter by the staircase from area O7. At 20 HP or fewer with no uses of Dohma Rally left, he offers to bargain for his life.

name: Ithu’rath
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +8, Int +11, Wis +7, Cha +9. Skills History +11, Insight +12, Intimidation +9, Perception +12. Condition immunities Charmed, Flanked, Frightened, Prone. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 22. Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.
description: An olothec called the All-Seeing breeds slime servants in the flooded ruins of Castle Wrathrock.

sections.Printed source: Olothec lairs, p. 200. Slime servants, p. 201. Stat block, p. 202.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Ithu’rath breathes air and water.
Immutable Form. Its shape cannot be changed by powers, spells, or other effects.
Slimy Resistance (3/day). Ithu’rath can turn a failed save into a success. Targets have advantage on the save against Devolving Tentacle until the end of Ithu’rath’s next turn.
Supernatural Resistance. Ithu’rath has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make six Devolving Tentacle attacks and use Piscine Transformation.
Devolving Tentacle. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage. On the first hit against a creature each turn, it must make a DC 19 Constitution save or become slimed. It subtracts a d4 from each attack roll and ability check. The penalty die increases one step at the end of each of its turns, from d4 to d6, d8, d10, then d12. The target can repeat the save at the end of each turn. Cure Ailment or Lesser Restoration also ends the slime.
Piscine Transformation (3rd-order power). Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. with a head, legs, or torso. On a failed DC 19 Wisdom save, choose one transformation. A fish head prevents speech. Fins reduce walking speed to 10 ft. if it was higher and give a 30-ft. swim speed. A fish torso allows breathing only in water and grants the ability to hold breath for 1 hour. If it gains a torso out of water, it begins suffocating. A 4th-order or higher Cure Ailment or Greater Restoration ends the transformation. All three changes together permanently make a fishlike hybrid, reversible by Wish or a similar supernatural effect.
sections.Bonus Actions: Jaunt (3rd-order power). Teleport 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space.
sections.Reactions: Liquefy (3rd-order power). When a creature within 30 ft. hits Ithu’rath with an attack, it must pass a DC 19 Constitution save or be pushed 5 ft. away and Restrained until the end of its next turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each villain action is available once per encounter. Use one at most per round, in any order, immediately after an enemy's turn.
1. Skeletal Collapse. Choose one or more creatures with skeletons within 60 ft. On a failed DC 19 Constitution save a target takes 18 (4d8) necrotic damage and has disadvantage on Strength- and Dexterity-based checks, attacks, and saves for 1 minute, with an end-of-turn save.
2. Psychic Pulse. Each enemy within 60 ft. must pass a DC 19 Strength save or take 18 (4d8) force damage and be moved up to 30 ft. in a direction Ithu’rath chooses.
3. Slime Storm. Each creature within 60 ft., except olothecs and slime servants, makes a DC 19 Constitution save. A failure deals 45 (10d8) piercing damage and Blinds the target until the end of its next turn. A successful save halves the damage and avoids blindness.
sections.Lair Rules: Use the Olothec lair actions when running Ithu’rath in its lair. The three options retain the DC 15 saves listed in the Olothec chapter. The same chapter gives the Slime Servant template.
sections.Psionic Powers (MCDM): Psionic powers require no components. Antimagic Field, Counterspell, and Dispel Magic do not stop powers. Melee power attacks can be used for opportunity attacks.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): When using the optional flanking rules, the immunity prevents enemies from flanking Ithu’rath.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 132 (stat block), p. 127 (lair), p. 133 (slime servants)
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: At Wrathrock, Ithu’rath uses the three lair actions on p. 127 and fights without summoning slime servants. The altered servants have their own profiles on p. 133.

name: Lady Emer
otherStatistics: Saves Str +8, Dex +11, Con +9, Wis +7. Skills Athletics +8, Deception +8, Perception +7, Persuasion +8, Stealth +11, Survival +7. Immune to poison damage and the Poisoned condition. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17. Common and Elvish.
description: A former scout who serves the Order of the Ouroboros as a covert assassin. She keeps some of her petrified targets in her courtyard.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 190.
sections.Traits: Stone Sacrifice (3/day). Emer can turn a failed save into a success by ending her Stone Gaze on a creature of her choice within 300 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Pinning Shot or make three attacks in any combination of Snake Bite and Longbow. Also use Stone Gaze or Envenomed Stone if available.
Snake Bite. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 17 (5d6) poison damage. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save the target is Poisoned and cannot take reactions until the end of Emer's next turn.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack +11, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d8 + 7) piercing plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.
Pinning Shot. Make three Longbow attacks against a creature touching the ground within 150 ft. Two or more hits Restrain it with arrows. The target or a creature that can reach it can use an action to remove the arrows and end the effect.
Stone Gaze. Up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. make DC 17 Constitution saves. A first failure starts petrification, reduces speed by 10 ft., and gives disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves. While turning to stone, an end-of-turn save ends the effect. If targeted by another Stone Gaze, a second failure cuts speed by another 10 ft. and Dazes the target. A third failure Petrifies the target and removes its repeat saves. Stone Sacrifice, Cure Ailment of at least 4th order, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can reverse the completed petrification.
Envenomed Stone (Recharge 5–6). Each creature within 60 ft. turning to stone from Stone Gaze makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 44 (8d10) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Mesmerizing Eyes. Choose one creature Emer can see within 60 ft. that can also see her. On a failed DC 17 Wisdom save, it is Charmed until the start of its next turn and must immediately spend its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed in a direction Emer chooses.
sections.Reactions: Blinding Mucus. When a creature Emer can see within 5 ft. hits her with a melee attack, that creature must pass a DC 17 Dexterity save or take 7 (2d6) acid damage and become Blinded until the start of its next turn.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each villain action is available once per encounter. Use one at most per round, in any order, immediately after an enemy's turn.
1. I See You! Use Stone Gaze on every visible enemy within 60 ft.
2. Medusa's Evolution. Gain a flying speed of 40 ft. for 1 minute, then move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
3. Stone Puppets. Emer and each creature turning to stone from her Stone Gaze move up to their speeds and each make a weapon attack against a creature Emer chooses, without an action.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Cloud Fang Keep, p. 106 (stat block), p. 98 (lair)
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Cloud Fang Keep adds Shadowstep, Stony Wail, and Venom Shower as lair actions. If warned of intruders, Emer uses the stone garden and its petrified victims to fuel Stone Sacrifice.

name: Lamasombra
otherStatistics: Saves Dex +11, Con +9. Skills Perception +7, Stealth +16, Survival +7. Blindsight 120 ft., passive Perception 17. No languages.
description: An eight-legged cave hunter that pulls victims within biting range and tracks anyone its bite infects.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 296.
sections.Traits:
Cave Apex. Tremorsense cannot detect the lamasombra. It is Invisible to creatures with darkvision while in darkness or dim light. Creatures without darkvision can see it in dim light.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without a check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tongue attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 33 (6d8 + 6) piercing damage. A creature hit by the bite must pass a DC 17 Constitution save or contract boiling wastes disease. Until cured, it cannot regain HP and the lamasombra can sense its direction when both are on the same plane.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack +11, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 27 (6d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 37 (9d6 + 6) against a creature that cannot see the lamasombra. Pull a Large or smaller creature up to 15 ft. directly toward the lamasombra.
sections.Bonus Actions: Nightmarish Cunning. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

name: Marvorok
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +9, Dex +12, Wis +10. Skills Athletics +9, Perception +16, Stealth +12. Blindsight 300 ft., passive Perception 26. Deep Speech.
description: A deep-cave predator that can seize two targets and vanish with both before they can call for help.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 342.
sections.Traits: Scent Reliance. If the marvorok cannot breathe or smell, it cannot use its blindsight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks and one Eviscerate attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) slashing damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 17) and Restrained while grappled. The marvorok can grapple up to two creatures.
Eviscerate. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 5 ft., one creature grappled by the marvorok. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing plus 17 (2d10 + 6) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Taste the Air. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Underground Stalker. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space with any creatures the marvorok is grappling. In dim light or darkness, it can Hide as part of the teleport, and grappled creatures cannot speak or make noise until the end of the marvorok's next turn.

name: Qar, Master of Jackals
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +3, Dex +7, Wis +7. Skills Acrobatics +7, Athletics +3, Perception +7, Stealth +7. Passive Perception 17. Common.
description: A former watch captain who uses stolen martial techniques to run down weakened enemies for the Black Iron Pact.

sections.Printed source: Black Iron Pact actions, p. 364. Stat block, p. 365.
sections.Traits:
Evasion. For a Dexterity save that would halve damage, Qar takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Exploit Opening (3/day). Gain advantage on an attack roll Qar makes.
Supernatural Resistance. Qar has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes. If the same creature is hit by all three, it is Dazed until the end of its next turn.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Iron Ring (2/day). Teleport to the Cyst. From inside the Cyst, teleport to somewhere Qar has visited.
sections.Reactions:
No Survivors. When a visible enemy within 40 ft. drops to 0 HP, move up to Qar's speed. If he ends that move within 5 ft. of an enemy, he can make an Unarmed Strike against that enemy.
Voice Stealer (3/day). When an enemy within 30 ft. that Qar can hear finishes casting a spell with a verbal component, it must pass a DC 15 Intelligence save or lose the ability to speak for 1 minute, with an end-of-turn save.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Black Iron Pact. The party may use one villain party action per round after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order, and requires its performer to be present and able to act.
Action 1. Party Tactics. Qar and each ally within 60 ft. who can see or hear him can move up to their speed.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

name: Scyza
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +7, Con +5. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.
description: A towering bipedal lizard that can carry a whole orc fighting company in a war harness.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 212.
sections.Traits:
Siege Monster. Deal double damage to objects and structures.
War Harness. A harness lets the scyza carry up to 36 Medium or smaller creatures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage and knock the target Prone.
Tail Whip. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A target on the scyza falls off and lands Prone.
Head Crest. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 23 (4d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature that can hear is Dazed until the end of its next turn.
Claw Twister (Recharge 6). Chosen creatures within 5 ft. make DC 15 Dexterity saves. On a failure, a target takes 13 (3d8) slashing damage, falls Prone, and is Blinded by dust until the start of the scyza's next turn. On a success, the target takes half damage and neither condition.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Hanging Tree, pp. 33–34, areas O6 and O9. The feed-room trap opens a portal the scyza can reach through with his head. In the vault, characters who have not harmed Horanus or attacked the mercenaries in his presence have one round after he spots them to calm him with a DC 14 Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. Offering meat gives advantage.

name: Sylphise
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Dex +7, Wis +3, Cha +8. Skills Acrobatics +7, Perception +3, Stealth +7. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Common, Elvish, Sylvan, telepathy 60 ft.
description: The Wilderkith’s nymph skirmisher slips between planes and slashes through a group before it can strike back.

sections.Printed source: Wilderkith actions, p. 369. Stat block, p. 370.
sections.Traits:
Fey Countenance (1/turn). A creature that can see Sylphise and targets her with an attack, power, or spell must pass a DC 16 Wisdom save or become Blinded until the start of its next turn. This takes no action.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. Communicate with Beasts and Plants as though they shared a language.
Supernatural Resistance. Sylphise has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks or use Sibilant Whispers twice.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) slashing plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage.
Sibilant Whispers. One visible creature within 60 ft. must pass a DC 16 Charisma save or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Etherealness. Enter the Ethereal Plane from the Mundane World, or return from the Ethereal Plane.
sections.Reactions: Too Slow! When a creature misses Sylphise with an attack, she can move up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Wilderkith. The party may use one villain party action per round after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order, and requires its performer to be present and able to act.
Action 3. Blood-Soaked Daisies. Sylphise moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks. Make one Claw attack against each enemy she passes within 5 ft. of during that move.

name: Tusker Demon
classification: Huge Fiend (Demon, Category 2), typically chaotic evil
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Wis +3, Cha +2. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to poison damage and to Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned. Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond that distance), soulsight 30 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands Abyssal but cannot speak.
description: A huge demon that tramples smaller foes and spends souls to rush anyone who draws its blood.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 122.
sections.Traits:
Starting souls. Use 2 souls or roll 1d4.
Trample. Move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures as difficult terrain. The first time the demon enters a creature's space on its own turn, it can make a Stomp attack against that creature without an action. It can end its turn in the space of a Prone Medium or smaller creature. That creature cannot stand while it remains in the demon's space.
sections.Actions:
Gore. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) piercing damage. Spend 1 soul to push the target up to 40 ft. directly away.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature must pass a DC 17 Strength save or fall Prone.
Tongue. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage. A creature must pass a DC 17 Strength save or be pulled up to 10 ft. toward the demon.
sections.Reactions: Vengeful Charge (1 soul). When an enemy within 40 ft. deals damage to the demon, move up to the demon's speed straight toward that enemy. If the demon ends within 10 ft. of the enemy, it can make a Gore attack against it.

name: Tuval-Uthriar
otherStatistics: Mithral plate and shield. Saves Str +7, Con +4, Wis +2. Skills Athletics +7, Perception +4, Stealth +5, Survival +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common, Elvish, Sylvan.
description: The Wilderkith’s paladin commander anchors the front line and uses his gauntlet to blast defenders and structures.

sections.Printed source: Wilderkith actions, p. 369. Stat block, p. 371.
sections.Traits:
Elf Glamour (1/day). When a creature targets Tuval-Uthriar with an attack, power, or spell, it must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or become Charmed by him until the end of his next turn. This takes no action.
Supernatural Resistance. Tuval-Uthriar has advantage on saves against powers, spells, and other supernatural effects.
Wheel of Ire. Enemies within 30 ft. have disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than Tuval-Uthriar.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) wielded with two hands.
Call Lightning (3/day, 3rd-level spell). Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Creatures within 5 ft. of it make DC 15 Dexterity saves, taking 16 (3d10) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Eye of Sunrise (1/day). The gauntlet blasts a 30-ft. cone, audible 300 ft. away. Creatures in the cone make DC 15 Dexterity saves, taking 17 (5d6) fire plus 17 (5d6) force damage on a failure or half on a success. Structures and unattended mundane objects in the cone take 35 (10d6) fire plus 35 (10d6) force damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Healing Word (2nd-level spell). Restore 8 (2d4 + 3) HP to one visible creature within 60 ft. that is neither a Construct nor Undead.
sections.Utility Spells:
Charisma, save DC 15. Each spell takes an action.
At will. Light, Mage Hand, Message.
3/day each. Detect Magic, Speak with Animals.
1/day each. Detect Thoughts, Find Traps, Pass without Trace.
sections.Villain Party Action:
Wilderkith. The party may use one villain party action per round after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order, and requires its performer to be present and able to act.
Action 4. Tactical Push. Each member of the Inner Circle within 60 ft. who can hear Tuval-Uthriar may make one attack or move up to its speed, without an action.

name: Anthracia, Princess of Venom
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +5, Wis +8, Cha +9. Nature +8, Perception +8, Stealth +8. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Common, Elvish, Sylvan.
description: The Wilderkith's dryad leader keeps her tree hidden inside Gemhollow and fights by shifting the ground beneath her enemies.

sections.Printed source: Wilderkith, pp. 367–369. Stat block and party action, p. 369.
sections.Traits: Supernatural Resistance. Anthracia has advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Stone Touch and Missile Thorn. Anthracia can also use Tree Teleport if available.
Stone Touch. Melee spell attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (3d8) necrotic damage. On a failed DC 17 Constitution save the target is Restrained and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns. If reduced to 0 HP by this attack, it stabilizes and is Petrified into a stone tree. A Cure Ailment power of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect ends the petrification.
Missile Thorn. Ranged spell attack +9, range 90 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d6) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Tree Teleport (3/day, 5th-level spell). Touch a living tree and teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of a second living tree no more than 500 ft. away. Both trees must be Medium or larger.
Wall of Poison (1/day). Center an opaque wall of poison gas on a visible point within 150 ft. It can be up to 50 ft. long, 15 ft. high, and 5 ft. thick. Its area is heavily obscured for 1 minute. Each creature in it when it appears or entering it for the first time on a turn makes a DC 17 Constitution save. It takes 26 (4d12) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. Creatures that need no air automatically succeed. Wind of at least 10 mph disperses it after 4 rounds and wind of at least 20 mph disperses it after 1 round.
sections.Reactions: Sudden Quake. When an enemy moves within 15 ft. of Anthracia, every creature within 15 ft. of her makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
sections.Villain Party Action:
The Wilderkith can take one party action per round after an enemy's turn. Each action is available once per encounter, in any order, and its actor must be present and able to act.
Action 1, Liquid Earth. Each creature within 60 ft. of Anthracia makes a DC 17 Dexterity save. A target can choose to fail. She can move each creature that fails up to 15 ft. horizontally.

name: Count Rhodar von Glauer
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +11, Wis +9, Cha +12. Deception +12, History +11, Intimidation +12, Perception +9, Persuasion +12, Stealth +11. Resists necrotic and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened, Prone, and Stunned. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 19. Common.
description: This vampire lord pins opponents with spears of darkness and drains their vitality with Sanguinus.

sections.Printed source: Vampire lair actions, p. 269. Stat block, p. 272.
sections.Traits:
Resting Place. If Rhodar drops to 0 HP away from his resting place, he teleports there. At 0 HP there he is stable, and after an hour there at 0 HP he regains 1 HP.
Spear Sacrifice (3/day). Rhodar starts with three floating spears and can call one to a free hand on his turn without an action. When he fails a check or save, he can destroy a spear to succeed. He can use neither Spear Sacrifice nor Spear of the Damned after the last spear is destroyed. Destroyed spears return at dusk.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Sanguinus attacks. Rhodar can also make one Spear of the Damned attack per remaining use of Spear Sacrifice.
Sanguinus. Melee weapon attack +12, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. A creature's maximum HP falls by the necrotic damage taken and Rhodar heals that amount. The reduction lasts until Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect removes it. A target whose maximum HP drops to 0 dies. A humanoid killed this way rises as a vampire spawn under Rhodar's control at the following midnight.
Spear of the Damned. Ranged spell attack +12, range 60 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) force damage. A creature hit falls Prone and is Restrained by the spear. It or a creature that can reach it can use an action or a bonus action to attempt a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing it on a success. It is also freed if Rhodar summons the spear to attack someone else or destroys it with Spear Sacrifice.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Beguile. Pick one visible creature within 30 ft. that can see Rhodar. On a failed DC 20 Wisdom save, the target spends its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed to a location Rhodar chooses. Rhodar chooses whether it then falls Prone or makes a melee attack against a target he picks.
Inhuman Agility. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Reactions: Withering Stare. When a visible creature within 60 ft. hits Rhodar, that creature makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each villain action once per encounter after an enemy's turn. Use at most one per round, in any order.
Action 1, Bloodstained. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere on a point Rhodar sees within 120 ft. Each creature there other than an Undead makes a DC 20 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is bloodstained until the end of Rhodar's next turn. He has advantage on attacks against it, and it has disadvantage on saves against his Beguile.
Action 2, Fire Drake. Rhodar and his gear turn into a Large dragon of fire. He releases any creature he is grappling and any Grappled or Restrained effect on him ends. He flies up to twice his speed to an unoccupied space, ignoring difficult terrain and opportunity attacks and able to pass through creatures and objects. Each creature he passes through makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. He then returns to his previous form.
Action 3, Mist of Blades. The area within 60 ft. is heavily obscured for other creatures. Rhodar can teleport up to four times to unoccupied spaces in the mist. After each teleport he can make one Sanguinus attack. The mist disappears at the end of the action.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 20. At will, 1 action each: Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Sending. 3/day each, longer casting times: Clairvoyance, Geas (9th level), Legend Lore.
sections.Lair Actions:
When fighting in its lair, a vampire takes one lair action at initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot repeat the same action in consecutive rounds.
Children of the Night. Bats and insects move with the vampire. The area within 30 ft. of it is heavily obscured for other creatures until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round.
Blood Rain. Choose a visible point within 60 ft. Blood falls there in a 10-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round. A creature other than an Undead that takes necrotic damage while inside takes an extra 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Obey My Desire. Each creature within 60 ft. that hears the vampire makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or is Charmed until the end of this turn. Each creature Charmed this way immediately spends its reaction, if available, to make a melee attack against another creature, make one against itself, or fall Prone. The vampire picks the effect.
sections.Flanked (MCDM): If using flanking rules, creatures cannot flank Rhodar.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Shadowkeep, p. 216 (stat block), pp. 208–209 (confrontation and lair actions), p. 214 (resting place).
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Start the Shadowkeep confrontation after the party defeats the other vampires and spawn or tries to leave the mountain. Rhodar’s lair actions are available in this fight. If reduced to 0 HP, he teleports to his resting place inside the petrified angel in area V7.

name: Green Hag (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Arcana +4, Deception +6, Perception +4, Stealth +5. Resists poison damage and is immune to Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common, Primordial, Sylvan.
description: A green hag strengthens her allies' weapons with venom and helps them escape or change positions.

sections.Printed source: Stat block and coven action, p. 137.
sections.Traits: Envenom. Allies within 30 ft. deal an extra 3 (1d6) poison damage with weapon attacks unless the hag is Incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Poison Claw once and Granny Says.
Poison Claw. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Granny Says. Choose another willing creature the hag sees within 30 ft. It either trades places with the hag by magic or spends its reaction, if available, to make an attack.
Naughty Mousey (3/day, 5th-level spell, Concentration). Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. and a Beast form of CR 2 or lower. On a failed DC 14 Wisdom save, the creature takes that form for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Use the Beast's statistics except the target retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, alignment, and personality. Its gear merges with the form and provides no benefits. It cannot speak or cast spells but can take the Beast's actions. If reduced to 0 HP in this form, it returns to its original form with half the HP it had before the change.
sections.Reactions: Get Gone. When an ally within 30 ft. is targeted by an attack, the hag can make the ally Invisible until the start of the ally's next turn. She must see the attacker and ally. This can impose disadvantage on the triggering attack.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 14. At will, 1 action each: Alter Self, Dancing Lights, Minor Illusion. 3/day each: Animal Messenger and Speak with Animals using 1 action, Legend Lore using its longer casting time. 1/day: Scrying using its longer casting time.
sections.Coven Action:
A coven has three hags, which may be of different kinds. A hag in the coven gains the following action.
Noxious Vines (Recharge 5–6). Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. Each ally within 30 ft. regains 18 (4d8) HP.

name: Harpy (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +4. Blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 10. Common, Giant.
description: A harpy uses its song to hold prey in place, then draws hearers toward cliffs or a waiting shambling mound.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 142. Chorus and shambling mound encounter, p. 143.
sections.Traits: Echolocation. The harpy loses its blindsight while Deafened.
sections.Actions:
Talons. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (3d4 + 2) slashing damage. A Medium or smaller target Charmed by the harpy is also Grappled (escape DC 12). The harpy cannot use Talons against another target until that grapple ends.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack +4, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Alluring Song. The harpy sings until it chooses to stop without using an action, becomes Deafened, or is Incapacitated. When a creature other than a harpy starts its turn within 200 ft. of the singer, if it can hear the song and shares a language with the singer, it makes a DC 12 Wisdom save. On a failure it is Charmed until the song stops or it can no longer hear it. While Charmed it cannot move willingly on its turn or attack, damage, or target any unwilling harpy. If damaged by a source other than a harpy, it can repeat the save to end the effect. A creature that succeeds is immune to all harpies' Alluring Songs for 1 hour.
sections.Bonus Actions: Beckon. Choose any number of creatures Charmed by this harpy's Alluring Song. Each spends its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed in a direction the harpy chooses. Before entering hazardous terrain it may attempt a DC 12 Wisdom save. On success the charm ends and it keeps its reaction.

name: Medusa (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +6, Dex +8, Con +7. Perception +4, Stealth +8, Survival +4. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Common.
description: This medusa slows and petrifies its enemies in stages while firing poisoned bolts.

sections.Printed source: Stat block and lair actions, p. 189.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Stone Gaze and make two attacks in any combination of Snake Bite and Heavy Crossbow.
Snake Bite. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) poison damage. On a failed DC 15 Constitution save, the target is Poisoned until the end of the medusa's next turn.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +8, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Stone Gaze. Up to three visible creatures within 60 ft. make DC 15 Constitution saves. A failure starts turning the target to stone, reducing its speed by 10 ft. and giving disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves. A save at the end of each of the target's turns ends the effect on success. If it fails another save against Stone Gaze while turning to stone, reduce its speed by another 10 ft. and apply Dazed until the effect ends. If it fails again while turning to stone and Dazed this way, it is Petrified and no longer repeats saves. Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect removes the petrification.
sections.Bonus Actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Lair Actions:
Take one lair action at initiative count 20, losing ties. The same option cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Venom Shower. Center a 10-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder on a visible point within 90 ft. Each creature in it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Poisoned through the end of initiative count 20 of the next round.
Shadowstep. Teleport up to 30 ft. to a visible unoccupied space.
Stony Wail. Each enemy within 60 ft. that can hear the lair's statues makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Frightened of the medusa through the end of initiative count 20 of the next round.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

name: Night Hag (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Deception +10, Insight +6, Perception +6, Stealth +7 (+17 with Pass without Trace). Resists fire, necrotic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16. Common, Infernal, Sylvan.
description: A night hag puts enemies to sleep, turns allies against each other, or shrinks small enough to haunt a sleeper.

sections.Printed source: Stat block and coven action, p. 138.
sections.Traits: Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Dream Claw attacks.
Dream Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing plus 3 (1d6) psychic damage. If this attack hits the same target more than once on a turn, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On failure it is Unconscious for up to 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Damage or another creature in reach using an action to wake it also ends the effect. A creature that cannot be supernaturally put to sleep automatically succeeds.
Vicious Visions (1/day, 6th-level spell). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Charmed for 1 minute, ending early if it deals damage to another creature. While Charmed it sees its allies as enemies and its enemies as allies.
Tiny Time. The hag and her gear shrink to 1 inch and become Tiny. She has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide while Tiny and retains her other statistics. As a bonus action she can return to normal size or enter the head of an Unconscious Humanoid within reach. Inside, she has total cover against outside effects and can speak telepathically to the host, which cannot tell where the voice comes from. The host gains no benefit from rest without her permission, and she can give it nightmares as it tries to sleep. Dispel Evil and Good or a similar supernatural effect expels the hag. She can also exit as a bonus action. Either exit restores her normal size.
sections.Bonus Actions: Sleepwalk. Move one visible Unconscious creature within 60 ft. up to 30 ft. horizontally. Tiny Time also gives the bonus action options in that action.
sections.Reactions: Aren't You Tired? When a creature within 5 ft. hits the hag, it makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure it cannot take reactions and has disadvantage on attacks and saves through the end of the hag's next turn. A creature that cannot be supernaturally put to sleep is immune.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 15. At will, 1 action each: Alter Self, Detect Magic, Pass without Trace. 3/day each, longer casting times: Dream, Legend Lore, Mirage Arcane. 1/day: Scrying using its longer casting time.
sections.Coven Action:
A coven has three hags, which may be of different kinds. A hag in the coven gains the following action.
Phantoms Abound (Recharge 5–6). Each enemy within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 22 (5d8) psychic damage and falls Prone, and the hag can use Dream Claw against it if it is within 5 ft. On a success it takes half damage and neither falls nor takes the claw attack.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Eighth City Advocacy Services, p. 206. Shadowkeep, p. 219.
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Sasha Darkdream offers help if the party retrieves her heart from the interrogation clinic (I9) and frees her from the holding cells (I8). In Shadowkeep, Putrid Agnes starts inside Ravlen’s head in Glauer Hall (V2).

name: Sea Hag (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Deception +5, Intimidation +5, Perception +4, Stealth +5. Resists cold and lightning. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Aquan, Common, Sylvan.
description: A sea hag hurls lightning and can surround herself with a moving storm.

sections.Printed source: Stat block and coven action, p. 139.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. Breathes air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Lightning Strike once and Dry Drowning.
Lightning Strike. Melee or ranged spell attack +5, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) lightning damage.
Dry Drowning. One visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or is Dazed until the start of the hag's next turn. A creature that breathes water or needs no air automatically succeeds.
sections.Bonus Actions: Sea Storm (1/day, 3rd-level spell, Concentration). For 1 minute a storm fills a 60-ft. radius centered on the hag and moves with her. Against targets in it her Lightning Strike has advantage and deals an extra 3 (1d6) lightning damage.
sections.Reactions: Fearsome Glare. When a visible creature within 30 ft. hits the hag, it makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or is Frightened of the hag until the end of her next turn.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 13. At will, 1 action each: Create or Destroy Water, Disguise Self. 3/day each: Control Water using 1 action, Identify using its longer casting time. 1/day each, longer casting times: Clairvoyance, Legend Lore.
sections.Coven Action:
A coven has three hags, which may be of different kinds. A hag in the coven gains the following action.
Grasping Detritus (Recharge 5–6). Each enemy in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure it takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and is Restrained until the end of the hag's next turn. On a success it takes half damage with no restraint.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn a Dazed creature can move, take an action, or take a bonus action. It chooses one. Becoming Dazed during its turn ends the turn. Extra actions from effects such as Haste or Action Surge are still available. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, and Greater Restoration can remove Dazed.

name: Shtriga Nonna
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throw Wis +5. Deception +7, Perception +5, Stealth +6, Survival +5. Resists thunder and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to cold, fire, Charmed, and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common, Giant, Infernal, Sylvan.
description: A mountain hag whose hut walks on cat paws. She fights alone and can turn into a cat to escape a failed save.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 140.
sections.Traits:
Feline Resilience (3/day). When Nonna fails a save, she can turn into a cat and succeed instead. The cat is Medium, or Large during Grow. She keeps her statistics and can speak, but cannot cast spells or use Soul Steal. She returns to her previous form at the end of her next turn.
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Corrosive Claw attacks. One can be replaced with Soul Steal if available.
Corrosive Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. with Grow, one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, or 14 (3d6 + 4) with Grow. If the target wears mundane metal armor it makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure the armor permanently loses 1 AC, cumulative across hits. The armor is destroyed if its AC falls to 10.
Soul Steal (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 16 (3d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Nonna regains 10 HP per failed save.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Grow (2/day, 3rd-level spell). For 1 minute Nonna and her gear grow to Large or the largest size the space permits. Her reach becomes 10 ft., her Strength-based weapon attacks deal an extra 3 (1d6) damage already included above, and she has advantage on Strength checks and saves.
Gobble You Up. An Unconscious creature within 5 ft. takes 10 (3d6) piercing damage and Soul Steal recharges.
sections.Reactions: Turned Upside Down. When a creature hits Nonna with a melee attack, each creature within 5 ft. of her makes a DC 15 Strength save. On failure it rises vertically 10 ft. and hangs there until the end of its next turn. It then falls unless it can stay aloft.
sections.Villain Actions:
Use each villain action once per encounter after an enemy's turn. Use at most one per round, in any order.
Action 1, Snackies for Sweeties. Each other creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of its turns. Holding its breath or needing no air gives no protection.
Action 2, Feline Felicity. Each creature within 5 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On failure it takes 10 (4d4) force damage and is pushed 10 ft. away. A success halves damage and prevents the push. Nonna can then move up to twice her speed.
Action 3, Open the Oven. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. It takes 13 (3d8) fire plus 13 (3d8) thunder damage on failure or half on success.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 15. At will, 1 action each: Alter Self, Detect Thoughts, Thaumaturgy. 3/day each, longer casting times: Fabricate, Legend Lore. 1/day: Scrying using its longer casting time.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

ruleNotes: The printed Corrosive Claw calls for a 'Dexterity throw.' Use a Dexterity saving throw, as the DC and attack context indicate.

Where Evil Lives.sourceLocator: Shtriga Nonna’s Hut, p. 53 (stat block), p. 50 (kitchen encounter).
Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Nonna is preparing a prisoner for dinner in the kitchen (H8). She may bargain for live prey or something the party values. If attacked or refused, she fights without calling for reinforcements.

name: Starving Harpy
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Blindsight 30 ft., passive Perception 10. Common, Giant.
description: This minion harmonizes with a harpy's song and pushes prey into bad ground.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 143.
sections.Traits:
Chorus of Death. A starving harpy that hears a harpy's Alluring Song can harmonize without an action. It stops when the song ends, when it chooses, or if it becomes Deafened or Incapacitated. Each harmonizing starving harpy adds 50 ft. to the song's range and +1 to both the singer's Alluring Song and Beckon save DCs. The DC increase caps at +5.
Echolocation. The starving harpy loses its blindsight while Deafened.
sections.Actions: Grasping Talons (group attack). Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 piercing damage per participant. The attackers can move a creature hit 5 ft. in any direction, or 10 ft. if at least three starving harpies joined the attack.

name: Swamp Dryad
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Str +9, Con +9, Wis +10. Acrobatics +6, Animal Handling +10, Arcana +6, Medicine +10, Survival +10. Resists acid, poison, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15. Sylvan and any languages it spoke before binding.
description: A dryad bound to a swamp tree can lock enemies in its roots long enough to turn them into wood.

sections.Printed source: Swamp, p. 336.
sections.Traits:
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against supernatural effects.
Speak with Beasts and Plants. The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as though they shared a language.
Tree Stride (1/turn). Spend 10 ft. of movement to enter a living tree within reach and emerge in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of another living tree up to 60 ft. from the first. Each tree must be Large or larger.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks and use Entangling Roots if available.
Slam. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute. On a success it takes half the poison damage without the condition.
Entangling Roots (Recharge 5–6). Center a 15-ft.-radius area on a visible point within 60 ft. of the dryad. The radius is 30 ft. instead if the dryad stands within 5 ft. of its tree. Each creature in the area makes a DC 18 Strength save or takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is Grappled (escape DC 14). It is Restrained while Grappled this way. If its third consecutive turn ends still Grappled, it is Petrified into a hardwood statue. The dryad can use an action to end that petrification, which also ends if it dies.
Fey Intimidation. Choose up to five visible creatures within 30 ft. Those that see the dryad make a DC 18 Wisdom save or become Frightened of it. A target repeats the save at the end of its turns. A creature that succeeds or recovers is immune to this dryad's Fey Intimidation for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus Actions: Swamp Medicine (3/day). Touch a creature. It regains 18 (3d8 + 5) HP, or the dryad can remove one disease or neutralize one poison affecting it instead.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: Boughs of Eternity (p. 303, L1). Sealh and Salix guard the entrance together. A DC 25 Charisma (Deception or Persuasion) check persuades them to admit the party without an appointment. They can spare their allies when using Entangling Roots here.

name: Vampire (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +10, Wis +8, Cha +10. Deception +10, History +9, Insight +8, Intimidation +10, Perception +8, Persuasion +10, Stealth +10. Resists necrotic and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 18. Languages known in life.
description: A vampire can leave its enemies reeling by turning to mist, then draw them close enough to feed.

sections.Printed source: Lair actions, p. 269. Stat block, p. 270.
sections.Traits:
Radiant Aversion. Whenever it takes radiant damage, it takes 10 extra radiant damage.
Resting Place. If it drops to 0 HP outside sunlight, running water, and its resting place, it teleports to its resting place. It is stable while there. After 1 hour there at 0 HP, it regains 1 HP.
Turn Resistance. Advantage on saves against effects that turn Undead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Bite attack if possible.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 18) and Restrained while held. Only one creature can be held this way. Moving while holding a Medium or smaller creature does not halve the vampire's speed.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the vampire, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's maximum HP falls by the necrotic damage taken and the vampire heals that amount. Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can restore that maximum. A creature dies if this brings its maximum HP to 0. A humanoid killed this way rises at the following midnight as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.
Exsanguinating Mist (Recharge 6). The vampire and its equipment turn to mist, releasing anything it is grappling and ending any Grappled or Restrained effect on itself. It flies up to twice its speed to an empty space, ignores difficult terrain and opportunity attacks, and can pass through creatures and objects. Each creature passed through makes a DC 18 Constitution save for 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The vampire then resumes its previous form.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Beguile. One visible creature within 30 ft. that can see the vampire makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure it spends its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed to a location the vampire chooses. The vampire then chooses whether the victim falls Prone or makes a melee attack against a target the vampire picks. A creature that cannot be Charmed succeeds automatically. A creature with advantage against Charmed makes this save with advantage.
Inhuman Agility. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Reactions: Run, My Child. When an ally the vampire can see takes damage, that ally can move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks at the vampire's command.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 18. At will, 1 action each: Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Sending. 1/day each, longer casting times: Clairvoyance, Geas.
sections.Lair Actions:
When fighting in its lair, a vampire takes one lair action at initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot repeat the same action in consecutive rounds.
Children of the Night. Bats and insects move with the vampire. The area within 30 ft. of it is heavily obscured for other creatures until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round.
Blood Rain. Choose a visible point within 60 ft. Blood falls there in a 10-ft.-radius, 40-ft.-high cylinder until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round. A creature other than an Undead that takes necrotic damage while inside takes an extra 5 (1d10) necrotic damage.
Obey My Desire. Each creature within 60 ft. that hears the vampire makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or is Charmed until the end of this turn. Each creature Charmed this way immediately spends its reaction, if available, to make a melee attack against another creature, make one against itself, or fall Prone. The vampire picks the effect.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.

name: Vampire Spawn (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Saving throws Wis +3, Cha +6. Acrobatics +7, Intimidation +6, Perception +3, Persuasion +6, Stealth +7. Resists necrotic. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Languages known in life.
description: A newly made vampire that pursues prey and fights at close quarters with claws and teeth.

sections.Printed source: Stat block, p. 271.
sections.Traits: Radiant Aversion. Whenever the spawn takes radiant damage, it takes 10 extra radiant damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks. One can be replaced with Bite.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. A Large or smaller target is also Grappled (escape DC 15). Only one creature can be held this way. Moving while holding a Medium or smaller creature does not halve the spawn's speed.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the spawn, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. The creature's maximum HP falls by the necrotic damage taken and the spawn heals that amount. The reduction lasts until the creature finishes a long rest or is affected by Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect. The target dies if this brings its maximum HP to 0.
sections.Bonus Actions: Inhuman Speed. Move up to speed.

Where Evil Lives.tableNote: In Shadowkeep, Merric accompanies Famsa in the war room (V3), and three spawn have a 50 percent chance of interrupting a rest unless Rhodar fell to 0 HP within the past hour. In Coronal Hollow, two spawn guard the Cultist Ritual (B6) with Eritha.

name: High Mage Vairae
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +11, Int +14, Wis +13, Cha +13. Arcana +14, Athletics +10, Deception +13, History +14, Perception +13, Persuasion +13. Resists fire and cold and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Charmed, Dazed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Speaks Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Elvish, Infernal, and Sylvan. Telepathy 120 ft.
description: The elven High Mage hides their lichdom. Their soulstone is a sphere of everlasting ice.

sections.Traits:
Draining Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed save into a success. Vairae then has disadvantage on spell attacks until the end of their next turn.
Rejuvenation (Soulstone Sanctum, area L8). If destroyed with the soulstone intact, Vairae's soul enters it. A creature that can see the stone at the start of its turn makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is Charmed until the end of its next turn and must try to move toward and touch the stone, avoiding clear hazards. Touching the occupied stone forces a DC 20 Constitution save. On a failure, the creature drops to 0 HP and Vairae reforms at full HP. On a success, the creature loses half its HP and Vairae reforms at half HP. In either case Vairae appears in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the stone. The stone has AC 19, 50 HP, and immunity to every damage type except force and thunder.
Supernatural Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells, powers, and other supernatural effects.
Turn Immunity. Vairae is immune to effects that turn Undead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Glare of Undeath and make four attacks in any combination of Conflagration, Immortal Pain, and Magic Drain.
Conflagration (4th-level spell). Ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 150-ft. range, one target. Hit 35 (10d6) fire damage. If the target takes both an action and a bonus action on its next turn, it takes 17 (5d6) more fire damage at the end of that turn.
Immortal Pain (4th-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 90-ft. range, one creature. Hit 28 (8d6) psychic damage and afflicts the target with pain, halving the damage its attacks deal. After each attack it makes against an enemy, the target can end the effect with a successful DC 22 Constitution save. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect also ends the pain.
Magic Drain (4th-level spell). Melee or ranged spell attack, +14 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 60-ft. range, one creature. Hit 26 (4d12) necrotic damage. If the target is under the effects of spells Vairae did not cast, those effects end on a failed DC 22 Wisdom save.
Glare of Undeath. One creature Vairae sees within 60 ft. makes a DC 22 Wisdom save. On a failure, it clutches itself and is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn. A creature the target can hear and understand can use an action to end the effect with a DC 22 Charisma (Persuasion) check.
Machinations of Bone (2/day). Choose a visible point within 150 ft. Every enemy within 30 ft. of that point makes a DC 22 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 54 (12d8) piercing damage, falls Prone, and cannot stand until it receives supernatural healing.
sections.Bonus Actions: Necrotic Form (3rd-level spell). Assume a shadow form and move up to their speed. Until the end of the turn, Vairae is immune to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and to Grappled and Restrained, and can pass through a 1-inch opening without squeezing.
sections.Reactions: Baleful Teleport (6th-level spell). When a visible creature within 120 ft. targets Vairae with an attack, the attacker makes a DC 22 Charisma save. On a failure, Vairae teleports the attacker up to 60 ft. into a visible unoccupied space. If Vairae is now an invalid target, the attacker must choose a new target or miss.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each action is available once per encounter, after an enemy finishes a turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
1. Cages of Wasting. Enemies within 60 ft. make DC 22 Dexterity saves. Failure deals 27 (5d10) necrotic damage and Restrains the target in a cage for up to 1 minute. A success halves the damage. A trapped target can repeat the save at the end of each turn or teleport out. Destroying Vairae also ends the restraint.
2. My Magic Alone. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 22 Wisdom saves. A creature that fails cannot benefit from magic items or cast spells of 4th level or higher until the end of Vairae's next turn.
3. Necrostorm. Creatures within 60 ft. make DC 22 Dexterity saves, taking 78 (12d12) necrotic damage or half on a success. A Humanoid killed by this damage rises as a wraith at the start of Vairae's next turn, permanently following Vairae's verbal commands.
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative 20, losing ties, use one effect. The same lair action cannot be used in consecutive rounds.
Soul Sip. Choose two visible enemies within 90 ft. Each takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage on a failed DC 20 Constitution save.
Spirit Shell. Until the end of initiative count 20 of the next round, a creature hitting Vairae with a melee attack makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is Dazed until the start of that creature's next turn.
Unnatural Born Leader. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed and make a weapon attack against a creature Vairae chooses.
sections.Dazed (MCDM): On its turn, a Dazed creature chooses one of these options: move, take an action, or take a bonus action. If it becomes Dazed during its turn, its turn ends. Extra actions from effects such as Haste and Action Surge still apply. Cure Ailment, Lesser Restoration, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can end this condition.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.
sections.Printed source: Boughs of Eternity, p. 313 (stat block), p. 307 (soulstone and lair)
sections.Soulstone Ward: One Last Horror. A 9th-level Glyph of Warding guards the soulstone. It triggers when a creature succeeds on the DC 20 Constitution save after touching the occupied stone, or when a creature other than Vairae touches the empty stone. The glyph casts True Polymorph on that creature. On a failed DC 22 Wisdom save, it turns the target into a camel.
sections.Winter Throne:
Vairae fights until destroyed while the soulstone remains intact. If it has been destroyed, Vairae tries to flee the tower upon reaching 100 HP.
Frozen Pool. The pool is difficult terrain. When a creature other than Vairae first touches it on a turn or starts a turn touching it, that creature makes a DC 22 Constitution save. On a failure it takes 19 (3d12) necrotic damage and falls Prone. The ice has AC 21 and 100 HP and is immune to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. A 9th-level Dispel Magic ends the magic and melts the ice. A lower-level casting requires a DC 19 spellcasting ability check.
Hallow. The chamber permits Fiends and Undead to enter. Other creatures entering can become vulnerable to necrotic damage under the spell’s Energy Vulnerability effect, with a DC 22 Charisma save.

ruleNotes: Machinations of Bone involves body horror. Spectral blades can describe the same effect at the table.

name: Xorannox
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Int +9, Wis +7, Cha +9. Arcana +9, Deception +9, Insight +7, Intimidation +9, Perception +7. Immune to Charmed, Flanked, Frightened and Prone. Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 17. Common, Deep Speech and Undercommon.
appearance: The Tyract is an armored vaurath with a massive central eye and eight detached psionic eyes.

sections.Traits: Painful Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Xorannox can succeed by destroying one of his eight floating eyes, chosen randomly with a d8. He grows a new eye to replace it 24 hours later.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Psionics. Use three different effects from the floating eyes. No effect can be used twice on the same turn. Except where an effect specifies otherwise, each targets one creature Xorannox can see within 120 ft.
Charm Beam. DC 17 Wisdom save or Charmed by Xorannox for 1 hour. The charm ends if he harms the target or one of the target’s allies.
Compulsion Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save or the target uses its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed toward its closest visible ally and make a weapon attack against that ally. Creatures immune to Charmed are unaffected.
Memory Beam. DC 17 Intelligence save. On a failure, the target expends an available spell slot of its highest remaining level with no effect. A target with no slots left loses proficiency with one weapon it holds or carries for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns to end that loss early.
Toxic Vapors. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. All creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Constitution save or become Poisoned for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end the effect early.
Telekinetic Field. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Each enemy within 10 ft. of it makes a DC 17 Strength save. On a failure, Xorannox moves the enemy up to 30 ft. in any direction and deals 7 (2d6) force damage at the end of that movement. He can also move an object in the area up to 30 ft. in any direction if it weighs 300 pounds or less and is neither worn nor carried. He can manipulate the object precisely.
Lightning Bolt. Creatures in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success.
Explosion. Choose a visible point within 120 ft. Creatures within 10 ft. of it make a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
Necrosis Beam. DC 17 Constitution save or the target takes 55 (10d10) necrotic damage immediately and loses 7 (2d6) HP at the start of each of its turns. A target reduced to 0 HP by this effect dies. The effect ends if Xorannox dies or loses sight of the target. He cannot use the beam again while that effect lasts.
sections.Bonus Actions: The Great Eye (Recharge 6). Xorannox projects a 150-ft. cone. For Xorannox and each creature in the cone affected by a spell, that spell’s effects end immediately for that creature.
sections.Reactions: Cower! When an attacker hits Xorannox, it makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it takes 21 (6d6) psychic damage and is Frightened of him for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
sections.Villain Actions:
Each option is available once per encounter after an enemy’s turn. Use them in any order, at most one per round.
Disruption Beams. Choose three visible creatures within 120 ft. Each makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) psychic damage whenever it makes more than one weapon attack on a turn or casts a spell of 1st level or higher. The effect lasts 1 minute, and each affected creature repeats the save at the end of its own turn to end it early.
Disappearing Act. Xorannox becomes Invisible until the end of his next turn and teleports to a visible unoccupied space within 120 ft.
Megabeam. In a 120-ft. line, 20 ft. wide, each creature saves against two random Eye Psionics effects from Xorannox’s remaining eyes. Reroll duplicates for each creature. Effects that normally cover an area affect only that individual creature.
sections.Printed source: The White Tower, p. 150 (stat block), p. 142 (lair)
sections.Lair Actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same action cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Gas Belch. Choose a point on a floor, wall, or ceiling within 60 ft. A 20-ft. sphere of gas lasts through the end of initiative count 20 next round. A creature that enters it for the first time or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or be Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Slime Shower. One enemy within 120 ft. makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it becomes vulnerable to fire and lightning damage until it takes either type of damage or initiative count 20 ends next round, whichever comes first.
Telekinetic Hold. Choose three enemies within 60 ft. Each makes a DC 15 Strength save. On a failure, the enemy’s speed becomes 0 and it rises straight up 20 ft. It falls at the end of initiative count 20 next round.
sections.Retreat: At 60 HP, Xorannox ends the levitation affecting the library furniture and tries to escape through the egg pit at X9. Other creatures in X5 or X6 make a DC 17 Dexterity save against the falling furniture, taking 35 (10d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Empowered Bog Body
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +2, Stealth +5. Immune to acid and poison damage and to the Poisoned condition. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Understands its languages from life and cannot speak.
description: This corpse hides in bog water and pulls victims under.

sections.Traits: Acidic Blood. When a creature within 5 ft. deals piercing or slashing damage to the bog body, that creature takes 3 (1d6) acid damage.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit this way is Grappled (escape DC 18). The bog body can Slam only that creature until the grapple ends.
