Sling Mud. Ranged weapon attack, +10 to hit, range 30 ft., one target. Hit 10 (1d4 + 8) bludgeoning plus 3 (1d6) acid damage.
Submerge. In swampy terrain, the bog body can sink into the water and mud to become heavily obscured. It takes any creature it is grappling down with it. The creature is heavily obscured, Restrained, and unable to breathe while submerged. It takes 4 (1d8) acid damage at the start of each of its turns.
sections.Bonus Actions: Resurface. The bog body returns to the surface with any target it still has Grappled.
sections.Printed source: Coronal Hollow, p. 242
sections.Encounter notes: Coronal Hollow (p. 237, B2). If the rot angels fight, six empowered bog bodies surface at the start of the second round.

name: Goblin Underboss Slime Servant
otherStatistics: Studded leather and shield. Saves Dex +5, Wis +3. Insight +3, Intimidation +2, Stealth +5. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Common and Goblin.
description: This slime servant directs Ithu’rath’s patrols and uses its allies for cover.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The servant breathes air and water.
Crafty. Leaving an enemy’s reach does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Servant Senses. Ithu’rath shares the servant’s senses and can use the servant’s body to speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Shortsword attacks or two Shortbow attacks. Command can replace one attack.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Command. Choose a visible ally within 30 ft. that can hear the underboss. That ally can spend its reaction to move up to its speed or make a weapon attack.
sections.Bonus Actions: Get Reckless (recharge 6). Each willing ally within 30 ft. that can hear the underboss gains advantage on attack rolls until the start of the underboss’s next turn. Attacks against those allies also have advantage during that time.
sections.Reactions: Cowardly Commander. When an attacker the underboss can see hits it, the underboss can redirect the hit to a willing ally within 5 ft.
sections.Printed source: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 134
sections.Encounter notes: Ruins of Wrathrock (p. 123). The standard slime servant patrol has three orc ramparts, a goblin underboss, and a lizardfolk bloodeye. Patrols end once Ithu’rath is defeated.

name: Human Brawler Slime Servant
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Athletics +5, Intimidation +3. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Passive Perception 10. Speaks Common.
description: The brawler wrestles intruders to the ground and shields itself with whoever it catches.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The servant breathes air and water.
Exploit Opening (3/day). The servant can make an attack with advantage.
Servant Senses. Ithu’rath shares the servant’s senses and can use the servant’s body to speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks in any combination of Grab and Haymaker.
Grab. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage and Grappled (escape DC 13). The brawler cannot Grab a second creature while the grapple lasts.
Haymaker. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 10 (3d4 + 3) if the target is Grappled.
Throw. Hurl one Grappled creature of Medium size or smaller, or one held object, up to 30 ft. horizontally. A thrown creature falls Prone. If the thrown target would enter the space of a creature or solid object no more than one size smaller than itself, it collides, comes to rest in the nearest open space, and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. thrown. A creature of Large size or smaller struck by the thrown target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or takes the same damage and falls Prone.
sections.Reactions: Meat Shield. While grappling a target, the brawler can add +2 AC against a ranged attack that hits it if it can see the attacker. If the bonus turns the hit into a miss, the grappled target takes the hit instead.
sections.Printed source: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 134
sections.Encounter notes: In the surface ruins (p. 123), two brawlers and two trickshots patrol together. A DC 17 group Dexterity (Stealth) check lets the characters avoid the patrol or surprise it.

name: Human Trickshot Slime Servant
otherStatistics: Perception +4, Stealth +6. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Passive Perception 14. Speaks Common.
description: This slime servant backs up Ithu’rath’s patrols with a bayonet and a heavy crossbow.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The servant breathes air and water.
Exploit Opening (3/day). The servant can make an attack with advantage.
Point Blank Shooting. A ranged weapon hit against a creature within 30 ft. deals 7 (2d6) extra piercing damage. An enemy within 5 ft. does not impose disadvantage on the trickshot’s ranged attacks.
Servant Senses. Ithu’rath shares the servant’s senses and can use the servant’s body to speak.
sections.Actions:
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Bayonet. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Ricochet Bolt (recharge 5–6). Make one Heavy Crossbow attack against a target within 100 ft. Make a second Heavy Crossbow attack against a different target within 30 ft. of the first target.
sections.Printed source: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 135
sections.Encounter notes: In the surface ruins (p. 123), two brawlers and two trickshots patrol together. A DC 17 group Dexterity (Stealth) check lets the characters avoid the patrol or surprise it.

name: Lizardfolk Bloodeye Slime Servant
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Save Str +5. Athletics +5, Perception +5. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Passive Perception 15. Speaks Common and Draconic.
description: The bloodeye snares intruders with a bola and uses its gaze to cut them off from their allies.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The servant breathes air and water.
Servant Senses. Ithu’rath shares the servant’s senses and can use the servant’s body to speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite or Bola attack, then use Bloodeye Bolt or Mesmeric Lure if available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Bola. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and the bola Restrains the target. A creature can spend an action to attempt a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature within reach. The bola has AC 10 and breaks after taking 5 slashing damage, freeing the target without hurting it.
Bloodeye Bolt (3/day). Choose a creature the bloodeye can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, it is Blinded for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.
Mesmeric Lure (3/day). Choose a creature the bloodeye can see within 30 ft. On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, every creature except the bloodeye becomes Invisible to the target until the end of the bloodeye’s next turn.
sections.Reactions: Reptilian Escape (1/day). On a failed Strength or Dexterity save, the bloodeye can shed its tail to succeed instead. Its tail grows back after a long rest.
sections.Printed source: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 135
sections.Encounter notes: Ruins of Wrathrock (p. 123). The standard slime servant patrol has three orc ramparts, a goblin underboss, and a lizardfolk bloodeye. Patrols end once Ithu’rath is defeated.

name: Minotaur Lackey Slime Servant
otherStatistics: Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Common.
description: These horned slime servants rush intruders in groups, on land or underwater.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The servant breathes air and water.
Goring Run. If the lackey moves at least 20 ft. straight toward an enemy and finishes within 5 ft. of that enemy, it deals 1 piercing damage.
Minion. Damage from an attack or a failed saving throw drops the lackey to 0 HP. Damage from another source kills it if that damage meets or exceeds its maximum HP. Otherwise it takes no damage.
Servant Senses. Ithu’rath shares the servant’s senses and can use the servant’s body to speak.
sections.Actions: Goring Horns (group attack). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 piercing damage. If at least two lackeys joined the attack, the target makes a Strength save with DC 10 plus the number of participants. On a failure, move the target horizontally 5 ft. per participating lackey.
sections.MCDM minion rules:
Minions with the same stat block can share a turn. They use fixed damage, cannot score critical hits, and have no Hit Dice.
Group attacks. Two to five minions sharing a turn can spend their actions on a single attack against a target in every participant’s range or reach. Add +1 to the roll per participant. On a hit, multiply the listed damage by the number of participants. Only use advantage or disadvantage when it applies to everyone involved. Split groups if the target has different cover or concealment from different attackers.
A minion attacking alone uses its printed bonus and damage. Eligible minions can each spend a reaction to join the same group opportunity attack. If a reaction or similar effect from the target would affect one attacker, the target chooses which participant it affects.
Overkill. A weapon attack that deals more damage than the minion’s maximum HP can apply the excess to another minion with the same block. Keep subtracting each extra target’s HP from the excess to find what carries over. Extra melee targets must be in reach. Extra ranged targets must be on the attack’s line and within the weapon’s short range. An opportunity attack cannot overkill.
sections.Printed source: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 136
sections.Encounter notes: Ruins of Wrathrock (p. 125, J2). In the flooded caverns, the party can keep its distance with a DC 16 group Dexterity (Stealth) or Charisma (Deception) check. Each character chooses their check and rolls with disadvantage if using a source of bright light. On a failed group check, fifteen lackeys attack. Ten more arrive every third round until the party wins or retreats.

name: Orc Rampart Slime Servant
otherStatistics: Chain mail and shield. Athletics +6, Perception +2. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Common and Orc.
description: The rampart guards its patrol and forces nearby enemies to deal with its spear.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The servant breathes air and water.
Relentless (1/turn). If the rampart would drop to 0 HP without dying outright and is not Incapacitated, it can attack an enemy before the HP loss takes effect. It needs no action for this attack. If the attack brings the target to 0 HP, the rampart drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.
Servant Senses. Ithu’rath shares the servant’s senses and can use the servant’s body to speak.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Spear attacks. If both target the same creature, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone except the rampart until the start of the rampart’s next turn.
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage, or 8 (1d8 + 4) on a melee hit using both hands.
sections.Reactions: No! When an enemy within 5 ft. targets another creature with an attack, redirect the attack to the rampart.
sections.Printed source: Ruins of Wrathrock, p. 136
sections.Encounter notes: Ruins of Wrathrock (p. 123). The standard slime servant patrol has three orc ramparts, a goblin underboss, and a lizardfolk bloodeye. Patrols end once Ithu’rath is defeated.

name: Vampire (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Dex +10, Wis +8, Cha +10. Deception +10, History +9, Insight +8, Intimidation +10, Perception +8, Persuasion +10, Stealth +10. Resists necrotic and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from mundane attacks. Immune to Charmed and Frightened. Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 18. Languages known in life.
description: A vampire can leave its enemies reeling by turning to mist, then draw them close enough to feed.

sections.Printed source: Shadowkeep, p. 221. Coronal Hollow, p. 249. Boughs of Eternity, p. 316.
sections.Traits:
Radiant Aversion. Whenever it takes radiant damage, it takes 10 extra radiant damage.
Resting Place. If it drops to 0 HP outside sunlight, running water, and its resting place, it teleports to its resting place. It is stable while there. After 1 hour there at 0 HP, it regains 1 HP.
Turn Resistance. Advantage on saves against effects that turn Undead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Bite attack if possible.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. A Large or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 18) and Restrained while held. Only one creature can be held this way. Moving while holding a Medium or smaller creature does not halve the vampire's speed.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +10, reach 5 ft., one creature Grappled by the vampire, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. The target's maximum HP falls by the necrotic damage taken and the vampire heals that amount. Cure Ailment of 4th order or higher, Greater Restoration, or a similar supernatural effect can restore that maximum. A creature dies if this brings its maximum HP to 0. A humanoid killed this way rises at the following midnight as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.
Exsanguinating Mist (Recharge 6). The vampire and its equipment turn to mist, releasing anything it is grappling and ending any Grappled or Restrained effect on itself. It flies up to twice its speed to an empty space, ignores difficult terrain and opportunity attacks, and can pass through creatures and objects. Each creature passed through makes a DC 18 Constitution save for 35 (10d6) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. The vampire then resumes its previous form.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Beguile. One visible creature within 30 ft. that can see the vampire makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure it spends its reaction, if available, to move up to its speed to a location the vampire chooses. The vampire then chooses whether the victim falls Prone or makes a melee attack against a target the vampire picks. A creature that cannot be Charmed succeeds automatically. A creature with advantage against Charmed makes this save with advantage.
Inhuman Agility. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Reactions: Run, My Child. When an ally the vampire can see takes damage, that ally can move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks at the vampire's command.
sections.Utility Spells: Charisma, save DC 18. At will, 1 action each: Charm Person, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Sending. 1/day each, longer casting times: Clairvoyance, Geas.
sections.Mundane Attacks (MCDM): A mundane attack is one that uses neither magic nor psionics.
sections.Encounter Notes: In Shadowkeep, Famsa guards the War Room (V3) with Merric and a hidden koptourok. Famsa and Azon use the stone shelves in Glauer Hall (V2) as resting places. In Coronal Hollow, Eritha and two vampire spawn guard the entrance to the hidden hoard (B6). In Boughs of Eternity, a vampire and thornblood attack when a living creature comes within 5 ft. of the bodies in the mortuary (L6).

name: Chimera (MCDM)
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Athletics +7, Perception +5. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. Understands one language. Cannot speak.
appearance: A young chimera with a lion’s head, a ram’s head, a dragon’s head, and a scaled tail.

sections.Traits: Volant. After reducing a creature to 0 HP, the chimera can move up to its speed toward an enemy it can see.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Bite attacks. Replace up to one with either Lion’s Toss or Dragon’s Eruption if the latter is available.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Lion’s Toss. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 15 Strength save or is moved up to 20 ft. in any direction.
Dragon’s Eruption (Recharge 6). Choose a point the chimera sees within 120 ft. Each creature in a sphere of radius 10 ft. around it makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. A failure takes 27 (6d8) fire damage and a success takes half.
sections.Bonus Actions: Roar. Every enemy within 60 ft. that can hear the chimera makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or becomes Frightened of it for 1 minute. Each affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on success. A creature that succeeds on a save against Roar or for whom the effect ends gains immunity to this chimera’s Roar for 24 hours.
sections.Reactions: Ram’s Defiance. When a creature within 30 ft. misses the chimera with an attack, the chimera can move in a straight line toward it up to half its speed. If the chimera ends within 5 ft. of it, the creature makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Printed source: Shtriga Nonna’s Hut, p. 51
sections.Encounter notes: On p. 49, Tearmonger hides in the rafters. A DC 14 Wisdom (Perception) check spots her and starts the fight. If unnoticed, she waits until someone searches the books or nest or tries another door, then attacks with the party surprised. She opens with Roar or Dragon’s Eruption before closing in.

name: Owlbear (MCDM)
appearance: A broad, feathered predator with owl eyes and beak, bear-like haunches and long talons.
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +3. Immune to Frightened. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. No languages.

sections.Traits:
Deadly Leap. The owlbear can long jump up to 30 ft. or high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start. After leaping at least 20 ft. toward a target and hitting it with Bite or Claw, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone.
Keen Sight and Smell. The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight or smell.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage. The owlbear can move the target 5 ft. in any direction.
Claw. Melee weapon attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.
Bear Hug (Recharge 4–6). Choose one creature the owlbear can see within 5 ft. It makes a DC 15 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is Grappled (escape DC 15). On a success, it takes half damage. While Grappled this way it is Restrained and takes 5 (1d10) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. Using Bear Hug or Claw against a different target also ends the grapple.
sections.Reactions: Hulking Rush. After taking damage, the owlbear can move up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Printed source: Cloud Fang Keep, p. 108

ruleNotes: Cloud Fang Keep, p. 95. Two owlbears at the doors look like statues. A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check spots their movements. They attack when the party comes within 30 ft. Four patrolling owlbears join at the start of round two. A blood-borne ooze emerges from each of the first two owlbears to die, and a griffon joins at the start of round four.

name: Ashsnake
otherStatistics: Natural armor. AC 18 under ash. Vulnerable to cold and resistant to fire. Blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Understands Ignan without speaking it.
appearance: A giant serpent with charcoal scales and heat glowing through its empty eye sockets.

sections.Traits:
Ash Cover. While burrowing through ash, the ashsnake has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and gains +4 AC.
Eruption. When it emerges from a burrow, any creature within 5 ft. that is at least one size smaller must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity save or fall Prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and either one Constrict or one Crush.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit for 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Constrict. Melee weapon attack +5, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit for 11 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapple the target (escape DC 14). While Grappled this way, the target is Restrained, and the ashsnake cannot use Constrict or Crush on another target. It can release the target at any time during its turn.
Crush. Deal 11 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage to the target the ashsnake is grappling.
Ashen Breath (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. It takes 11 (2d10) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 177

name: Aspect of Fire
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Wisdom saves +6. Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. Immune to fire and poison damage and to Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Restrained, and Unconscious. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Ignan.
appearance: A mountain-sized elemental body of molten rock and open flame.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). On a failed save, the aspect can choose to succeed.
Molten Skin. A creature takes 11 (2d10) fire damage if it touches the aspect, attacks the aspect in melee from within 5 ft., or ends its turn within 5 ft. Flammable objects within 5 ft. ignite.
Natural Light. Bright light extends 60 ft. from the aspect and dim light extends another 60 ft.
Cooling. Taking at least 50 cold damage in one round reduces the aspect’s speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
Fuel for the Fire. Plant life does not slow its movement as difficult terrain. If it starts a turn occupying plants that provide cover, it burns away the plants in its occupied spaces and regains 1d4 HP per 5-ft. square consumed. Regaining at least 17 HP this way recharges Magma Throw.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Molten Fist attacks.
Molten Fist. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit for 16 (2d10 + 5) fire damage.
Stomp. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 20 (3d10 + 5) fire damage. The target falls Prone on a failed DC 17 Constitution save.
Magma Throw (Recharge 5–6). Choose a point within 60 ft. Each creature within 15 ft. of that point makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Legendary Actions:
The aspect has three legendary actions and recovers spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Detect. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check.
Molten Fist. Make one Molten Fist attack.
Magma Barrage (costs 2 actions). Use Magma Throw. Table ruling. If Magma Throw has yet to recharge, the aspect can take 17 cold damage to use it anyway.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 179. Scorched Grove finale, p. 173.
sections.Encounter notes: Scorched Grove finale. Only the southern tree cover can fuel the aspect in this scene. It gains Rekindle and regains 10 HP if it starts its turn at 0 HP. Cold damage that drops it to 0 HP or hits it while at 0 prevents Rekindle on that turn and petrifies it when the turn starts. Petrification lasts an hour. It then returns to full HP. A shattered petrified aspect reassembles in 1d4 rounds, and any pieces still separated when petrification ends have Molten Skin.

ruleNotes: The v1.04 Magma Barrage text is ambiguous about its 17 cold damage clause. Fuel for the Fire separately recharges Magma Throw after the aspect heals at least 17 HP from plants.

name: Caustic Slime
otherStatistics: Immune to acid damage. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8. No languages.
appearance: A pale green ooze with partly dissolved remains visible inside.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including walls and ceilings, without a check.
Caustic. A creature that touches the slime or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 2 (1d4) acid damage on a failed DC 12 Dexterity save.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage.
sections.Reactions: Split. If a hit deals slashing damage while the slime is Medium or larger and has at least 10 HP, it divides into two slimes. Each is one size smaller and has half the original’s HP, rounded down.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 186

name: Emberbat
otherStatistics: Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 11. No languages.
appearance: A tiny bat with ash-colored fur and a flame at the tip of its nose.

sections.Traits:
Echolocation. Deafened prevents the emberbat from using blindsight.
Keen Hearing. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing.
Ember Flame. It can light its nose at will and end the flame at any time. The flame sheds bright light for 5 ft. and dim light for 5 ft. farther. The flame adds the fire damage listed in Bite.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack +0, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 1 piercing damage plus 1 fire damage while its flame is lit.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 182

name: Shifting Slime
otherStatistics: Adaptive determines its damage immunity. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8. No languages.
appearance: An iridescent ooze that changes color after absorbing a damaging spell.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces, including walls and ceilings, without a check.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 5 (1d6 + 2) acid damage and grapple the target (escape DC 13). The target is Restrained until the grapple ends. The slime cannot use Pseudopod on another target while the grapple lasts.
Swallow. Make a Pseudopod attack against a grappled target at least one size smaller than the slime. On a hit, the grapple ends and the target is swallowed. A swallowed target is Restrained and has total cover against attacks and effects from outside the slime. At the start of each of the target’s turns it makes a DC 13 Constitution save, taking 3 (1d6) acid damage on a failure. If Adaptive gives the slime damage immunity, use that damage type instead. The slime can keep one creature swallowed. If the slime dies, the target is free to move and is no longer Restrained.
sections.Reactions:
Split. If a hit deals slashing damage while the slime is Medium or larger and has at least 10 HP, it divides into two slimes. Each is one size smaller and has half the original’s HP, rounded down. Both new slimes retain Adaptive and inherit the parent’s current immunity.
Adaptive. When hit by a damaging spell, the slime can gain immunity to that damage type for 1 hour. A new immunity replaces the existing one and changes the slime’s color.
sections.Adaptive colors: Acid is lime green, cold ice blue, fire bright crimson, force clear, lightning bright yellow, necrotic black, poison dark green, psychic bright violet, radiant warm orange, and thunder bright white.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 187

name: Sticky Slime
otherStatistics: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, and Prone. Blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 8. No languages.
appearance: A rubbery ooze that drags a trail of sticky residue behind it.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. Move through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Slime Trail. The slime’s trail remains sticky for up to 15 minutes. A creature that steps in the trail becomes Restrained on a failed DC 12 Strength save. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns and ends the effect on a success.
Mucus. When an attacker hits the slime in melee, their weapon sticks on a failed DC 12 Strength save. A creature can use an action to free it with a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. All stuck weapons can be recovered once the slime dies.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack +3, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit for 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 188

name: Swarm of Emberbats
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, and Stunned. Blindsight 60 ft., passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A dense cloud of emberbats whose small flames warm the air around the colony.

sections.Traits:
Echolocation. Deafened prevents the swarm from using blindsight.
Keen Hearing. The swarm has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing.
Flame Essence. A creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the swarm takes 2 (1d4) fire damage on a failed DC 10 Constitution save.
Swarm. Creatures can share the swarm’s space, and the swarm can pass through any gap a Tiny bat fits through. The swarm cannot regain HP or gain temporary HP.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack +4, reach 0 ft., one creature sharing the swarm’s space. Hit for 5 (2d4) piercing damage, reduced to 2 (1d4) at half HP or below.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 182

name: Wakewyrm
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Passive Perception 11. No languages.
appearance: An enormous sea reptile with an eel-like body and a long, lashing tail.

sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The wakewyrm can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack, or two Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit for 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage. On a failed DC 16 Strength save, the target is Grappled (escape DC 16). While grappling a creature, the wakewyrm cannot grapple a second creature or Bite a different target.
Tail. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 25 ft., one target. Hit for 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Swallow. Make a Bite attack against a Large or smaller creature the wakewyrm is grappling. On a hit, the grapple ends and the target is swallowed. It is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the wakewyrm, and takes 11 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the wakewyrm’s turns. If a creature inside deals at least 18 damage to the wakewyrm, the wakewyrm must make a DC 15 Constitution save at the end of that creature’s turn. On a failure, the wakewyrm disgorges every swallowed creature, and each falls Prone in a space within 10 ft. If the wakewyrm dies, swallowed creatures are no longer Restrained by it and can spend 20 ft. of movement to escape. Its body floats for several hours before gradually sinking.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, Bestiary, p. 189

name: Birdfolk Skeleton
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Vulnerable to bludgeoning damage. Immune to poison damage and to Exhaustion and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Auran and Birdfolk without speaking.
description: A reanimated birdfolk skeleton retains familiar skills, including the use of weapons it wielded in life.

sections.Traits: Talons. The skeleton has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces it can grip with its talons.
sections.Actions:
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 180

name: Cobblefright
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saving throws Con +6, Wis +2. Immune to poison damage and to Charmed, Exhaustion, and Poisoned. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 9. Understands Auran, Birdfolk, and its other languages from life without speaking.
description: Several birdfolk skeletons form a single undead body that can sustain itself by draining its victims.

sections.Traits: Berserk. At the start of a turn when the cobblefright has 40 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6 it goes berserk. While berserk, it attacks the nearest creature it can see each turn. If it cannot move to and attack a creature, it attacks an object, preferring one smaller than itself. It stays berserk until destroyed or restored to full HP.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Claw attacks. One may be replaced by Grab.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Grab. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature the cobblefright is not already grappling. On a hit the creature is Grappled (escape DC 15). The cobblefright can hold up to two creatures. At the start of its turn, it can squeeze each creature held, once per target. Each squeezed creature must pass a DC 15 Strength save or take 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Soul Siphon. One creature held by the cobblefright makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 11 (2d10) necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Reduce the target's hit point maximum by the necrotic damage dealt and restore the same number of hit points to the cobblefright. The reduction lasts until the target completes a short or long rest.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 181

name: Forest Prowler
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +6. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. No languages.
description: Leaves and moss grow through this cat's spotted fur, concealing it while it hunts from the canopy.

sections.Traits:
Natural Camouflage. The prowler makes Dexterity (Stealth) checks in forests with advantage. An attacker also has advantage against a target that cannot see them.
Pounce. If the prowler advances at least 10 ft. toward a creature and hits it with Claw on the same turn, the creature must succeed on a DC 14 Strength save or fall Prone. The prowler can make an additional Claw attack against that target as a bonus action.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Bite attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. A Prone target takes 4 (1d8) extra piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Ambuscade. Take the Dash or Hide action.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 183

name: Havel of the Autumn Moon
otherStatistics: AC 16 with Barkskin. Saving throws Int +7, Wis +5. Nature +4, Medicine +5, Perception +5. Passive Perception 15. Speaks Birdfolk, Druidic, and Sylvan. Understands Auran without speaking it.
description: A Summerblossom of the Tenders, Havel helps refugees at the order's headquarters in Alderheart.

sections.Traits: Seedspeech. Havel can convey simple ideas to living plants and understand their replies in simple terms.
sections.Spellcasting:
Havel is a 4th-level Wisdom spellcaster. Spell save DC 13, +5 to hit.
Cantrips, at will. Druidcraft, Gust Barrier, Produce Flame.
1st level, 4 slots. Cure Wounds, Elevated Sight, Entangle, Thunderwave.
2nd level, 3 slots. Barkskin, Gust of Wind.
sections.Actions: Staff. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 1 (1d6 - 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wing Flap. Rise up to half the gallus's movement speed. This can extend a normal jump but cannot be used while gliding.
sections.Reactions: Glide. If the gallus falls at least 10 ft., they can use their reaction to fly in one direction up to their speed as they descend. They land in an empty space and take no falling damage. Heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields prevent gliding, but the gallus can drop held items as part of the reaction.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 207

ruleNotes: Use the printed Intelligence save bonus of +7.

name: Oakheart
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Resists fire, bludgeoning, and piercing damage. Passive Perception 13. Speaks Birdfolk, Druidic, Ignan, and Sylvan.
description: Fire burns through the canopy of this charred treant, who guards the Borealus beneath the Scorched Grove.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. If he stays still, Oakheart resembles a charred oak with smoldering bark and branches tipped with flames.
Siege Monster. Oakheart deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Slam attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (3d6 + 5) fire damage.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit 28 (4d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Animate Trees (1/day). Animate one or two visible trees within 60 ft. Each ally uses Oakheart's statistics, except it has Intelligence and Charisma 1, cannot speak, and can only use Slam. A tree returns to normal after one day, if it or Oakheart dies, if it and Oakheart are more than 120 ft. apart, or if Oakheart dismisses it as a bonus action. A reverted tree takes root where possible.
sections.Encounter notes: In the Guardian encounter, Oakheart opens by animating the other two charred trees. He stays alert if the party attacks during his greeting. At 0 HP he survives, ends the fight, and sends the trees back to their places. If the party struggles, he may end combat early and ask why they need the Borealus.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 203–204. Guardian encounter, pp. 166–167.

name: Tevor of the Spring Path
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Athletics +4. Resists poison damage. Passive Perception 12. Speaks Birdfolk and Druidic. Understands Auran without speaking it.
description: A junior member of the Tenders and former Perch Guard recruit, Tevor avoids fighting after an ashsnake killed his mentor.

sections.Traits:
Fated (recharges after a long rest). Tevor can reroll an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw.
Resilience. He has advantage on saves against being Poisoned.
Drop Attack. He can attack during his Glide for an extra 4 (1d8) damage.
sections.Actions:
Spear. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) with two hands in melee.
Tender Healing (recharges after a long rest). Cast Cure Wounds at 1st level using Wisdom, restoring 1d8 + 2 HP.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wing Flap. Rise up to half the luma's movement speed. This can extend a normal jump but cannot be used while gliding.

1st level, 4 slots. Charm Person, Detect Magic, Mage Armor, Shield, Sleep, Thunderwave.
2nd level, 3 slots. Darkness, Hold Person, Ray of Enfeeblement.
3rd level, 3 slots. Counterspell, Fireball.
4th level, 3 slots. Banishment, Stellar Bodies.
5th level, 2 slots. Conjure Elemental, Mislead.
Stellar Bodies. Cast as an action. Two orbiting stars shed dim light to 10 ft. for up to 1 minute. A creature within 5 ft. that hits the wizard in melee makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 1d8 radiant damage per remaining star on a failure. Once per round on the wizard’s turn, use an action to expend one star and make a ranged spell attack (+7 to hit) against an enemy within 120 ft. It deals 4d8 radiant damage on a hit. The target then makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded until the start of the wizard’s next turn. The spell ends when time runs out, the wizard falls Unconscious, or all stars are spent. Each two slot levels above 4th add one star and 5 ft. to the light radius.
sections.Actions: Staff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Wing Flap. Rise up to half the creature’s movement speed. This can extend a regular jump and is unavailable while gliding.
sections.Reactions:
Glide. When falling at least 10 ft., use a reaction to fly in one direction up to the creature’s speed while descending. Land in an empty space and take no falling damage. Heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields prevent this, but the creature can drop held items as part of the reaction.
Charming (3/day). When a creature attacks the wizard, it makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, it targets the next closest creature within range, choosing between ties. This has no effect if no other creature is in range.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 201. Stellar Bodies p. 52.

name: Mountain Lion
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Perception +4, Stealth +4. Passive Perception 14. No languages.
description: A rock-armored ambush hunter from the Crest Mountains. Its roar can bring down the rocks around its prey.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
Pounce. After moving at least 20 ft. toward a creature and hitting it with Claw on the same turn, the target makes a DC 13 Strength save or falls Prone.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.
Call Avalanche. Once per short or long rest, while in mountainous terrain, center a rockslide on a visible space within 60 ft. Each creature in its 15-ft. radius makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half on a success.
sections.Bonus Actions: Pounce Bite. The mountain lion can make a Bite attack against a Prone target.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 184–185. Stat block p. 185.

name: Mapach Bandit
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Resists poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach.
description: A bandit who uses darkness and climbable terrain to set up an ambush.

sections.Traits:
Resilience. The bandit rolls saves against being poisoned with advantage.
Skulker. In dim light or darkness, the bandit has advantage on Stealth checks.
sections.Actions:
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 202.

ruleNotes: This printing gives the Short Sword slashing damage.

name: Mapach Brute
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Dex save +5, Cha save +4. Deception +4, Persuasion +4. Resists poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach.
description: A bandit enforcer who fights with a rapier and parrying dagger. Krall uses this profile.

sections.Traits:
Resilience. The brute rolls saves against being poisoned with advantage.
Skulker. In dim light or darkness, the brute has advantage on Stealth checks.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rapier attacks and one Parrying Dagger attack.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
Parrying Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 2 AC against a melee attack that would hit the brute. They must see the attacker and hold a melee weapon.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 202.

name: Mapach Tinkerer
otherStatistics: Resists poison damage. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach.
description: A practical inventor with a kit of gadgets that can disrupt a fight.

sections.Traits:
Resilience. The tinkerer rolls saves against being poisoned with advantage.
Skulker. In dim light or darkness, the tinkerer has advantage on Stealth checks.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Tinker's Toys. Choose a gadget or roll 1d4. Each gadget can be used once per day.
1. Cogwork Bird. Distract a creature within 30 ft. The next attack against it has advantage.
2. Flash-bangs. Choose a point within 10 ft. Each creature within 10 ft. of that point makes a DC 11 Con save. On a failure it is blinded until the start of the tinkerer's next turn.
3. Nettle Gun. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 10/20 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Each creature within 5 ft. of the target makes a DC 11 Dex save or takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
4. Grease Balloon. Coat a 10-ft. square within 15 ft. in grease, making the area difficult terrain. Creatures in the square when it is coated, those that enter it, and those that end their turn there must pass a DC 11 Dex save or fall prone.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 203.

ruleNotes: The printed Grease Balloon entry leaves the duration of the grease unspecified.

name: Raptor Explorer
otherStatistics: Leather armor. History +2, Perception +6, Stealth +4, Survival +6. Passive Perception 16. Understands Auran and speaks Birdfolk.
description: A guide who ignores difficult natural ground and can use readied actions to turn a tight spot to their advantage.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The explorer has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Patient. During a readied action taken as a reaction, the explorer has advantage on their first attack roll, skill check, or ability check.
Keen Hearing and Sight. The explorer has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use hearing or sight.
Sure Footing. The explorer ignores nonmagical difficult terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks or two Hand Crossbow attacks.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Saber. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the explorer can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 204. Explorer background, p. 203.

name: Raptor Ranger
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Athletics +3, Stealth +7, Survival +5. Passive Perception 13. Speaks Birdfolk and Mapach. Understands Auran.
description: A wilderness archer who can scout through an arrow fired from a Red-Feather Bow.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The ranger has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Aerial Defense. Attack rolls against the ranger have disadvantage while the ranger falls, glides, or jumps.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Red-Feather Bow attacks.
Red-Feather Bow. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Dagger. Weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions:
Arrow Sight (3/day). When the ranger fires their Red-Feather Bow, see for 1 minute from the spot where that arrow lands. If it hits a creature, see through that creature's eyes instead.
Hunter (3/day). The ranger's next shortbow or longbow attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the ranger can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Spellcasting: The ranger casts as a 3rd-level Wisdom spellcaster (save DC 13, +5 to spell attacks). 1st level (3 slots) Cure Wounds, Fog Cloud, Hunter's Mark, Protection from Evil and Good.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 205. Ranger background, p. 203. Red-Feather Bow, Appendix D, p. 214.

ruleNotes: The printed Red-Feather Bow lists 6 average damage and a roll of 1d6 + 4. Those values differ. The Dagger lists a 20/60 ft. range alongside its melee label. Use the listed range when it is thrown.

name: Strig Knight
otherStatistics: Half plate and shield. Con save +5, Wis save +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12. Understands Auran and speaks Birdfolk.
description: A Perch Guard knight who can open a retreat route for an ally. Riffin the Ash-Knight uses this profile with lawful good alignment.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The knight has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Maneuver (2/day). After the knight hits, an ally within 5 ft. of the target can use their reaction to move away from it at half speed without provoking an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Short Sword attacks.
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Wing Crest Shield (1/day). Use the shield to cast Gust of Wind (save DC 15).
sections.Bonus Actions: After hitting with Talons, the knight can grapple the target as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the knight can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 205. Knight background, p. 204. Wing Crest Shield, Appendix D, p. 214.

ruleNotes: The printed Wisdom save is +4. The Talons entry allows a grapple but supplies no special escape DC, so use the normal grapple rules.

name: Strig Tracker
otherStatistics: Hide armor. Acrobatics +6, Perception +4, Survival +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Speaks Birdfolk and two other languages. Understands Auran.
description: A woodland tracker who can search for a hidden creature while keeping pressure on a fight.

sections.Traits:
Talons. The tracker has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to climb surfaces their talons can grip.
Patterned Feathers. The tracker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in a forest.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one melee Longsword and one melee Handaxe attack, or two ranged Handaxe attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) when held in two hands.
Handaxe. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Reya's Keen Eye. Make a Wisdom (Perception) check to find hidden creatures.
sections.Reactions: Glide. After falling at least 10 ft., the tracker can spend a reaction to glide up to their speed in one direction while descending. They land in a free space at the end and take no fall damage. They need to be free of heavy objects, heavy weapons, and shields to glide. They can drop anything held as part of the same reaction.
sections.Spellcasting:
The tracker casts as a 3rd-level Wisdom spellcaster (save DC 12, +4 to spell attacks). 1st level (3 slots) Elevated Sight, Hunter's Mark, Longstrider, Speak with Animals.
Elevated Sight takes one action and lasts up to 1 minute with concentration. A moving, invisible sensor gives the caster a 360-degree view from up to 120 ft. above them. They can change its height as a bonus action and switch to their own sight during their turn. Their own eyes are blind while they view through the sensor.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 206. Elevated Sight, p. 49.

ruleNotes: The printed passive Perception is 15 even though its Perception skill is listed as +4.

name: Vulpin Captain
otherStatistics: Studded leather. Acrobatics +4, Perception +4. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14. Speaks Birdfolk and Vulpin.
description: A bandit officer who coordinates raids and is capable of running a camp. Fray Merridan uses this profile.

sections.Traits: Evasive. Add the captain's Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saves.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Short Sword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry (1/round). Add 2 AC against a melee attack that would hit the captain. They must see the attacker and hold a melee weapon.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, pp. 208–209. Captain background, p. 207.

name: Vulpin Noble
otherStatistics: Breastplate. Deception +5, History +4, Insight +3, Persuasion +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11. Speaks Birdfolk and Vulpin.
description: A courtier who can throw an opponent off balance with a timely insult.

sections.Traits: Evasive. Add the noble's Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saves.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage.
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Disparaging Remark. When someone the noble sees attacks an ally, impose disadvantage on that attack roll if the attacker can hear and understand the noble.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 209. Noble background, p. 208.

name: Vulpin Priest of Kren
otherStatistics: Chain shirt. Medicine +7, Persuasion +3, Religion +5. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13. Speaks Birdfolk, Celestial, and Vulpin.
description: A priest of the fox Amaranthine who can turn a spell slot into venomous melee strikes. Shyla Denn uses this profile.

sections.Traits: Evasive. Add the priest's Intelligence modifier to Dexterity saves.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Divine Eminence. Spend a spell slot. Until the end of the turn, the priest's melee weapon hits deal an extra 10 (3d6) poison damage. Add 1d6 more damage for each slot level above 1st.
sections.Spellcasting:
The priest casts as a 5th-level Wisdom spellcaster (save DC 13, +5 to spell attacks).
Cantrips at will. Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy.
1st level (4 slots). Cure Wounds, Disguise Self, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots). Lesser Restoration, Mirror Image, Spiritual Weapon.
3rd level (2 slots). Blink, Spirit Guardians.
sections.Printed source: Appendix B, p. 209. Shyla Denn, p. 208.

name: Amalgamation
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +17, Dex +7, Con +14, Int +13, Wis +11. Arcana +13, Deception +12, Insight +11, Perception +11. Immune to psychic damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 21. All languages and telepathy 1 mile.
description: An aberration that forms around a planar rupture and draws other creatures through.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Malignancy. It cannot be teleported or taken to another plane against its will.
Immutable Form. Effects that would alter its form fail.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
sections.Innate Spellcasting: Charisma, save DC 20, no components. At will, Detect Thoughts and Dispel Magic.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Contaminating Presence and make three Tentacle attacks. Any of those attacks can be replaced with Fling.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 5 ft., one target, 23 (3d8 + 10) piercing. A Large or smaller target already Grappled by the amalgamation is Swallowed, ending that grapple. Inside, it is Blinded and Restrained, has total cover from outside, takes 42 (12d6) acid damage, and gains one level of Contamination at the start of the amalgamation's turns. If the amalgamation takes 50 or more damage in a single turn from a creature inside it, it makes a DC 25 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure all swallowed creatures fall Prone within 10 ft. If it dies, they cease to be Restrained and can spend 15 ft. of movement to exit Prone.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack +17, reach 50 ft., one target, 20 (3d6 + 10) bludgeoning. Grapple the target (escape DC 18). It is Restrained while grappled. Each of twelve tentacles can hold one target.
Fling. Throw one Large or smaller held object or grappled creature up to 60 ft. A thrown creature lands Prone. Against a solid surface, it takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning per 10 ft. thrown. A creature the target is thrown at must pass a DC 18 Dexterity save or take the same damage and fall Prone.
Mind-breaking Whispers. One creature within 120 ft. must pass a DC 20 Intelligence save or take 35 (10d6) psychic damage and become insane until it finishes a long rest. It cannot take actions, understand speech, or read, and can only speak gibberish. Greater Restoration ends the effect.
Contaminating Presence. Each humanoid within 120 ft. must pass a DC 20 Constitution save or take 10 (3d6) necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Tentacle Attack or Fling. Use either option.
Mind-breaking Whispers (2 actions). Use Mind-breaking Whispers.
Piper at the Gate (3 actions). Summon up to five gibbering mouthers into empty spaces within 30 ft. They obey the amalgamation, act immediately after it on the same initiative count, and remain until destroyed. It can have at most ten mouthers summoned by this action.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 206–207

name: Crimson Countess
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +5, Wis +5. Acrobatics +11, Deception +7, Perception +8. Immune to lightning and thunder. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16. Abyssal.
description: A harpy matriarch who fights in flight with an electrified javelin.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. She can use Frightful Screech, then make two Talons attacks or one Javelin attack.
Talons. Melee weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft., one target, 11 (1d10 + 5) slashing.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack +8, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target, 9 (1d6 + 5) piercing plus 14 (4d6) lightning.
Frightful Screech. Chosen creatures within 120 ft. that are not Deafened must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or become Frightened for 1 minute. While affected, a creature must Dash and flee by the safest route on each turn if possible. It repeats the save whenever it ends a turn out of her line of sight. A successful save or the end of the effect grants immunity to her screech for 24 hours.
Thunder Blast (recharge 5–6). Creatures in a 15-ft. cube make a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 14 (4d6) thunder damage, getting pushed 10 ft., and falling Prone on failure. On success they only take half damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Aerial Acrobat. Dash, Disengage, or Dodge.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 208–209

name: Executioner
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Str +15, Con +13, Wis +6. Immune to poison and psychic damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that are not adamantine. Immune to Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 10. Understands Common without speaking.
description: An execution construct that patrols Slaughterstone Square and hurls a returning blade.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Immutable Form. Effects that would alter its form fail.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Rejuvenation. After destruction, it returns at full HP after 24 hours unless someone casts Disintegrate on the remains.
sections.Actions:
Guillotine Blade. Melee or ranged weapon attack +15, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target, 30 (6d6 + 9) slashing plus 14 (4d6) necrotic. On a failed DC 21 Constitution save, reduce the target's maximum HP by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest. A target whose maximum HP becomes 0 dies. The blade returns immediately after a ranged attack.
Necrotic Vents (recharge 5–6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 21 Constitution save, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails by 5 or more gains one level of Contamination.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Lumber Forward (2 actions). Move up to half speed.
Attack (2 actions). Make a melee or ranged Guillotine Blade attack.
Summon Shadows (3 actions). Up to six visible humanoid corpses within 60 ft. that died violently each produce a shadow in their space or the nearest empty one. They obey the Executioner and act after it on the same initiative count. They disappear after 1 minute or if the Executioner is destroyed, and can be destroyed earlier.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 209

ruleNotes: The stat block lists CR 20 without an XP figure. The profile uses the standard 25,000 XP value.

name: Gravekeeper
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +10, Wis +8, Cha +10. Perception +13. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 23. Understands all languages without speaking.
description: A floating mass of former cryptkeepers carrying lanterns whose beams have different effects.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Dazzling Illumination. Sheds bright light for 60 ft. and imposes disadvantage on attacks against it. A hit disrupts the trait until the end of its next turn. It is also disrupted while it is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target, 14 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning plus 10 (3d6) necrotic.
Lantern Blast. Every creature within 120 ft. without total cover rolls a d6 for the ray that strikes it. The save DC is 18. Failure deals 35 (10d6) damage of the listed type and applies that ray's effect. Table ruling. Success halves the damage and prevents the other effects for every ray.
sections.Lantern Blast Rays:
1. Dispelling Blast. Intelligence save, psychic damage. End all spells and magical effects on the target and break its spell concentration.
2. Forceful Blast. Strength save, force damage. Push 20 ft. away and knock Prone.
3. Blinding Blast. Constitution save, radiant damage. Blinded for 1 minute. Repeat the save on each of the target's turns to end it.
4. Contamining Blast. Constitution save, necrotic damage and one level of Contamination.
5. Igniting Blast. Dexterity save, fire damage. The target also takes 35 (10d6) fire damage at the start of its turns until someone spends an action to douse it.
6. Freezing Blast. Constitution save, cold damage. No reactions until the end of the target's next turn. On that turn it can only do one of these: move, take an action, or take a bonus action.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Slam. Make one Slam attack.
Glide. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Lantern Blast (3 actions). Use Lantern Blast.
sections.Lair Actions:
At initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one effect. Each must be used before an effect repeats, and the same effect cannot occur in consecutive rounds.
Sludge Spout. A 10-ft.-radius, 30-ft.-high cylinder erupts. Creatures inside make a DC 18 Constitution save. Failure deals 42 (12d6) necrotic damage and one level of Contamination. Success halves the damage.
Grasping Walls. Walls within 120 ft. grow arms. Chosen creatures starting a turn within 10 ft. of one make a DC 15 Dexterity save or become Grappled. Escape with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Lantern. A torch or lantern in the room emits a Lantern Blast.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 210–211

ruleNotes: Slam preserves the printed average of 14 alongside the printed formula 4d8 + 4. For rolled damage, use the formula.
The successful save instruction follows ray 6 in the printing. This profile applies it to all six rays.

name: Lord of the Feast
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Saves Con +9, Dex +9, Wis +9, Cha +6. Athletics +9, Perception +14, Stealth +14, Survival +9. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 24. Abyssal.
description: A garmyr hunter who uses specialized arrows to snare, drag, or contaminate prey.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Regeneration. Regain 20 HP at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 HP.
Close-Quarters Hunter. Hostile creatures within 5 ft. do not give his ranged attacks disadvantage.
Predatory Senses. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. He pinpoints Invisible creatures within 120 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make a Bite and two Claws attacks, or one attack with each of the three arrow types.
Bite. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 5 ft., one target, 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic. DC 17 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Claws. Melee weapon attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target, 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing.
Contaminating Arrow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target, 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing plus 18 (4d8) necrotic. DC 17 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Ensnaring Arrow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target, 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing. A Large or smaller target must pass a DC 17 Dexterity save or become Restrained for 1 minute. It can spend an action to repeat the save and escape.
Harpoon Arrow. Ranged weapon attack +9, range 150/600 ft., one target, 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing. A Huge or smaller creature must pass a DC 17 Strength save or be pulled up to 20 ft. directly toward him.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Dash. Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Arrow (2 actions). Make an arrow attack of his choice.
Call of the Hunt (3 actions). His howl can be heard around Drakkenheim. Garmyr within 60 ft. that can see and hear him can use a reaction to move up to half speed and make one melee or ranged attack with advantage.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, p. 211

name: Pale Man
otherStatistics: AC 15 with Mage Armor. Saves Int +10, Con +8, Wis +7. Arcana +10, Perception +7, History +10. Immune to necrotic and poison. Resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, and Restrained. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common and five other languages.
description: A wizard held together by swarming insects, able to reform if the swarm escapes.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Insect Body. It can share spaces with creatures and pass through openings large enough for a Tiny insect.
Crawling Flesh. At 0 HP, it breaks into a swarm of insects in its space. If that swarm survives, it returns to the cocoon and reforms after 1d6 days.
sections.Spellcasting:
16th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 18, +10 to hit.
At will: Chill Touch, Mage Hand, Mending, Prestidigitation, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots): Delerium Orb, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots): Hold Person, Invisibility, Warp Bolt.
3rd level (3 slots): Counterspell, Lightning Bolt, Purge Contamination.
4th level (3 slots): Delerium Blast, Forced Evolution.
5th level (3 slots): Conjure the Deep Haze, Siphon Contamination.
6th level (1 slot): Chain Lightning.
7th level (1 slot): Octarine Spray.
8th level (1 slot): Antimagic Field.
sections.Setting Spells:
Delerium Orb. Action, 120 ft. One visible creature makes a save using an ability chosen by the caster. Choose cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, psychic, or radiant damage. Deal 6d6 on failure or half on success, plus 2d6 per slot level above 1st.
Warp Bolt. Action, 60 ft., concentrate up to 1 minute. Automatically hit a contaminated target, or make a ranged spell attack against an uncontaminated one. A hit deals 6d6 necrotic and one level of Contamination. On later turns, use an action for a new bolt. Each slot level above 2nd permits one more target.
Delerium Blast. Action, 150 ft. Creatures in a 20-ft.-radius sphere make an Intelligence save. Failure deals 10d6 psychic damage and Incapacitates until the end of the target's next turn. Success halves damage and prevents Incapacitated. Add 2d6 per slot level above 4th.
Conjure the Deep Haze. Action, 120 ft., concentrate up to 10 minutes. A 20-ft.-radius sphere spreads around corners and is heavily obscured until it ends or strong wind clears it. First entry on a turn or starting a turn there forces a Constitution save. Failure deals 8d6 necrotic and one level of Contamination. Success halves damage without Contamination. Holding breath does not help.
Octarine Spray. Action, 60-ft. cone. Each creature makes a Constitution save. Roll a d8 for each creature. On rolls of 1–5, deal 20d6 psychic, necrotic, force, radiant, or thunder damage respectively, half on success. On a failed save, 6 compels the target to spend its movement approaching the nearest visible creature and use its action to attack a random creature in reach, with a Wisdom save at each turn's end to stop. A 7 causes a level of Contamination at each turn's start, with a Constitution save at each turn's end to stop. An 8 adds two rolls and can repeat.
Each spell above consumes a 100 gp delerium fragment and gives its caster one level of Contamination.
Purge Contamination. One hour, touch. Consume 100 gp of alchemical fluids or holy water to clear a humanoid's Contamination and mutations. It gains one Exhaustion level per level removed.
Forced Evolution. Eight hours, touch. Consume a 250 gp alchemical mixture to replace one mutation with one selected by the GM or rolled randomly.
Siphon Contamination. One hour, touch. Consume 500 gp of alchemical fluids and a 5,000 gp delerium geode. A second willing humanoid takes all Contamination removed from a first willing humanoid, whose mutations are also removed. A transformed former humanoid can instead return to their original form if the second willing humanoid has at least their transformed CR in levels or CR. The recipient then undergoes Monstrous Transformation. Preventing the transfer makes the spell fail.
sections.Actions:
Contaminating Touch. Melee spell attack +8, reach 10 ft., one target, 10 (3d6) necrotic. DC 16 Constitution save or one level of Contamination.
Infest the Flesh (recharge 6). Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 22 (5d8) necrotic and Restrains the creature. It takes 22 (5d8) necrotic at the start of each of the Pale Man's turns. It repeats the save at the end of its own turns to end the effect.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Cantrip. Cast a cantrip.
Slither (2 actions). Move up to speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Contaminate (3 actions). Each target Restrained by Infest the Flesh makes a DC 16 Constitution save or gains one level of Contamination.
sections.Printed source: Appendix A, pp. 212–213. Setting spells, Appendix D, pp. 227–229.

ruleNotes: Contaminating Touch and Infest the Flesh use their printed attack bonus and save DC. These differ from the general Spellcasting numbers.
The stat block lists Siphon Contamination among the 5th-level slots, but Appendix D defines it as a 6th-level spell. Table ruling. Use the Appendix D level when casting it.

name: Rat Prince
otherStatistics: Leather armor. Acrobatics +6, Athletics +3, Perception +6, Stealth +8. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 15. Common.
description: An armored ratling raider who carries delerium-laced bolts.

Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that use smell.
Pack Tactics. Advantage against a target if a non-Incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of it.
Contaminated Ammunition. Carries 2d6 contaminated projectiles. A hit with one adds 1d6 damage and forces a DC 10 Constitution save. Failure adds one level of Contamination.

Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack +6, range 30/120 ft., one target, 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing.

Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

20th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 19, +11 to hit.

8th level (1 slot): Maze.

sections.Actions: Staff of Power. Melee weapon attack +6, reach 5 ft., one creature, 10 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning.

Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Cantrip. Cast a cantrip.
Teleport. Teleport 60 ft. to a visible empty space.
Cast a Spell (3 actions). Cast a spell by spending a slot.

Divine Strikes. His weapon attacks are magical and add 4d8 radiant damage, included below.

20th-level paladin. Charisma, save DC 17, +9 to hit.
1st level (4 slots): Bless, Command, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt.
2nd level (3 slots): Aid, Branding Smite, Lesser Restoration.
3rd level (3 slots): Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic.
4th level (3 slots): Banishment, Death Ward.
5th level (2 slots): Flame Strike, Hallow.

Holy Avenger. Melee weapon attack +13, reach 5 ft., one target, 10 (1d8 + 8) bludgeoning plus 18 (4d8) radiant.
sections.Legendary Actions:
Three legendary actions per round. Use one option after another creature's turn and recover spent actions at the start of this creature's turn.
Attack. Make one weapon attack.
Holy Bolt (2 actions). Cast Guiding Bolt without spending a slot.

name: Queen of Thieves
otherStatistics: Canny Defense and Mage Armor. Saves Dex +10, Int +10. Acrobatics +10, Arcana +10, Deception +14, Insight +8, Perception +8, Persuasion +9, Sleight of Hand +10, Stealth +15. Immune to Charmed. Darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 18. Common, Dwarvish, Elvish, and Undercommon.

sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Canny Defense. Add Intelligence to AC with light or no armor and no shield.
Sneak Attack (1/turn). Add 18 (5d6) to a weapon hit if she has advantage, or if the target has a non-Incapacitated ally of the Queen within 5 ft. and she has no disadvantage.
Memory Thief. Creatures do not notice when she reads their thoughts or charms them. When one of her spells that Charms a creature ends, she can force a DC 18 Intelligence save. Failure erases up to 8 hours of the time the creature spent Charmed by her. Heal or similar magic restores these memories.
sections.Special Equipment: Amulet of Proof Against Detection and Location, Spymaster's Signet, and +3 rapier. The attuned signet casts Disguise Self at will. 20th-level wizard. Intelligence, save DC 18, +10 to hit.

1st level (4 slots): Feather Fall, Mage Armor, Shield, Sleep.
