sections.Actions:
Attack. Wing claw +2 melee (1d3 − 1) or bite −3 melee (1d4 − 1).
Full Attack. Two wing claws +2 melee (1d3 − 1 each) and bite −3 melee (1d4 − 1).
Shriek (Ex). One sonic attack each round. The victim must succeed on a DC 16 Fortitude save or be paralyzed for 6 rounds. The book gives no range. The bat uses this on a flyby before closing to slash with its wing claws.

name: Skeletal Bat
description: A winged skeleton that carries messages for necromancers or guards their lairs. Colonies and swarms attack with their exposed claws.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Colony of 10–40 or swarm of 20–50. Always neutral. Standard treasure. Printed advancement is 3 HD (Large) or 5–15 HD (Huge). No level adjustment.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +3. Touch AC 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +0, grapple +0. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +0, Ref +3, Will +2.
sections.Skills and feats: Listen +10. Flyby Attack.
sections.Traits: Damage reduction 5/bludgeoning, cold immunity, and undead traits.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +0 melee (1d4).
Full Attack. Two claws +0 melee (1d4 each).

name: Giant Scarab Beetle
description: A five-foot scavenger that digs between burial chambers. Strong light usually sends it retreating, though light itself does it no harm.
otherStatistics: Desert and underground. Solitary, cluster of 2–5, or swarm of 6–11. Always neutral. No treasure. Advancement 5–7 HD (Medium) or 8–10 HD (Large). No level adjustment.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +0. The printing lists touch AC 18 and flat-footed AC 18. Base attack +3. The grapple value is blank in print. Use +7 from its listed BAB, Strength and Medium size. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +1.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +5, Listen +5, Spot +3. Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Finesse.
sections.Traits: Vermin traits. This kind of scarab stays active and rarely attacks a living target unless provoked.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +7 melee (1d8 + 6) and filth fever.
Disease (Ex). A bite that infects the target allows a DC 12 Fortitude save. Filth fever incubates for 1d3 days and deals 1d3 Dexterity damage and 1d3 Constitution damage.

ruleNotes: The printed touch AC 18 includes the effect of its +8 natural armor. Under normal 3.5 touch attack rules, use touch AC 10.

name: Grave Scarab Beetle
description: An active grave scarab hunts warm flesh. A dormant survivor in a sealed tomb takes on a golden finish and can pass for jewelry until body heat wakes it.
otherStatistics: Desert and underground. Solitary or swarm of 10–100. Always neutral. No treasure, advancement, or level adjustment.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +2. Touch AC 20, flat-footed 22. Base attack +0, grapple −15. Space 1/2 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +0.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +2, Hide +10, Listen +2, Spot +1. Weapon Finesse (bonus).
sections.Traits: Tremorsense and vermin traits. The sense has no listed range. It attacks the closest food and can be lured away with another food source.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +10 melee (1d2 − 5, minimum 1 on a hit) plus flesh burrow.
Flesh Burrow (Ex). It travels along armor or similar material until it can reach bare skin. A successful attack roll lets it burrow toward the heart, dealing 1d4 hit point damage per round. It reaches the heart in 2 rounds for a Small target, 3 for Medium, or 4 for Large. Once there it inflicts 1d4 permanent Constitution damage each round. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to this attack.
Removal. Cutting off the affected limb removes it. Attacks against a buried beetle target it without its Dexterity bonus and split damage evenly between beetle and host. A host attacking the beetle inside their own body takes −2 to attack and damage rolls.

name: Monstrous Scarab Beetle
description: The largest scarab digs beneath caverns and tombs for carrion. Intruders that threaten its nest or eggs draw a charge.
otherStatistics: Desert or underground. Solitary, cluster of 2–5, or swarm of 6–11. Always neutral. No treasure or level adjustment. Printed advancement 8–10 HD (Medium) or 11–21 HD (Large).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +0. Touch AC 9 and flat-footed AC 21, calculated from the listed −1 size and +12 natural bonuses. Base attack +6, grapple +11 as printed. Space 5 ft., reach 10 ft. as printed. Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +2.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +5, Listen +8, Spot +7. Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Weapon Finesse.
sections.Traits: Vermin traits. It normally initiates combat only to protect its eggs or nest.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +12 melee. The named Keen Pincers ability gives the bite 4d8 + 9 damage with a critical threat on 19–20. The printed table gives 2d6 + 9 for Attack and 1d6 + 9 for Full Attack. Use the named ability for both if you want one damage expression.
Trample (Ex). 2d8 + 3 damage. Reflex DC 20 half, Strength-based.

ruleNotes: The listed 5-ft. space, grapple modifier, Hit Dice bonus, and Medium advancement band are kept as printed. The primary size line is Large.

name: Boneless
speed: 30 ft. (6 squares), 60 ft. on all fours
description: A mindless undead servant animated from flesh after its skeleton was removed. It can collapse onto all fours to run or fold into a jar for transport.
otherStatistics: Sample human commoner. Any environment or organization. Always evil, usually neutral evil. No treasure, advancement, or level adjustment for this sample.

sections.Sample combat statistics: Roll 3d12 hit points. Initiative +4. Touch AC 14 and flat-footed AC 10, calculated from its listed +4 Dex bonus. Base attack +1, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +1, Will +2. Agility.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Slap +2 melee (1d4 + 2).
Full Attack. Two slaps +2 melee (1d4 + 2 each). If both hit, the target is automatically grappled. Starting the next round, Constrict deals 2d4 + 2 each round. The target can take only one action, an opposed Strength check to escape. In particular it cannot make physical attacks or cast a spell requiring material components.
sections.Traits:
Undead traits and damage reduction 5, bypassed by slashing or piercing weapons. The sample lists vulnerability to turning without giving a modifier. Holy water or the touch of a holy symbol deals 1d8 damage.
Pliability (Ex). It can squeeze through a gap at least 1 inch wide or fold into a 1-cubic-foot container, including an airtight one. Soak it at least once per week or keep it in a reservoir of water. If it dries out it loses its special maneuvers, including its grapple attack, and moves and fights as a zombie. A dried boneless takes double damage from fire.
sections.Creating a Boneless:
Acquired template for a corporeal, formerly skeletal creature other than an undead, with fewer than 20 HD. Keep size. Replace type with undead and drop alignment and kind subtypes without adding the augmented subtype. Keep base statistics where the template gives no change. Drop class Hit Dice, to a minimum of 3 HD, and use d12s for current and future Hit Dice. Set speed to 30 ft. or 60 ft. on all fours. It cannot fly, even with wings.
Keep weapons and weapon proficiencies. Retain natural attacks except claws and bites. Each hand deals 1d4 + Strength bonus, and constriction after a successful grapple deals 2d4 + Strength bonus per round. Replace other special attacks with Constrict. Keep only extraordinary special qualities that enhance melee attacks and add the traits listed above.
Base saves are Fort and Ref +1 per 3 HD and Will +2 plus half HD. Dexterity increases by 2, Wisdom becomes 10, and Charisma becomes 1. Remove Constitution and Intelligence scores, skills, and prior feats. Gain Agility. CR starts at 3 and rises with HD. Advancement follows the base creature unless it advanced by class, in which case use none. Any environment or organization, no treasure or level adjustment, always evil and usually neutral evil.

ruleNotes: The sample stat block and template use 2d4 + Strength for constriction. The general combat paragraph says 2d4. This summary uses the sample's explicit 2d4 + 2.
The sample lists Will +2. Its template's formula gives +3 at 3 HD. Use the listed sample save for this encounter and the template formula when creating another boneless.

name: Boowray
otherStatistics: Initiative +8. AC 16 (+2 size, +4 Dex). Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Base attack +0, grapple −11. Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +3. Hide +6, Listen +6, Spot +6. Improved Initiative and Lightning Reflexes (bonus), Weapon Finesse. Temperate forest. Solitary. No treasure. Always lawful evil. Advancement 5–6 HD (Small).
description: This fey approaches as a translucent child and whispers instructions that only its chosen victim can hear.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +4 melee (1d2−4).
Suggestive Whispers (Sp). Use suggestion at will as an 8th-level sorcerer. The listener can resist with a DC 17 Will save. Each suggestion the listener obeys imposes a cumulative −1 penalty on further saves against the whispers. A successful save reduces the accumulated penalty by 1. Only the victim hears the whispers. The boowray speaks in a language the victim speaks fluently and can remain invisible. Silence blocks the whispers while it lasts. Acts performed under direct compulsion require no Ravenloft powers checks. Prolonged harassment can call for Ravenloft Madness saves and eventually shift the victim's alignment to evil.
sections.Defenses: Incorporeal subtype. Immune to mind-influencing effects. Invisibility (Su) at will as a free action, for any duration. Dispel evil can drive it away.
sections.Tactics: It hides until it chooses a victim, then appears harmless. It escapes through solid objects or turns invisible when confronted. Bite if it cannot retreat.

ruleNotes: The book lists AC 16 but no touch or flat-footed values. From its listed AC bonuses, touch AC is 16 and flat-footed AC is 12.

name: Bowlyn
otherStatistics: Initiative +6. AC 13 (+2 Dex, +1 deflection), touch 13, flat-footed 11. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +2. Balance +6, Hide +8, Listen +8, Profession (sailor) +6, Search +8, Spot +10. Alertness (bonus), Dodge, Power Attack. Any aquatic environment. Solitary. No treasure. Always chaotic evil. Advancement 5–8 HD (Medium).
description: A drowned sailor rises to punish the crew it blames for its death. Its first appearance always falls on the anniversary of the accident.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Incorporeal touch +7 melee (1d6, or 1d6+7 against ethereal targets) or ghostly scimitar +7 melee (1d6+3).
Seasick Touch (Su). A hit on a living victim deals 1d6 damage. On a failed DC 15 Fortitude save, it also nauseates the victim until a Heal check or healing magic cures the nausea.
Manifestation (Su). While manifested, creatures on the Material or Ethereal Plane can attack the bowlyn, and it can strike with its touch or scimitar. Seeing it manifest causes fear as cast by a 12th-level sorcerer. DC 15 Will negates.
Telekinesis (Su). Once per round as a free action, as a 12th-level sorcerer. It can only move objects.
sections.Defenses: Incorporeal subtype, undead traits, and +5 turn resistance.
sections.Haunting: It waits 1–10 years after death before returning. Once per night it engineers an accident against a former crewmate or where it worked on the ship. It uses Seasick Touch if it cannot cause an accident. It keeps returning until the crew dies or the ship is destroyed. Running the ship aground immediately destroys the spirit.

name: Bruja
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC 17 (+3 Dex, +4 natural), touch 13, flat-footed 14. Base attack +8, grapple +14. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +2, Will +2 as printed. Gather Information +5, Handle Animal +7, Sense Motive +7, Survival +9. Alertness and Track (bonus), Animal Affinity, Improved Initiative, Power Attack. Rural terrain. Solitary. No treasure. Always neutral. Advancement 9–12 HD (Medium), 13–16 HD (Large). Speaks the local language and communicates with wild animals.
description: A solitary, haglike figure who knows when and how she will die. She often disguises herself to help travelers without alarming them.

sections.Actions:
One claw +14 melee (1d6+6). Full attack, two claws +14 melee each (1d6+6 per hit).
Spell-like abilities at will. Bless, disguise self (DC 12), hide from undead (DC 13), invisibility (DC 13), pass without trace, and speak with animals.
Spell-like abilities once per day each. Dispel evil (DC 17), heal, magic circle against evil (DC 15), remove curse (DC 15), and sunray (DC 19).
sections.Traits:
Wild empathy, darkvision 60 ft., immunity to surprise, spell resistance 10, swift tracker, and ranger-style tracking. The book gives no wild empathy or swift tracker level.
In combat she favors magic, using her claws when cornered.

ruleNotes: The printed 8d8+2 Hit Dice cannot roll the accompanying 6 HP. Use 38 HP, the average of the printed dice and modifier, as a table ruling.

name: Carrion Stalker
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC 17 (+2 size, +3 Dex, +2 natural), touch 15, flat-footed 14. Base attack +0, grapple −12. Space 2 ft., reach 15 ft. Fort +4, Ref +3, Will +0. Hide +18, Spot +4. Underground. Solitary or clusters of 2–6. No treasure. Always neutral. Advancement 2–4 HD (Small), with overlapping ranges in print.
description: A corpse-dwelling scavenger whose eight legs resemble exposed ribs. It uses the corpse for cover and to anchor its tendrils.

sections.Actions:
Tendrils (Ex). Tendril +5 ranged (1d2 plus pinning). Full attack, up to eight tendrils +5 ranged each (1d2 plus pinning per hit). On any hit, the target makes one Reflex save at DC 13 + the number of tendrils that hit or is pinned. The stalker itself is not considered grappled. Escape requires an Escape Artist or Strength check at DC 15 + the number of wrapping tendrils. Each tendril deals 1 damage per round to the bound target. An ally who uses Aid Another to help takes 1 damage. The stalker keeps attacking that target with tendrils that previously missed, at the printed +4 to hit. Each tendril has AC 20 (+8 size, +2 natural), 2 separate HP, and takes damage only from slashing weapons. Tendrils continue stinging for 1d4 rounds after the stalker dies.
Infest (Ex). Drag the pinned victim 5 ft. closer each round without provoking attacks of opportunity. When the victim reaches the stalker's square, release 2d4 larvae as a free action and die. If killed first, the stalker releases its larvae toward an adjacent creature. Larvae burrow on the following round. Before then, a helper who succeeds on a DC 15 Spot check can remove 1d4 larvae as a standard action. While larvae are burrowed, each deals 1d2 temporary Constitution damage per round unless the victim succeeds on a Fortitude save at DC 12 + the number of burrowed larvae. Removing each requires a DC 15 Heal check. Helpers risk the tendrils if the victim is still bound. Remove disease kills all larvae. They mature in two weeks.
sections.Senses: Heatsense (Ex) detects warm-blooded creatures within 30 ft. through invisibility or concealment. Treat the stalker as blinded against creatures that give off no heat. Vermin traits.
sections.Tactics: Stay hidden in a corpse until warm-blooded prey comes within 15 ft., then strike with the tendrils.

name: Carrionette
otherStatistics: Initiative +0. AC 14 (+4 size), touch 14, flat-footed 14. Base attack +0, grapple −12. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +0, Ref +0, Will −1. Climb +8, including a +8 racial bonus. Odiare. Solitary or packs of 2–8. No treasure. Always chaotic evil. Advancement 3–4 HD (Tiny).
description: A painted marionette that uses silver needles to disable a victim and take over their body.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Straight razor −2 melee (1d4−2) or silver needle +0 ranged (special).
Silver Needles (Su). Carries 10 reusable needles. Throw one up to 15 ft. A hit strikes a limb the carrionette chooses and deals no damage. A failed DC 14 Will save paralyzes that limb and makes the trailing silver cord invisible. Removing the needle ends paralysis after 1d4 rounds. The needles are nonmagical, and carrionettes are immune to the paralysis.
Possession (Su). Drive a silver needle into the neck of a sleeping, unconscious, or fully immobilized humanoid or monstrous humanoid. The doll and victim swap essences indefinitely, as magic jar with no save. The carrionette wakes in the stolen body after one round and can safely remove its own needles. The victim wakes in the doll after one hour. The doll remains linked to the carrionette, which dies if the doll is destroyed. If the victim in the doll drives a silver needle into the stolen body, reverse the swap. The carrionette remains inert in the doll for an hour, and the victim wakes in their own body after one round.
Ventriloquism (Sp). At will.
sections.Defenses: Construct traits and darkvision 60 ft. Warp wood instantly destroys the carrionette.

name: Crypt Cat
otherStatistics: Initiative +7 as printed. AC 15 (+2 size, +2 Dex, +1 natural), touch 14, flat-footed 13. Base attack +0, grapple −9. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. as listed. Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +2. Balance +5, Climb +5, Jump +5, Move Silently +4. Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse. Any land or underground. Solitary or guardians in groups of 10–20. Standard treasure. Always neutral.
description: This mummified cat guards a tomb. It lies still until it can surprise intruders, then its claws leave wounds that resist ordinary healing.

sections.Actions:
Claw +2 melee (1d3−1 and infection). Full attack, two claws +2 melee each (1d3−1 and infection) and a bite (1d3−1 and infection, use −3 to hit as a table ruling).
Infection (Su). A living creature damaged by a crypt cat must make a DC 12 Fortitude save. On a failure, 1 HP from that wound remains unhealed even with magical healing. A single heal or remove disease spell cures all such wounds.
sections.Defenses: Undead traits, immunity to cold, and damage reduction 5/bludgeoning.

ruleNotes: The printing omits the bite attack bonus. The table ruling treats the bite as a standard secondary natural attack, five below the claw bonus.

name: Midnight Cat
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC 22 (+2 size, +3 Dex, +7 luck), touch 22, flat-footed 19. Base attack +3, grapple −7. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +3. Balance +11, Climb +10, Hide +14, Listen +9, Move Silently +12, Spot +10. Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse. Any land. Solitary. Standard treasure. Always neutral evil. Usually speaks at least one domain language.
description: A black cat with misty breath that trades relief from curses for favors, often at someone else's expense.

sections.Actions:
Claw +6 melee (1d2−2). Full attack, two claws +6 melee each (1d2−2 per hit) and bite −2 melee (1d3−2).
Steal Breath (Sp). Perch on the chest of a sleeping victim and inhale its breath. DC 15 Fortitude or 1 point of Constitution drain. The victim also cannot benefit from healing magic until the cat dies.
Curses (Sp). As a standard action at will, draw out a curse up to troublesome severity by inhaling the victim's breath. The target can be awake. The cat usually demands payment or an evil favor. When offended, it can instead lay a curse of vengeance up to troublesome severity at will as a standard action, with a +15 curse check. Use the Ravenloft curse rules.
sections.Traits: Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision. Racial skill bonuses of +4 to Hide and Move Silently and +8 to Balance. The racial Hide bonus rises to +8 in darkness. Uses its Dexterity modifier when climbing.
sections.Tactics: Avoid a fight with a larger creature. When attacked, respond with a curse.

name: Plains Cat
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC components −1 size, +3 Dex, +3 natural. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack +3, grapple +12. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +2.
description: The cat hunts the grasslands of Nova Vaasa. Its hunting cry sounds enough like a human scream to draw would-be rescuers near.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +7 melee (1d6 + 5).
Full attack. Two claws +7 melee (1d6 + 5 each) and bite +2 melee (1d8 + 2).
Pounce (Ex). On a charge, make a full attack and add two rakes, each +7 melee for 1d8 + 2 damage.
Startle (Ex). At will, roar in place of a bite. Enemies within 30 ft. who hear it make an immediate DC 10 Fear save or are stunned for 1 round. After that save, the same cat’s roar cannot affect them again for one day.
sections.Traits: Scent. It fights if threatened or if intruders enter its territory.
sections.Skills and feats: Balance +5, Climb +5, Hide +7, Jump +9, Move Silently +7. The +4 racial Hide bonus rises to +12 in tall grass or dense underbrush, raising total Hide to +15. Balance and Move Silently each include a +4 racial bonus. Feat: Dodge.
sections.Encounter details: Temperate plains. Solitary. Always neutral. No treasure. Advancement 5–8 HD (Large).

name: Resplendent Cloaker
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC components −1 size, +3 Dex, +5 natural. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +4. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +7. Standard treasure.
description: A jewel-bright cloaker waits on furniture for a suitable host. It feeds by mending wounds, and its glow draws unwanted eyes.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Attach +8 melee touch (no damage).
Full attack. Attach +8 melee touch (no damage) and bite +3 melee (1d4 + 2), as printed.
Color Spray (Su). Release a burst that works like color spray from a 6th-level sorcerer. DC 16 Will negates.
Attach (Su). If the spray stuns or knocks out a human-shaped living creature at least one size smaller, attempt a touch attack to make it a host.
Hit Point Drain (Su). As a free action each round, heal up to 5 HP of damage to either the cloaker or its host. For every 2 HP it heals on the host, it feeds on 1 HP of that damage. When it heals itself from its host, the host takes 2 damage for each HP the cloaker regains. It cannot heal damage it inflicted. If it fails to feed on at least 1 HP of damage in a day, it takes 1 damage.
sections.Host and vulnerabilities: It detaches if the host dies, if either the host or the cloaker receives magical healing, or if it goes four days without feeding. A DC 15 Strength check can tear it free. Both make DC 14 Fortitude saves or die, and a surviving host is stunned for 1d8 minutes. The cloaker loses 1 HD per week without a host and recovers 1 HD per day of feeding on a new host. Magical darkness deals 1 damage per round to the cloaker. Healing magic applied to the cloaker deals the amount that would be healed to both it and its host.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +12, Listen +11, Move Silently +12, Spot +11. Its glow grants observers a +10 circumstance bonus to Spot it except in very bright light. Feats: Alertness, Improved Initiative.
sections.Encounter details: Underground. Solitary. Usually chaotic neutral. Advancement 7–9 HD (Large), 10–18 HD (Huge).

ruleNotes: The stat block gives both 6d8 + 20 and 35 HP. Use its listed HP for the printed specimen. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives +4 alone.

name: Shadow Cloaker
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC components −1 size, +3 Dex, +7 natural. Touch AC 12, flat-footed AC 16. Base attack +4. Space 10 ft., reach 10 ft. (5 ft. with bite). Fort +9, Ref +5, Will +7. Standard treasure.
description: This cloaker moves like a patch of darkness, then latches onto a lone traveler’s shadow and feeds through their touch.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Tail slap +8 melee (1d6 + 5).
Full attack. Tail slap +8 melee (1d6 + 5) and bite +3 melee (1d4 + 2). It can use the tail on another target while engulfing and can use the tail while attached.
Attach (Su). On a bite that hits a human-shaped living creature at least one size smaller, attach to its shadow. It cannot bite while attached. This ends when either dies or when a daylight, sunbeam, or sunburst spell targets the cloaker. Without a host it loses 1 HD per week, recovering 1 HD per day of feeding through a new host.
Constitution Drain (Su). The cloaker feeds once per day. Its host’s contact with a living creature deals 1 point of Constitution drain to that creature 2d8 minutes later. Against an unwilling creature, the host must make a touch attack. If the host touches no living creature for 24 hours, the cloaker feeds from the host. A creature drained to Constitution 0 dies and rises as a shadow 24 hours later.
Shadow Shift (Su). The cloaker and its host gain concealment (20% miss chance) for 1d4 rounds.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +12, Listen +11, Move Silently +12, Spot +11. In shadowy areas it gains a +5 racial bonus on Hide checks (total +17), and a host also gains that +5 racial bonus. A successful Move Silently check lets the cloaker gain surprise when it attacks. Feats: Alertness, Improved Initiative.
sections.Encounter details: Underground. Solitary. Always chaotic neutral. Advancement 7–9 HD (Large), 10–18 HD (Huge).

ruleNotes: The stat block gives both 6d8 + 18 and 34 HP. Use its listed HP for the printed specimen. The Base Attack/Grapple row gives +4 alone.

name: Corpse Candle
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC components +3 Dex, +2 deflection. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack +3, grapple +3 as listed. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +8.
description: A murder victim’s spirit waits over its body until someone sees the glow in its dead eyes and becomes a witness to the killing.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Incorporeal touch +5 (1d6 spiritual flame damage).
Control Flame (Su). Take hold of a nearby flame and make someone see the killer’s face in fire. A tendril from the fire can reach up to 10 ft., deal 1d6 damage, or ignite flammable material.
Death Vision (Su). The first person to look into the corpse’s eyes makes a DC 16 Will save. Success gives immunity to this power for one day. On failure, the person relives the victim’s last moments in a trance, which often calls for a Ravenloft Horror save. They see who killed the victim and feel driven to bring the killer to justice.
sections.Traits: Incorporeal subtype, undead traits, +2 turn resistance. The spirit is naturally invisible. Magic that reveals invisible or ethereal creatures can show it as mist over its body or as an image of the dead person riding its chosen agent’s shoulders. The agent’s eyes glow slightly in the dark.
sections.Skills and feats: Intimidate +15, Spot +15, Survival +15. Feats: Alertness, Blind-Fight, Iron Will, Track.
sections.Encounter details: Any land and underground. Solitary. Usually chaotic neutral. No treasure. Advancement 8–12 HD (Medium).

name: Crimson Bones
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC components +3 Dex, +2 natural. Touch AC 13, flat-footed AC 12. Base attack +1, grapple +3. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +4.
description: This blood-dripping skeleton rises from a flaying victim and attacks the living until destroyed.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +2 melee (1d4 + 3).
Full attack. Two claws +2 melee (1d4 + 3 each) and bite −3 melee (1d8 + 2).
Blood Poisoning (Ex). An adjacent attacker who hits makes a DC 14 Reflex save to avoid a splash. A living attacker splashed then makes a DC 13 Fortitude save or takes 1 damage each round until death or treatment with neutralize poison or an equivalent effect.
Burning Blood (Su). The bite transmits a supernatural disease on a failed DC 13 Fortitude save. After a 1-day incubation, it deals 1 Constitution drain. Standard recovery saves do not end it. It continues until the victim dies at Constitution 0 or receives remove disease or similar magic.
sections.Traits: Undead traits, DR 5/bludgeoning, cold immunity. It can be turned but cannot be rebuked or commanded by evil clerics. Sithkin changelings or arcane casters using control undead can control it. It does not understand or speak languages.
sections.Skills and feats: No skills listed. Feat: Improved Initiative.
sections.Encounter details: Any land, any organization. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 3–7 HD (Large), 8–14 HD (Huge).

name: Dreamweaver
otherStatistics: Initiative +7. AC components +3 Dex, +4 size. Touch AC 17, flat-footed AC 14. Base attack +0, grapple −14. Space 1 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +2.
description: These small spiders spin dreams. The pale ones bring rest, while black ones weave nightmares. Both communicate only through dreams.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +3 melee (1d2 − 2 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). DC 11 Fortitude. Initial damage 1d6 Wisdom, secondary damage 2d6 Wisdom. At Wisdom 0, the victim cannot be awakened until their Wisdom goes above 0.
Web (Su). It spins around sleepers within 50 ft. A light dreamweaver relieves Ravenloft’s nightmares horror effect. A sleeper free of that effect gains a full night’s rest in four hours. A dark dreamweaver imposes the nightmares effect while the creature sleeps near its silk.
sections.Traits: Natural sunlight causes it to fade away permanently. It fights only when cornered.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +10, Move Silently +6, Spot +2. Feat: Improved Initiative.
sections.Encounter details: Any land or underground, usually in dreams. Solitary, colony (2–5), or swarm (6–11). Usually a colony has only light or only dark dreamweavers. Always lawful neutral. No treasure.
sections.Nightmares: The victim is shaken for 5d6 rounds. Each attempt to sleep ends after 5d6 minutes, preventing rest, natural healing, and recovery of arcane spells. Each full day without rest adds a cumulative −1 morale penalty to attack rolls, saves, skill checks, and ability checks, up to −4. A sleep spell allows dreamless rest and clears the accumulated penalties, but the nightmares return on nights without it. Elves are normally immune. The optional waking dream during meditation instead works like major image and permits a Will save to disbelieve. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, p. 81.

ruleNotes: The attack lines assign poison to the bite. The poison paragraph calls it a sting but gives no separate sting attack.
Nightmares refers to the horror effect in the Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, Chapter Three.

name: Drownling
otherStatistics: Initiative +4. AC components +4 Dex, +1 size. Touch AC 15, flat-footed AC 11. Base attack +1, grapple −4. Space 5 ft., reach 5 ft. Fort +1, Ref +5, Will +1.
description: Three drownlings stage a drowning to lure strangers into stagnant water. One asks for help while the others make the scene convincing.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +1 melee (1d4 − 1).
Full attack. Two claws +1 melee (1d4 − 1 each).
Improved Grab (Ex). Hit a swimming target of Medium size or smaller with both claws to start a grapple. On a hold, try to pin the victim and drag them below the surface. The other drownlings use aid another to help maintain the pin until the victim drowns.
Spell-like abilities. Each 1/day at caster level 8th: charm person, confusion, dancing lights, detect magic, entangle. Save DC 12 + spell level.
sections.Traits:
DR 5/silver. It breathes air and water.
Unified Spirits (Su). Divide damage to one evenly among its covey of three. When one reaches 0 HP, the others flee. In their native waters they cannot die unless all three reach −10 HP. There they automatically stabilize and regain 1 HP per hour.
Water Dependency (Ex). Each hour on dry land deals 1d4 Strength damage. In its native waters the drownling recovers 1 point of lost Strength per minute.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +10, Hide +15, Listen +6, Move Silently +7, Sense Motive +8, Spot +6. Feats: Alertness (bonus feat), Dodge.
sections.Encounter details: Aquatic and marsh terrain or anywhere near water, including underground. Covey (3). Covey members communicate telepathically and speak other languages. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure.

name: Broken One
otherStatistics: Initiative −1. AC 15 (−1 Dex, +6 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +0, Will +5. Climb +8, Hide +4, Listen +5, Spot +5. Multiattack. Any land or underground. Solitary, gangs of 2–5, or packs of 6–11. Standard treasure. Usually neutral evil. Advances at 4–6 HD (Medium) or 7–9 HD (Large).
description: Scarred and mismatched limbs show where magic, surgery, or a curse remade this creature.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +5 melee (1d4+3).
Full attack. Two slams +5 melee (1d4+3 each).
sections.Choose two powers:
Each broken one has two of these powers. For a quick encounter, use Damage Reduction and Improved Grab.
Damage Reduction (Su). DR 10/magic.
Extra Limb (Ex). Add one slam to the full attack and gain Multiattack.
Frenzy (Ex), 1/day. Gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength and Constitution and take −2 AC until the broken one or its opponent dies.
Fluid Body (Su). Flatten and pass through any opening that water could pass through.
Improved Grab (Ex). A successful slam allows a free grapple attempt without provoking an attack of opportunity.
Inhuman Strength (Ex). Add 4 to Strength and raise melee attack and damage by 2.
sections.Tactics and languages: It tends to charge without concern for its own safety. It understands the languages it knew before transformation but speaks them with difficulty. A specimen made from an animal often speaks its creator’s language.

ruleNotes: Both the printed base stat line and Extra Limb list Multiattack. If using Extra Limb, apply the feat once. The two powers suggested for a quick encounter are a table choice.

name: Dread Doppelganger
otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC 17 (+1 Dex, +6 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 16. Base attack +4, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +6. Bluff +12, Disguise +12, Listen +11, Sense Motive +6, Spot +8. Alertness, Dodge. Any land or underground, especially Paridon. Solitary, pair, or clan of 4–12. Double standard treasure. Usually neutral evil. Advances by class.
description: Clans replace members of wealthy households one at a time. A cornered impostor may fake its death to keep the rest of the clan hidden.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +6 melee (1d6+2).
Full attack. Two slams +6 melee (1d6+2 each). It can instead use the weapons of its assumed identity.
sections.Traits:
Change Shape (Su). Assume the shape of any Small or Medium humanoid and keep it indefinitely.
Detect Thoughts (Su). Works continuously as the spell at caster level 18th, Will DC 14 negates. Suppress or resume it as a free action.
Glamer (Su). As a free action, change the look and texture of an object it carries without changing its underlying material. The object reverts at a separation of 5 ft. or more.
Immune to sleep and charm effects.
sections.Disguise checks: Bluff and Disguise receive a +4 racial bonus. Add another +10 circumstance bonus to Disguise in an assumed shape. When it can read the observer’s mind, add +4 circumstance to both Bluff and Disguise.

ruleNotes: The skill paragraph calls Change Shape “disguise self,” but the stat block lists Change Shape and Glamer. At the table, apply the +10 bonus to an assumed shape.

name: Ermordenung
otherStatistics: Initiative +8. AC 15 (+4 Dex, +1 padded armor), touch 14, flat-footed 11. Base attack +3, grapple +7. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +10, Will +4. Bluff +12, Diplomacy +12, Escape Artist +7, Gather Information +10, Hide +10, Intimidate +8, Listen +8, Move Silently +11, Sense Motive +12, Spot +12, Use Magic Device +8. Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes. Three potions of cure moderate wounds. Solitary or pair in Borca. Standard treasure. Usually lawful evil. Advances by class.
description: Ivana Boritsi’s assassin passes among Borca’s nobility and can poison a target through bare skin.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Unarmed strike +7 melee (1d3+4 nonlethal plus poison) or +1 dagger at +8 melee (1d4+5). Sneak attack +2d6 when eligible.
Toxic Touch (Ex). An unarmed strike against bare skin ignores the target’s natural armor. A foe striking the ermordenung unarmed is also exposed. Contact poison, Fortitude DC 15, initial and secondary damage 2d4 Constitution.
Kiss of Death (Ex). In combat, a successful grapple check delivers the same poison at Fortitude DC 19.
sections.Defenses: Evasion and uncanny dodge. Immune to poison except toxins from other ermordenung and poisons created by Ravenloft’s closed domain borders.

ruleNotes: This is the print’s 4th-level human rogue sample. The DCs follow the printed formula, 10 + half the creature’s HD + Constitution modifier, plus 4 for Kiss of Death. The sample’s weapon damage line gives the dagger no poison.

name: Gremishka
otherStatistics: Initiative +10. AC 18 (+2 size, +6 Dex), touch 18, flat-footed 12. Base attack +1, grapple −10. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +8, Will −1. Hide +18, Listen +4, Move Silently +8, Sleight of Hand +12, Spot +4, Tumble +10. Dodge, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse (bonus). Darkvision 60 ft. and low-light vision. Any land, often in darkness. Swarm of 20–40. Double standard treasure. Usually chaotic evil. Advances at 2–3 HD (Small).
description: These nimble pests spring traps and leap onto intruders in packs.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +8 melee (1d2−3).
Full attack. Two claws +8 melee (1d2−3 each) and bite +3 melee (1d3−3).
Improved Grab (Ex). If both claws hit, attempt to grab. On success, the gremishka latches on and deals its bite damage automatically each round. Its target is not grappled but carries the gremishka’s 4 lb. Attacks from someone else deal damage to the gremishka first. Excess beyond its HP goes to the creature carrying it.
Swarm (Ex). Up to 20 gremishkas can attack and latch onto a Medium target in one round. Double that limit per size category larger or halve it per category smaller. Every four attached gremishkas add 1 to their combined bite damage.
sections.Bright light: Skitterish (Ex). Sudden bright light, such as from daylight, calls for a DC 15 Fear save. Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.
sections.Tactics and languages: Groups prefer dark ambush sites and often build traps. They speak Gremishka, and some understand human languages without speaking them.

ruleNotes: Apply the 3.5 minimum of 1 point of damage on a successful hit when the printed damage roll is 0 or lower.

name: Grim
speed: Dog 60 ft. (12 squares). Owl 10 ft. (2 squares), fly 90 ft. (average).
otherStatistics: Initiative +10. AC 18 (+6 Dex, +2 natural), touch 16, flat-footed 12. Base attack +4, grapple +6. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +3. Listen +12, Sense Motive +14, Spot +15. Extra Turning, Improved Initiative, Multiattack. Solitary on any land. No treasure. Always neutral good. Advances at 5–8 HD (Medium) or 9–15 HD (Large).
description: A black dog or horned owl keeps watch over the grave or shrine to which it is bound.

sections.Actions:
Dog attack or full attack. Bite +7 melee (2d6+3).
Owl attack. Claws +6 melee (1d4+2). Full attack adds bite +4 melee (1d6+2).
Frightful Presence (Ex). It howls or screeches when it first detects evil on its grounds and can repeat the howl at will as a standard action. Evil creatures within 30 ft. make a DC 15 Fear save. A success grants immunity to this grim’s Frightful Presence for one day.
Turning (Su). Turn or destroy evil undead and outsiders as a 9th-level cleric.
sections.Traits:
The grim chooses dog or owl form at dusk and retains it until dawn. Most statistics are shared across both forms. It fades in daylight, invisible and intangible, and returns fully healed at sunset. It never leaves its grounds and does not need food or sleep.
Detect Corruption (Su). It continually detects evil undead and outsiders within 60 ft. It has a 20% chance per failed powers check to detect corruption in other creatures.
DR 15/magic and spell resistance 16. Immune to necromantic effects. Magic circle against evil operates continuously at caster level 12th and cannot be suppressed. Sense Motive and Spot get a +4 racial bonus.
sections.Fear save: Ravenloft Fear save. Roll against the DC using Will and applicable fear adjustments. Failure by 1–5 leaves the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11 or more panicked for 5d6 rounds. Failure by 16 or more also calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Another failed Fear save escalates an existing fear effect by one step. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

ruleNotes: Touch and flat-footed AC follow from the listed Dexterity and natural armor bonuses. The book lists only total AC.

name: Impersonator
otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC 12 (+1 size, +1 Dex), printed touch 11 and flat-footed 11. Base attack +3, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +5. Disguise +10, Listen +4, Spot +4. Skill Focus (Disguise). Temperate or warm marshes and underground. Solitary. Standard treasure. Always neutral evil. Advances at 6–8 HD (Medium) or 9–10 HD (Large).
description: A pool the color of old blood can briefly take the shape of someone it has fed on.

sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee (1d4).
Paralysis (Ex). A slam in natural form forces a DC 16 Fortitude save. Failure paralyzes the target as long as contact continues and for 1d4 rounds after it ends.
Blood Drain (Ex). Envelop a paralyzed creature and deal 1d4 Constitution damage per round without pain. The process does not wake an already sleeping victim.
sections.Traits:
Immune to paralysis, sleep, stunning, polymorphing, and critical hits.
Replication (Ex). Change shape as a standard action into a Small or Medium creature whose blood it has tasted. It typically has 3d4 forms ready and can keep a form for one hour per point of Constitution damage it inflicted on that victim by draining blood. Copy none of the target’s abilities. A copied weapon deals only 1d4 damage. Replication grants +10 circumstance on Disguise checks. It understands simple ideas in the languages of past victims but cannot speak.

ruleNotes: The book prints touch AC 11 despite listing only +1 size and +1 Dexterity bonuses, which would normally give touch AC 12. It also prints grapple +3 for this Small creature. The encounter keeps the printed values.

name: Skin Thief
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC 15 (+3 Dex, +2 natural), touch 13, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +5. Bluff +6, Disguise +5, Hide +6, Intimidate +6. Dodge. Any land or underground. Solitary, family of 3–6, or clan of 4–12. Double standard treasure. Usually chaotic evil. Advances by class.
description: A stocky, shaggy shapeshifter slips into the skin of someone it killed and waits for that person’s friends.

sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +4 melee (1d6+2).
Full attack. Two claws +4 melee (1d6+2 each) and bite −1 melee (1d4+1 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). Injury, Fortitude DC 13, initial and secondary damage 1d6 Dexterity.
Skin Theft (Su). Use one full-round action to skin a humanoid it killed and another to put on the skin. It takes on the victim’s appearance and natural armor bonus, and gains +8 racial on Disguise, without acquiring memories or abilities. Whenever it takes damage, make a Reflex save at DC 10 + damage taken. Failure bursts the disguise.
sections.Tactics and languages: It lures isolated prey, then uses its bite or attacks with its clan. Its mixed dialect borrows from languages it has heard. A listener has a 5% chance per language they know of understanding the gist of any statement.

name: Dread Wight
description: A dread wight can pass for the person it once was until it gets close. Greater dread wights send their lesser kin into the fight first.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Solitary, gang of 2–5, or pack of 6–11. Always lawful evil. No treasure. Common advancement 6–9 HD (Medium).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex and +5 natural. Touch 12, flat-footed 15. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +5.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +8, Hide +10, Listen +8, Move Silently +20, Search +7, Spot +8. Blind-Fight, Toughness. Dread wights have a +8 racial bonus on Move Silently, already reflected in the listed modifier.
sections.Traits: DR 5/magic and undead traits.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Slam +5 melee for 1d6 + 3 plus energy drain.
Energy Drain (Su). A living creature hit by the slam gains one negative level. Use DC 14 for the later Fortitude save to remove it.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid slain by the wight rises as a dread wight in 1d4 rounds. It loses its former abilities and serves its creator until that creator dies.
sections.Greater dread wight:
Large Undead, CR 6. 10d12 + 3 (68 HP), initiative +2, speed 40 ft. (8 squares), AC 20 (−1 size, +2 Dex, +9 natural), touch 11, flat-footed 18. Base attack +5, grapple +12. Use the printed 5-ft. space and 10-ft. reach. Fort +3, Ref +5, Will +9. Str 25, Dex 14, Int 13, Wis 14, Cha 17. Climb +12, Hide +10, Intimidate +8, Listen +10, Move Silently +22, Search +10, Spot +10. Blind-Fight, Cleave, Power Attack, Toughness. DR 10/magic, +1 turn resistance, and undead traits. Advancement 11–14 HD (Large).
Slam +12 melee for 1d8 + 10 plus energy drain, or make two such slams as a full attack. Each hit on a living creature applies one negative level, Fortitude DC 18 to remove. As for a common dread wight, humanoid victims rise in 1d4 rounds. A giant slain by the greater wight becomes a greater dread wight. It controls its spawn until destroyed.

ruleNotes: The greater wight is Large but prints a 5-ft. space. Both the table and its stat line give that value.

name: Ghoul Lord
description: A ghoul lord rules a feeding ground such as a graveyard or battlefield. Its ghasts and ghouls bring it flesh and spread its influence.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Solitary or accompanied by 2–4 ghasts and 7–12 ghouls. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure. Advances by character class. The sample is a 6th-level human fighter. It knows its languages from life and communicates telepathically with ghouls and ghasts within 100 ft.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +7. AC +3 Dex, +4 natural, +4 masterwork chain shirt. Touch 13, flat-footed 18. Base attack +6, grapple +10. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +4.
sections.Skills and feats: Climb +10, Hide +12, Jump +10, Listen +11, Move Silently +12, Ride +9, Search +10, Spot +11, Swim +10. Cleave, Dodge (bonus), Exotic Weapon Proficiency (bastard sword), Great Cleave, Improved Initiative (bonus), Multiattack, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (bastard sword), Weapon Specialization (bastard sword).
sections.Traits:
Undead traits and +2 turn resistance.
Miasma (Su). Good-aligned creatures within 60 ft. make a DC 14 Will save or suffer a −4 morale penalty on attacks, checks, and saves until they leave the radius. This is a fear effect.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Bite +8 melee for 1d6 + 2.
Full attack. Bite +8 melee for 1d6 + 2 and two claws +10 melee for 1d4 + 4 each. Alternatively, use the masterwork bastard sword +14 melee for 1d10 + 8 or the masterwork shortbow +10 ranged for 1d6. The bite carries paralysis and fever, and the claws carry paralysis.
Paralysis (Su). A bite or claw hit requires a DC 14 Fortitude save or paralysis lasts 1d6 + 6 minutes.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid or monstrous humanoid killed by fever at Constitution 0 rises as a ghoul lord after 24 hours if the body has not been destroyed. Someone slain directly by a bite or claw rises as a ghast after 1d4 days. Spawn serve their creator until it dies.
sections.Ravenous fever: A bite can spread this supernatural disease. Fortitude DC 20, incubation 1d4 days, damage 1d4 Constitution. Once infected, a victim needs raw flesh daily. The amounts in pounds, Fine through Colossal, are 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32. After more than 2 Constitution damage from the disease only humanoid flesh suffices. After more than 5 only flesh from living humanoids suffices. Going hungry for a day deals 1d4 temporary Constitution damage and calls for a Madness save, DC 10 + the Constitution damage suffered. Failure temporarily compels the victim to try to feed. Only heal cures the disease.
sections.Adapting the encounter: For a different humanoid or monstrous humanoid base, change its type to undead, keep size, speed, and saves, convert current and future Hit Dice to d12, and add +4 natural armor. A base creature with a swim speed retains it and is called a lacedon lord. Keep base attacks and add missing claws and bite. Base bite/claw damage by size, Fine to Colossal: 1/none, 1d2/1, 1d3/1d2, 1d4/1d3, 1d6/1d4, 1d8/1d6, 2d6/2d4, 2d8/2d6, 4d6/2d8. Use better existing natural damage if applicable. Str +2, Dex +4, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +4. Remove Con. Add Multiattack and +8 racial bonuses to Hide, Listen, Move Silently, Search, and Spot. CR increases by 2. Miasma and paralysis DCs are 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

ruleNotes: The sample prints one attack for each weapon in its full-attack alternatives, despite its +6 base attack. The listed sample routines preserve the printed values.

name: Jolly Roger
description: The laughing carcass of a drowned captain keeps a wreck afloat by force of will. Its zombie crew follows it on raids against anchored ships and coastal settlements.
otherStatistics: Any sea. Solitary in the stat line, often with its zombie crew. Always chaotic evil. Double standard treasure. Advancement 6–9 HD (Medium). Communicates telepathically with its own zombies.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative −1. AC −1 Dex and +2 natural. Touch 9, flat-footed 12. Base attack +2, grapple +3. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +0, Will +4.
sections.Skills and feats: Balance +7, Climb +6, Listen +2, Profession (sailor) +5, Spot +2, Survival +6, Use Rope +7. Improved Unarmed Strike, Toughness.
sections.Traits: DR 5/magic, fire resistance 20, immunity to water- and cold-based spells, and undead traits. Destroying the captain sinks its ship in 2d4 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Touch +3 melee.
Cackling Touch (Su). On a touch hit, a living target makes a DC 14 Fortitude save. Success means 1d6 hit point damage only. On failure, apply Tasha’s hideous laughter as from a 7th-level caster, except it lasts until dispelled or the victim dies and costs the victim 1d4 Constitution points each round.
Grinning Gaze (Sp). Anyone within 30 ft. subject to its gaze and able to hear the captain makes a DC 14 Will save or suffers Tasha’s hideous laughter at caster level 7.
Create Spawn (Su). A humanoid killed by the touch rises as a waterlogged zombie after 24 hours unless blessed and given a traditional burial at sea.
sections.Tactics: The captain opens with its gaze and chuckling to pin down the crew, then moves in to use its touch. It carries weapons as part of its old outfit but does not attack with them.

ruleNotes: The touch says the target loses Constitution points without specifying damage or drain. Treating the loss as Constitution damage is a table ruling.

name: Lebendtod
description: A lebendtod plays the part of the same worker or neighbor it was in life. When its master calls, the disguise drops and the entire household can turn on intruders.
otherStatistics: Any land on Graben Island. Solitary, pair, family of 5–8, or community of 40–60. Always neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advances by character class. The sample is a 2nd-level human commoner. Knows its languages from life.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative −1. AC −1 Dex, +2 natural, and +2 leather armor. Touch 9, flat-footed 14. Base attack +1, grapple +2. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +0, Ref −1, Will +2.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +6, Disguise +8, Profession (farmer) +5, Sense Motive +4. Iron Will (bonus), Skill Focus (Disguise).
sections.Traits: DR 10/magic and undead traits. Lifespan runs ten times that of the base creature. It normally fights only on its master’s orders.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +2 melee for 1d4 + 1 or sickle +2 melee for 1d6 + 1. Full attack makes two claws +2 melee for 1d4 + 1 each and a bite −3 melee for 1d3 + 1, or uses the sickle.
Detachable Limbs (Ex). It can remove or reattach any extremity unharmed as a standard action and still sense and control it when detached. Seeing it take off its head or use an arm as a club prompts a DC 15 Horror save except for the most callous witnesses.
Disguise Self (Sp). Twice per day at caster level 12, assume its appearance on the day it died. A free action maintains the disguise indefinitely. Magical or supernatural damage ends it immediately.
Create Spawn (Su). As a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, breathe into the mouth of a dying humanoid below 0 HP as the target takes its last breath. Isolate the body for 72 hours. It rises as a lebendtod if left untouched, or as a ghast with none of its former abilities if disturbed but largely intact. Either serves the lebendtod’s master until that master dies.
sections.Adapting the encounter: For a different humanoid base, keep its size, speed, base attack, saves, and skill points. Make it undead, convert Hit Dice to d12, add +2 natural armor, and add missing claw and bite attacks. Claw/bite base damage from Fine through Colossal: none/none, 1/none, 1d2/1, 1d3/1d2, 1d4/1d3, 1d6/1d4, 2d4/1d6, 2d6/1d8, 2d8/2d6. Use better existing damage. Str +2, Dex −2, Int −2. Remove Con. Add Iron Will and +5 racial bonuses to Bluff and Disguise. CR increases by 1. A clerical lebendtod rebukes instead of turning and cannot rebuke its master or the master’s other lebendtod.

ruleNotes: DR 10/magic appears in the sample stat block. The general template does not list it as a benefit.

name: Odem
description: An odem drains a victim’s judgment before taking control. The host stays aware as the spirit acts through the body.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 6–10 HD (Small). Speaks the languages it knew in life. A viewer who can see ethereal creatures sees a faint white aura around a possessed face.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +7. AC +1 size, +3 Dex, and +2 deflection. Printed touch 14, flat-footed 13. Base attack +2, printed grapple +2. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +6.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +14, Intimidate +12, Listen +10, Search +8, Sense Motive +12, Spot +10. Dodge, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative (bonus), Weapon Finesse (bonus).
sections.Traits:
Undead and incorporeal traits and +3 turn resistance.
Natural Invisibility (Su). Continually invisible, even while attacking. Invisibility purge does not suppress it.
Unnatural Aura (Su). Animals sense it within 30 ft. even when it is possessing a creature. They refuse to approach and panic while forced to stay inside the radius.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Incorporeal touch +6 melee. A living target hit makes a DC 15 Fortitude save or suffers 1d6 Wisdom drain, which requires magical restoration.
Possession (Su). Once per round as a standard action, merge with a creature on the Material Plane as magic jar at caster level 10 without a receptacle. DC 15 Will negates and gives one day of immunity to possession by that odem. On failure the odem controls the body. The host stays conscious and can take purely mental actions. The odem cannot be turned or rebuked while inside the host, and damage to the host does not harm the odem. The host is immune to nonlethal damage and stunning. The odem is expelled if the host dies.

ruleNotes: The printed touch AC is 14 even though the listed bonuses would produce 16 under the usual touch rules. The printed grapple bonus is also retained, although incorporeal creatures normally cannot physically grapple corporeal creatures.

name: Valpurleiche
description: This hanged revenant hunts the people it blames for its execution. If it died unjustly, evidence of its innocence can lay it to rest.
otherStatistics: Any land. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. Standard treasure. Advancement 9–11 HD (Medium) or 12–15 HD (Large). Understands its old languages and speaks only to whisper the accusations against it.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative −1. AC −1 Dex and +5 natural. Printed touch 13, flat-footed 14. Base attack +4, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +4, Ref +1, Will +7.
sections.Skills and feats: Intimidate +8, Listen +10, Move Silently +8, Sense Motive +12, Spot +10. Great Fortitude, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (slam).
sections.Traits:
Undead traits.
Regeneration 5 (Su). Only the attack forms it was accused of using or, if it was guilty, attacks by its former victims deal normal damage. It cannot regrow severed parts, but pressing one to its stump reattaches it immediately. Severed parts can act independently and can retain a hold they already had.
Restless (Su). An unjustly hanged valpurleiche reforms at full health 2d4 days after being slain. Presenting exonerating evidence to an authority reduces it to dust for good.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +9 melee for 1d6 + 4. Full attack makes two slams.
Animate Rope (Su). Three times per day at caster level 8.
Improved Grab (Ex). After hitting a Medium or smaller target with both slams, it can start a grapple. After a successful hold, Strangle (Ex) automatically deals 2d6 + 4 damage each round the hold lasts. Its victim cannot breathe and follows the 3.5 suffocation rules.

ruleNotes: Touch AC 13 and flat-footed AC 14 are printed, even though the listed Dex and natural armor produce different numbers under ordinary AC calculations.

name: Zombie Fog
description: This green-lit fog drifts over graves after dark. Its cadavers draw attention away from the cloud itself, which feeds on the dying.
otherStatistics: Any land. Solitary. Always neutral evil. No treasure. Advancement 7–12 HD (Colossal). It does not communicate.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative −2. AC −2 Dex, −8 size, and +12 deflection. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. No base attack or grapple listed. Printed space 60 ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +5.
sections.Skills and feats: Listen +6, Search +5, Spot +6. Toughness.
sections.Traits:
DR 15/magic, SR 12, and undead traits. The cloud fills an area 25 ft. square and 10 ft. deep per HD.
Vaporous (Ex). Passes through tiny cracks, makes no movement noise, cannot enter liquids, and automatically fails saves against damaging air or wind effects. The cloud gives concealment at 5 ft. and total concealment beyond 5 ft. Its cadavers can see through it.
Unnatural Aura (Su). Animals refuse to approach within 30 ft. and panic while inside that range if forced to enter.
Daylight Powerlessness (Ex). In natural sunlight the fog hangs motionless and its cadavers drop lifeless until sundown. A daylight spell does not have this effect.
sections.Actions:
Animate Cadaver (Su). Animate humanoid corpses inside the cloud, even buried corpses unless blessed at burial or interred in sanctified ground. Raise up to 10 per round, including previously defeated cadavers at full HP. The number active at once cannot exceed the fog’s current HP.
Despair (Su). A creature that sees the fog makes a DC 13 Fear save or stays shaken until it has spent 10 minutes completely out of sight. Whatever the result, that fog cannot affect it with despair again for one day.
Life Drain (Su). A creature at negative HP in the cloud loses 1 additional HP each round, even after stabilizing. The drain stops at 0 HP or higher. Protection from evil prevents it.
sections.Fog cadaver:
Medium Undead, CR 1/2. 2d12 + 3 (16 HP), initiative −1, speed 20 ft. (4 squares). AC 10 (−1 Dex, +1 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 10. Base attack and grapple are unlisted. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +0, Ref −1, Will +3. Str 11, Dex 9, Wis 10, Cha 1. Toughness, +4 turn resistance, undead traits. Always neutral, no treasure. The printed mob is 9–73.
Attack or full attack. Slam +1 melee for 1d6. The cadaver can move or attack in a round, doing both only as part of a charge. Dreadful Moan (Ex) requires a DC 12 Fear save within 10 ft. Cadavers collapse if taken out of the fog or exposed to natural sunlight.
sections.Feeding and advancement: If fewer creatures die in it during a week than its current HD, it loses 1 HD. If at least twice its HD die inside it during a week, it gains 1 HD.

ruleNotes: For the 6-HD fog, use the printed 60-ft. combat space and the description’s per-HD coverage for situational extent. A printed mob can exceed the sample fog’s 42-cadaver cap, so use current HP to determine how many the individual fog controls.
The cadaver’s moan gives a Fear save without a special failure effect or a repeat interval. Use the normal Ravenloft Fear result for the failed save.

name: Zombie Lord
description: This decaying spellcaster directs other zombies from a distance and sees through their eyes. The sample is a 6th-level human adept with a toad familiar.
otherStatistics: Any land. Solitary. Usually neutral evil. Standard treasure. Advances by character class.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex, +4 natural, and +2 leather armor. Touch 12, flat-footed 16. Base attack +3, grapple +5. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +8.
sections.Skills and feats: Concentration +7, Knowledge (arcana) +7, Knowledge (nature) +7, Listen +5, Profession (herbalist) +8, Spot +5, Search +3, Survival +12. Alertness, Brew Potion, Scribe Scroll, Toughness, Track.
sections.Traits:
Undead traits and toad familiar.
Aura of Death (Su). In the first round a living creature comes within 90 ft., it makes a DC 12 Fortitude save. Failure imposes a disease chosen by the zombie lord as contagion. A save failed by more than 10 kills the target and raises it as a zombie under the lord’s control. The lord cannot suppress the aura.
Speech of the Dead (Su). Speak telepathically with undead, which usually only report basic facts about their former lives and recent experiences. Use speak with dead at will by touching a corpse as a standard action.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +5 melee for 1d8 + 2. Full attack makes two such slams or a sling attack +5 ranged for 1d4.
Zombie Master (Su). Command zombies in sight mentally as a free action at will. The lord can see or otherwise sense through any zombie within a mile.
Awaken the Dead (Su). Use animate dead at caster level 12 to create zombies only.
Zombify (Su). On a successful touch attack against a living creature, a failed DC 12 Fortitude save kills the target. It rises after 1d4 rounds as a controlled zombie. Awaken the Dead and Zombify share one use per day.
sections.Spellcasting: Adept divine slots 4/3/2 for spell levels 0–2. Save DC 13 + spell level. The source leaves spell preparation to the DM.
sections.Adapting the encounter: Apply to a humanoid or monstrous humanoid base. Its type becomes undead, Hit Dice become d12, and natural armor increases by +4. Keep speed, saves, skills, and base attacks. Add two slams if it had none. If armed, use the weapon as the primary attack and a slam as secondary. Slam base damage from Fine through Colossal: 1d2, 1d3, 1d4, 1d6, 1d8, 2d6, 2d8, 4d6, 4d8. Keep stronger original damage. Str +4, no Con. Add Toughness and increase CR by 3. Aura of Death and Zombify use DC 10 + half HD + Cha modifier.

ruleNotes: The printed sample gives a single sling attack as the alternative to two slams. The general template allows a weapon attack with a secondary slam.

name: Assassin Imp
description: A spiny-winged familiar treats anyone close to its master as a potential threat. It prefers an apparent accident to an open fight.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Solitary. Always lawful evil. No treasure. Advancement 4–6 HD (Tiny). No level adjustment listed.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +3. AC +2 size, +3 Dex, +3 natural. Touch AC 15 and flat-footed AC 15, derived from those bonuses. Base attack +3, grapple −5. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Fort +3, Ref +6, Will +4.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +18, Listen +11, Move Silently +8, Search +9, Spellcraft +7, Spot +7. Flyby Attack, Weapon Finesse.
sections.Traits: Damage reduction 5/magic, darkvision 60 ft., immunity to poison, fire resistance 20, spell resistance 10. Regeneration 1 (Ex). Acid and hits from holy or blessed weapons deal normal damage.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Sting +8 melee (1d8 plus poison).
Poison (Ex). DC 13 Fortitude. Initial damage 1d4 Str, secondary damage 2d4 Str. A victim reduced to Strength 0 appears dead to nonmagical examination.
Spell-like abilities. Caster level 6th, save DC 10 + spell level. At will detect magic, find traps, and self-only invisibility. Three times per day each, knock and inflict light wounds. Once per day, command.
sections.Tactics: When pressed, use invisibility and flyby attacks to deliver the sting.

name: Fenhound
description: At the full moon, these golden marsh hounds track someone who has committed a deed that calls for a powers check.
otherStatistics: Temperate marsh. Pair or pack of 5–8. Always chaotic good. No treasure. Advancement 6–10 HD (Large). No level adjustment listed.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +2. AC +2 Dex and +6 natural, touch 12, flat-footed 16. Base attack +4, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +6, Will +4.
sections.Skills and feats: Listen +7, Move Silently +9, Spot +7, Survival +7. Endurance, Track.
sections.Traits: Damage reduction 5/—, scent, spell resistance 14. Magic Immunity (Ex). Immune to Sun domain spells. Spells cast by priests of deities of the moon, moors, or revenge cannot harm it.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Bite +8 melee (1d8 + 4).
Trip (Ex). After a bite hits, make a trip check at +4 as a free action. No touch attack or attack of opportunity, and the target cannot counter-trip on a failure.
Bay (Su). At the start of the hunt its howl carries one mile. The quarry must immediately attempt a DC 13 Fear save if it hears the bay.
sections.The hunt: A deed requiring a powers check in a swamp or moor draws at least two hounds on the next full moon. They track the quarry unerringly, fight anyone who interferes, and vanish at dawn. They return on the three nights of a full moon while the quarry survives and the curse remains. A slain hound dissolves into luminous vapor. Recurrence (Su). Killing a fenhound makes the killer the target of a pack at each full moon. Atonement ends the pursuit.
sections.Ravenloft Fear: When using the Ravenloft Fear rules, roll a Will save. Apply modifiers to saves against fear. Failure by 1–5 makes the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11–15 panicked. Failure by 16 or more makes it panicked and calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. A second failure escalates shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked. Creatures without Intelligence scores are immune. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

name: Hearth Fiend
description: A hearth fiend lives inside a stubborn flame. It whispers bargains from the fire and tries to get a servant to build it a bigger one.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground, inside an open fire. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 3–5 HD (Medium), 6–9 HD (Large), or 10–18 HD (Huge). No level adjustment listed. Speaks Ignan and can communicate with any creature that has a language.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +5 as printed. AC 15 (+1 size, +1 Dex as printed, +3 natural). Touch AC 12 and flat-footed AC 14 use those listed bonuses. Base attack +1, grapple −3. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +0, Ref +4, Will +0.
sections.Skills and feats: Listen +6, Spot +6. Blind-Fight (bonus), Improved Initiative.
sections.Traits: Damage reduction 10/magic, elemental traits, Fire and Mists subtypes, and immunity to electricity. Normally invisible, visible at will, and detectable with see invisibility. The fire it occupies stays lit until it is slain or driven out. Water Vulnerability (Ex). Magically created water deals 1d4 damage per gallon.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Fire bolt +3 ranged (1d6 damage, ignites flammables) or slam (1d4 plus 1d4 fire). Use +2 melee for the slam as a table default.
Burn (Su). A fire bolt reaches 10 ft. per HD (20 ft. for this fiend). A creature hit must make a DC 14 Reflex save or catch fire for 1d4 rounds. Use the 3.5 catching-on-fire procedure.
Transfer Flame. As a standard action, transfer to another open flame within 5 ft.
Fire Charm (Su). Someone near the flame must succeed on a DC 15 Listen check to make out its whispers, then make a DC 14 Will save or be affected as by charm person (caster level 8th). The fiend can charm only one creature at a time. It may keep trying until the target gives in or leaves.
sections.Arrival: Casting a fire-based spell in Ravenloft has a 1% chance per spell level to draw a hearth fiend into the nearest open flame.

ruleNotes: The printed initiative and Dex contribution to AC do not follow the listed Dex 16 and Improved Initiative. Use the printed totals. The slam has no printed attack bonus. The table default uses +1 base attack, +1 size, and +0 Str.

name: Hebi-no-onna
description: A serpent enchanter hides its snake arms inside wide sleeves. In its lair, cultists and vipers guard it while it casts spells.
otherStatistics: Any land (Rokushima Táiyoo and Sri Raji). Solitary or pair (mother and daughter). Always lawful evil. Standard items and double art objects. No advancement or level adjustment listed. Speaks several domain languages, commonly Rajian or Rokuma, and reptilian languages including Draconic.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +6. AC +2 Dex, touch AC 12 and flat-footed AC 10 derived from the listed bonus. Base attack +14, grapple +14. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +7, Ref +11, Will +10.
sections.Skills and feats: Appraise +12, Bluff +11, Concentration +13, Craft (alchemy) +10, Diplomacy +11, Disguise +10, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Sense Motive +10, Spellcraft +11. Combat Casting, Dodge (bonus), Improved Initiative (bonus), Mobility, Scribe Scroll (bonus), Spell Focus (Enchantment), Spell Penetration, Two-Weapon Fighting (bonus).
sections.Traits: Immunities (Su). Immune to poisons and to the gaze attacks of reptilian creatures, including other hebi-no-onna. Snake Control (Su). Any snake that can hear its commands obeys, even at the cost of its life. This does not summon snakes. A lair often holds 20–40, many of them vipers.
sections.Actions:
Attack. One snake-arm bite +14 melee (1d3 plus poison) or one human-mouth bite +9 melee (1d2 plus poison). Full attack. Two snake-arm bites +14 each, or one human-mouth bite +9.
Snake-arm poison (Ex). DC 15 Fortitude. Initial and secondary damage 1d6 Constitution each.
Daigatu (Ex, 3/day). On a human-mouth bite, DC 20 Fortitude. Initial and secondary effects each cause hallucinations and stun for 1d10 + 2 rounds. Before reaching maturity at about 12, a daughter’s bite instead deals 1d2 − 1. Her venom nauseates the target for 2d4 rounds on a failed DC 13 Fortitude save.
Hypnotic Gaze (Su). Choose a target as a standard action. DC 20 Will or hypnotism at caster level 14th. Merely looking at the hebi-no-onna does not trigger the effect.
sections.Spells: Casts as a 14th-level wizard specializing in Enchantment. Save DC 14 + spell level. Only material components with a listed gp cost are required. Preferred spells include charm monster, charm person, confusion, dominate monster, dominate person, feeblemind, geas, globe of invulnerability, hold monster, hold person, lesser globe of invulnerability, ray of enfeeblement, suggestion, and greater teleport.
sections.Tactics: Use servants to hold foes back while casting or using the gaze from behind a lesser globe of invulnerability. Use greater teleport to flee if gravely threatened.

ruleNotes: The summary lists gaze immunity broadly. The detailed rule limits it to reptilian sources. The preferred spell list contains dominate monster but the creature casts as a 14th-level wizard. Use the native wizard slot limits and leave that 9th-level spell unprepared in this encounter. The spell list is a set of preferences rather than a prepared loadout.

name: Mist Ferryman
description: This skeletal ferryman herds travelers deeper into the Mists. If subdued, it may trade passage for its freedom.
otherStatistics: Misty border and fogbanks on any land. Solitary. Always neutral evil. No treasure. Advancement 6–9 HD (Large). No level adjustment listed. Can communicate with any creature that has a language.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +7. AC +3 Dex and +4 natural, touch 13, flat-footed 14. Base attack +2, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +6.
sections.Skills and feats: Listen +8, Spot +8, Survival +11. Improved Initiative.
sections.Traits: Undead traits, +2 turn resistance, damage reduction 5/magic. Obscuring Mist (Su). When summoned within a domain, obscuring mist at caster level 12th remains centered on it. It vanishes if that mist is dispelled. Mist does not obscure the ferryman’s own vision.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +4 melee (1d6 + 2 plus ferryman’s rot). Full attack. Two claws +4 each and bite −1 melee (1d8 + 1); each hit can transmit rot.
Ferryman’s Rot (Su). Injury disease. DC 15 Fortitude, incubation 1 week, initial damage 1d4 Con. It persists until remove disease or similar magic cures it, or the victim reaches Constitution 0 and dies. An afflicted victim who dies rises as a mist ferryman after 6 rounds and retreats into the Mists.
Summoning Howl (Ex). When outmatched, call 1d8 + 1 other ferrymen. They arrive in 2d6 rounds and help until combat ends.
sections.Summoned ferryman: Someone can conjure it with summon monster VII, but it attacks the summoner. If incapacitated, it can bargain for release by taking itself and all adjacent creatures to a requested spot in Ravenloft, as with greater teleport.

ruleNotes: The special-attack summary says mist poison, while the attacks and detailed rules use ferryman’s rot. Ongoing damage is not listed separately. Use the 3.5 disease timing and the printed 1d4 Constitution damage on a failed daily save as a table default, while preserving the exception to natural recovery.

name: Shadow Fiend
description: A winged demon fights from darkness. It tries to disarm anyone carrying a lantern or torch, then charges from cover.
otherStatistics: Any land or underground. Solitary. Always chaotic evil. No treasure. Advancement 8–12 HD (Medium) or 13–20 HD (Large). Level adjustment +7. Requires no sustenance.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +6. AC 13 (+2 Dex, +1 natural), touch 13 as printed, flat-footed 11. Base attack +7, grapple +8. Space and reach 5 ft. Fort +6, Ref +7, Will +7.
sections.Skills and feats: Bluff +8, Concentration +8, Hide +8 (add +10 racial in low light or darkness), Intimidate +10, Jump +10, Listen +13, Move Silently +10, Sense Motive +7, Spot +9. Alertness, Improved Initiative.
sections.Traits:
Blindsight, damage reduction 5/silver, immunity to poison and electricity, resistance 10 to acid, cold, and fire, and tanar’ri traits. Telepathy (Su). 100 ft. with any creature that has a language.
Shadow Armor (Su). Add +4 deflection AC in dim light such as torchlight or moonlight. Add +8 instead in total darkness.
Sensitivity to Light (Ex). In bright sunlight or daylight, it takes −2 on attacks. A hit against it that threatens a critical hit automatically confirms.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Claw +8 melee (1d6 + 1). Full attack. Two claws +8 melee each (1d6 + 1), plus bite +3 melee (1d8).
Pounce (Ex). On a charge, make a full attack with four rake attacks. Each rake is +8 melee (1d6 + 1).
Spell-like abilities. Caster level 10th, save DC 12 + spell level. Darkness and cause fear at will. Magic jar once per week.

ruleNotes: The printed touch AC is 13 despite the listed +1 natural armor. Blindsight has no printed range. Set the range at the table if needed.

name: Shadow Unicorn
description: A dark-coated unicorn slips through shadowed woodland, then breaks cover with a flaming horn and a scream.
otherStatistics: Temperate forests of Darkon, Falkovnia, and the Phantasmal Forest. Solitary or pair. Always neutral evil. No treasure. Advancement 6–10 HD (Large). No level adjustment listed. Speaks Sylvan, Infernal, and Abyssal.

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +8 as printed. AC −1 size, +4 Dex, +8 natural, touch 13, flat-footed 17. Base attack +5, grapple +17. Space 10 ft., reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. with the horn. Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +3.
sections.Skills and feats: Hide +6, Jump +6, Listen +5, Move Silently +10, Spot +6, Survival +7. Alertness, Multiattack.
sections.Traits: Damage reduction 5/magic. Immune to charm-related spells, poisons, and the fire from its own horn. Shadow Merge (Su). In shadowy areas, gain total concealment and move without sound. It can suppress the effect.
sections.Actions:
Attack or full attack. Horn +13 melee (1d8 + 12, plus 1d4 fire when aflame). As an alternative full attack, make two hoof attacks +13 melee each (1d4 + 4), and one bite +11 melee (1d8 + 4).
Flaming Horn (Su). Ignite the horn as a free action. A hit with it adds 1d4 fire damage and ignites combustibles.
Blink (Sp, 3/day). Caster level 8th. Use only in shadowy areas.
Terror Scream (Su). Functions as fear at caster level 8th, DC 20. A failed Ravenloft Fear save that produces a major effect also permanently turns the victim’s hair white.
sections.Ravenloft Fear: When using the Ravenloft Fear rules, roll a Will save. Apply modifiers to saves against fear. Failure by 1–5 makes the target shaken, 6–10 frightened, and 11–15 panicked. Failure by 16 or more makes it panicked and calls for an immediate Horror save at the Fear DC minus 5. Fear lasts 5d6 rounds. A second failure escalates shaken to frightened or frightened to panicked. Creatures without Intelligence scores are immune. See Ravenloft Player’s Handbook, pp. 77–79.

ruleNotes: Initiative +8 and 45 hp are printed values. The initiative includes an unexplained +4 above the Dex modifier.

name: Bloodroot
description: Red-tipped roots hang from a cavern wall or ceiling. They stay still until prey passes within reach.
otherStatistics: Underground. Solitary. Always neutral. Standard treasure. Advancement 5–8 HD (Large), 9–12 HD (Huge).

sections.Combat statistics: Initiative +0. AC includes +5 natural, touch 10, flat-footed 15. Base attack +3, grapple +4. Space and reach 5 ft. each. Fort +5, Ref +1, Will +1.
sections.Traits:
Plant traits and vulnerability to fire.
Blindsight (Ex). Detect creatures within 10 ft. by scent, sound, and vibration.
Camouflage (Ex). Before it strikes, notice it with a DC 20 Spot check. Dwarves with stonecunning and anyone with Survival or Knowledge (plants or herbs) can use the relevant ability or skill instead.
sections.Actions:
Attack. Slam +4 melee (1d4 + 1) or gore +4 melee (1d6 + 1 plus poison).
Full attack. Two slams +4 or one gore +4. It has one attacking root per HD, and at most four roots can attack the same creature at once.
Improved Grab (Ex). After a slam hits, attempt a grapple. On a successful grab, use a second root to gore the held creature each round until it dies.
Poison (Ex). A gore hit exposes the target to poison, Fort DC 13. Initial damage 1d4 Con, secondary damage 1d3 Wis. Harvest the sap of a slain but intact bloodroot to obtain one dose of the weaker bloodroot poison from the Dungeon Master’s Guide.

name: Crawling Ivy
