In its lair, the death tyrant is CR 15 (13,000 XP). Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. No lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the first turn if surprised.
Spectral Obstruction. Choose a 50-ft. cube within 120 ft. Spectral eyes and tentacles make it Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain for creatures other than the tyrant until initiative count 20 next round.
Spectral Grasp. Walls sprout spectral limbs until initiative count 20 on the round after next. A hostile creature, even on the Ethereal Plane, that starts its turn within 10 ft. of a wall makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or becomes Grappled. Escape with a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Spectral Eye. An eye appears in the air at a point within 50 ft. and fires one random eye ray at a target the tyrant chooses. The ray comes from an ethereal source. The eye then disappears.
Use all three effects before repeating one, and never repeat on consecutive rounds.
sections.Regional effects:
Creatures within 1 mile of the lair sometimes feel watched. Whenever a creature that knows about the tyrant and is hostile to it finishes a Long Rest within 1 mile, roll a d20 for that creature. On a 10 or lower it is subjected to one random eye ray.
After the tyrant dies, these effects fade over 1d10 days.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 27–29.

ruleNotes: In Charm Ray, the book says “beholder” once in the death tyrant’s rules. Treat that reference as the death tyrant.

name: Death Knight
description: A fallen paladin commands undead retainers and can return after its destruction.

sections.Defenses and senses: Plate and shield. Immune to necrotic and poison damage and to Exhaustion, Frightened and Poisoned. Darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13. Abyssal and Common.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Marshal Undead. Unless the knight is Incapacitated, it and Undead it chooses within 60 ft. have advantage on saves against effects that turn Undead.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep. The 2014 edition errata adds this rule.
Immortal Until Redeemed. A destroyed death knight can rise again. Atonement or redemption can end that cycle. The book leaves when and how it returns to the DM.
sections.Spellcasting:
19th-level spellcaster. Charisma, save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks. Its prepared paladin spells are listed below. It cannot use its magic to heal.
1st level (4 slots). Command, Compelled Duel, Searing Smite.
2nd level (3 slots). Hold Person, Magic Weapon.
3rd level (3 slots). Dispel Magic, Elemental Weapon.
4th level (3 slots). Banishment, Staggering Smite.
5th level (2 slots). Destructive Wave (necrotic).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing with two hands. Either hit also deals 18 (4d8) necrotic damage.
Hellfire Orb (1/day). Pick a point it can see within 120 ft. The blast fills a 20-ft.-radius sphere, spreading around corners. Each creature in the sphere makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 35 (10d6) fire and 35 (10d6) necrotic damage. Success halves both.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Against one melee attack that would hit, add 6 to AC against that attack. It must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 47.

name: Demilich
description: A levitating skull guards the tomb where a lich’s remaining power and phylactery lie.

sections.Defenses and senses: Natural armor. Resists bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from magic weapons. Immune to necrotic, poison and psychic damage and to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks (per the 2014 edition errata). Immune to Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone and Stunned. Truesight 120 ft., passive Perception 13. No languages listed.
sections.Traits:
Avoidance. If a saving throw would normally halve damage on a success, the demilich takes none on a success and half on a failure.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Turn a failed saving throw into a success.
Turn Immunity. Immune to effects that turn Undead.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink or sleep. Its HP use the maximum result of its Hit Dice.
Enduring Existence. An intact phylactery restores the destroyed skull in 1d10 days. A demilich that still has the will to feed a soul to its phylactery can return to lich form by doing so.
sections.Actions:
Howl (Recharge 5–6). Every creature within 30 ft. that can hear the howl makes a DC 15 Constitution save. Failure drops it to 0 HP. Success leaves it Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Life Drain. Choose up to three visible creatures within 10 ft. Each makes a DC 19 Constitution save or takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. The demilich heals HP equal to the total damage dealt.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions. Spend one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Regain spent actions at the start of this creature’s turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before its first turn if surprised.
Flight (1 action). Fly up to half its flying speed.
Cloud of Dust (1 action). Each creature within 10 ft., even around a corner, makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Blinded until the end of the demilich’s next turn. On a success that creature is immune to this effect until the end of the demilich’s next turn.
Energy Drain (2 actions). Every creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Constitution save. On a failure, reduce maximum HP by 10 (3d6). A target dies if its maximum falls to 0. Greater Restoration or similar magic can restore the lost maximum.
Vile Curse (3 actions). One visible creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. On failure it is magically cursed and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saves. It repeats the save at the end of each turn and ends the curse on success.
sections.Lair actions:
In its lair, the demilich is CR 20 (24,500 XP). Act on initiative count 20, losing ties. No lair action while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act, or before the first turn if surprised. Roll a d20. On 11 or higher, choose an effect. Never repeat the same effect on consecutive rounds.
Tremor. Each creature on the tomb floor makes a DC 19 Dexterity save or falls Prone.
Antimagic. Choose one visible creature within 60 ft. Antimagic Field fills its space and moves with it until initiative count 20 next round.
Seal Healing. Choose any number of visible creatures within 30 ft. They cannot regain HP until initiative count 20 next round.
sections.Lair traits:
Use any of these optional tomb traits. A non-evil creature takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage the first time it enters. Monsters in the tomb have advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened and turning. A ward prevents unauthorized creatures from using teleportation or planar travel to enter or leave, but allows such movement entirely within the tomb.
After the demilich is destroyed, these effects fade over 10 days.
sections.Variant. Acererak and his disciples:
Use the base stat block and add Trap Soul. CR 21 (33,000 XP), or CR 23 (50,000 XP) in the lair.
Trap Soul. Choose one creature the demilich can see within 30 ft. DC 19 Charisma save. Failure traps its soul in a gem, causing its body and gear to cease to exist. On a success it takes 24 (7d6) necrotic damage, and if that leaves it at 0 HP, trap its soul as on failure. After 24 hours in a gem, the soul is devoured and ceases to exist. At 0 HP this demilich is destroyed, leaving the gems behind. Crush a gem to free the soul still inside. Its body re-forms in the nearest unoccupied space, in the state it was in when trapped.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 48–49.

ruleNotes: The lair introduction mentions extra uses for legendary actions, but this printing does not specify a different action budget. The stat block gives three each round.

name: Mind Flayer
description: Illithids rule Underdark colonies through telepathy and thralls. A mind flayer lets its thralls engage strong foes while it looks for an escape or an isolated target.

sections.Skills: Arcana +7, Deception +6, Insight +6, Perception +6, Persuasion +6, Stealth +4.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The mind flayer has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Psionics use Intelligence (spell save DC 15) and require no components.
At will: detect thoughts, levitate.
1/day each: dominate monster, plane shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the creature is Medium or smaller, it is Grappled (escape DC 15) and makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. On failure it is Stunned until this grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Incapacitated humanoid grappled by the mind flayer. Hit 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If the damage reduces it to 0 HP, the mind flayer extracts its brain and kills it.
Mind Blast (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Intelligence save against the magical blast. On failure it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and is Stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 221–222.

name: Mind Flayer Arcanist
description: This illithid adds wizard training to its psionics. Other mind flayers shun the practice.

sections.Skills: Arcana +7, Deception +6, Insight +6, Perception +6, Persuasion +6, Stealth +4.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The mind flayer has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Psionics use Intelligence (spell save DC 15) and require no components.
At will: detect thoughts, levitate.
1/day each: dominate monster, plane shift (self only).
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. If the creature is Medium or smaller, it is Grappled (escape DC 15) and makes a DC 15 Intelligence save. On failure it is Stunned until this grapple ends.
Extract Brain. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Incapacitated humanoid grappled by the mind flayer. Hit 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If the damage reduces it to 0 HP, the mind flayer extracts its brain and kills it.
Mind Blast (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 15 Intelligence save against the magical blast. On failure it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) psychic damage and is Stunned for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
The arcanist is a 10th-level wizard spellcaster. It uses Intelligence (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips at will: blade ward, dancing lights, mage hand, shocking grasp.
1st level, 4 slots: detect magic, disguise self, shield, sleep.
2nd level, 3 slots: blur, invisibility, ray of enfeeblement.
3rd level, 3 slots: clairvoyance, lightning bolt, sending.
4th level, 3 slots: confusion, hallucinatory terrain.
5th level, 2 slots: telekinesis, wall of force.
sections.Variant: Uses the Mind Flayer base profile, including Magic Resistance, innate psionics, and all three actions. The printed variant adds prepared wizard spells and changes the challenge to 8 (3,900 XP).
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 222.

name: Intellect Devourer
description: A brain on clawed legs stalks the Underdark. It can steal a host, use its memories, and lure others to mind flayers.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 12.
sections.Languages: Understands Deep Speech. Cannot speak. Telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Traits: Detect Sentience. Senses the presence and location of creatures within 300 ft. that have Intelligence 3 or higher. Barriers do not block this sense. Mind blank protects a creature from it.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and use Devour Intellect.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage.
Devour Intellect. One visible creature within 10 ft. that has a brain makes a DC 12 Intelligence save against this magic. On failure it takes 11 (2d10) psychic damage. Also roll 3d6 on that failure. If the roll meets or exceeds the target's Intelligence score, reduce the score to 0. The creature is Stunned until it regains at least 1 Intelligence.
Body Thief. Make a contested Intelligence check against an Incapacitated humanoid within 5 ft. that lacks protection from evil and good. If the devourer wins, it magically consumes the humanoid's brain, teleports into its skull, and controls its body.
While inside, the devourer has Total Cover against attacks and other effects from outside the host. It keeps its Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, traits, understanding of Deep Speech, and telepathy. It takes the host's other statistics and knows everything the host knew, including languages and spells.
Body Thief ends when the host dies, protection from evil and good is cast on the body, or wish restores the brain. The devourer can leave voluntarily by spending 5 ft. of movement to teleport to the nearest empty space within 5 ft. If it leaves and the brain is not restored within 1 round, the body dies.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 191.

ruleNotes: Body Thief includes the 2015 Monster Manual errata for the 2014 rules. The errata bars protected targets and uses the host's death to force departure. The early printing triggers departure at 0 HP.

name: Carrion Crawler
description: This scavenger patrols sewers, caves, and ruins. It can drop from a ceiling to paralyze prey and drag it away.

sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks based on smell.
Spider Climb. Climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Tentacles attack and one Bite attack.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) poison damage. The creature makes a DC 13 Constitution save. On failure it is Poisoned for 1 minute and Paralyzed while that poison lasts. Repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 37.

name: Grell
description: A grell floats over dungeon passages and seizes prey from above. It can hover with a victim held in its tentacles.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft., blind beyond that range. Passive Perception 14.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Tentacles attack and one Beak attack.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage. On a failed DC 11 Constitution save, the creature is Poisoned for 1 minute and Paralyzed while the poison lasts. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the poison on a success.
A Tentacles hit also Grapples the creature (escape DC 15). If the creature is Medium or smaller, it is Restrained until the grapple ends and moves with the grell when the grell moves. During this grapple the grell has advantage on attack rolls against its captive and cannot use Tentacles against anyone else.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 172.

name: Displacer Beast
description: A six-legged hunter appears several feet from where it stands. A pack can lure pursuers into a second ambush.

sections.Traits:
Avoidance. If an effect allows a save for half damage, the displacer beast takes no damage on a success and half damage on a failure.
Displacement. Its magical image makes attack rolls against it have disadvantage. A hit suppresses the image until the end of its next turn. The image is also suppressed while the displacer beast is Incapacitated or its speed is 0.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Tentacle attacks.
Tentacle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 81.

name: Umber Hulk
description: An umber hulk waits behind stone and senses movement through the ground. It bursts into a passage and catches startled prey with its gaze.

sections.Senses: Darkvision 120 ft., Tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 10.
sections.Traits:
Confusing Gaze. Unless Incapacitated, the umber hulk can force a DC 15 Charisma save when a creature starts its turn within 30 ft. and can see its eyes. On failure the creature has no reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine its current turn.
1–4: do nothing. 5–6: take no action and use all movement to move in a random direction. 7–8: make one melee attack against a random creature within reach, or do nothing if no creature is within reach.
Unless Surprised, the creature can avert its eyes at the start of its turn to skip the save. It cannot see the umber hulk until the start of its next turn. If it looks sooner, it makes the save immediately.
Tunneler. Burrow through solid rock at half burrow speed, leaving a tunnel 5 ft. wide and 8 ft. high.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Mandibles attack.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.
Mandibles. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 292.

name: Gelatinous Cube
description: A nearly clear ooze creeps through dungeon corridors, digesting creatures while their belongings drift inside it.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 8.
sections.Traits:
Ooze Cube. The cube fills its entire space. A creature that enters it is subject to Engulf and rolls the save with disadvantage. Creatures inside are visible and have total cover. A creature within 5 ft. can spend an action to pull a creature or object out. The creature attempting the rescue takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and needs a DC 12 Strength check to succeed. The cube holds one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures at a time.
Transparent. A cube that has neither moved nor attacked takes a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice even in plain sight. A creature that tries to enter its space without noticing it is surprised by the cube.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Engulf. The cube moves up to its speed and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On success, the creature may be pushed 5 ft. back or to the side of the cube. Declining the push counts as a failed save. On failure, the cube enters its space, deals 10 (3d6) acid damage, and engulfs it. The victim is Restrained, cannot breathe, and moves with the cube. It takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. It can use an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On success it moves into a space it chooses within 5 ft. of the cube.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 242.

name: Rust Monster
description: An armored scavenger follows the scent of iron and steel. Loose metal can draw it away from the party.

sections.Traits:
Iron Scent. It can locate ferrous metal by smell within 30 ft.
Rust Metal. A hit with a nonmagical metal weapon deals its damage before the weapon takes a permanent, cumulative −1 to damage rolls. The weapon breaks at −5. Nonmagical metal ammunition is destroyed immediately after dealing damage.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
Antennae. Touch one visible nonmagical ferrous metal object within 5 ft. If unattended, a 1-ft. cube of the object is destroyed. A creature wearing or carrying it can avoid contact with a DC 11 Dexterity save. Touched armor and shields take a permanent, cumulative −1 to the AC they provide. Armor breaks when reduced to AC 10 and a shield breaks when its bonus reaches +0. A held metal weapon corrodes as in Rust Metal.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 262.

name: Hook Horror
description: Underdark hunting packs scale cavern walls and signal to one another by clacking their hooks against stone.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 13.
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. Being Deafened shuts off its blindsight.
Keen Hearing. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks.
Hook. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 189.

name: Helmed Horror
description: An empty suit of plate follows the purpose behind its creator's orders. In battle it flies to reach weaker opponents and spellcasters.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons unless they are adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 14.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Spell Immunity. The creator chooses three spells to which the construct is immune. Fireball, heat metal, and lightning bolt are typical choices.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage with one hand or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage with two.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 183.

name: Galeb Duhr
speed: 15 ft., 30 ft. when rolling, 60 ft. when rolling downhill
description: A living boulder keeps watch over isolated rocky sites. It can set nearby stones rolling against intruders.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.
sections.Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary boulder.
Rolling Charge. After rolling at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Slam hit against it on the same turn deals an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way also makes a DC 16 Strength save or falls Prone.
Stone Guardian. It does not age or need sustenance. When it dies, it remains bound to the Material Plane.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Animate Boulders (1/day). Choose up to two visible boulders within 60 ft. Each uses the galeb duhr's statistics with Intelligence and Charisma 1. The boulders cannot be Charmed or Frightened, and they cannot use Animate Boulders. They stay animated while the galeb duhr maintains Concentration as on a spell, up to 1 minute.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 139.

name: Crawling Claw
description: Dark magic leaves a severed hand free to crawl and strike. It follows simple commands and can feel for a key or doorknob.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 10.
sections.Traits:
Turn Immunity. Effects that turn undead do not affect the claw.
Creator's Control. Spells that control undead do not control the claw. Its creator can concentrate on it while it is in sight to direct its actions mentally. Without new directions it keeps following its last command. It can follow simple orders but cannot track and single out a specified person.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Living Claw. If the creature whose hand was animated still lives, the claw can rejoin that creature's arm. On separating again, the creature falls into a coma. Destroying the detached claw kills that creature. Killing the creature has no effect on the claw.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning or slashing damage, chosen by the claw.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 44.

name: Scarecrow
description: A bound spirit keeps vigil in a straw body, holding still until an intruder comes close enough to see its face.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary scarecrow.
Construct Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. A creature hit must also make a DC 11 Wisdom save or become Frightened through the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
Terrifying Glare. Choose one creature the scarecrow can see within 30 ft. If the creature can also see the scarecrow, it makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On failure it is magically Frightened through the end of the scarecrow's next turn and Paralyzed while Frightened by this glare.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 268.

name: Arcanaloth
description: A jackal-headed scholar and mercenary that trades its services for secrets or powerful magic items.

sections.Defenses: Resists cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to acid, poison damage, Charmed, and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks count as magical.
Back to Gehenna. When killed away from its home plane, it dissolves into ichor and reforms in Gehenna at full strength.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 15. These spells require no material components.
At will. Alter Self, Darkness, Heat Metal, Invisibility (self only), Magic Missile.
sections.Spellcasting:
16th-level wizard spellcaster. Intelligence, save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks.
Cantrips (at will). Fire Bolt, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.

sections.Actions:
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage. The target also makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 311, 313.

name: Barlgura
description: An ape-shaped demon that hunts dangerous prey in packs and hangs trophies around its territory.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15.
sections.Defenses: Resists cold, fire, and lightning. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Reckless. At the start of its turn it may gain advantage on melee weapon attacks for that turn. Attack rolls against it then have advantage until its next turn starts.
Running Leap. With a running start it can long jump up to 40 ft. and high jump up to 20 ft.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Wisdom, save DC 13. These spells require no material components.
2/day each. Disguise Self, Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Entangle, Phantasmal Force.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Fist attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 9 (1d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Optional summoning: Summon Demon (1/day). Attempt to summon one barlgura with a 30 percent chance of success. It appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., serves as an ally, and cannot summon more demons. It remains for 1 minute, until either demon dies, or until the summoner dismisses it as an action.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 54, 56.

ruleNotes: The 2015 errata raised its walking and climbing speeds from 30 ft. to 40 ft. each.

name: Chasme
description: A fly-shaped demon that hunts down deserters. Its drone can leave prey unconscious before it lands.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15.
sections.Defenses: Resists cold, fire, and lightning. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Drone. Each nondemon starting its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Constitution save or falls Unconscious for 10 minutes. A creature unable to hear the drone succeeds automatically. Damage ends this effect, as does another creature using an action to splash the target with holy water. A creature that saves or recovers is immune to the drone for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Proboscis. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing and 24 (7d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target’s maximum HP by the necrotic damage it took. It dies if this reduces its maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until it finishes a long rest or receives a spell such as Greater Restoration.
sections.Optional summoning: Summon Demon (1/day). Attempt to summon one chasme with a 30 percent chance of success. It appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., serves as an ally, and cannot summon more demons. It remains for 1 minute, until either demon dies, or until the summoner dismisses it as an action.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 54, 57.

name: Manes
description: A soul warped by the Abyss into a shambling demon. Manes swarm intruders and attack other creatures whenever they can.

sections.Defenses: Resists cold, fire, and lightning. Immune to poison damage, Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned.
sections.Traits: Reformation. The encounter lore says a slain manes dissolves into foul vapor and reforms after one day. Demon lords that consume one destroy it.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (2d4) slashing damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 53, 60.

name: Shadow Demon
description: A demon whose essence took shape as a shadow after it was denied a new body in the Abyss. It hunts from dark cover.

sections.Defenses: Vulnerable to radiant damage. Resists acid, fire, necrotic, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to cold, lightning, poison damage, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, and Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. It can pass through objects and creatures as difficult terrain. If it ends its turn inside an object, it takes 5 (1d10) force damage.
Light Sensitivity. While in bright light it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
Shadowy Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. While in dim light or darkness, it can take the Hide action as a bonus action.
sections.Actions: Claws. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) psychic damage, or 17 (4d6 + 3) psychic damage if the attack roll had advantage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 54, 64.

name: Spined Devil
description: A small horned devil that flies ahead of infernal forces to scout and harass their enemies.

sections.Defenses: Resists cold and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren’t silvered. Immune to fire, poison damage, and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Devil’s Sight. Its darkvision works in magical darkness.
Flyby. Flying out of a foe’s reach doesn’t provoke an opportunity attack.
Limited Spines. It has twelve tail spines. Spines spent on attacks regrow by the end of a long rest.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Fork attack, or make two Tail Spine attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (2d4) slashing damage.

Tail Spine. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 20/80 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 78.

name: Yochlol
description: A handmaiden of Lolth that can approach as a drow or giant spider. Its true form is a column of yellow slime with one eye.

sections.Defenses: Resists cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks. Immune to poison damage and Poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action it can become a female drow, a giant spider, or return to its demon form. It keeps the same statistics and its gear keeps its shape. It returns to its true form on death.
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
Web Walker. Webbing doesn’t restrict its movement.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma, save DC 14. These spells require no material components.
At will. Detect Thoughts, Web.
1/day. Dominate Person.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Slam (Bite in spider form). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or 10 ft. in demon form, one target. Hit 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, or piercing in spider form, plus 21 (6d6) poison damage.
Mist Form. It and its gear become toxic mist until it returns to its true form. It reverts on death. In mist form it is Incapacitated and cannot speak. It can hover, fly 30 ft., and pass through any gap that isn’t airtight. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves and is immune to nonmagical damage. It can enter and stop in a creature’s space. Each time that creature starts its turn sharing the space, it makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Poisoned until its next turn starts. It remains Incapacitated while Poisoned in this way.
sections.Optional summoning: Summon Demon (1/day). Attempt to summon one yochlol with a 50 percent chance of success. It appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft., serves as an ally, and cannot summon more demons. It remains for 1 minute, until either demon dies, or until the summoner dismisses it as an action.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 54, 65.

name: Marid
description: A powerful water genie that expects mortals to recognize its rank.

sections.Defenses: Resists acid, cold, and lightning.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 13.
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It breathes air and water.
Elemental Demise. When it dies, it bursts into water and foam, leaving its worn and carried equipment.
sections.Innate spellcasting:
Charisma. Spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks. It casts without material components.
At will. Create or Destroy Water, Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Purify Food and Drink.
3/day each. Tongues, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day each. Conjure Elemental (water elemental only), Control Water, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Plane Shift.

Water Jet. Each creature in a 60-ft. line, 5 ft. wide, makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. Failure deals 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and pushes a Huge or smaller target up to 20 ft. away from the marid and knocks it Prone. Success halves the damage and prevents the push and knockdown.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 146.

name: Mezzoloth
description: The foot soldier of yugoloth armies, armed with a trident and protected by a thick chitinous shell.

sections.Defenses: Resists cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to acid and poison damage. Immune to the Poisoned condition.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 13.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Back to Gehenna. If it dies elsewhere, its body dissolves into ichor. It reforms at full strength on Gehenna, where it can be killed permanently.

2/day each. Darkness and Dispel Magic.

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 313. Back to Gehenna, p. 312.

name: Nycaloth
description: A winged mercenary that strikes at close range, then teleports out of reach.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14.

description: A yugoloth commander whose luminous eyes can freeze a foe in place.

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 314. Back to Gehenna, p. 312.

name: Fomorian
description: A giant of the Underdark that can pass on the fey curse that twisted its own body.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Greatclub attacks, or one Greatclub attack and one Evil Eye.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit 19 (3d8 + 6) bludgeoning.
Evil Eye. One visible creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 14 Charisma save against magic. Failure deals 27 (6d8) psychic damage. Success halves the damage.
Curse of the Evil Eye (recharges after a short or long rest). Use Evil Eye. On a failed save, the creature also becomes Cursed with magical deformities. Its speed is halved, and it has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity ability checks, saves, and attack rolls. It can repeat the save after finishing a long rest, ending the curse on a success.

name: Flumph
description: A floating Underdark creature that feeds on psionic energy and shares what it learns with allies.

sections.Defenses: Vulnerable to psychic damage.
sections.Languages: Understands Undercommon without speaking. Telepathy 60 ft.
sections.Traits:
Advanced Telepathy. It can perceive the content of any telepathic communication within 60 ft. Creatures with any form of telepathy cannot surprise it.
Prone Deficiency. When knocked Prone, roll a die. On an odd result it lands upside down and becomes Incapacitated. At the end of each turn it can attempt a DC 10 Dexterity save to right itself and end the incapacitation.
Telepathic Shroud. It is immune to divination spells and effects that sense its emotions or read its thoughts.
sections.Actions:
Tendrils. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing plus 2 (1d4) acid. At the end of each of its turns, the creature must make a DC 10 Constitution save. It takes 2 (1d4) acid on a failure. Success or Lesser Restoration ends the recurring damage.
Stench Spray (1/day). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a DC 10 Dexterity save. Failure coats the creature in a liquid that stinks for 1d4 hours. The coated creature is Poisoned for the duration. Other creatures are Poisoned while within 5 ft. of it. A creature can remove the stench from itself by spending a short rest bathing in water, alcohol, or vinegar.

name: Water Weird
description: An elemental guardian bound to a pool or fountain, invisible until it breaks the surface.

sections.Defenses: Resists fire and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons. Immune to poison damage and to Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, Prone, and Unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Invisible in Water. It is Invisible while fully immersed in water.
Water Bound. It dies if it leaves its bound water or that water is destroyed.
Elemental Nature. It does not need air, food, drink, or sleep. A weird turned evil by fouled water loses that alignment if the water is cleansed with Purify Food and Drink.
sections.Actions: Constrict. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning. A Medium or smaller target is also Grappled (escape DC 13) and pulled 5 ft. toward the weird. While that grapple lasts the target is Restrained, the weird tries to drown it, and the weird cannot constrict anyone else.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 299.

name: Monodrone
description: A winged Mechanus worker that can perform one simple task at a time and relay a message of at most 48 words.

sections.Traits:
Axiomatic Mind. No effect can compel the modron to go against its nature or instructions.
Disintegration. At death, the modron crumbles into dust. Its weapons and other possessions remain.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.
Javelin. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +2 to hit, 5-ft. reach or 30/120-ft. range, one target. Hit 3 (1d6) piercing damage.

sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), p. 226.

name: Myconid Adult
description: An Underdark fungus that lives in a myconid circle. These creatures usually welcome peaceful visitors.

sections.Traits:
Distress Spores. When the myconid takes damage, other myconids within 240 ft. sense its pain.
Sun Sickness. Sunlight gives it disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls, and saves. More than 1 hour in direct sunlight kills it.
sections.Actions:

name: Myconid Sovereign
description: The largest myconid in a colony leads its circles and can animate corpses as spore servants.

sections.Languages: None. Rapport Spores allow telepathic communication.
sections.Traits:
Distress Spores. When the myconid takes damage, other myconids within 240 ft. sense its pain.

sections.Spore servant template:
Use the template for a Large or smaller creature that once had flesh and blood. Keep its AC, HP, Hit Dice, Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, vulnerabilities, resistances, and immunities. Its type becomes Plant, its tags fall away, and its alignment becomes unaligned. Reduce each speed by 10 ft., to a minimum of 5 ft. Set Intelligence to 2, Wisdom to 6, and Charisma to 1.
Remove the creature's original saving throw and skill bonuses, special senses, traits, and languages. Give it blindsight 30 ft., with blindness beyond that range, and immunity to Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, and Paralyzed. It takes orders through a myconid's Rapport Spores and prioritizes orders from the most powerful myconid.
Keep Multiattack and melee weapon attacks that deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. Drop any other damage types unless they come from equipment. If the servant cannot otherwise deal damage, it can make an unarmed strike for 1d4 + its Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, or 2d4 + its Strength modifier if Large.
