Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, the inventor has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Weapon Invention. Choose an option or roll 1d8. Each option can be used at most once per day.
1. Acid. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d6) acid damage.
2. Alchemist’s Fire. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. On a hit, the target takes 2 (1d4) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it spends an action and succeeds on a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
3. Basket of Centipedes. Throw the basket into a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Centipedes emerges with 11 hit points and rolls initiative. It has a 50 percent chance to disperse at the end of each of its turns.
4. Green Slime Pot. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 5/20 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d10) acid damage and coats the target in slime, which deals 5 (1d10) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can use an action to scrape or wash the slime away.
5. Rot Grub Pot. Break the pot in a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Rot Grubs emerges and remains a hazard in that space.
6. Scorpion on a Stick. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 piercing damage. The target then makes a DC 9 Constitution save and takes 4 (1d8) poison damage on a failure or half on a success.
7. Skunk in a Cage. Release a skunk in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, a walking speed of 20 ft., and no effective attacks. It rolls initiative and on its turn uses its action to spray a random creature within 5 ft. The creature must pass a DC 9 Constitution save or be incapacitated by retching for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that does not need to breathe or is immune to poison succeeds automatically. The skunk must finish a short or long rest before spraying again.
8. Wasp Nest in a Bag. Throw the bag into a 5-ft. square within 20 ft. A Swarm of Wasps emerges with 11 hit points and rolls initiative. It has a 50 percent chance to disperse at the end of each of its turns.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 164.

name: Kobold Scale Sorcerer
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A kobold spellcaster who advises its community. Those who speak for a dragon sometimes wear artificial wings as a sign of office.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kobold has advantage on attacks against a creature when at least one ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Sunlight Sensitivity. While in sunlight, the kobold has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Dagger or Chromatic Bolt for each. The kobold can replace one attack with Spellcasting.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Chromatic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) damage. The kobold chooses acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12), without material components.
At will. Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Charm Person, Fog Cloud, Levitate.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 165.

name: Korred
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A secretive fey that can tunnel through rock and bind intruders with rope made from its own hair.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Stone Camouflage. The korred has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide in rocky terrain.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Greatclub or Rock for each.
Greatclub. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
Rock. Ranged weapon attack, +9 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage, or 19 (3d8 + 6) if the korred is on the ground.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 13), without any components.
At will. Commune with Nature, Meld into Stone, Stone Shape. Commune with Nature takes an action for the korred.
1/day. Otto's Irresistible Dance.
sections.Bonus actions:
Command Hair. The korred has at least one 50-ft. rope woven from its hair. Choose one such rope within 30 ft. and command it to move up to 20 ft. and entangle a visible Large or smaller creature. Unless the creature succeeds on a DC 13 Dexterity save, the rope grapples it (escape DC 13). It is restrained for as long as the grapple lasts. The korred can release it as a bonus action. The grapple also ends if the korred dies or becomes incapacitated.
Hair rope. The rope has AC 20 and 20 hit points. At the start of each of the korred's turns, the rope regains 1 hit point if it still has at least 1 hit point and the korred is alive. The rope is destroyed at 0 hit points.
sections.Magical hair: When cut, hair from a korred's head turns into the material of the cutting tool. A korred uses iron shears to make strands it can weave into iron ropes.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 166.

name: Kraken Priest
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A kraken grants this devotee power and changes its appearance. The kraken can speak through the priest.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The priest can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Thunderous Touch or Thunderbolt for each.
Thunderous Touch. Melee spell attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (5d10) thunder damage.
Thunderbolt. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d10) lightning damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage and knocks the target prone.
Voice of the Kraken (recharges after a short or long rest). The kraken speaks through the priest in Abyssal, Infernal, or Primordial, and its voice carries 300 ft. Each creature the priest chooses that can hear the words must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or be frightened of the priest for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Wisdom (spell save DC 13), without material components.
At will. Command, Create or Destroy Water.
3/day each. Control Water, Darkness, Water Breathing, Water Walk.
1/day. Evard's Black Tentacles.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 167.

name: Kruthik Hive Lord
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An armored burrower that hunts alongside its hive. Kruthiks nest near heat sources such as forges and lava.

sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The kruthik has advantage on attacks against a creature when at least one ally is within 5 ft. of that creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
Tunneler. The kruthik burrows through solid rock at half its burrowing speed and leaves a tunnel 10 ft. in diameter.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Stab or Spike for each.
Stab. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.
Spike. Ranged weapon attack, +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Acid Spray (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 15-ft. cone must make a DC 14 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 169.

name: Leucrotta
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A foul-smelling predator that leaves deerlike tracks and mimics voices to draw prey close. It often hunts alongside gnolls.

sections.Traits:
Mimicry. The leucrotta can imitate Beast sounds and Humanoid voices. A listener can identify the imitation with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
Stench. Each creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the leucrotta must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. This trait exempts leucrottas and gnolls. A successful save makes the creature immune to the Stench of all leucrottas for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Hooves attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage. On a critical hit, roll the bite's damage dice three times.
Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Kicking Retreat. Take the Disengage action immediately after making a Hooves attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 170.

name: Leviathan
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A vast serpent formed from water. It can drag ships under or flood a settlement along the coast.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a saving throw, the leviathan can choose to succeed.
Partial Freeze. If the leviathan takes at least 50 cold damage during one turn, both of its speeds drop to 20 ft. and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
Siege Monster. The leviathan deals double damage to objects and structures.
Water Form. The leviathan can enter and stop in a hostile creature's space. It can pass through openings at least 1 inch wide without squeezing.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Slam attack and one Tail attack.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (2d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) acid damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (2d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Tidal Wave (recharge 6). Magically send a wave out from a visible point within 120 ft. The wave can reach up to 250 ft. long, 250 ft. tall, and 50 ft. wide. Each creature in it makes a DC 24 Strength save. It takes 45 (7d12) bludgeoning damage and falls prone on a failure. A success halves the damage and avoids falling prone. Water spreads along the ground in all directions, extinguishes unprotected flames in the wave's area and within 250 ft. of that area, and vanishes.
sections.Legendary actions:
The leviathan has 3 legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It can use one option at the end of another creature's turn. It needs to be able to act and, if surprised, can spend them only after its first turn ends.
Move (costs 1 action). Move up to the leviathan's speed.
Slam (costs 2 actions). Make one Slam attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 171.

name: Lonely Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Shadowfell creature that draws others close on the ends of its harpoon arms.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Traits:
Psychic Leech. At the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, every creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Thrives on Company. The sorrowsworn has advantage on attack rolls when at least two other creatures are within 30 ft. It has disadvantage on attack rolls at all other times.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Harpoon Arm attack and use Sorrowful Embrace.
Harpoon Arm. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage and grapples the target if it is a Large or smaller creature (escape DC 15). The sorrowsworn has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.
Sorrowful Embrace. Each creature the sorrowsworn is grappling makes a DC 15 Wisdom save, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Regardless of the save, pull each of those creatures up to 30 ft. directly toward the sorrowsworn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 223.

name: Lost Sorrowsworn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Shadowfell creature that seizes travelers in its spiked arms and tightens its grip when injured.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Arm Spike attacks.
Arm Spike. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.
Embrace (recharge 4–6). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage and grapples a Medium or smaller creature (escape DC 14). The sorrowsworn can grapple only one creature at a time. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened and takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns.
sections.Reactions: Tightening Embrace. When the sorrowsworn takes damage, the creature it is grappling with Embrace takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 224.

name: Male Steeder
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An Underdark hunting spider that duergar often train to pull loads. Sticky secretions on its legs hold prey and grip stone.

sections.Traits:
Extraordinary Leap. A long jump covers 3 ft. for each foot of walking speed the steeder spends on it.
Spider Climb. The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.
Sticky Leg. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. On a hit, the creature sticks to the steeder's leg and is grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can hold one creature in this grapple at a time.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 231.

name: Martial Arts Adept
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A trained monk who might guard a monastery, travel to learn another fighting style, or earn a living as a bodyguard.

sections.Traits: Unarmored Defense. Add the adept's Wisdom modifier to its AC while it wears no armor and uses no shield.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Unarmed Strikes or five Dart attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once per turn, the adept can add Knock Down or Push. Choose the effect or roll a d4, with Knock Down on 1–2 and Push on 3–4.
Knock Down. The target makes a DC 13 Dexterity save or falls prone.
Push. The target makes a DC 13 Strength save or is pushed up to 10 ft. directly away from the adept.
Dart. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Deflect Missile. When a ranged weapon attack hits the adept, reduce its damage by 1d10 + 3. If that reduces the damage to 0, the adept can catch the missile if it fits in one hand and a hand is free.
sections.Optional tattoo: Roll a d8 or choose a tattoo. 1, arm patterns like marble or granite. 2, bright dragon scales. 3, Elementals or Fey at play. 4, stars forming constellations on the palms. 5, an excerpt from a combat manual. 6, poisonous flowers. 7, a pair of metallic-ink couatls twisting together. 8, a detailed landscape.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 172.

name: Marut
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An inevitable created by Primus to enforce contracts registered at the Hall of Concordance in Sigil. The contract is engraved on a gold plate carried in the marut's chest.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immutable Form. The marut is immune to spells and effects that change its form.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the marut fails a save, it can spend one use to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The marut has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Unusual Nature. The marut needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Unerring Slam attacks.
Unerring Slam. Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft., one target. It hits automatically and deals 60 force damage. A Huge or smaller target is pushed up to 5 ft. away from the marut.
Blazing Edict (Recharge 5–6). Every creature in a 60-ft. cube originating from the marut's chest takes 45 radiant damage. Any creature that takes damage from the edict makes a DC 20 Wisdom save or is stunned until the end of the marut's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting: Plane Shift (3/day). Cast Plane Shift as an action using Intelligence, without material components. Use the spell as written or choose an unwilling creature the marut sees within 60 ft. That creature makes a DC 20 Charisma save. On a failure, it is sent to a teleportation circle in the Hall of Concordance in Sigil.
sections.Contract enforcement: The Kolyarut accepts enforceable contracts, records the agreed terms on a gold plate, and places it in the marut. The marut follows the written terms until the contract is fulfilled, including punishment for breaches. It uses lethal force only if the terms require it, the contract is completely broken, or someone attacks the marut.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 173.

name: Master Thief
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A practiced heist artist who might retire to lead a thieves' guild or fund a life of luxury.

sections.Languages: Any one language, usually Common, and thieves' cant.
sections.Traits: Evasion. When a Dexterity save normally halves damage, the thief takes no damage on a success and half on a failure. Evasion is unavailable while the thief is incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks using Shortsword or Shortbow.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack hits the thief and the thief can see the attacker, halve the attack's damage to the thief.
sections.Optional calling card: Roll a d10 or pick a calling card. 1, a tiny origami cat. 2, a red feather. 3, a rose petal. 4, a twig-and-twine figurine. 5, a handwritten farewell. 6, a glass eye bead. 7, pistachio shells. 8, two playing cards leaned together. 9, a bitten coin with no value. 10, a charcoal or chalk sketch of a domino mask.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 174.

name: Maurezhi
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon created by Doresain to lead ghouls and ghasts. It takes on a victim's appearance after consuming the body, and the disguise rots over time.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Assume Form. The maurezhi can look like any Medium Humanoid it eats. The disguise lasts 1d6 days and decays until it falls away.
Magic Resistance. The maurezhi has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage. A Humanoid hit also loses 1d4 Charisma until it finishes a short or long rest. If its Charisma reaches 0, it dies. Its corpse rises as a ghoul 24 hours later unless the victim was revived or its corpse destroyed.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit other than an Undead makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
Raise Ghoul (Recharge 5–6). Revive one dead ghoul or ghast the maurezhi can see within 30 ft. It returns with full hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 175.
sections.Feeding behavior: Consuming the corpse of a Humanoid it killed takes about 10 minutes.

name: Maw Demon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A demon drawn to gnoll war bands that worship Yeenoghu. It follows them into battle and eats whatever it can.

sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Disgorge (Recharge 6). The demon spews into a 15-ft. cube. Each creature in it makes a DC 11 Dexterity save. On a failure, it takes 11 (2d10) acid damage and falls prone.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 176.
sections.Stomach contents mechanics: When the demon finishes an 8-hour rest, everything it swallowed goes to Yeenoghu's gullet. Choose what remains in its stomach before then or roll a d8. 1, a wineskin containing wine. 2, an iron skillet. 3, scraps of a silk banner embroidered with a moon and stars. 4, a rusty gauntlet around a skeletal hand. 5, assorted keys. 6, an old leather boot. 7, a beehive. 8, Humanoid teeth.

name: Meazel
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A Shadowfell hermit that ambushes travelers with a garrote and drags them through the shadows. Other creatures can then sense the cursed victim.

sections.Actions:
Garrote. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target of the meazel's size or smaller. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target. Escape requires a DC 13 check with disadvantage. The victim takes 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the meazel's turns until the grapple ends. The meazel cannot make weapon attacks while it holds a creature this way.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). The meazel, its worn and carried gear, and any creature it grapples teleport up to 500 ft. Both ends must be in dim light or darkness. The meazel must have seen the destination before. It can choose a spot outside its current line of sight. If that space is occupied, the teleport ends in the nearest unoccupied space. Each other creature carried by the teleport is cursed for 1 hour. Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends the curse early. Until it ends, Undead and creatures native to the Shadowfell within 300 ft. of the cursed creature sense it, so it cannot hide from them.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Stealth. Take the Hide action while in dim light or darkness.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 177.

name: Meenlock
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Overwhelming fear can bring these crustacean-like fey into being. When several spawn together, a network of moss-lined tunnels may form nearby.

sections.Traits:
Fear Aura. A Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 10 ft. of the meenlock makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn.
Light Sensitivity. In bright light, the meenlock has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) slashing damage. The target must pass a DC 11 Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the paralysis on a success.
sections.Bonus actions: Shadow Teleport (Recharge 5–6). Teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 ft. Both the starting space and destination must be in dim light or darkness. The meenlock can teleport to a space it cannot see.
sections.Telepathic Torment mechanics:
Up to four meenlocks can torment one incapacitated creature with telepathy. They can move, act, and react normally, but cannot use telepathy for another purpose during the torment. A creature immune to being frightened is unaffected.
If the target remains incapacitated for 1 hour, it makes a Wisdom save. The DC is 10 plus the number of participating meenlocks that stayed within sight of the target and were never incapacitated during the hour. On a failure, the target takes 10 (3d6) psychic damage. On a success, it takes half damage. The meenlocks can repeat the process.
A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage immediately becomes a full-health meenlock under the DM's control. Wish or divine intervention can reverse the transformation.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 178.

name: Merregon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Faceless soldiers of the Nine Hells, merregons wear metal masks marked with the identity of their commander and the layer they serve.

sections.Languages: Understands Infernal but cannot speak, telepathy 120 ft.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The merregon's darkvision works in magical darkness.
Magic Resistance. The merregon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Halberd attacks.
Halberd. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage.
Heavy Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Reactions: Loyal Bodyguard. When an attack roll hits another Fiend within 5 ft. of the merregon, the merregon can take the hit in its place.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 179.

name: Merrenoloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: These grim ferrymasters navigate the River Styx and wield fiery oars against unwelcome boarders.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The merrenoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Oar attack and use Fear Gaze.
Oar. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) fire damage.
Fear Gaze. Choose one creature the merrenoloth can see within 60 ft. It must pass a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened of the merrenoloth for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 13). No material components are required.
At will. Charm Person, Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Gust of Wind.
3/day. Control Water.
sections.Bonus actions: Teleport. Teleport up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space the merrenoloth can see, taking any equipment it wears or carries.
sections.Lair actions:
While captaining a vessel, the merrenoloth can choose one option on initiative count 20, losing ties. It cannot use the same option in consecutive rounds. It must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish its first turn.
Gale. For one round, the air within 60 ft. of the vessel is difficult terrain. A Medium or smaller creature that flies into the area or starts its turn flying there must pass a DC 13 Strength save or fall prone. The gale ends on initiative count 20 of the next round.
Propel. Increase the vessel's speed by 30 ft. until initiative count 20 of the next round.
Repair. The vessel regains 22 (4d10) hit points.
sections.Regional effects:
Choose one or both effects for the vessel.
Unerring. The vessel stays on course for the destination the merrenoloth names.
Unsinkable. The vessel stays afloat even if its hull is breached.
The effects fade over 1d6 hours after the merrenoloth dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 180.

name: Mindwitness
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An elder brain can convert a stunned beholder in its brine pool into a mindwitness. The colony uses it to relay messages telepathically.

sections.Traits: Telepathic Hub. When the mindwitness receives a telepathic message, it can relay it to up to seven other creatures it can see within 600 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tentacles attack, or use Eye Ray three times.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 16 (4d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 20 (4d8 + 2) psychic damage. A Large or smaller creature is also grappled (escape DC 13) and must pass a DC 13 Intelligence save or be restrained until the grapple ends.
Eye Ray. Roll a d6 to choose a magical ray and reroll any result already used this turn. Choose one target the mindwitness can see within 120 ft.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 181.
sections.Eye Ray outcomes mechanics:
Aversion Ray (1). On a failed DC 13 Charisma save, the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Fear Ray (2). On a failed DC 13 Wisdom save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the fear on a success.
Psychic Ray (3). The target takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage on a failed DC 13 Intelligence save.
Slowing Ray (4). On a failed DC 13 Dexterity save, the creature's speed is halved for 1 minute. During that time, it cannot take reactions and can take at most one action or one bonus action on each turn. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Stunning Ray (5). On a failed DC 13 Constitution save, the creature is stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
Telekinetic Ray (6). On a failed DC 13 Strength save, move a creature up to 30 ft. in any direction and restrain it until the start of the mindwitness's next turn or until the mindwitness is incapacitated. An unworn and uncarried object of up to 300 lb. can be moved up to 30 ft. in any direction. The ray can also manipulate an object precisely, such as opening a door or using a simple tool.

name: Moloch
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The former ruler of Malbolge seeks a way to reclaim his title.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, Moloch can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. Moloch has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Regeneration. Moloch regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage prevents this healing at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, and one Many-Tailed Whip attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 26 (4d8 + 8) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) force damage.
Many-Tailed Whip. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d4 + 8) lightning damage plus 11 (2d10) thunder damage. On a failed DC 24 Strength save, a creature is pulled up to 30 ft. straight toward Moloch.
Breath of Despair (Recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 30-ft. cube must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or take 27 (5d10) psychic damage, drop whatever it is holding, and become frightened of Moloch for 1 minute. On each of its turns while frightened in this way, it must Dash and move away from Moloch by the safest route available. If it has nowhere to move, it can skip the Dash. At the end of its turn, it can repeat the save if it has no line of sight to Moloch, ending the fear on a success.
Teleport. Teleport up to 120 ft. to an unoccupied space Moloch can see, taking any equipment he wears or carries.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components are required.
At will. Alter Self (Moloch can become Medium when changing his appearance), Confusion, Detect Magic, Fly, Major Image, Stinking Cloud, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
sections.Legendary actions:
Moloch has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost to use one option at the end of another creature's turn. He regains spent actions at the start of his turn. He must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish his first turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Bite, Claw, or Many-Tailed Whip attack.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 183.
sections.Nine Hells transformation mechanics: When he enters the Nine Hells, he becomes an imp and cannot recover his usual powers until he leaves.

name: Molydeus
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This demon speaks for its lord. Its master can see and speak through its serpent head, and the weapon its master grants it dissolves when the molydeus dies.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, poisoned, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). After failing a save, the molydeus can choose to succeed instead.
Magic Resistance. The molydeus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Demonic Weapon, one Snakebite, and one Wolf Bite attack.
Demonic Weapon. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 35 (4d12 + 9) force damage. On a natural 20 against a target with a head, the attack removes one head, killing the target if it cannot survive without it. On that natural 20, if the headed target takes none of the damage, has legendary actions, or is Huge or larger, it instead takes an extra 27 (6d8) force damage.
Snakebite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one creature. A hit deals 16 (2d6 + 9) poison damage. On a failed DC 22 Constitution save, the target's hit point maximum decreases by the damage taken until it finishes a long rest. If the reduction takes its maximum to 0, it becomes a manes. Only Wish can reverse this transformation.
Wolf Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (3d10 + 9) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 22). No material components are required.
At will. Dispel Magic, Polymorph, Telekinesis, Teleport.
3/day. Lightning Bolt.
sections.Legendary actions:
The molydeus has 3 legendary actions. Spend the listed cost to use one option at the end of another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It must be able to act and, if surprised, must first finish its first turn.
Attack (1 action). Make one Demonic Weapon or Snakebite attack.
Move (1 action). Move without provoking opportunity attacks.
Cast a Spell (2 actions). Use Spellcasting.
sections.Demon summoning mechanics: Summon Demon (1/day, optional). As an action, choose 1d6 babaus, 1d4 chasmes, or one marilith. The attempt has a 50% chance to succeed. Each summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 ft. and acts as the molydeus's ally. It cannot summon other demons. It stays for 1 minute or until it dies, the molydeus dies, or the molydeus dismisses it as an action.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 184.

name: Morkoth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A morkoth collects treasures, secrets, and captives on an island that drifts between the planes. Its prized possessions are kept in the island’s central sanctum.

sections.Traits: Amphibious. The morkoth can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks and one Tentacles attack, or make three Bite attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature is grappled (escape DC 14) and restrained until the grapple ends. It takes 15 (3d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of its turns. The morkoth cannot use Tentacles against another target while it holds this creature.
Hypnosis. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone of magical energy makes a DC 17 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is charmed by the morkoth for 1 minute and must try to get as close to the morkoth as possible, using its actions to Dash until within 5 ft. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns and whenever it takes damage, ending the charm on a success. When a creature succeeds on a save or the effect ends for it, it has advantage on saves against this morkoth's Hypnosis for 24 hours.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 17). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Hand.
3/day each. Darkness, Dimension Door, Dispel Magic, Lightning Bolt, Sending.
sections.Reactions: Spell Reflection. When the morkoth succeeds on a save against a spell or a spell attack misses it, choose a different creature the morkoth can see within 120 ft. The chosen creature becomes the target in its place and can be the caster. That creature makes its own save, or the spell's attack roll is rerolled against it, as appropriate.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, the morkoth can choose one option while in its lair and able to act. If surprised, it must first finish its first turn. Its lair profile is CR 12 (8,400 XP).
Cast a Spell. Cast Darkness, Dispel Magic, or Misty Step using Intelligence without spending a spell slot.
Hypnotize. Use Hypnosis from a point within 120 ft. of the morkoth. It can use a point it cannot see.
sections.Regional effects:
The effects below end immediately if the morkoth dies.
Alter Water. With no action, the morkoth can change the water in its lair. One minute later, it becomes clear and breathable like air or returns to normal water of any clarity.
Locate Creatures and Objects. The morkoth notices new creatures and objects on the island or in its sanctum. As an action, it can locate one creature or object on the island. Visitors feel watched.
Lost Possessions. A creature that has been on the island for under a year must make a DC 10 Intelligence save after each short or long rest. On a failure, it misplaces a possession. A player chooses what their character loses. A DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check can recover the concealed item nearby. After 1 hour, any unrecovered item reaches the lair, where its owner easily recognizes it.
Supernatural Lure. While in its lair and not incapacitated, the morkoth can switch the lure at its entrances on or off at any time. A creature within 30 ft. of an enchanted entrance that can see it must make a DC 15 Wisdom save. On a failure, it must use its movement each turn to enter and head straight toward the morkoth without realizing that it is approaching a creature. It can repeat the save when it first sees the morkoth, at the end of each of its turns, and whenever it takes damage. A success ends the effect.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 186.

name: Mouth of Grolantor
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
classification: Huge giant (hill giant), typically chaotic evil
description: Hill giant worshipers starve a sick giant they take to embody Grolantor’s hunger. They keep it chained until battle or a raid.

sections.Traits: Mouth of Chaos. The giant is immune to the Confusion spell. Each turn, it uses all its movement to approach the nearest creature or anything else it mistakes for food. Roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its action.
sections.Mouth of Chaos mechanics:
Roll 1–3. Make three Fist attacks against one random creature within reach. With no creature in reach, gain advantage on all attack rolls until the end of the giant’s next turn.
Roll 4–5. Make one Fist attack against every creature within reach. With no creature in reach, make one Fist attack against itself.
Roll 6–7. Make one Bite attack against a random creature in reach. With no other creature in reach, the giant is stunned until the start of its next turn.
Roll 8–10. Make one Bite and two Fist attacks against one random creature within reach. With no creature in reach, gain advantage on all attack rolls until the end of the giant’s next turn.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 15 (3d6 + 5) piercing damage. The giant magically regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 187.

name: Nabassu
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A soul-eating demon that preys on other demons and looks for a chance to turn on its summoner.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Demonic Shadows. The area within 10 ft. of the nabassu is dim light that nonmagical light cannot brighten.
Devour Soul. The nabassu can consume the soul of a creature it killed in the past hour, excluding Constructs and Undead. It spends at least 10 minutes within 5 ft. of the corpse, then gains d8 Hit Dice equal to half the slain creature’s Hit Dice. Roll the new dice and add their total to the nabassu’s hit points. Each four Hit Dice gained add 3 (1d6) damage to its attacks on a hit. The added dice, hit points, and damage last 6 days. Only Wish can bring the victim back to life.
Magic Resistance. The nabassu has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack, and use Soul-Stealing Gaze.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 38 (5d12 + 6) necrotic damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (4d10 + 6) force damage.
Soul-Stealing Gaze. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft., excluding Constructs and Undead. It makes a DC 16 Charisma save. On a failure, it takes 13 (2d12) necrotic damage. Lower its hit point maximum by the damage it took and restore half that amount to the nabassu. The reduction lasts until a short or long rest. The target dies if its maximum reaches 0. A Humanoid killed this way immediately rises as a ghoul controlled by the nabassu.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 188.

name: Nagpa
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The Raven Queen cursed thirteen wizards to learn new magic only from ruins and calamities. They now plot disasters and plunder what survives.

sections.Languages: Common plus up to five other languages.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Staff and Deathly Ray. Spellcasting can replace one of the three attacks.
Staff. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 24 (7d6) necrotic damage.
Deathly Ray. Ranged spell attack, +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 30 (7d6 + 6) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 20).
At will. Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Message, Minor Illusion.
2/day each. Fireball, Fly, Hold Person, Suggestion, Wall of Fire.
1/day each. Dominate Person, Etherealness, Feeblemind.
sections.Bonus actions:
Corruption. Choose one visible creature within 90 ft. It makes a DC 20 Charisma save, at disadvantage if it is evil. On a failure, the nagpa charms it until the start of the nagpa’s next turn. A success grants immunity to this nagpa’s Corruption for 24 hours.
Paralysis (Recharge 6). All creatures within 30 ft. except Constructs and Undead make a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, a target is paralyzed for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 189.

name: Narzugon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Devils recruit fallen paladins as mounted knights. A narzugon serves an archduke of the Nine Hells and rides a nightmare summoned by infernal spurs.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid and cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Infernal Tack. As an action, the narzugon can use the spurs from its Infernal Tack to summon its nightmare companion.
Magic Resistance. The narzugon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Hellfire Lance attacks and use either Infernal Command or Terrifying Command.
Hellfire Lance. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (1d12 + 5) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) fire damage. If it kills a creature with a soul, that soul rises from the River Styx as a lemure in Avernus in 1d4 hours. Once the lemure rises, restoring the victim to life requires Wish, or killing the lemure and casting True Resurrection on the victim’s original body. Constructs and devils are immune to the soul effect.
Infernal Command. Allies within 60 ft. cannot be charmed or frightened until the end of the narzugon’s next turn.
Terrifying Command. Every non-Fiend creature within 60 ft. makes a DC 17 Charisma save. On a failure, it is frightened of the narzugon for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A success grants immunity to this narzugon’s Terrifying Command for 24 hours.
Healing (1/day). The narzugon or one creature it touches regains 100 hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 190.

name: Necromancer Wizard
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Necromancers study life, death, and undeath. Some raise servants from corpses, while others hunt the undead.

sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Arcane Burst attacks.
Arcane Burst. Melee or ranged spell attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 25 (4d10 + 3) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 15).
At will. Dancing Lights, Mage Hand, Prestidigitation.
2/day each. Bestow Curse, Dimension Door, Mage Armor, Web.
1/day. Circle of Death.
sections.Bonus actions: Summon Undead (1/day). Magically summon five skeletons or five zombies in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft. They obey the necromancer and take their turns immediately after it. Each remains for up to 1 hour, until it or the necromancer dies, or until the necromancer dismisses it as a bonus action.
sections.Reactions: Grim Harvest (1/turn). When the necromancer kills a creature with necrotic damage, it regains 9 (2d8) hit points.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 264.

name: Neogi
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Neogi judge rank by how much control one creature has over another. They mark themselves and captives to show whom they serve.

sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The neogi has advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened and cannot be put to sleep by magic.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and traverse ceilings upside down without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or becomes poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Enslave (recharges after a short or long rest). Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Wisdom save. On a failure, the neogi magically charms it for 1 day. The effect ends earlier if the neogi dies or is more than 1 mile from the target. The target obeys the neogi, cannot take reactions, and can communicate telepathically with it within 1 mile. The target can repeat the save whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 192.

name: Neogi Hatchling
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: Neogi hatchlings compete with their siblings for survival. Adult neogi control the survivors and train them to dominate umber hulks.

sections.Traits:
Mental Fortitude. The hatchling has advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened and cannot be put to sleep by magic.
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces and traverse ceilings upside down without an ability check.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 10 Constitution save or becomes poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 191.

name: Neogi Master
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A neogi whose magic comes from pacts with aberrant beings that resemble stars.

sections.Languages: Common, Deep Speech, Undercommon, telepathy 30 ft.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. Magical darkness does not limit the neogi's darkvision.
Mental Fortitude. The neogi has advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened. Magic cannot put it to sleep.
Spider Climb. The neogi can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack, or make two Tentacle of Hadar attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage. The target makes a DC 12 Constitution save or is poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.
Tentacle of Hadar. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) necrotic damage. The target cannot take reactions until the end of the neogi's next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 14).
At will. Guidance, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation.
1/day each. Dimension Door, Hold Person, Hunger of Hadar.
sections.Bonus actions: Enslave (recharges after a short or long rest). Choose a creature the neogi can see within 30 ft. It makes a DC 14 Wisdom save or becomes magically charmed by the neogi for 1 day. The charm ends early if the neogi dies or the two are more than 1 mile apart. While charmed, the target obeys the neogi, cannot take reactions, and can communicate telepathically with it from up to 1 mile away. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat the save, ending the charm on a success.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 192.

name: Neothelid
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A giant worm that can grow from the last surviving tadpole in an abandoned mind flayer colony. It hunts by sensing nearby minds.

sections.Traits:
Creature Sense. The neothelid senses creatures with Intelligence 4 or higher within 1 mile. It knows their direction, distance, and Intelligence scores. Mind Blank, Nondetection, or similar magic blocks this sense.
Magic Resistance. The neothelid has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) psychic damage. A Large or smaller creature must also pass a DC 18 Strength save or be swallowed. The swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the neothelid, and takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the neothelid's turns.
If a creature inside the neothelid deals at least 30 damage to it in one turn, the neothelid makes a DC 18 Constitution save at the end of that turn. On a failure it regurgitates every swallowed creature, and each falls prone within 10 ft. of it. If the neothelid dies, its restraint on swallowed creatures ends. Each can spend 20 ft. of movement to leave the corpse and exits prone.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 35 (10d6) acid damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell without components, using Wisdom (spell save DC 16).
At will. Levitate.
1/day each. Confusion, Feeblemind, Telekinesis.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 193.

name: Nightwalker
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A creature from the Negative Plane that destroys living things. On the Material Plane, it seeks out places and people tied to the creature it replaced.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder. It also resists bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Annihilating Aura. Each creature that starts its turn within 30 ft. makes a DC 21 Constitution save or takes 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. Undead are immune.
Life Eater. A creature that the nightwalker reduces to 0 hit points dies. Only Wish can revive it.
Unusual Nature. The nightwalker needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Enervating Focus attacks. Replace one with Finger of Doom if available.
Enervating Focus. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 28 (5d8 + 6) necrotic damage. The target makes a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure its hit point maximum drops by the necrotic damage taken until it finishes a long rest. If its maximum reaches 0, it dies.
Finger of Doom (recharge 6). Choose one creature the nightwalker can see within 300 ft. The target makes a DC 21 Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 39 (6d12) necrotic damage and is frightened until the end of the nightwalker's next turn. It is paralyzed while frightened this way. A successful save makes the target immune to this nightwalker's Finger of Doom for 24 hours.
sections.Negative Plane crossing mechanics: A creature that survives entering the Negative Plane is trapped there as a nightwalker emerges in its place. To escape, it needs the nightwalker lured back with living prey. If the nightwalker is destroyed, the trapped creature cannot escape.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 194.

name: Nilbog
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A fragment of a goblin trickster god that takes goblin hosts. Fey courts sometimes indulge a goblin jester to keep the spirit from appearing.

sections.Traits: Nilbogism. Before trying to damage the nilbog, a creature makes a DC 12 Charisma save. On a failure, it is charmed until the end of its next turn and must use its action to praise the nilbog. The nilbog can regain hit points only by using Reversal of Fortune.
sections.Actions:
Fool's Scepter. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Mocking Word. Choose a creature the nilbog can see within 60 ft. It makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or takes 5 (2d4) psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 12).
At will. Mage Hand, Tasha's Hideous Laughter.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Take the Disengage or Hide action.
sections.Reactions: Reversal of Fortune. When another creature deals damage to the nilbog, reduce that damage to 0 and regain 3 (1d6) hit points.
sections.Nilbog possession mechanics: Without a host, the spirit is invisible, flies 30 ft., cannot be attacked, and is immune to all damage and conditions. On initiative count 20, losing ties, it can only try to possess a goblin within 5 ft. The goblin makes a DC 15 Charisma save. On a failure it is possessed and uses the nilbog stat block. On a success, the spirit cannot possess that goblin for 24 hours. If the host dies or a spell such as Hallow, Magic Circle, or Protection from Evil and Good ends the possession, the spirit seeks another goblin. It can leave voluntarily at any time but does so only if another potential host is nearby. A freed goblin returns to its usual statistics and loses the traits granted by the spirit.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 195.

name: Nupperibo
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A low-ranking devil surrounded by hungry vermin. Nupperibos obey telepathic orders from other devils and grow more dangerous in packs.

sections.Traits:
Cloud of Vermin. A creature other than a devil that starts its turn within 20 ft. of one or more nupperibos makes a DC 11 Constitution save or takes 5 (2d4) acid damage. If the creature is in at least two of these areas, it makes the save with disadvantage.
Driven Tracker. In the Nine Hells, the nupperibo can track without error any creature damaged by any nupperibo's Cloud of Vermin in the past 24 hours.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 196.

name: Oblex Spawn
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A young ooze that forms when a mature oblex sheds a stolen personality. It grows by feeding on memories and cannot yet impersonate its victims.

sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The oblex can pass through a gap 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Aversion to Fire. After taking fire damage, the oblex has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.
Unusual Nature. The oblex does not need sleep.
sections.Actions: Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 197.

name: Ogre Battering Ram
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A siege ogre drilled to smash fortifications with a heavy club and halt enemies that come within reach.

sections.Traits: Siege Monster. The ogre deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bash attacks.
Bash. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d10 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The ogre can push a Huge or smaller target 5 ft. away.
sections.Reactions: Block the Path. When a creature enters a space within 5 ft. of the ogre, make one Bash attack against it. On a hit, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the start of the ogre's next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 200.

name: Ogre Bolt Launcher
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This ogre carries a ballista-sized crossbow. When it runs out of bolts, it can use small trees or beams torn from buildings as ammunition.

sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Bolt Launcher. Ranged weapon attack, +3 to hit, range 120/480 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (3d10 + 1) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 200.

name: Ogre Chain Brute
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This ogre wields a spiked chain with both hands, swinging it low to knock enemies down or bringing it down overhead.

sections.Actions:
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
Chain Smash (Recharge 6). Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. The target must pass a DC 14 Constitution save or be stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save whenever it takes damage and at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Chain Sweep. Every creature within 10 ft. of the ogre makes a DC 14 Dexterity save. A creature that fails takes 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and falls prone. A creature that succeeds takes half damage and stays upright.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 201.

name: Ogre Howdah
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: This ogre carries a wooden fighting platform on its back. Goblins with bows or spears often ride in it.

sections.Traits: Howdah. Up to four Small creatures can ride in the ogre's fort without squeezing. Riders need a spear or a reach weapon to make melee attacks against a target within 5 ft. of the ogre. Riders have three-quarters cover against attacks and effects originating outside the fort. If the ogre dies, place the riders in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of it.
sections.Actions: Mace. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 201.

name: Oinoloth
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An army may hire this yugoloth to break a siege by spreading plague. The oinoloth can remove disease too, at lasting cost to the patient.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold, fire, lightning, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The oinoloth has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and use either Spellcasting or Teleport.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 22 (4d10) necrotic damage.
Corrupted Healing (Recharge 6). Touch one willing creature within 5 ft. It regains all its hit points. The oinoloth can also end one disease or remove one condition from the target. The eligible conditions are blinded, deafened, paralyzed, and poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion and loses 7 (2d6) from its hit point maximum. It dies if its maximum drops to 0. Only Wish or three castings of Greater Restoration on the target within the same hour can remove this reduction.
Teleport. Teleport up to 60 ft. to a visible, unoccupied space, taking any worn or carried equipment along.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (save DC 16). No material components are required.
At will. Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Hold Monster, Invisibility (self only).
1/day each. Feeblemind, Globe of Invulnerability.
sections.Bonus actions:
Bringer of Plagues (Recharge 5–6). Blight a 30-ft.-radius sphere centered on the oinoloth for 24 hours. Normal plants in the area wither and die.
A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there makes a DC 16 Constitution save. On a failure, it takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned. On a success, it gains immunity to this oinoloth's Bringer of Plagues for 24 hours.
A creature poisoned this way cannot regain hit points. Every 24 hours, it can repeat the save. Each failure reduces its hit point maximum by 5 (1d10) until the poison ends. The creature dies if its maximum drops to 0. Three successful saves end the poison.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 202.

name: Orcus
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The Demon Prince of Undeath rules Thanatos from the fortress city of Naratyr. He wants to extinguish all life and rule the Undead that remain.

sections.Armor: Natural armor. AC 20 while holding the Wand of Orcus.
sections.Damage immunities: Necrotic and poison. Nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When Orcus fails a save, he can spend a use to succeed.
Magic Resistance. Orcus has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
Master of Undeath. Orcus can cast Animate Dead at will and Create Undead three times per day. He chooses the level for each casting. The resulting Undead obey him indefinitely. He can cast Create Undead at any time of day.
Special Equipment. Orcus carries the Wand of Orcus.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks in any combination of Wand of Orcus, Tail, or Necrotic Bolt.
Wand of Orcus. Melee weapon attack, +19 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 24 (3d8 + 11) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) necrotic damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 21 (3d8 + 8) force damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.
Necrotic Bolt. Ranged spell attack, +15 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. A hit deals 29 (5d8 + 7) necrotic damage.
Conjure Undead (1/day). While holding the Wand of Orcus, summon any combination of Undead with a total of up to 500 average hit points. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 300 ft. and obey Orcus until destroyed or dismissed by him as an action.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (save DC 23). No material components are required.
At will. Detect Magic.
3/day. Dispel Magic.
1/day. Time Stop.
Wand Spellcasting. While holding the Wand of Orcus, use an action to cast a listed spell (save DC 18). The wand holds up to 7 charges and regains 1d4 + 3 charges each dawn.
At will from the wand. Animate Dead, Blight, Speak with Dead.
1 charge each. Circle of Death or Finger of Death.
2 charges. Power Word Kill.
sections.Legendary actions:
Orcus has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of his turn. Spend the stated cost on one option immediately after another creature's turn. He cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Attack (1 action). Make one Tail or Necrotic Bolt attack.
Creeping Death (2 actions). Choose a point on the ground that Orcus can see within 100 ft. A cylinder 60 ft. high and 10 ft. in radius rises from that point until the end of his next turn. Creatures inside have vulnerability to necrotic damage.
sections.Lair actions:
At initiative count 20, after any creature tied at that count, Orcus can use one option while in his lair and able to act. He cannot repeat the same option two rounds in a row. If surprised, he must finish his first turn before using one.
Deadly Utterance. Subject one creature Orcus knows is in his lair to Power Word Kill. He can target a creature he cannot see.
Grasp of the Dead. Conjure skeletal arms in a visible 20-ft. square of ground until the next initiative count 20. Each creature in the square when the arms appear makes a DC 23 Strength save. On a failure, it is restrained until the arms vanish or Orcus releases it, which requires no action.
Undead Servants. Animate up to six corpses in the lair as skeletons, zombies, or ghouls. They obey Orcus's telepathic commands anywhere in the lair.
sections.Regional effects:
One or both effects can occur in the region around the lair.
Charnel Realm. The region smells of rotting flesh and fills with swarms of flies.
Undead Beasts. Some dead Beasts rise as skeletons or zombies. Undead versions of local wildlife are common.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Orcus dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 204.

name: Orthon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An infernal bounty hunter that tracks quarry across the planes. An orthon between assignments may work for anyone who offers it a difficult hunt.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks made without silvered weapons.
sections.Traits: Magic Resistance. The orthon has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Infernal Dagger. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 11 (2d4 + 6) force damage. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failure, it is also poisoned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.
Brass Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. A hit deals 14 (2d10 + 3) force damage and applies one of the rider effects below. The orthon cannot choose the same effect two rounds in a row.
Acid. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution save, taking an extra 17 (5d6) acid damage on a failure or half on a success.
Blindness. The target takes 5 (1d10) extra radiant damage. The target and every other creature within 20 ft. of it must pass a DC 17 Dexterity save or be blinded until the end of the orthon's next turn.
Concussion. The target and every other creature within 20 ft. of it must make a DC 17 Constitution save, taking 13 (2d12) thunder damage on a failure or half on a success.
Entanglement. The target makes a DC 17 Dexterity save or is restrained by sticky webs for 1 hour. It can use an action to make a DC 17 Strength or Dexterity check, escaping on a success.
Paralysis. The target takes 22 (4d10) lightning damage and makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On a failure, it is paralyzed for 1 minute and can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the condition.
Tracking. For 24 hours, the orthon knows the target's direction and distance while they share a plane. If the target is on another plane, the orthon knows which plane it is on without learning its exact location.
sections.Bonus actions: Invisibility Field (Recharge 4–6). The orthon becomes invisible. Its gear remains invisible while it wears or carries it. The effect ends immediately after it makes an attack roll or an attack roll hits it.
sections.Reactions: Explosive Retribution. When the orthon drops to 15 hit points or fewer, it explodes. Every other creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 17 Dexterity save, taking 9 (2d8) fire damage plus 9 (2d8) thunder damage on a failure or half on a success. The explosion destroys the orthon, its infernal dagger, and its brass crossbow.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 205.

name: Phoenix
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: An elder fire elemental shaped like a vast bird. When freed from the Inner Planes, it travels from place to place setting fires.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Fiery Death and Rebirth. When the phoenix dies, each creature in a 60-ft.-radius sphere centered on it makes a DC 20 Dexterity save, taking 22 (4d10) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The blast ignites flammable objects that no one is wearing or carrying and destroys the phoenix's body.
The blast leaves a 5-pound, egg-shaped cinder immune to all damage. A creature that touches it takes 21 (6d6) fire damage at most once per round. A new phoenix hatches after 1d6 days.
Fire Form. Move through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The phoenix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage. The phoenix can also ignite flammable objects it touches if they are unworn and uncarried. This takes no action.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy's reach provokes no opportunity attacks.
Illumination. Shed bright light in a 60-ft. radius and dim light for another 30 ft.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the phoenix fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed.
Siege Monster. Deal double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak attack and one Fiery Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 15 (2d6 + 8) fire damage.
Fiery Talons. Melee weapon attack, +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d8 + 8) fire damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
The phoenix has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Spend the stated cost on one option immediately after another creature's turn. It cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed.
Peck (1 action). Make one Beak attack.
Swoop (2 actions). Move up to its speed and make one Fiery Talons attack.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 206.

name: Quickling
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: The Queen of Air and Darkness cursed these tiny Fey with a pace the rest of the world can barely follow. A quickling lives at most fifteen years and often uses its speed to make others take the blame for its pranks.

sections.Traits:
Blurred Movement. The quickling imposes disadvantage on attack rolls against it. Attacks lose that disadvantage if the quickling is incapacitated or its speed is 0.
Evasion. While not incapacitated, the quickling takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save against an effect that normally deals half damage on a success. It takes half damage on a failed save against that effect.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Dagger attacks.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d4 + 6) piercing damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 207.

name: Red Abishai
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A commander among Tiamat's devils, a red abishai leads troops in the Nine Hells or takes control of a cult that has strayed from her orders.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The abishai sees through magical darkness out to the range of its darkvision.
Magic Resistance. The abishai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Claw attack. The abishai can also use either Frightful Presence or Incite Fanaticism.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 38 (7d10) fire damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 17 (2d10 + 6) force damage plus 11 (2d10) fire damage.
Frightful Presence. The abishai chooses creatures within 120 ft. that are aware of it. Each makes a DC 18 Wisdom save. On a failure it is frightened of the abishai for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds or recovers gains immunity to this abishai's Frightful Presence for 24 hours.
Incite Fanaticism. Choose up to four other creatures within 60 ft. that can see the abishai. Until the start of its next turn, each has advantage on attack rolls and is immune to the frightened condition.
Power of the Dragon Queen. Choose one Dragon the abishai can see within 120 ft. The Dragon makes a DC 18 Charisma save with disadvantage if it is chromatic. A success grants immunity to this ability from this abishai for 1 hour. On a failure the Dragon is charmed by the abishai for 1 hour and treats it as a trusted friend to heed and protect. Damage from the abishai or one of its companions ends the charm.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 40.

name: Redcap
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
description: A redcap can sprout where a sentient creature kills out of bloodlust in the Feywild or near a fey crossing. The bloodstained cap appears first, then the creature rises in moonlight.

sections.Traits:
Iron Boots. The redcap has disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Outsize Strength. Treat the redcap as Medium when it grapples. It can attack with heavy weapons without the disadvantage normally imposed by their weight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Wicked Sickle attacks.
Wicked Sickle. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage.
